requirement: Pager scroll debug HUD environment and flood ignored PTY check
contract: The ignored env-on HUD test SHALL spawn bottom-pinned 120-row marker scrollback with `GROW_SCROLL_DEBUG=1` and forced trackpad mode. Before scrolling, the screen must contain `scroll debug` and `mode:trackpad`. A 30-report upward burst at eight-millisecond spacing, a settle, and one repaint notch must leave pager live without panicked, show `last:trackpad`, and reduce the topmost visible marker index. It proves a visible runtime overlay and observed upward travel, but not every report's classification, exact travel, flush cadence, overlay geometry or absence of rendering interference beyond the marker comparison.
scenarios: Initial HUD
debug and trackpad env overrides are active
the HUD title and forced mode echo are visible.
Finalized breadcrumb
the flood settles and a repaint notch follows
last:trackpad appears.
Observer travel
the flood is delivered with the HUD on
the visible marker index moves upward.
Granularity
the final screen assertions pass
per-report classification and frame timing remain unobserved.

requirement: Pager scroll debug HUD default-off ignored PTY check
contract: The ignored default-off HUD test SHALL spawn the same bottom-pinned marker scrollback without the debug environment override and require the current screen not to contain `scroll debug`, then cleanly quit. It does not send scroll input, sample a stable negative window, check other HUD strings or distinguish hidden overlay state from absence of its title text.
scenarios: Default
marker scrollback starts without GROW_SCROLL_DEBUG
the current screen lacks the HUD title.
Later frames
a delayed frame would reveal the HUD
the test has already completed its single negative assertion.

requirement: Pager scroll debug command live toggle ignored PTY check
contract: The ignored command-toggle test SHALL begin without the HUD title, send Space after a helper that leaves scrollback focused, then submit `/debug scroll` and require the title within five seconds. Submitting the same command again and waiting 500 milliseconds must remove the title while pager remains live without panicked. It does not inspect the runtime flag, persist or reload the setting, verify all HUD cells clear, exercise malformed arguments, or require an acknowledgement separate from title visibility.
scenarios: Enable
the first /debug scroll command is submitted
the HUD title appears.
Disable
the command is submitted again
the HUD title is absent after the repaint delay.
Liveness
the round trip completes
pager remains running without panicked.
State
title visibility changes
the internal flag and persistence are not inspected.

requirement: Pager repeated double-click word-select tip acceptance ignored PTY check
contract: The Unix-only ignored word-select tip test SHALL seed flash selection mode with contextual hints enabled, settle selectable body text and confirm scrollback focus. The first synthetic double-click must leave the tip title absent after 600 milliseconds; a second gesture must show the tip plus either settings-path text and the Ctrl+Y chord. Ctrl+Y must show the word_select confirmation and an asynchronously polled config.toml must contain the exact assignment. A later double-click must leave the tip title absent and pager must avoid panicked. It does not assert the word was selected or copied, parse TOML structurally, verify one config key, use a real pointer, or prove the first negative over the full repeat window.
scenarios: First gesture
one synthetic double-click lands mid-token
the tip title is absent after 600 milliseconds.
Repeated gesture
the second gesture lands within the test's timing
the tip advertises settings and Ctrl+Y.
Accept
Ctrl+Y is pressed while the tip is visible
a confirmation appears and config text eventually contains word_select.
Post-accept
another double-click is sent
the tip stays absent, without proving selection output.

requirement: Pager word-select mode suppresses selection tip ignored PTY check
contract: The Unix-only ignored mode-gate test SHALL seed `keep_text_selection = word_select`, settle body text, confirm scrollback focus, send two synthetic double-click gestures separated by 600 milliseconds, and after another 800 milliseconds require the tip title absent and no panicked marker. It does not inspect selected cells, clipboard output or config after startup, and a missing tip alone does not prove word selection occurred.
scenarios: Mode gate
two qualifying gestures occur while word_select is seeded
the tip title remains absent.
Selection behavior
the title remains absent
the test does not observe a selected word or clipboard payload.

requirement: Pager word-select contextual hint opt-out ignored PTY check
contract: The Unix-only ignored opt-out test SHALL write flash mode with `[ui.contextual_hints].word_select = false`, explicitly blank inherited `GROW_CONTEXTUAL_HINTS`, settle body text, confirm scrollback focus, and send two synthetic double-click gestures with the same 600/800-millisecond timing. The tip title must remain absent. It does not inspect parsed configuration, prove the environment master was otherwise unset, check selection output, assert pager liveness or scan for panicked.
scenarios: Per-tip opt-out
two qualifying gestures occur with the word_select hint disabled
the tip title remains absent.
Environment
the pager is spawned
the inherited master override is replaced by an empty value.
Liveness
the negative assertion passes
this test does not separately poll the process or scan for panic text.

requirement: Pager viewer monotonic turn anchor from wall-clock timestamp
contract: The viewer turn-anchor helper SHALL sample the current monotonic instant, return it when the shell timestamp is absent or not earlier than the current UTC millisecond time, and otherwise subtract the saturating wall-clock delta. If checked monotonic subtraction cannot represent that delta, it falls back to the sampled current instant. The conversion does not preserve an absolute timestamp, compensate for wall-clock changes between shell and pager, or report invalid and out-of-range inputs.
scenarios: No timestamp
turn_start_ms is absent
the sampled current Instant is returned.
Past timestamp
UTC now is later than the supplied milliseconds and subtraction is representable
the Instant is back-dated by that delta.
Future timestamp
the supplied time is current or future
the sampled current Instant is returned.
Unrepresentable delta
checked_sub fails
the sampled current Instant is returned without an error.

requirement: Pager subagent mutable activity projection and waiting label
contract: The subagent activity helpers SHALL mutate only the matching `subagent_sessions` entity projection and leave immutable lifecycle rows untouched. A child view's resolved turn activity is formatted through the shared subagent label formatter; when no activity resolves but the child session is busy, the display label is `Waiting`, and an idle child with no activity has no label. An unknown child key is a silent no-op.
scenarios: Known child
sync receives a child_key present in subagent_sessions
its activity_label is replaced by the supplied optional value.
Unknown child
the child_key is absent
no state changes and no error is returned.
Resolved activity
the child view resolves current turn activity
the shared formatted activity label is returned.
Busy without activity
the child has no resolved activity and its state is busy
Waiting is returned; otherwise the label is absent.

requirement: Pager orphaned subagent synthetic terminal projection
contract: The killed-subagent finalizer SHALL operate only when the supplied session resolves to a root agent and an unfinished child record matches the supplied subagent id. It serializes and re-enters the canonical `grow/session/update` handler with `SubagentFinished`, preserving the child session id and supplied terminal status while setting error and output absent and tool calls, turns, duration and tokens to zero. Missing roots, missing agents, already-finished or unknown children, serialization failure, or downstream rejection return false. The synthetic record does not recover the original failure, output, counters or runtime.
scenarios: Eligible orphan
a root owns an unfinished matching subagent
a canonical SubagentFinished notification is synthesized and dispatched.
Synthetic fields
the terminal update is built
status and child identity are preserved while unavailable detail is empty or zero.
Idempotence
the matching child is already finished
the helper returns false without another update.
Invalid owner
the session is missing or resolves to a child
the helper returns false.

requirement: Pager MCP initialization progress owner update
contract: The MCP initialization progress handler SHALL require a camelCase payload containing unsigned total, connected and sessionId fields. A successfully resolved MCP target has its session progress updated and the handler returns whether that target is active; malformed or unresolved payloads return false. This function does not itself validate connected against total, distinguish a no-op update from a mutation, log rejected payloads or schedule a catalog fetch.
scenarios: Routed progress
the payload parses and mcp_target_agent resolves an owner
that session receives total and connected and active status is returned.
Malformed payload
a required field is absent or has the wrong type
the handler returns false.
Unknown session
target resolution fails
no progress is updated and false is returned.
Range relationship
connected exceeds total
this handler performs no explicit rejection.

requirement: Pager MCP initialization completion root-only clearing
contract: The MCP initialized handler SHALL require a camelCase sessionId, resolve it through the shared session matcher, reject child and unknown sessions, and clear initialization progress only on the matched root agent. It requests redraw only when clearing actually changed state and the matched agent is active. Malformed payloads, absent agents, already-clear state and inactive owners return false, although an inactive owner's progress can still be cleared.
scenarios: Active root
a known active root reports initialized and progress was present
progress clears and true is returned.
Inactive root
a known inactive root reports initialized
progress may clear but false is returned.
Child
the session matcher identifies a child session
the notification is dropped.
No mutation
the root progress was already clear
false is returned.

requirement: Pager MCP server status modal patch and owner-scoped refetch
contract: The MCP server-status handler SHALL parse the shell's canonical payload, route by sessionId, and warn then reject malformed input. When tools are omitted for ConfigAdded, ConfigRemoved or ConfigChanged, an open modal with no pending fetch for that agent and a current session id schedules one owner-scoped FetchMcpsList effect. If the target modal is open with loaded server data, Ready, Initializing or Unavailable and any supplied tool detail are passed to `patch_server_row`; closed, loading or errored modals skip the patch. The return value requests redraw only for an active owner when either a refresh was scheduled or the named row mutated; an absent named server can still return true through the scheduled refresh path.
scenarios: Catalog delta
a qualifying config reason omits tools for an open modal
one fetch is scheduled unless that agent already has a pending fetch.
Loaded row
the matched modal has loaded server data
the named row is offered mapped status and optional replacement tools.
Unavailable surface
the modal is closed or its data is loading or errored
the row patch is skipped.
Redraw ownership
the matched owner is inactive
state/effects may update but the handler returns false.
Malformed status
canonical payload parsing fails
a bounded warning is emitted and false is returned.

requirement: Pager ask-user reverse request session routing and replacement
contract: The ask-user reverse-request handler SHALL parse the typed payload or reply with ACP -32602, route its session through the shared root/child matcher, and drop the response sender when no local concrete view exists so transport failure completes the request. On a valid target it cancels any existing question response, adds that question's open duration to paused time, restores its stashed prompt, emits a cancellation notice for displaced local question kinds, then stashes the current prompt, installs the new question with response sender and mode, clears prompt text and stamps last_active_at. Every successfully opened question returns true even off-screen so dashboard and parent status can repaint. It does not immediately answer the new request, preserve a displaced local directive payload, or distinguish active-view redraw in its return value.
scenarios: Invalid params
typed request parsing fails
an Invalid params ACP error is sent and false returned.
Unknown view
session matching or concrete child resolution fails
the response sender is dropped and false returned.
Replacement
the target already has a question
the old response is Cancelled, its prompt is restored and local kinds receive a notice.
Open
a valid target accepts the question
prompt is stashed and cleared, question state and activity time are installed, and true is returned.
Deferred response
the overlay opens
the new response sender remains stored until later user action or replacement.

requirement: Pager plan approval reverse request overlay ownership
contract: The plan-approval reverse-request handler SHALL parse typed params, reject blank trimmed plan content with ACP -32602, route to the concrete root or child view, and drop the response sender on unresolved ownership. Replacing an existing approval sends its stale cancellation, restores its prompt and clears the line viewer; active modal and block viewer are dismissed, an in-progress casual comment restores its earlier prompt, and current plan comments and edit ranges reset. The new approval stashes and clears the prompt, attempts a plan preview, marks an available plan viewer feedback-active or focuses the approval prompt, and returns true only when the concrete target view is visible. It does not dismiss a question overlay in this function, preserve comments across replacement, or send an approval response before user action.
scenarios: Invalid plan
JSON is malformed or planContent trims empty
ACP -32602 is sent and false returned.
Unknown target
the addressed concrete view cannot be resolved
the response sender is dropped and false returned.
Replacement
an approval is already active
it receives stale cancellation and its stashed prompt is restored before new state is installed.
Overlay ownership
the new approval opens
modal, block viewer, casual edit and prior plan-comment state are cleared as specified.
Visibility
the target is parked off-screen
state opens but false is returned; a visible target returns true.

requirement: Pager session match priority and unassigned-active fallback
contract: The shared session matcher SHALL scan agents once, return the first exact root session-id match immediately, otherwise retain the first child-view key match, and only after the scan use a child match. When neither exists, an active Agent view whose root session id is absent is returned as a Root fallback; all other unmatched notifications return none. Root precedence applies even if the same string is also a child key. Hash-map iteration determines which parent wins if duplicate child keys exist. The fallback does not verify that the notification originated from the active agent's in-flight creation.
scenarios: Root precedence
one root id matches
that root is returned even if a child key also matches.
Child fallback
no root matches and a child map contains the id
the first encountered owning parent is returned as Child.
Race fallback
nothing matches and the active root has no assigned session id
the active agent is returned as Root.
Known active root
nothing matches but the active root already has an id
none is returned.
Duplicate child key
multiple parents contain the same child id
the hash-map's first encountered match wins.

requirement: Pager matched notification owner and MCP root resolution
contract: Notification-owner resolution SHALL combine shared session matching, parent-agent active status and mutable parent lookup, returning the SessionMatch, active-parent flag and owner. MCP lifecycle resolution reuses that result but rejects Child matches, because progress is stored only on the root agent. The active flag identifies the parent container rather than whether a particular child is fullscreen. Missing matches or missing owner entries return none.
scenarios: Notification owner
session matching and parent lookup succeed
match kind, active-parent flag and mutable parent are returned.
Missing parent
a match cannot be resolved to an agent entry
none is returned.
MCP root
the payload id resolves to a root
the root and active-parent flag are returned.
MCP child
the payload id resolves to a child
MCP target resolution returns none.

requirement: Pager concrete root-child session and scrollback borrowing
contract: The concrete target-view resolver SHALL return the child AgentSession and ScrollbackState from `subagent_views[child_sid]` for a Child match, or the parent root session and scrollback for a Root match. A missing child key returns none; the Root branch does not compare child_sid. This helper borrows transcript state only and does not decide visibility, redraw or notification validity.
scenarios: Root pair
the match is Root
the parent session and scrollback are returned.
Child pair
the match is Child and child_sid exists
that child view's session and scrollback are returned.
Missing child
the match is Child but child_sid is absent
none is returned.
Visibility
a parked child resolves
the borrow succeeds without implying the child is visible.

requirement: Pager parent-active and concrete-view-active distinction
contract: The parent-active predicate SHALL be true when active_view is the matched AgentId. The concrete-view predicate additionally requires the parent active and then treats a root as visible only when no active_subagent is attached, while a child is visible only when active_subagent exactly equals the addressed session string. Missing parents, dashboard or other active agents return false. These predicates do not validate that active_subagent still names an existing child view.
scenarios: Parent active
active_view names the owner
the parent-active predicate is true.
Root hidden by child
the owner is active with any active_subagent
the root concrete view is inactive.
Fullscreen child
the owner is active and active_subagent equals the child session
that child concrete view is active.
Stale active child
active_subagent equals the string but its map entry is absent
this predicate alone can still return true.

requirement: Pager concrete interactive AgentView resolution
contract: Interactive AgentView resolution SHALL return the parent itself for Root or dereference the matching boxed child view for Child. A missing child key returns none. It does not re-check session identity, ownership, visibility or active_subagent, relying on the previously produced SessionMatch and supplied child string.
scenarios: Root
the prior match is Root
the mutable parent AgentView is returned.
Child
the prior match is Child and its key exists
the mutable child AgentView is returned.
Missing child
the supplied child key is absent
none is returned.
Prior evidence
match and child_sid disagree
the function uses the supplied key without independently validating the original session id.

requirement: Pager permission owner routing root auto-approval and notification
contract: Permission handling SHALL match the request session to a root or child owner and cancel unknown or vanished owners. A root whose owning session is always-approve auto-selects the first AllowOnce option and returns false without notification or redraw; it does not select AllowAlways when AllowOnce is absent, and Child requests never inherit the root UI switch. Otherwise one ApprovalRequired notification is emitted only when the notification service's permission suppression is false, the request is FIFO-enqueued on the parent root interaction layer, and redraw is returned only for an active owning parent. Notification can occur before a later parent lookup fails and cancels the request.
scenarios: Unknown session
shared session matching returns none
Cancelled is sent and false returned.
Root always approve
the root owner is always-approve and offers AllowOnce
that option is selected immediately without redraw.
Missing AllowOnce
always-approve offers only other allow kinds
the request falls through to interactive enqueue.
Child request
a child of an always-approve root asks
the root switch is not inherited and the request is queued.
Notification gate
the permission notification is not suppressed
one ApprovalRequired event is sent and the service is marked notified before enqueue.

requirement: Pager permission FIFO state prompt and pane transition
contract: Permission enqueue SHALL tolerantly parse Bash highlights from request meta, derive the default always-allow word count, parse MCP tool scope only from the `allow-always-mcp` option meta, build provenance and display fields, assign and increment the agent-local request id, and resolve the initial option cursor. On the empty-to-nonempty transition it stashes and clears the prompt; if Scrollback owns the pane it also remembers that pane and forces Prompt. It clones request options, pushes a PermissionViewState without replacing older requests, stamps session last_active_at and returns true. Later enqueues do not restash prompt or pane and malformed optional metadata silently removes the corresponding enhancement.
scenarios: First request
the permission queue and stash are empty
prompt is stashed and cleared before FIFO push.
Scrollback transition
the first request arrives while Scrollback is active
Scrollback is remembered and Prompt is forced.
Concurrent request
the queue is already nonempty
the request is appended with a new id without replacing or restashing.
Optional metadata
Bash or MCP metadata fails typed parsing
enqueue continues without that parsed state.
Activity
the state is pushed
last_active_at is reset to the current Instant and true is returned.

requirement: Pager permission subagent provenance confidence tiers
contract: Permission provenance SHALL be absent when the request session exactly equals the root session id. A non-root id found in `subagent_sessions` is labelled `Subagent <canonical formatted title>:`; any other non-root id is labelled `Child session (untracked):`. When the root session id itself is absent, every supplied id is treated as non-root and therefore tracked or untracked child provenance.
scenarios: Root
the root session id exists and equals the request id
no provenance label is returned.
Tracked child
subagent_sessions contains the non-root id
the canonical formatted subagent title is prefixed and suffixed as a label.
Opaque child
the non-root id has no tracked record
the untracked child label is returned.
Unassigned root
the agent root session id is absent
the request id cannot be recognized as root by this helper.

requirement: Pager permission title raw command and kind fallback
contract: Permission display construction SHALL try to deserialize shared BashToolInput from raw_input, otherwise extract a raw command only from an ACP title exactly wrapped as `Execute `<command>``. A request is execute-like when Bash highlights exist, kind is Execute or a raw command was recovered. Execute title prefers a nonblank trimmed Bash description, then the first highlighted word as `Allow `<bin>`?`, then `Allow Execute?`; raw command is returned only for execute-like requests. Edit-like requests are detected by an AllowAlways option whose lowercased name contains `edit`, then prefer raw_input.file_path, otherwise a prettified title, otherwise `Allow Edit?`. Other titled tools use the prettified title, and untitled kinds fall back to Edit, Execute, Delete or generic Allow. Description lines are delegated separately.
scenarios: Typed Bash
raw_input parses as BashToolInput
command and optional trimmed description drive execute display.
Title command
typed parsing fails but title has the exact Execute backtick wrapper
the inner command makes the request execute-like.
Edit path
the option-name heuristic marks edit and raw_input.file_path is a string
the path appears in the edit title.
Named tool
the request is neither execute nor edit and has a title
the MCP-qualified name is prettified in the title.
Untitled kind
no earlier branch applies
known kinds or the generic Allow fallback provide the title.

requirement: Pager permission protected edit and MCP argument description ordering
contract: Permission description construction SHALL start with MCP planned-argument lines and, when the request is edit-like and meta parses as ProtectedEditPermission with a nonempty description, insert that protected-edit note at index zero. Missing, malformed or empty protected descriptions are omitted. Non-edit requests never show the protected description through this path even if their meta has the same shape.
scenarios: Protected edit
edit detection succeeds and typed meta contains a nonempty description
the note precedes all MCP argument lines.
Malformed meta
ProtectedEditPermission parsing fails
no protected note is added.
Empty note
the parsed description is empty
it is omitted.
Non-edit
compatible protected meta appears on another request kind
the note is not inserted.

requirement: Pager MCP permission planned argument formatting bounds
contract: MCP argument display SHALL operate only when raw_input.variant is exactly UseTool or MCPTool and nonnull tool_input exists. It pretty-serializes that value as JSON, truncates each produced line after 2000 Unicode scalar positions with an ellipsis, and when more than 200 lines exist retains the first 200 plus a summary line containing the hidden count. Missing, null, nonmatching or serialization-failing inputs return no lines. The limit is scalar-count based rather than terminal display width or bytes, and output may contain 201 stored lines after the summary is appended.
scenarios: MCP arguments
a recognized variant has nonnull serializable tool_input
pretty JSON lines are returned.
Line bound
a pretty line exceeds 2000 scalar values
the prefix through that boundary plus an ellipsis is stored.
Count bound
pretty JSON produces more than 200 lines
200 lines and one hidden-count summary remain.
Not MCP
the variant is missing or different
no argument lines are returned.
No payload
tool_input is absent or null
no argument lines are returned.

requirement: Pager late automatic recap admission predicate
contract: Late-recap admission SHALL drop a recap only when all three conditions hold: it is automatic, it is not history replay, and the agent is not idle. Manual recap and replay always remain admissible, as does an automatic recap received while idle. The predicate does not inspect event identity, turn id, recap age or current scrollback ordering.
scenarios: Late live auto
auto is true, replay false and agent idle false
the recap is dropped.
Replay
the recap is replayed
it is retained regardless of auto or busy state.
Manual
auto is false
it is retained regardless of busy state.
Idle auto
the live automatic recap arrives while idle
it is retained.

requirement: Pager recap immutable block commit and manual live-feedback clearing
contract: Recap application SHALL clear the shared `recap` live-feedback entry for manual recaps and then append the supplied RenderBlock to scrollback. Automatic recaps append without that clear. The helper does not deduplicate, validate recap type, check lateness, distinguish retained from native scrollback or report whether the clear changed state.
scenarios: Manual recap
auto is false
recap live feedback is cleared before the block is pushed.
Automatic recap
auto is true
the block is pushed without clearing manual progress.
Duplicate
the same block is applied twice
this helper appends twice because it has no identity gate.

requirement: Pager authoritative model catalog publication
contract: A valid `grow/models/update` SHALL deserialize the shell SessionModelState, convert it to pager ModelState, replace the process-owned `app.models` template even when the old default remains available, recursively update concrete sessions, retry deferred authoritative controls and resynchronize subagent control projections, then return true. Malformed notification parameters warn and return false. The process catalog's current model is a fallback for sessions whose own current model is absent from the new catalog, not an unconditional overwrite of every live selection.
scenarios: Valid publication
SessionModelState parses
the app template and concrete session catalogs are reconciled and true returned.
Changed default
the shell publishes a different current model while the old one remains available
the future-session app template adopts the shell current.
Live selection
a session's current model remains in the new catalog
catalog update preserves that concrete selection.
Malformed
notification parsing fails
a warning is logged and false returned.

requirement: Pager recursive model catalog update with workflow route freeze
contract: Concrete model-catalog reconciliation SHALL update the current AgentView, warning when its selected model is absent and passing the process fallback into `update_catalog`. It recursively visits child views except a child whose parent `subagent_sessions` record has a workflow_run_id; that workflow child and all descendants beneath it keep their frozen runtime route. A child view without matching metadata is treated as non-workflow and updated.
scenarios: Current view
catalog reconciliation visits an AgentView
its catalog is replaced and an unavailable current selection can fall back.
Ordinary child
a child has no workflow_run_id
it and its descendants are recursively reconciled.
Workflow child
the child's metadata has workflow_run_id
that child subtree is skipped.
Missing metadata
a child view has no subagent_sessions record
it is updated as an ordinary child.

requirement: Pager recursive deferred authoritative control retry
contract: After each catalog publication, deferred authoritative controls SHALL be retried for every AgentView that has a session id and recursively for every child view. Results are OR-folded so all children are visited even after a prior change. Workflow-run subtrees are not skipped by this retry helper, although their catalog update may have been skipped; views without session ids only recurse into children. The caller does not use the returned changed flag to decide its final true result.
scenarios: Root with id
the root session id exists
deferred controls are applied against that id.
Root without id
the root id is absent
its own retry is skipped but child recursion continues.
Multiple children
one child reports a change
remaining children are still visited and the aggregate remains true.
Workflow subtree
a workflow child exists
this helper still enters it.

requirement: Pager live Auto permission gate emergency downgrade
contract: When a settings update carries auto_permission_mode_enabled, Pager SHALL replace `auto_mode_gate`. If false, it first captures live top-level session ids whose AgentSession is Auto, invokes the shared displayed-Auto downgrade, then fire-and-forget sends `grow/permission_mode_changed` with ask for each captured id over the shared ACP channel; send failures and response receivers are ignored. Whether disabling or enabling, slash permission commands are resynchronized. Absent gate fields leave this path untouched, and the captured notification list does not independently traverse child AgentViews.
scenarios: Disable
the pushed gate is false
displayed Auto is downgraded and previously-Auto live root sessions receive ask notifications.
Enable
the pushed gate is true
no downgrade notification is sent and slash gates are resynchronized.
No live id
an Auto top-level agent has no session id
it is not included in outbound notifications.
Transport failure
the ACP send fails
the function does not retry or report that failure.
Omitted field
the update lacks the gate
existing gate and slash exposure are not changed by this block.

requirement: Pager pushed permission soft-default latch
contract: A presence-aware pushed permission_mode SHALL re-arm the future-session default only while `permission_mode_from_soft_default` remains true. Resolution uses one effective-config read and precedence `[ui]` over remote over Ask; requested Auto is clamped to Ask when the current auto gate is off. The resolved runtime enum and canonical current-ui string are replaced. Live sessions are untouched, nothing is persisted, omitted fields do nothing, and once the user has claimed the selector this update path ignores both null and string pushes.
scenarios: Soft latch
the field is present and soft-default ownership remains
local UI config and remote value are resolved into the future-session default.
Auto gated
resolution requests Auto while the feature gate is false
Ask is stored.
Explicit null
the present field clears the remote value
resolution proceeds with remote absent.
User-owned
permission_mode_from_soft_default is false
the pushed field is ignored.
Live session
the future default changes
existing session permission modes are not changed here.

requirement: Pager settings display flag and session picker precedence
contract: A valid settings update SHALL directly replace show_resolved_model when present. For a present session_picker_grouped remote value, resolution prefers `GROW_SESSION_PICKER_GROUPED` only for exact 1/true/0/false strings, then effective `[cli].session_picker_grouped` boolean, then the remote value. Invalid environment strings and config-load/type failures fall through. Absent fields preserve prior values. The handler duplicates startup precedence locally rather than calling a shared resolver.
scenarios: Display flag
show_resolved_model is present
the app boolean is replaced.
Environment
the grouping env is an accepted exact string
it overrides config and remote.
Config
env is absent or invalid and effective config has a boolean
the config value overrides remote.
Remote fallback
neither higher source resolves
the pushed grouping value is stored.
Omitted
a field is absent
its prior app value remains.

requirement: Pager remote verb-grouping resolution and transcript invalidation
contract: Every valid settings update SHALL load disk config once and resolve group_tool_verbs from local config plus the update's optional remote value, including None to clear a previous remote enable. Only when the resolved value differs from the appearance cache does Pager set the cache, clear group expansion and invalidate heights for every top-level agent scrollback and each direct child scrollback. It does not recursively invalidate grandchildren in this loop, preserve expansion ids across grouping shapes or report individual invalidation changes.
scenarios: Remote clear
the update omits or clears a prior remote group value
local/default resolution is recomputed.
No flip
resolved grouping equals the cache
transcript expansion and heights are left alone.
Flip
resolved grouping differs
cache changes and root plus direct-child transcripts clear expansion and invalidate heights.
Nested child
a child owns its own subagent view
that grandchild is not visited by this loop.

requirement: Pager pushed tips and slash tags as local re-resolution signals
contract: When a valid update carries tips, Pager SHALL ignore the pushed vector's contents as data, re-resolve tips from the already-loaded local disk config, choose and advance a tip using grow_home when nonempty, or clear the current tip when empty. When slash_command_tags is present as null or a valid map, Pager SHALL ignore the contained remote value and replace command tags by resolving effective local config; malformed tag values are deserialized as absent so they do not trigger re-resolution or fail sibling fields. Omitted fields preserve current projections.
scenarios: Tips signal
tips is present
local tips are reloaded and current tip is advanced or cleared.
Tags map
slash_command_tags contains a valid map
its presence triggers local effective-config tag resolution.
Tags clear
slash_command_tags is explicit null
the same local re-resolution occurs.
Malformed tags
the field is present with another JSON shape
a warning is logged, tags stay unchanged and sibling settings still parse.
Omitted
neither signal is present
current tips and tags remain.

requirement: Pager leader roster changed upsert and removal projection
contract: A `grow/sessions/changed` notification SHALL parse RosterChanged or warn and return false. Every upserted entry is passed to app.upsert_roster_entry in payload order, followed by every removed session id passed to app.remove_roster_entry. The handler returns true when either list contained at least one item, even if an upsert or removal was idempotent, and false for a valid empty change. It does not resolve conflicts between an id present in both lists beyond applying removal after upsert.
scenarios: Upserts
the payload contains entries
each is applied in order and affected becomes true.
Removals
the payload contains ids
each is removed after all upserts and affected becomes true.
Same id
an id is upserted and removed in one payload
the removal is applied last.
Empty
both lists are empty
false is returned.
Malformed
RosterChanged parsing fails
a warning is logged and false returned.

requirement: Pager announcement update filtering hidden-id pruning and slash gate
contract: A valid announcements update SHALL filter expired announcements, replace active_announcements, project the first remaining announcement as current, prune hidden ids against the active set, enqueue PersistAnnouncementsHidden with the cloned survivors only when pruning changed them, synchronize the session announcement slash gate, and return true. Parse failure returns false without logging in this function. A valid identical or empty update still returns true and runs slash synchronization.
scenarios: Filter
the payload parses
expired items are removed and the first active item becomes current.
Hidden prune
stored hidden ids no longer correspond to active announcements
they are pruned and one persistence effect is queued.
No prune
hidden ids remain unchanged
no persistence effect is added.
Empty active
all announcements expire or input is empty
current announcement becomes absent and slash gate is synchronized.
Malformed
typed parsing fails
false is returned.

requirement: Pager partial settings DTO presence and tolerant tag decoding
contract: PagerSettingsUpdate SHALL accept omitted fields through serde defaults. permission_mode distinguishes omission as None, JSON null as Some(None), and a string as Some(Some(value)); a malformed nonstring fails the enclosing update. slash_command_tags likewise distinguishes absent, null and a valid ordered string map, but a malformed present value logs a warning and becomes outer None so sibling fields remain usable. tips and ordinary optional booleans do not distinguish absent from null. The pager DTO intentionally lists only TUI-consumed shell fields and ignores unknown additions.
scenarios: Permission omit
permission_mode is absent
no update is represented.
Permission null
permission_mode is null
an explicit remote clear is represented.
Tags map
slash_command_tags is a string map
the ordered map is retained inside both option layers.
Malformed tags
slash_command_tags is an array or otherwise wrong
it becomes absent while sibling fields parse.
Unknown fields
the shell adds unlisted fields
default serde behavior ignores them.

requirement: Pager background task cumulative stdout interception
contract: A ToolCallUpdate SHALL be intercepted as background output only when its tool-call string maps to a task id; otherwise false delegates it to the normal tracker. A mapped update is consumed and returns true even without raw output, a known task row or extractable content. Only raw_output type Bash is examined: output_for_prompt string has priority, otherwise integer elements from output array are cast to u8 and decoded lossily. Nonempty output replaces the task's cumulative stdout through set_stdout; shell truncated true latches the task flag, while empty output never clears prior stdout. Non-Bash and malformed fields remain consumed without mutation.
scenarios: Not background
the tool-call id has no task mapping
false is returned for normal tracking.
Prompt output
mapped Bash raw output has output_for_prompt
that string replaces task stdout when nonempty.
Byte output
no prompt string exists but output is an array
integer elements are cast to bytes and decoded with UTF-8 loss replacement.
Empty completion
the extracted cumulative buffer is empty
existing stdout is retained.
Consumed malformed
the mapped update lacks usable Bash content
true is still returned without task mutation.

requirement: Pager background task start demotion and monitor classification
contract: A TaskBackgrounded session update SHALL route to the concrete root or child session, mark replay restores, drain the deferred-tool entry, and classify monitors from structured monitor_description or a `[monitor] ` command prefix. Description priority is nonblank monitor description, stripped prefix, notification description, deferred description, then an existing Execute description during demotion. New running BgTaskState uses current SystemTime and empty output. When a pending Execute entry exists it is converted in place to collapsed unpinned BgTask, carries prior output through set_stdout, stops running and leaves the tracker; if that entry vanished, or no demotion exists, a fresh running block is pushed. Task state, tool correlation and scrollback id are inserted, and only parent active status controls the return value.
scenarios: Fresh background
no pending Execute entry exists
a running BgTask block and central state are created.
Demotion
the tracker points to an existing Execute block
output and fallback description migrate and the same entry becomes a collapsed BgTask.
Vanished entry
the tracker id no longer exists
pending tracking is removed and a fresh BgTask block is pushed.
Monitor
structured description or legacy prefix exists
the task is marked monitor and the prefix can supply a bare label.
Replay
notification meta marks history replay
restored_from_replay is set for later pane behavior.

requirement: Pager monitor event background stdout append
contract: A MonitorEvent SHALL parse the SessionNotification, route to the addressed root or direct concrete child session, and append event_text through the matched task's bounded append_stdout path. Unknown task ids perform no mutation but still return the owning parent's active status. Malformed, wrong-variant, unmatched or missing child notifications return false. The payload description is ignored and this handler does not create a missing task or scrollback block.
scenarios: Known task
routing succeeds and task_id exists
event_text is appended with stdout trimming and line-count invariants.
Unknown task
the owner resolves but task_id is absent
no task is created and parent active status is returned.
Child
the session match is Child and the view exists
that child's central task store is targeted.
Invalid
parsing, variant or routing fails
false is returned.

requirement: Pager scheduled task creation projection and provisional purge
contract: A ScheduledTaskCreated update SHALL route by session match to the owning parent agent, remove every scheduled-task entry whose key begins `provisional-`, then upsert the canonical task id in the parent's root scheduled_tasks map. Existing entries replace prompt, human schedule and next fire while retaining created_at, tag and last_subagent_id; new entries use current Instant, tag loop and no last subagent. The return value is parent active status. Child matches still target the parent root map, and a matched-but-missing agent is treated as an invariant panic.
scenarios: Provisional cleanup
a valid created update arrives
all provisional-prefixed entries are removed before upsert.
Existing task
the canonical id already exists
prompt, schedule and next fire are replaced without resetting other fields.
New task
the id is absent
a loop entry with current creation time and no last child is inserted.
Child session
the notification matches a child
the owning parent's scheduled task map is used.
Visibility
the owner is inactive
state updates but false is returned.

requirement: Pager scheduled task fire update and unknown-task self-heal
contract: A ScheduledTaskFired update SHALL route to the owning parent scheduled_tasks map. Existing task entries replace next_fire_at and record the firing subagent id while leaving prompt and schedule unchanged. An unknown task self-heals from the fire payload only when next_fire_at is present, creating a loop entry with current Instant and the firing child; when next_fire_at is absent it returns parent active status without insertion. Malformed, wrong-variant or unmatched notifications return false.
scenarios: Known fire
task id exists
next fire and last subagent are updated.
Recoverable unknown
id is absent and next_fire_at is present
a new scheduled task is built from the fire payload.
Terminal unknown
id is absent and next_fire_at is absent
no entry is inserted.
Inactive owner
routing succeeds off-screen
state may update but false is returned.

requirement: Pager scheduled task deletion idempotent projection
contract: A ScheduledTaskDeleted update SHALL route to the owning parent agent and remove the task id from its root scheduled_tasks map. It returns parent active status whether or not an entry existed, so true represents redraw ownership rather than mutation. Malformed, wrong-variant and unmatched updates return false; Child matches share the parent map.
scenarios: Existing
the task id is present
it is removed and active status returned.
Missing
the id is already absent
the map stays unchanged but active status is still returned.
Child
the update matches a child session
the owning parent map is mutated.
Invalid
parse, variant or match fails
false is returned.

requirement: Pager child cwd and worktree flag independent derivation
contract: Child path derivation SHALL use SubagentInfo.child_cwd when present and otherwise clone the parent cwd. Independently, is_worktree is true exactly when info exists and worktree_path is present. worktree_path does not supply cwd, child_cwd does not imply worktree, and the helper does not canonicalize, verify existence or compare either path.
scenarios: Child cwd
child_cwd is present
its raw path becomes the effective cwd.
Parent fallback
info or child_cwd is absent
the parent cwd is cloned.
Worktree
worktree_path is present
the worktree flag is true independently of child_cwd.
Cwd only
child_cwd exists but worktree_path does not
the child path is used with false worktree flag.

requirement: Pager git head notification root-first cache update
contract: A GitHeadChanged notification SHALL parse the shared typed payload, search top-level agents for an exact ACP session id first, and otherwise search each agent's direct child views. The first match updates the shared per-cwd git cache plus that view's current_branch, is_worktree and main_repo, then returns true regardless of active visibility. Malformed or unmatched payloads return false. Root matches take precedence over child matches, and nested grandchildren are not searched.
scenarios: Root
a top-level session id matches
shared cwd cache and root display fields update and true returns.
Direct child
no root matches and a direct child id matches
that child's cache and display fields update.
Root precedence
the same id could match a root and child
the root search returns first.
Nested child
only a grandchild session id matches
this handler returns false.
Malformed
typed payload parsing fails
false is returned.

requirement: Pager background task completion state and stale-load suppression
contract: A TaskCompleted update SHALL route to the concrete root or child. Success is exit code zero or both exit code and signal absent; signal `session_restart` marks stale-on-load. A known task updates Done/Failed, exit/signal/end time and clears pending kill, deriving elapsed and description from stored state. An unknown task derives elapsed from snapshot times when ordered and a nonblank display_command differing from raw command, stripping a monitor prefix, but is not inserted into the central task map. The original started entry is finished and descriptions synchronize when available. Stale-on-load returns after state finalization without a new terminal block; other completions append completed or failed blocks and return parent active status.
scenarios: Known success
a tracked task completes with exit zero
state becomes Done, kill state clears and a completed block is appended.
Signal-free unknown exit
exit code and signal are both absent
completion is classified successful.
Unknown task
no central task exists
snapshot data drives a terminal block without inserting central state.
Description recovery
stored description is blank but the started block has one
it is recovered into central state and terminal label.
Stale load
signal equals session_restart
running state is finalized but no fresh completion/failure block is appended.
Failure
success predicate is false
a failed block carries exit code and signal.

requirement: Pager recursive subagent control projection synchronization
contract: Control projection by session id SHALL depth-first search every top-level AgentView and nested subagent view, stop at the first parent containing the child key, and invoke sync_child_control_projection there; no match returns false. Full-tree synchronization SHALL snapshot each view's direct child ids, recursively synchronize each child subtree first, then synchronize that child's projection into its parent, producing post-order propagation without holding overlapping map borrows. Duplicate child ids in different branches are resolved by iteration order in the by-id helper.
scenarios: By id
a nested parent contains the child session key
that parent-child projection is synchronized and true returned.
Missing
no subtree contains the key
false is returned.
Full tree
an agent has nested descendants
descendants synchronize before their projection is copied upward.
Duplicate id
multiple branches contain the same child key
the first branch visited wins for by-id synchronization.

requirement: Pager ACP client message dispatch acknowledgement contract
contract: The top-level ACP handler SHALL route SessionNotification, RequestPermission, ExtNotification and ExtMethod to their dedicated paths. SessionNotification and ExtNotification always attempt an Ok unit response after processing even when ignored, rejected or not visually affected; response-send failures are ignored. WaitForTerminalExit returns the pager-specific unsupported error and false. Unhandled message variants return false without a response in this function. The boolean denotes redraw effect according to each branch rather than protocol success.
scenarios: Session notification
processing completes or drops the update
Ok is attempted and the branch's affected boolean is returned.
Extension notification
method dispatch returns
Ok is attempted even for unknown methods.
Permission or method
an interactive request arrives
ownership of its response follows the dedicated handler.
Wait for exit
terminal-exit waiting is requested
an unsupported error is sent and false returned.
Other
another ACP client message variant arrives
false is returned.

requirement: Pager root session live event highwater and metadata admission
contract: For a root SessionNotification, Pager SHALL parse NotificationMeta and drop a non-replay event whose event sequence is at or below the session highwater; an admitted non-replay sequence advances that highwater before further routing. Replay is exempt and never seeds it. Unexpected replay is then dropped through the load/reconnect guard. For admitted live deltas with a prompt id differing from current, attached_as_viewer is recomputed from whether Pager originated that prompt. Only non-deduped updates may confirm total tokens or replace turn_start_ms and its prompt binding, preventing stale metadata regression. The highwater assumes live delivery order and cannot distinguish a valid lower sequence arriving late.
scenarios: Live duplicate
event_seq is at or below last_applied_event_seq
render and token/timing mutation are dropped.
Live advance
a higher event sequence arrives
the highwater advances before update dispatch.
Replay
meta marks replay
highwater comparison and seeding are skipped.
Viewer derivation
an admitted live prompt id differs from current
viewer status becomes the inverse of self-originated ownership.
Fresh metadata
the event is not deduped
total tokens and turn-start fields may update.

requirement: Pager root special session info plan and background stdout updates
contract: Before generic tracking, a root SessionInfoUpdate SHALL decode title entities, set generated title for Value, additionally set display_name only for `grow/titleSource=user`, clear both on Null, and treat Undefined as mutation only when context-pressure meta is true; it advances reconnect cursor. A Plan update refreshes watchdog time only for live activity whose prompt id equals current, converts every entry to todo, marks reload todo update, advances reconnect cursor and reports mutation only outside replay/loading. A background ToolCallUpdate consumed by background stdout routing likewise advances reconnect cursor and reports live non-loading mutation without keeping the foreground watchdog alive.
scenarios: Generated title
SessionInfo title is a value
HTML entities decode into generated title and user source also becomes display name.
Title clear
title is Null
generated and display names clear.
Plan
a plan update arrives
entries replace todo state and reload-todo is marked.
Plan watchdog
a live plan carries the current prompt id
last_prompt_event_at is refreshed.
Background stdout
the background router consumes a tool update
generic tracker is bypassed and reconnect cursor advances.

requirement: Pager root prompt mismatch guard and viewer turn adoption
contract: A live root update whose prompt id differs from current SHALL be dropped before generic tracking when the agent is not attached as viewer; the return mutation remains true only when replay loading is not active. A viewer instead may adopt the mismatching prompt id, clear visible follow-ups while retaining the seen ring, and flush pending follow-ups for the adopted id. Replay never drives adoption. This gate relies on opaque prompt identity and self-originated history; updates without a prompt id bypass the mismatch branch.
scenarios: Driver stale prompt
a non-viewer receives a live different prompt id
the update is not passed to session.handle_update.
Viewer adoption
a viewer receives a live different prompt id
current prompt changes and matching buffered follow-ups flush.
Replay
a replay update has a different prompt id
this live adoption branch does not run.
No prompt id
metadata omits prompt identity
the mismatch guard cannot reject it.

requirement: Pager root generic tracker side-channel drain and first activity log
contract: An admitted generic root update SHALL optionally detect behavior/plan-mode state, stamp live last_prompt_event_at, pass the update to AgentSession.handle_update, and when tracker activity transitions from absent to present clear in_flight_prompt and emit one `turn.first_activity` unified log per turn-start Instant with elapsed milliseconds and activity label. It drains pending ACP commands as the sole generation-bump site, refreshes workflow-run management and conditionally queues a workflows modal refresh when workflow command fingerprints changed. It also drains workflow definitions, diagnostics, tools and edit-highlight entry ids into their owning views and workers. Repeated activity does not log first activity again for the same start Instant.
scenarios: First activity
tracker activity changes None to Some
rewind stash clears and one TTFA log is emitted for the turn.
Commands
pending commands exist
catalog replaces, generation increments once and workflow capabilities refresh.
Workflow metadata
pending definitions or diagnostics exist
the workflow view projections replace.
Tools
pending ACP tools exist
session available_tools becomes a collected set.
Edit highlights
pending entry ids exist
each is submitted to the highlight worker.

requirement: Pager viewer running chrome and behavior admission drain
contract: After an admitted live generic delta, an attached viewer outside replay/loading SHALL enter TurnRunning without resetting the tracker when its current prompt is neither terminal-replayed nor rewound and state is not already TurnRunning. It stamps observed status time and back-dates turn_started_at from turn_start_ms. Behavior control resolution is applied after reconnect cursor advancement; when a resolution changes in-flight behavior, deferred authoritative controls retry. An Applied resolution matching deferred_session_mode clears that admission latch, may drain the prompt queue, records page-flip state and appends resulting effects. Settings modal refresh and workflow modal refresh are processed after the agent borrow.
scenarios: Viewer live turn
an eligible viewer receives any applied live delta
state becomes TurnRunning and elapsed anchor is established.
Terminal or rewound
the current prompt is terminal-replayed or rewound
viewer running chrome is not armed.
Behavior resolution
a live update resolves in-flight behavior
deferred authoritative controls are retried.
Admission release
Applied matches deferred_session_mode
the latch clears and queue drain effects/page flip are propagated.
Modal refresh
plan/command or workflow fingerprints require refresh
the corresponding app-level refresh is issued after mutation.

requirement: Pager child session update projection and parent activity sync
contract: A Child SessionNotification SHALL locate the direct child from the matched parent, confirm total tokens, replace turn_start_ms without prompt binding, detect plan mode, and pass every update directly to the child session tracker without the root live-event highwater, unexpected-replay guard, prompt mismatch/adoption logic, reconnect cursor or command/workflow/tool side-channel drains in this branch. Edit highlights and behavior resolution/deferred controls are handled; a matching Applied deferred mode may drain the child's queue into parent-scoped effects/page flip. The child's resolved live activity label is then copied to parent subagent info. The return value is parent-agent active status regardless of replay, loading or actual mutation.
scenarios: Child update
a matched direct child exists
its session and scrollback consume the update.
Metadata
child meta has tokens or turn start
context and timestamp update without root prompt binding.
Behavior drain
an Applied behavior matches the child's deferred mode
the latch clears and effects propagate through the parent app.
Activity projection
child handling completes
the parent subagent activity label is synchronized.
Return
the parent is active
true is returned even if the child update was replay or made no visible mutation.

requirement: Pager workflow command fingerprint capability and modal refetch
contract: Workflow command fingerprinting SHALL include commands whose meta contains workflowSource, returning name, description, source as an optional string and optional workflowPath in catalog order; a nonstring workflowSource remains included with None. Workflow-run management availability is true exactly when any available command name equals `workflow-run` and is copied to every stored run. When an open modal's workflow fingerprint changes, refetch scheduling requires a current root session id and coalesces pending FetchWorkflowsList effects by AgentId before appending one effect.
scenarios: Fingerprint
a command meta contains workflowSource
its display fields and optional path participate in ordered equality.
Nonstring source
the key exists but is not a string
the command is still included with absent source.
Management
workflow-run is present or absent
every run's management_available mirrors that presence.
Refetch
an agent has a session id and no pending per-agent fetch
one FetchWorkflowsList effect is queued.
Coalesced
that agent already has a pending fetch
no duplicate effect is added.

requirement: Pager Grow extension notification method dispatch table
contract: Grow ExtNotification dispatch SHALL recognize two aliases for session updates plus follow-ups, background start/completion, models, settings, roster, queue, interjection, monitor, scheduled create/fire/delete, announcements, git head and three MCP lifecycle methods, forwarding each to its owning handler. Unknown method strings return false. The outer ACP handler still acknowledges every ExtNotification Ok regardless of this boolean, so false is not a protocol rejection.
scenarios: Session aliases
method is grow/session_notification or grow/session/update
the shared Grow session handler is called.
Known method
one listed method matches
its dedicated handler determines affected state.
Unknown method
no table arm matches
false is returned.
Acknowledgement
the dispatcher returns false
the outer ExtNotification path still attempts Ok.

requirement: Pager root interjection optimistic-echo deduplication
contract: A `grow/session/interjection` notification SHALL parse JSON with string sessionId and text, optionally read a string interjectionId, and accept only a Root session match. When the root consumes the id from its self-interjection set, the broadcast echo is dropped and false returned; otherwise an interjection prompt block is appended and parent active status returned. Missing or null ids always render, Child matches are rejected, and malformed or incomplete payloads return false. This function does not deduplicate legacy id-less retransmissions.
scenarios: Remote interjection
a root notification has an id not minted locally
its text is appended to scrollback.
Self echo
the id exists in the root's optimistic set
the id is consumed and no second block is appended.
Legacy
interjectionId is absent or null
the block always renders.
Child
session matching yields Child
the notification is dropped.
Invalid
JSON, sessionId or text is invalid
false is returned.

requirement: Pager blocking extension method dispatch and method-not-found response
contract: Blocking ExtMethod dispatch SHALL route exactly `grow/ask_user_question` and `grow/plan_approval` to their interactive handlers, transferring response ownership. Every other method logs a warning, attempts ACP -32601 with `Method not found: <method>`, ignores response-send failure and returns false. It performs no prefix matching, version negotiation or generic forwarding.
scenarios: Question
the exact ask-user method arrives
the question handler owns state and response.
Plan approval
the exact plan-approval method arrives
the plan handler owns state and response.
Unknown
another method arrives
a method-not-found error is attempted and false returned.
Send failure
the unknown-method response channel is closed
the failure is ignored.

requirement: Pager typed UI notice projection live progress and coordination merge
contract: UiNotice projection SHALL map all shell tones and Command/Coordination/Lifecycle categories, assemble correlation, subject, description and details metadata, use event-id terminal notices when available and typed notices otherwise, and attach command_invocation_id for Command. Progress becomes live feedback only outside replay/loading and before a command result exists. Non-progress Command clears matching feedback and pending memory browse. Outgoing inquiry coordination notices are hidden; structured incoming inquiry facts become upserted passive coordination tool rows with terminal/failure state, while unparseable identity and other notices remain raw blocks.
scenarios: Progress
a fresh progress notice has no command result
live feedback is set instead of a retained block.
Command terminal
a non-progress Command arrives
matching feedback and memory browse clear and a command-correlated notice is pushed.
Outgoing inquiry
coordination subject is outgoing inquiry or completed
no row is rendered.
Incoming audit
structured incoming inquiry identity parses
one coordination row is upserted with terminal/error projection.
Opaque coordination
structured audit parsing fails
the raw notice fact is preserved.

requirement: Pager replayed subagent descriptor merge preserves live lifecycle
contract: A replayed SubagentSpawned descriptor merged into an existing entity SHALL replace durable identity, description and type, copy optional model/context/resume/capability/permission/workflow/parent fields only when replay supplies them, and always replace context_normalized. It SHALL preserve live or terminal status, counters, timing, tools, error, activity, background and kill state fields omitted from this merge so reconnect replay cannot regress a newer lifecycle.
scenarios: Durable identity
a replayed spawn merges
ids, description and subagent type replace existing values.
Optional absent
an incoming optional descriptor is None
the existing optional value remains.
Normalized flag
incoming context_normalized differs
the incoming boolean replaces it.
Live lifecycle
existing status/counters/kill state are newer
they remain untouched.

requirement: Pager live stop hook prompt batch stashing
contract: Live stop/stop_failure batches SHALL be stashed under an optional prompt id. When an existing pending batch belongs to a different prompt, all stale groups are first emitted as standalone lifecycle hooks. A first event name creates a group; a same-name repeat extends that group only when merge_same_name is true, otherwise it is emitted standalone without replacing the pending group. Different names append groups in arrival order.
scenarios: Prompt switch
pending prompt id differs
all old groups flush standalone before a new batch is created.
First name
no group has the event name
one pending group is appended.
Merge
the name exists and merge_same_name is true
new runs extend the stored group.
No merge
the name exists and merge_same_name is false
new runs render standalone and stored runs remain pending.

requirement: Pager confirmed context usage and model-window refresh
contract: Context refresh SHALL obtain the current model context window or zero and pass used/total into AgentView. The confirmed path additionally records used on the session for pending compaction messaging and is intended only for meta.totalTokens. It does not clamp used to total or distinguish an unknown window from an actual zero window.
scenarios: Known window
the current model exposes a context window
used and that total refresh the view.
Unknown window
no context window resolves
total zero is applied.
Confirmed
meta.totalTokens is accepted
the bar refreshes and the session records the count.
Over total
used exceeds total
this helper performs no explicit clamp.

requirement: Pager replay admission incident accounting and reconnect cursor consumption
contract: Replay admission SHALL accept non-replay, accept replay only while loading_replay and mark that reload as having seen replay, and otherwise drop it while incrementing a saturating incident counter; the first incident warns and later incidents debug-log. Reconnect cursor advancement SHALL consume meta.event_id and pass it with replay status only for applied paths chosen by callers. Missing ids do nothing, and taking the id prevents a second advance from the same mutable metadata.
scenarios: Expected replay
loading_replay is true
replay is accepted and the reload window is marked.
Unexpected first
replay arrives outside a load with zero prior drops
a warning is logged and the counter becomes one.
Unexpected later
another replay arrives
debug logging and saturating increment occur.
Applied id
meta carries event_id
the id is consumed into the agent reconnect cursor.
No id
event_id is absent
cursor state is unchanged.

requirement: Pager Grow session notification routing highwater and forced descendant owner
contract: Grow session notifications SHALL parse a SessionNotification and forward background start/completion plus scheduled create/delete to their dedicated handlers before general routing. Normal routing uses session match; descendant replay may force a specific owner only when that owner's direct subagent_views contains the addressed id and otherwise does not fall back globally. Non-lifecycle Child updates are limited to an explicit handled variant set, use a child Grow-event highwater for live events, advance highwater/cursor only for handled variants, and may drain controls. Descendant lifecycle from a Child uses the parent-child highwater but mutates the top-level owner's flat descendant index. Root non-workflow live updates use a separate Grow highwater; WorkflowUpdated bypasses it.
scenarios: Dedicated event
the variant is a routed task or schedule lifecycle
its dedicated handler returns immediately.
Forced owner
descendant replay names an owner containing the direct child
routing is fixed to that owner as Child.
Child duplicate
a live handled child event sequence is not above its highwater
the event is dropped.
Nested lifecycle
a lifecycle envelope matches a child parent
the child-parent highwater gates a flat descendant update.
Root duplicate
a non-workflow live root Grow sequence is stale
the event is dropped.
Workflow
the update is WorkflowUpdated
root Grow highwater comparison and seeding are skipped.

requirement: Pager subagent permission decision immutable audit row
contract: A SubagentPermissionDecision SHALL look up an optional canonical subagent title by child session id and append one immutable permission event carrying child/type/description, tool identity, access summary/detail, outcome/source/reasons, classifier reason and latency. Unknown children still render with no title. This path does not mutate permission mode, resolve an interactive request or deduplicate by tool-call/event identity.
scenarios: Known child
subagent metadata exists
the formatted title accompanies the full decision audit.
Unknown child
metadata is absent
the decision still renders without a title.
Duplicate
the same decision is delivered twice outside outer dedup
this arm appends twice.
Authorization state
the audit row is appended
no permission selection is changed here.
Canonical child title
a nonempty trimmed subagent_title exists
child_label and compact/detail projections use that title without falling back to type or description.
Fallback child label

child_label chooses type plus description, type, description, or the literal `subagent` in that order.
Compact audit row

Complete live detail
access_detail, classifier reason, reason and latency are present

Replay-safe detail

detail_text uses `Access summary (replay-safe)` so replay retains safe context.
Outcome mapping
outcome is Approved, Denied, TimedOut, Unavailable or Cancelled
stable outcome text is returned and only Approved is considered approved.

requirement: Pager durable turn terminal replay seal and live finalization
contract: TurnCompleted SHALL, during loading replay, seal the current subagent-permission group, record the prompt id in replayed_terminal_prompts and report no change. Outside loading replay it delegates prompt id, stop reason and optional agent result to durable terminal finalization, defers the resulting TerminalOutcome until after shared cleanup, and reports no direct changed flag. The app-level terminal outcome determines final redraw/effects after cursor and control processing.
scenarios: Replay terminal
loading_replay is true
permission grouping seals and the prompt is recorded as terminal without live finalization.
Live terminal
the event is live
durable finalization produces a deferred TerminalOutcome.
Ordering
a live outcome exists
common cursor/control cleanup runs before app.apply_terminal_outcome.
Direct mutation
either branch matches
the match arm itself returns false.

requirement: Pager subagent spawn replay merge view hydration and lifecycle row
contract: SubagentSpawned SHALL reject duplicate live child ids, derive background status from the tracker, construct model state from child payload or parent fallback, and preserve a previously replayed terminal row over a later spawn. Replay merges descriptors into an existing entity; live spawn replaces it and may enrich from Timeline. Existing child views are rehydrated without resetting pending controls, while missing views are created in Vim scrollback mode with inherited appearance and slash visibility. Cwd/worktree, permission, Agent name, workflow names and model are applied; inherited child updates replay once after parent loading. Non-workflow children receive an event-id-deduped Started row unless a terminal row already exists; workflow children omit this lifecycle row. Screen-mode handoff is restored only when controls are not pending and removed after handling.
scenarios: Duplicate live
the child id already exists on a non-replay spawn
the lifecycle fact is ignored.
Replay merge
the child entity exists during replay
durable descriptors merge without regressing terminal/live fields.
New view
no concrete child view exists
one is created with inherited UI capabilities and resolved runtime state.
Existing view
a reconnect repeats spawn
the exact view is reused and control generations remain.
Terminal precedes spawn
a finished row already exists
entity terminal state is recovered and no reversed Started row is added.
Workflow child
workflow_run_id is present
generic subagent lifecycle rows are suppressed.

requirement: Pager subagent progress metrics and context projection
contract: SubagentProgress SHALL update an existing entity's duration, turn/tool counts, tokens, context window/percentage, tools, errors and last-progress time. A matching child view with positive context_window_tokens overrides its model window. Activity is resolved from the child view and synchronized into the entity. Unknown entities are not created, yet the arm returns true; zero context window does not override the child model.
scenarios: Known entity
progress arrives for a tracked child
all supplied metrics and tools replace its projection.
Context window
a matching child view and positive window exist
the child model context window is overridden.
Zero window
context_window_tokens is zero
the model window is not overridden.
Unknown child
neither entity nor view exists
no state is created but true is returned.

requirement: Pager subagent finish interaction cleanup terminal row and child idle
contract: SubagentFinished SHALL clear transport interactions for the child, clear live activity, and append at most one generic terminal row when the known entity was unfinished and is not a workflow child: completed and cancelled are explicit, every other status renders failed with optional error. Event-id insertion may reuse a replayed row. Existing entity metrics/status are finalized, positive tokens replace prior tokens, kill state clears and progress time updates. A matching child view becomes Idle and is finalized only outside parent replay loading. Unknown entities may still produce a generic terminal row but are not inserted into the entity map.
scenarios: Completed
an unfinished ordinary child reports completed
one completed row and finalized metrics are produced.
Other status
status is neither completed nor cancelled
a failed row is used.
Already finished
the entity is terminal
no additional generic terminal row is appended.
Workflow
workflow_run_id is present
generic terminal row is suppressed.
Child view
a concrete view exists
it becomes Idle and live finalization is skipped during replay loading.
Unknown
no entity exists
a terminal row may render without creating metadata.

requirement: Pager hook occurrence dedup attachment batching and annotations
contract: HookExecution SHALL first claim occurrence_id and drop an already-claimed occurrence. Run DTO status maps to Success/Skipped/Blocked/Failed with elapsed/output. Live pre/post tool hooks attach to the latest tool entry when one exists; replay/loading tool hooks render standalone to avoid false attachment. Live stop hooks for a foreign prompt render standalone, for an active local turn enter the pending stop batch, otherwise attach to the latest accepting turn marker or fall back standalone. Other hook names render standalone. Every annotation appends a HookAnnotation session event after hook placement.
scenarios: Duplicate occurrence
claim_hook_occurrence returns false
all runs and annotations are dropped.
Live tool hook
pre/post arrives with a latest tool row
runs attach using the matching phase.
Replay tool hook
replay or loading is active
runs render as standalone lifecycle hooks.
Active stop
stop belongs to the current live turn
runs are stashed for terminal marker folding.
Settled stop
an accepting marker exists
runs attach to that marker.
Annotations
messages accompany a claimed occurrence
each becomes a separate annotation event.

requirement: Pager hook and plugin catalog push with skills refetch
contract: HooksChanged SHALL replace hooks modal data with a loaded hooks/project-trust/error response only while an extensions modal exists. PluginsChanged SHALL seed plugin groups once, replace plugin data as loaded, and when skills data is not already Loading set it Loading and later queue FetchSkillsList for the root session; if that session disappears it sets a modal error when possible. PluginUpdatesInstalled with nonempty tuples appends one notice joining `name old → new`, while an empty list reports no change. Closed modals ignore HooksChanged and PluginsChanged.
scenarios: Hooks open
the extensions modal exists
hooks data becomes Loaded.
Plugins open
the modal exists
groups seed and plugin data becomes Loaded.
Skills refresh
skills are not already Loading and a root session remains
one FetchSkillsList effect is appended.
No session
refetch was requested but no session id remains
skills data becomes Error when the modal remains.
Installed updates
the tuple list is nonempty
one joined version transition notice is pushed.
Closed modal
catalog pushes arrive without an extensions modal
they return false and store no catalog here.

requirement: Pager session recap admission focus marker and unavailable toast
contract: SessionRecap SHALL drop only a busy live automatic recap; accepted replay, manual or idle-auto recap marks recap shown on the focus tracker and appends an immutable Recap event, with manual recap first clearing `recap` live feedback. SessionRecapUnavailable is ignored during replay; live delivery clears recap feedback, chooses a toast from whether scrollback has user messages, and returns true. Accepted recap does not deduplicate by event id in this arm, and unavailable does not clear retained recap blocks.
scenarios: Busy auto
an automatic live recap arrives while the agent is not idle
it is dropped without marking recap shown.
Accepted
manual, replay or idle-auto recap arrives
