focus tracking is marked and a Recap block is appended.
Manual
the accepted recap is manual
recap live feedback clears before append.
Unavailable replay
unavailability is replayed
it is ignored.
Unavailable live
unavailability is live
feedback clears and a user-history-sensitive toast appears.

requirement: Pager model auto-switch diagnostics and immutable timeline event
contract: ModelAutoSwitched SHALL sample up to ten available model ids, log a tracing warning and unified warning containing previous/new ids and catalog evidence, append a ModelUnavailable session event with the supplied reason, and return true. It does not itself change the current model, validate that the new model exists, suppress replay diagnostics, deduplicate the event or redact model ids.
scenarios: Diagnostic
auto-switch notification arrives
previous/new ids, available count and up to ten keys are warned through both logging paths.
Timeline
the diagnostic is emitted
one ModelUnavailable event is appended.
Selection
the event names a new model
this arm does not mutate current model state.
Replay
the update is replayed
this arm contains no replay-specific suppression.

requirement: Pager authoritative model change local-intent and catalog gates
contract: ModelChanged application SHALL parse optional reasoning effort, then when a local sampling control is pending require that control to resolve against the model and parsed effort; a mismatch is stored as deferred authoritative state and reports unchanged. Even after resolution, a model absent from the local catalog is deferred. An available model clears deferred state, becomes current, sets user_model_preference, and reports change only when model or applied effort differs. Invalid effort strings parse as absent rather than rejecting the update. The wrapper returns Option<bool> but all current paths return Some.
scenarios: Intent mismatch
a pending local sampling control does not resolve
the broadcast is deferred without applying.
Catalog lag
the model id is unavailable locally
the change is held until catalog refresh.
Apply
control and catalog gates pass
model, applied effort and user preference update.
No-op
model and effective effort already match
deferred state clears but false is returned.
Malformed effort
the effort string cannot parse
it is treated as absent rather than failing the model id.

requirement: Pager deferred model and Agent authoritative control drain
contract: Deferred authoritative control application SHALL atomically take the latest deferred model and Agent values, apply the model through the normal intent/catalog gates and independently apply the Agent name, then OR their changed results. A still-unavailable model can re-defer itself while the Agent change proceeds. AgentChanged similarly resolves a pending local Agent control or defers a mismatch; without a pending control it applies immediately. Each domain therefore releases independently.
scenarios: Both
deferred model and Agent values exist
each domain is attempted independently.
Model remains unavailable
model reapplication hits catalog lag
it is deferred again while Agent may still apply.
Agent mismatch
a live AgentChanged conflicts with pending local intent
the authoritative name is deferred.
No pending Agent
AgentChanged arrives at a stable boundary
the name applies directly.
Aggregate
either domain changes
the drain returns true.

requirement: Pager correlated memory files modal admission
contract: MemoryFiles SHALL be accepted only for a live non-loading update whose invocation id equals pending_memory_browse. Acceptance clears the pending id and matching live feedback before checking modal occupancy. If another active modal exists, the files are discarded and false returned; otherwise files are converted to memory entries and installed as a boxed MemoryBrowser modal. Replay, loading and stale invocation ids leave pending state untouched and return false.
scenarios: Correlated
a live invocation matches and no modal is active
pending feedback clears and MemoryBrowser opens.
Modal collision
the invocation matches but another modal is active
pending state clears, files are discarded and false returns.
Stale id
the invocation differs
nothing changes.
Replay
the update is replayed or loading replay
it is ignored without clearing the pending browse.

requirement: Pager workflow update direct ingestion outside Grow highwater
contract: WorkflowUpdated SHALL be passed intact to AgentView.ingest_workflow_update. In the enclosing root Grow path it is exempt from live event-sequence highwater rejection and does not seed that highwater, though unexpected replay admission and reconnect event-id advancement still apply. This file delegates workflow identity, revision and deduplication semantics to ingest_workflow_update and does not inspect its payload here.
scenarios: Ingest
WorkflowUpdated reaches the match arm
the full update is delegated and its boolean returned.
Sequence
its live event sequence is below the root Grow highwater
this outer path does not reject it.
Highwater
a higher workflow sequence applies
the root Grow highwater is not advanced by it.
Replay
workflow replay arrives outside an expected load
the shared unexpected-replay gate can still drop it.

requirement: Pager goal update cleared parsed state and elapsed floor
contract: GoalUpdated SHALL call clear_goal when status is exactly `cleared`, ignoring the other supplied fields for that branch. Other statuses must parse through GoalDisplayStatus or warn and return false. A valid state constructs GoalDisplayState with objective, budgets, usage completeness, timestamps and status message, stamps received_at now, sets elapsed_floor_ms equal to supplied elapsed_ms, and delegates to apply_goal_update. This arm does not validate chronological timestamp order, used against budget or goal id continuity.
scenarios: Cleared
status equals cleared
current goal is cleared regardless of remaining payload.
Valid
status parses
a complete display state with received time and elapsed floor is applied.
Malformed
status is not recognized
a warning is emitted and false returned.
Invariants
budget, usage or timestamps are inconsistent
this arm performs no explicit rejection.

requirement: Pager interaction resolved root and child dismissal routing
contract: A root InteractionResolved SHALL delegate its session id and tool-call id to the root AgentView dismissal logic. For a child update, Pager first asks the owning parent to dismiss the interaction because child permissions are centralized there, then short-circuit ORs with dismissal on the concrete child view for other interactions. If the parent dismissal succeeds, the child dismissal is not attempted. Missing child views return the parent result.
scenarios: Root
a root interaction resolves
root dismissal receives root session and tool-call identity.
Central child permission
parent dismissal succeeds for a child session
true returns without touching the child overlay.
Child-local
parent dismissal returns false and child view exists
the child dismissal is attempted.
Missing child
parent dismissal fails and no child view exists
false is returned.

requirement: Pager child Grow update variant projection and control resync
contract: Child Grow dispatch SHALL support UiNotice, ControlStateUpdate, ModelChanged, AgentChanged, InteractionResolved, compaction/retry, and memory lifecycle events. Compaction completion refreshes child context and mirrors tokens/derived percentage into parent SubagentInfo when context window is positive. Unsupported variants return false. After every supported or unsupported match result, sync_child_control_projection is called, while the enclosing caller advances child highwater/cursor only for its handled whitelist rather than this changed boolean.
scenarios: Controls
model, Agent or ControlStateUpdate targets a child
the concrete child applies the same domain logic.
Compaction
child compact completes
child context and parent entity usage are refreshed.
Interaction
child interaction resolves
parent-centralized then child-local dismissal is used.
Unsupported
another variant is supplied directly
changed is false but control projection sync is still attempted.
Missing child
the concrete child view is absent
variant application returns false.

requirement: Pager child model and Agent control projection into parent metadata
contract: Child control projection SHALL read a concrete child view's current model and optional Agent name, then require matching parent SubagentInfo. It reports changed when model differs or a present Agent name differs from subagent_type, always replaces info.model, and replaces subagent_type only when the child has an Agent name. Missing child view or metadata returns false. Clearing a child's Agent name does not clear the parent's previous subagent_type.
scenarios: Model
child current model differs
parent metadata model is replaced and changed is true.
Agent name
a present child Agent name differs
subagent_type is replaced.
Agent absent
child Agent name is None
existing subagent_type remains.
Missing
view or metadata is absent
false is returned.

requirement: Pager control state receipt validation projection and terminal notice
contract: ControlStateUpdate SHALL validate receipt_only updates by matching current and desired domains, requiring intent and terminal Applied/Rejected/Superseded phase; a valid receipt is accepted unchanged, invalid receipt rejected. Non-receipts delegate shell control application with loading state. Accepted updates resolve reconnect intent and combine that with state mutation. Superseded, missing-message and nonterminal phases add no notice. Replayed terminals remain silent unless they resolve an exact local intent. Applied produces Success and Rejected Error with target-specific retry details; event id is used when present, otherwise a synthetic epoch/domain/revision identity deduplicates the terminal notice.
scenarios: Receipt
receipt_only has consistent terminal identity
it is accepted without direct state mutation.
Rejected receipt
domain, desired, intent or phase validation fails
false is returned.
Replay terminal
no reconnect intent resolves
authoritative state may hydrate without a new notice.
Applied
a terminal message accompanies Applied
a success Control notice is pushed.
Rejected
a terminal message accompanies Rejected
an error notice includes target-specific recovery detail.
Synthetic id
event id is absent
epoch, desired-domain fallback and revision form the notice identity.

requirement: Pager compaction lifecycle prompt hold feedback and deferred completion
contract: AutoCompactStarted SHALL preserve the first in-flight prompt in compact_held_prompt, clear in_flight_prompt, set AutoCompacting activity and progress feedback. Async completion immediately appends an informational terminal/ordinary notice and returns without clearing compaction state in this branch. Synchronous completion clears activity, feedback and held prompt; manual or replay/loading completion appends CompactionCompleted immediately, otherwise it defers the compaction event. Failure clears activity/feedback and appends CompactionFailed but does not clear compact_held_prompt. Cancellation clears activity/feedback/held prompt and appends CompactionCancelled. ImageDropped and ImageProjected join notes with newline into notices.
scenarios: Start
compaction begins
the first prompt is held, active prompt clears and progress appears.
Async complete
async_compact is true
an informational notice is appended through an early return.
Manual or replay complete
synchronous completion is manual or loading replay
a completed event is appended immediately.
Deferred complete
automatic synchronous live completion occurs
the completion fact is deferred on session state.
Failure
compaction fails
failure renders while compact_held_prompt remains unchanged.
Cancel
compaction cancels
activity, feedback and held prompt clear.

requirement: Pager recent compaction failure trailing-block scan
contract: Recent compaction-failure detection SHALL scan scrollback backward through the trailing run of SessionEvent and Notice blocks, return true on any CompactionFailed SessionEvent, ignore Notice blocks, and stop with false at the first other block or beginning. A failure earlier than intervening user/tool/content is not considered recent; other session events do not stop the scan.
scenarios: Trailing failure
a CompactionFailed exists among trailing session/notices
true is returned.
Notices
notices follow the failure
they are skipped and the failure remains recent.
Other session
another session event follows failure
the scan continues through it.
Content boundary
a non-session non-notice block is encountered first
false is returned without scanning earlier history.

requirement: Pager image compression fallback visibility
contract: ImageCompressed SHALL treat an empty images list as re-encode fallback: warn, append the supplied persistent notice and return true. A nonempty images list logs successful compression and returns false without TUI output. It does not inspect individual image entries, message severity, replay status or whether the model-facing reminder was attached.
scenarios: Fallback
images is empty
the message is warned and retained in scrollback.
Success
at least one image entry exists
the message is info-logged with no visible block.
Entries
individual results disagree
only vector emptiness controls this helper.

requirement: Pager retry terminal projection rate-limit diagnostic and context suppression
contract: Retrying SHALL clear retry activity and produce no visible retry row. Exhausted clears activity, marks model_failure_reported, emits a RateLimitHit diagnostic only when flagged rate-limited, sanitizes the shared rate-limit message or builds a generic attempts/reason error, and appends RetryFailed. Failed likewise marks failure; context_length appends ContextTooLarge only when the trailing session/notice run lacks CompactionFailed, while other types append RetryFailed with type/message. Every retry variant clears in_flight_prompt. apply_session_event reports false only for Retrying; the root Grow arm separately treats Retrying as no redraw.
scenarios: Retrying
recovery remains in progress
retry activity and in-flight prompt clear without a retained row.
Rate limited
attempts exhaust with rate-limit flag
diagnostic and sanitized RetryFailed are emitted.
Other exhausted
attempts exhaust normally
attempt count and reason form the error.
Context after compact failure
context_length follows a recent CompactionFailed
ContextTooLarge is suppressed.
Other failed
error type differs
typed RetryFailed is appended.

requirement: Pager authoritative Behavior mode plan phase and confirmation projection
contract: CurrentModeUpdate SHALL be the sole Behavior state source. Unknown or pager-unsupported ids warn and return false. Supported Normal, Clarify, Plan, Workflow and Goal replace behavior_mode, clear switch confirmation on identity change, hide workflows outside Workflow, project optional grow/planPhase, and process grow/behaviorChange: confirmation_required with a valid target shows a warning using remainingMs or one, while applied/rejected clears confirmation. plan_mode_active becomes mode.is_plan and the handler returns true even when state is unchanged.
scenarios: Unsupported
mode id is unknown or outside the supported set
the update is warned and ignored.
Mode
a supported id arrives
behavior identity and plan-active projection update.
Leave workflow
new mode is not Workflow
show_workflows clears.
Confirmation
status requires confirmation with valid target
a timed switch warning appears, defaulting missing remainingMs to one.
Terminal
status is applied or rejected
switch confirmation clears.
No change
all projected fields already match
the handler still returns true.

requirement: Pager Behavior control resolution and explicit target extraction
contract: Behavior resolution SHALL operate only on CurrentModeUpdate with a supported pager Behavior id. Missing behaviorChange status and explicit `applied` map to Applied, `confirmation_required` and `rejected` map to their distinct resolutions, and every other status returns none. Explicit target extraction independently reads grow/behaviorChange.target and parses any known BehaviorId; it does not require a supported current mode or terminal status. Callers use this target to prevent delayed non-applied outcomes from resolving newer intent.
scenarios: Plain update
supported current mode has no behaviorChange status
Applied is returned.
Explicit applied
status is applied
Applied is returned.
Confirmation
status is confirmation_required
ConfirmationRequired is returned.
Rejected
status is rejected
Rejected is returned.
Unknown
mode or status is unsupported
resolution is absent.
Target
metadata contains a parseable target id
that BehaviorId is returned independently.

requirement: Pager announcement replacement and hidden prune unit checks
contract: The announcement unit tests SHALL start an in-memory app, route updates through the extension dispatcher, and require a new critical announcement to replace both active_announcements and current announcement. A second test seeds hidden ids old and kept, updates active announcements to kept, requires old pruned and kept retained, and requires some pending PersistAnnouncementsHidden effect contain kept but not old. They do not execute persistence, cover expiry filtering, empty announcements, slash gate, malformed payloads or prove exactly one effect.
scenarios: Replace
a new one-item update arrives
active snapshot and current item equal the new announcement.
Prune
only one of two hidden ids remains active
the stale id is removed and a matching persistence effect exists.
Persistence
the effect is present
the test does not run or count it.

requirement: Pager workflow update common projection unit check
contract: The workflow unit test SHALL send one revision-one active workflow update through the public ExtNotification and top-level ACP handler, require true, one session workflow run with expected name/status/current phase, and a workflow_blocks entry whose scrollback Workflow block carries the current phase and active-agent count. It does not test later revisions, event sequence, replay, deduplication, terminal states, phases beyond one, Agent details beyond construction or acknowledgement reception.
scenarios: Ingest
the fixture update is sent for sess-A
the public handler reports affected and stores one workflow run.
Transcript
the run maps to a block id
the block is Workflow with Research phase and one active agent.
Coverage
the initial active revision succeeds
revision ordering and lifecycle transitions remain untested.

requirement: Pager child permission parent queue and unknown cancellation unit checks
contract: The child-permission tests SHALL first register a child through SubagentSpawned, attach it fullscreen, route a child-session permission through the public handler, and require parent redraw, one parent FIFO item retaining child session identity, and an unresolved response until standard PermissionSelect allow-once dispatch. That dispatch must resolve Selected allow-once and empty the queue. An unregistered child request must resolve Cancelled and leave the queue empty. The tests do not run leader relay, verify spawn-before-permission transport ordering, render the modal, exercise inactive parents, multiple queued children or other permission outcomes.
scenarios: Registered child
permission arrives after spawn registration
it queues on the parent with original child identity and remains pending.
Approve
standard allow-once selection dispatches
the response selects that option and the queue empties.
Unknown
permission names an unregistered child
Cancelled resolves and nothing queues.
Ordering
the in-memory test registers spawn first
leader delivery ordering is assumed rather than exercised.

requirement: Pager child cwd and git-head root direct-child routing unit checks
contract: The git-head unit module SHALL verify all four derive_child_cwd combinations: child cwd plus worktree, parent fallback without worktree, independent worktree flag with parent cwd, and no-info fallback. It SHALL also require root GitHeadChanged to set branch/worktree/main-repo, direct-child routing to update only that child, an unknown id to return false without root mutation, and an existing parent branch to survive a child update. It does not inspect the shared per-cwd git cache, nested grandchildren, duplicate ids, branch clearing, malformed payloads, active-view behavior or filesystem/git state.
scenarios: Path matrix
child cwd, worktree path and info presence vary
effective cwd and worktree flag match their independent derivation.
Root
root session id matches
root display fields update.
Child
only a direct child id matches
child fields update and parent fields remain.
Unknown
no root or direct child matches
false returns without root branch mutation.
Nested
a grandchild would match
this test module contains no such fixture.

requirement: Pager plugin push collapse seeding and installed notice unit checks
contract: The plugin tests SHALL open an in-memory Plugins modal and require a live PluginsChanged to replace loaded data without changing previously seeded collapsed groups. When the push wins the first-load race, user and config origin groups must seed collapsed once; manually expanding user then delivering another push must preserve that expansion. A nonempty PluginUpdatesInstalled must produce durable scrollback text containing the heading and both exact version transitions. The tests do not inspect skills Loading/refetch effects, closed modal, empty updates, error paths, plugin ordering, persistence or actual install execution.
scenarios: Existing seed
plugins_groups_seeded is already true
data refreshes while collapse state remains.
First push
a fresh modal receives two origins
both origin groups seed collapsed.
Later push
one group was expanded after seeding
the expansion survives delivery.
Installed
two update tuples arrive
one durable notice contains both version transitions.
Skills
PluginsChanged fires
this module does not assert the skills refetch path.

requirement: Pager goal projection retired wire replay and history isolation unit checks
contract: The goal unit tests SHALL send public notifications and require an active long-term goal to map id, objective, status, optional budget, usage, elapsed and status message. A payload adding retired plan_markdown must be rejected with no goal state. Replay while Goal behavior is active must hydrate active/paused/active/complete state without scrollback. Across Goal, Normal, Clarify, Plan and Workflow, active/paused/blocked/budget_limited/complete updates must change state without history; cleared must remove state/detail, record last id and keep history empty. After one successful `/goal clear` UiNotice, repeated clear plus stale active must leave behavior unchanged, reject the stale state, and retain exactly one collapsed command notice. The tests do not cover usage_incomplete, timestamp validation, multiple goal ids, budget exhaustion runtime, persistence, rendering detail contents beyond the notice or actual goal execution.
scenarios: Projection
an active fixture arrives
long-term fields map into GoalDisplayState.
Retired field
plan_markdown is added to the canonical update
deserialization rejects it and no state appears.
Replay
four states hydrate during loading replay
goal projection changes without transcript rows.
Behavior matrix
five statuses arrive under each supported behavior
state changes without duplicate history.
Clear
cleared arrives
goal/detail clear and last_cleared_goal_id records g1.
Stale after clear
command success then repeated clear and active update arrive
only one collapsed command notice remains and stale active is rejected.

requirement: Pager background task replay routing demotion and completion unit checks
contract: The background-task unit module SHALL exercise generic replay restoration for TaskBackgrounded and scheduled create/delete; Execute-to-background demotion including late detection and description cleanup; root/direct-child routing for start, completion and monitor events; monitor prefix classification; session_restart quiet completion versus other-signal failure output; inactive-owner mutation with false redraw; unknown-session rejection; and replay marker storage. These are direct in-memory handler tests. They do not run an ACP transport, persisted replay, a background process, cumulative stdout parsing, scheduled firing, unknown-task completion, nested descendants, or the actual test binary.
scenarios: Replay envelope
generic grow/session/update replays background and schedule lifecycle updates
background state restores and scheduled create/delete nets back to empty.
Demotion
a pending Execute is backgrounded normally or after late detection
the existing row stops running, tracking and deferred keys drain, and no duplicate row is created.
Ownership
start, completion or monitor events address a root or direct child
only the addressed concrete view mutates; an inactive owner still mutates but returns false.
Monitor and description
structured or legacy monitor data and blank wire descriptions vary
monitor classification and the tested deferred-description fallback hold.
Completion
a restored task ends with session_restart or a live task ends with another signal
the former finalizes quietly while the latter adds a failure block.
Unknown and replay
the session is unknown or notification metadata marks replay
unknown events return false; a restored task records restored_from_replay.

requirement: Pager command feedback memory correlation and compaction replay unit checks
contract: The command-feedback unit module SHALL verify that newer command progress survives an older terminal notice, its own terminal clears live feedback, and later progress for that completed correlation is rejected; replay progress stays non-live and duplicate event-id terminal notices produce one immutable row. Memory result checks require a matching pending live invocation, open the browser once, clear pending state on a command warning or replay start, and reject stale or replayed results. Manual compaction completion is appended immediately without a later finish-turn duplicate, while duplicate replay deliveries for manual, async, failed and cancelled terminals each leave one row. These tests use in-memory handlers and do not execute persistence, reconnect transport, memory loading, modal rendering, compaction, or the test binary.
scenarios: Progress ownership
older and newer progress correlations coexist before the older terminal arrives
the newer live status remains until its own terminal clears it, and late progress is rejected.
Replay notice
progress and a duplicated terminal event id replay
progress does not animate and one terminal row remains.
Memory correlation
unsolicited, stale, matching and repeated memory results arrive
only the first matching live result opens a browser.
Memory invalidation
a command warning or begin_replay clears a pending browse
later live or replayed empty results do not open a browser.
Manual compaction
manual synchronous completion precedes finish_turn
the immutable completion row appears immediately and is not appended again.
Compaction replay
each supported terminal outcome is replayed twice with one event id
one scrollback row remains for that outcome.

requirement: Pager parked lifecycle and broadcast interjection unit checks
contract: The interjection unit module SHALL verify that an interjection arriving while a turn is parked adds its prompt block without a turn marker, background completions and repeated subagent finishes remain markerless during that park, and re-parking after intervening parent output also creates no marker. Broadcast checks require a matching active root and an attached viewer to render, an unknown session to remain unchanged, an originator-owned interjection id to suppress its echo and be forgotten, and a foreign id to render. These direct in-memory fixtures do not exercise ACP transport, child-session interjection delivery, persistence/replay, terminal drawing, queue submission, model ingestion, or a real parked process.
scenarios: Parked interjection
a broadcast arrives during a task-output park
the interjection appears and no turn marker is inserted.
Parked completions
background tasks or repeated subagents finish during the park
no turn markers or work-only status lines are introduced by the tested sequence.
Re-park
parent output occurs between two waits on the same task
the second park remains markerless.
Root and viewer
a broadcast addresses the root session in driver or viewer state
the interjection block renders and the active owner reports affected.
Unknown
the broadcast session does not match
false returns and no interjection block is added.
Echo identity
the optional id is owned locally or belongs to another pane
the local echo is consumed and forgotten, while the foreign interjection renders.

requirement: Pager coordination sideband lifecycle replay and source-tool unit checks
contract: The coordination unit module SHALL verify that a live incoming-inquiry sideband is restored after full or cursor reload finalization without taking foreground activity, while an unstructured receipt is a finite notice. Outgoing source audit notices stay hidden in live and replay paths, but actual list_active_sessions and ask_session tool calls retain ordinary running-to-collapsed terminal rows and their full prompt output. A target inquiry start, approval and terminal update mutate one passive row in place, survive foreground finish, preserve manual expansion and expose audit details; replay duplicates and later start/terminal events cannot duplicate or resurrect it. Failed, cancelled and rejected outcomes finish that original row as unsuccessful, and unrelated runtime-health errors remain visible notices. These are in-memory reducer checks and do not run coordination IPC, reload storage, tool execution, terminal rendering, multi-owner routing, or the test binary.
scenarios: Reload sideband
a live start is followed by full or cursor replay finalization and a fresh transient snapshot
one running passive row survives while the foreground session remains Idle.
Unstructured receipt
coordination details cannot deserialize to an inquiry identity
a finite Notice is rendered with no running entry.
Source projection
outgoing audits and real coordination tools are processed
audits stay hidden while tools use normal terminal rows with full converted output.
Target lifecycle
start, approval and completion share one inquiry id
one independent row updates in place, survives foreground finish, preserves expansion and contains audit details.
Replay and lateness
start/completion replay and then arrive again live
the finished row remains single and cannot be resurrected.
Failure and health
failure, cancellation, rejection or runtime-unavailable notices arrive
inquiry terminals become unsuccessful foldable rows and runtime health remains a visible Notice.

requirement: Pager permission argument recap pane and cleanup unit checks
contract: The permission unit module SHALL verify MCP argument projection for UseTool and MCPTool, omission for non-MCP, missing and null shapes, Unicode-scalar line capping, and the 200-line-plus-summary storage cap. Recap checks require manual application to clear recap live status and leave one fresh terminal block, automatic application to preserve that status, and late-auto admission to depend on automatic, replay and idle flags. Permission enqueue checks require the first request from Scrollback to stash that pane and focus Prompt, preserve Prompt/Queue/Tasks ownership, avoid re-stealing on a second request, and restore Scrollback after selection. Replay cleanup cancels queued requests and restores draft/pane state; child-terminal cleanup cancels only matching requests, advances retained focus and preserves shared stashes. These are in-memory helper/dispatch tests and do not execute an MCP tool, render the permission or recap UI, run transport replay, exercise auto-approval, validate every permission option, or run the test binary.
scenarios: MCP arguments
raw input is MCP, another tool shape, missing or null
only MCP nonnull tool_input is pretty-projected.
Argument bounds
one line exceeds the scalar limit or the payload exceeds the line limit
the line ends with one ellipsis and stored output is capped with a hidden-count summary.
Recap application
manual or automatic recap is applied with live recap status
manual clears status and stays fresh; automatic appends while retaining the status.
Late automatic recap
automatic, replay and idle flags vary
only a busy live automatic recap is dropped by the tested predicate.
Pane ownership
the first permission arrives from Scrollback, Prompt, Queue or Tasks and a second can follow
only the first Scrollback transition is stashed and moved to Prompt.
Selection restore
the stashed Scrollback request resolves by allow-once
the queue empties and Scrollback ownership restores.
Replay cleanup
transport interactions are cleared for replay
the request is cancelled and the prior draft and pane restore.
Child cleanup
one of two queued requests is reassigned to a terminating child
only that request is cancelled, the retained request resets to Options and stashes remain.

requirement: Pager MCP progress owner modal patch and catalog refresh unit checks
contract: The MCP handler unit module SHALL verify seeded progress updates in place without moving started_at, unseeded creation, N-server and zero-server progress-to-initialized clearing, and session-id routing that updates or clears a background root without touching the active root or requesting redraw. Unknown roots and direct child session ids are rejected. Server-status checks require a loaded owner modal to receive status and tool details while an active non-owner remains untouched; closed foreground/background modals and loading data schedule no effect or redraw, and a missing status does not coerce to Unavailable. The canonical shell payload round-trips Ready. A configuration catalog delta without tools schedules one FetchMcpsList for the owning agent, while a payload without sessionId is rejected. These in-memory tests do not start MCP servers, exercise shell transport, render the modal, cover errored data or pending-fetch deduplication, patch every status/reason, or run the test binary.
scenarios: Progress mutation
progress is seeded or absent and updates arrive
values update in place with the seeded timestamp preserved, or a new progress object is created.
Lifecycle
three-server or zero-server progress reaches initialized
the root progress overlay clears.
Owner routing
progress or initialized addresses a background root
only that root mutates and false redraw is returned.
Rejected owner
initialized addresses an unknown or direct child session
the parent and active root progress remain unchanged.
Loaded modal
server status with tools addresses a background owner modal
that owner row becomes Ready with two tools while the active agent remains unchanged.
Cheap paths
the owner modal is closed or its data is Loading
no row mutation, effect or redraw is produced.
Wire status
status is missing or the canonical shell Ready payload round-trips
malformed input leaves Initializing unchanged and canonical serialization retains ready.
Catalog refresh
a config delta omits tools with or without sessionId
the owner receives one FetchMcpsList only when session identity is present.

requirement: Pager settings verb grouping auto gate and soft permission default unit checks
contract: The settings unit module SHALL verify that a present remote group_tool_verbs value and its later omission re-resolve the full local/environment/default chain, while an effective flip clears stale verb-group expansion. Disabling the Auto gate clears every root session in Auto regardless of the active UI mirror and emits one session-scoped Ask transition per Auto session while preserving an AlwaysApprove sibling. Settings payload announcements are ignored even when another field applies. Permission soft-default checks require a user-owned mode to block re-arm, field omission to preserve the latch and display without recomputation, a present field to reach the applier, remote AlwaysApprove to update default and UI without persistence, explicit null to recompute back to Ask, and a disabled Auto gate to clamp remote Auto to Ask. The grouping assertions can be short-circuited by higher-priority host configuration as stated in the tests. These in-memory checks do not exercise settings transport, disk persistence, announcement delivery, UI drawing, agent acknowledgement, concurrent pushes, or the test binary.
scenarios: Verb resolution
remote grouping is enabled and then omitted
the resolved chain is recomputed instead of retaining the old remote value.
Grouping flip
an expanded read group exists and the effective setting flips off
the stale group header expansion clears and rows render individually.
Auto kill switch
multiple roots are Auto while the active mirror says Ask
all Auto roots leave Auto and receive scoped Ask notifications; AlwaysApprove remains.
Announcements
settings/update contains announcements plus a supported field
announcements remain sourced from their dedicated push while the supported field applies.
User claim and omission
permission mode is user-owned or the soft-default field is absent
remote re-arm is blocked for the user claim and omitted data preserves soft state.
Soft application
a latched soft default receives AlwaysApprove
default and display update without a persistence effect.
Explicit null
the latched remote permission field is explicitly null
soft AlwaysApprove recomputes to Ask without persistence.
Auto clamp
a latched remote Auto arrives while its gate is disabled
Ask is displayed and AlwaysApprove remains disarmed.

requirement: Pager scheduled task fire upsert linkage and owner routing unit checks
contract: The scheduled-task unit module SHALL verify that firing a known task changes only next_fire_at, including clearing it with None, while an unknown task is created from a payload only when a next fire exists. Every fire updates last_subagent_id to its latest detached child. A created update upserts prompt, schedule and next fire without changing created_at or prior child linkage. Fire, create and delete notifications route by root session id even when another agent is active, mutate only the owner and return false for background redraw. These in-memory checks do not exercise scheduler persistence, clock parsing/countdown rendering, replay, direct child session routing, provisional-row clearing, malformed or unknown sessions, missed-task removal delivery, task execution, or the test binary.
scenarios: Known fire
an existing task fires with a new or absent next time
only next_fire_at changes and no duplicate is inserted.
Unknown fire
a missing task fires with a next time
a new entry is built from the payload with created_at near now.
Expired unknown
a missing task fires without a next time
the handler reports affected but inserts no entry.
Child linkage
successive fires carry different detached subagent ids
last_subagent_id tracks the latest value.
Created upsert
a create update repeats an existing task id
mutable schedule fields update while created_at and linkage persist.
Background owner
fire, create or delete addresses a non-active root
only that root changes and no redraw is requested.

requirement: Pager session demultiplex race fallback and activity ownership unit checks
contract: The session-routing unit module SHALL verify that assistant chunks route to their owning active or inactive root, or to a registered direct child through its parent, with redraw requested only for the active root; unknown ids are dropped once the active root has an assigned session. During the pre-assignment race, an active root whose session id is None receives an otherwise unmatched chunk, including when multiple roots are unassigned. Plan and AvailableCommands updates mutate the addressed inactive root, command updates increment its generation, and behavior availability refreshes an already-open Settings snapshot. Mapped background Bash stdout updates the inactive owner without renewing foreground activity. Plan activity renews the watchdog only when its prompt id matches the current foreground prompt. Alternating chunks for two roots remain isolated. These in-memory checks do not run ACP transport, nested descendants, viewer adoption, event-id replay/deduplication, malformed payloads, terminal rendering, timeout behavior, or the test binary.
scenarios: Root chunk
a chunk addresses an active or inactive root
it lands only in that root and redraw reflects active ownership.
Direct child
a registered child chunk arrives while another root is active
it lands in the parent-owned child view without redraw.
Unknown
an unmatched id arrives after roots have assigned sessions
the chunk is dropped without mutation.
Creation race
one or several roots have no session id
the currently active unassigned root receives the otherwise unmatched chunk.
Inactive projections
plan, commands or behavior availability address a root
todo and commands mutate their owner, and an open Settings snapshot refreshes.
Background output
mapped Bash stdout addresses an inactive root
its task buffer updates without moving the foreground prompt activity anchor.
Plan activity
plan metadata omits, mismatches or matches the current prompt id
only the matching identity renews foreground liveness.
Two-root isolation
chunks for A and B arrive in sequence while B is active
each root retains only its own text.

requirement: Pager interaction resolution background ownership and plan reopen unit checks
contract: The interaction unit module SHALL verify that InteractionResolved removes the matching root permission, primary-owned child permission, question or plan approval while an unrelated tool-call id leaves state intact; a child resolution with the same call id retains the root request. Permissions for an inactive root queue on that owner without responding, while its AlwaysApprove mode selects allow-once without redraw. A child request does not inherit the parent AlwaysApprove mode and remains in the parent interaction queue; an unknown-session permission is cancelled. Ask-user requests route independently to background roots and sibling direct-child views, with a background child contributing parent needs_input; an unknown session drops the response sender without returning an error payload. Closing a plan viewer preserves approval and its pending response, reopening restores feedback controls, and approving after reopen preserves newly typed prompt text while returning approved. These in-memory checks do not exercise leader relay, ACP wire transport, invalid parameter decoding, nested descendants, replacement of an existing question/approval, rendered UI, timeout behavior, or the test binary.
scenarios: Resolve
a matching permission, child permission, question or plan approval is resolved
only the matching interaction is dismissed and redraw is reported.
Unrelated resolution
the tool-call id does not match
the pending interaction remains unchanged.
Inactive permission
a request addresses an inactive root in Ask or AlwaysApprove
Ask queues without response; AlwaysApprove selects allow-once without redraw.
Child permission
a direct child asks while its parent is AlwaysApprove
the request stays pending in the primary queue and does not inherit auto-approval.
Unknown permission
no root owns the session
no queue changes and a Cancelled response is sent.
Question ownership
background roots or sibling direct children ask questions
each concrete view retains its own pending question and parent activity reflects child input.
Unknown question
no concrete view owns an ask-user request
the sender is dropped, no error response is sent and unrelated UI remains empty.
Plan viewer close
the plan viewer closes before a decision
approval state and response sender remain pending.
Plan reopen
the viewer reopens and approval occurs after new prompt input
feedback controls return, approved is sent and the newer prompt text survives.

requirement: Pager model catalog authoritative change control and child isolation unit checks
contract: The model unit module SHALL verify that process catalog updates preserve a selected model and reasoning effort while present, use the shell default when a selection disappears or no root is active, and make each inactive root fall back independently rather than copying the active model. A follower ModelChanged applies silently, updates user preference and optional effort, while an invoking root with a local sampling control defers the change until that control drains. An unrelated AgentChanged is not blocked by sampling control. An unknown authoritative model waits until a catalog publication makes it resolvable, and an unknown session is dropped. A direct child receives only its own ModelChanged, refreshes an ordinary catalog without losing selection, and rejects a lower event sequence using its own highwater; a workflow-pinned child retains its workflow catalog and agent names across process reload. These are in-memory state tests and do not run leader broadcast, config RPC, model sampling, provider traffic, selector rendering, replay, same-ModelId endpoint or wire-route changes, native conversation reset, nested descendants, or the test binary.
scenarios: Catalog preserve
a selected model and effort remain in a refreshed catalog
the session selection and user effort survive while the process template follows the shell default.
Catalog fallback
a selected model disappears or no root is active
the affected session or template uses the shell default.
Independent roots
an inactive root loses its selected model
it uses the shell default rather than the active root selection.
Follower change
a known ModelChanged arrives with no local control pending
model, preference and optional effort update without a scrollback switch notice.
Local control
ModelChanged races an in-flight sampling control
the update waits and the newest server state applies after that control drains.
Control domain
AgentChanged arrives during sampling control
agent identity applies immediately and is not replayed on sampling drain.
Catalog race
ModelChanged names an unknown model later published
the old selection remains until publication retries the held authoritative state.
Session isolation
ModelChanged targets an unknown root or one direct child
unknown is dropped; child updates without changing the root.
Child catalog
an ordinary child receives process catalog refresh and later ModelChanged
available models refresh while its current selection is preserved until the explicit change.
Child highwater
child events arrive with sequence 12 then 11
the second is rejected and child cursor/highwater remain at 12.
Workflow pin
a workflow child has pinned model and agent metadata
process catalog reload does not replace its catalog, selection or workflow names.

requirement: Pager plan approval Behavior confirmation and held FIFO unit checks
contract: The plan-mode unit module SHALL verify that a nonblank plan approval uses request content even without a tracked tool, opens or can reopen its preview, dismisses competing modal and block viewers, remains interactive in AlwaysApprove, and routes to its background root without affecting the active root. Missing content returns an error and a later invalid request preserves the current plan. Tool-call titles cannot activate or deactivate Plan; supported CurrentModeUpdate is authoritative, unknown ids are ignored, and an idempotent supported update still requests refresh. ConfirmationRequired retains the source Behavior, projects the target/banner, keeps a deferred Behavior FIFO held, but permits an unrelated deferred Agent identity to apply. Applied or a matching initial identity releases held work under the new Behavior, while an initial different identity does not. Applied clears Plan, leaving Workflow closes its management view, Rejected retains the source without a local toast, and terminal outcomes or replay start clear confirmation. These in-memory checks do not execute plan tools, model turns, ACP transport, preview rendering/scrolling, keyboard confirmation, replacement response cancellation, persistence, nested child routing, or the test binary.
scenarios: Approval content
a nonblank approval arrives with or without tracked tool state
request markdown becomes the retained preview.
Approval collision
another modal or block viewer is open
the competing surface closes and plan approval remains interactive.
Invalid approval
content is missing before or after a valid approval
an error is returned without creating or replacing the valid plan.
Mode and owner
approval arrives under AlwaysApprove or for a background root
it still waits for interaction on the owning root and redraw follows visibility.
Tool titles
plan-like ToolCall names or updates arrive
they neither activate nor deactivate Plan.
Authoritative mode
Plan, Normal, unknown or repeated supported CurrentModeUpdate arrives
supported identity projects mode and refresh; unknown leaves state unchanged.
Confirmation
confirmation_required targets Normal from Plan
Plan remains authoritative, target/banner appear and held Behavior work stays queued.
Control domains
a deferred Agent identity exists during Behavior confirmation
Agent identity applies without releasing Behavior-held work.
FIFO release
Applied or the matching deferred identity arrives
deferred mode clears and one queued prompt becomes SendPrompt under the new identity.
Mismatched initial mode
Normal arrives while Plan is deferred
the FIFO remains held until Plan arrives.
Terminal projection
Behavior is applied, rejected, leaves Workflow or replay begins
state follows the authoritative outcome, workflow view and confirmation clear where asserted, and rejection adds no local toast.

requirement: Pager ACP test fixture topology and typed notification builders
contract: The ACP test fixture module SHALL build a base AgentSession as AgentId zero with an optional session id, default model state, /tmp cwd, Ask permission and an unconsumed channel, then wrap it in empty scrollback. Its one-root app activates that root through switch_to_agent; its two-root topology assigns sess-owner to agent zero, sess-active to agent one and activates agent one; its parent-child topology registers one direct child in both metadata and concrete views. Shared builders produce typed ACP/Grow notifications for text, plans, commands, tools, replay/event metadata, permissions, interactions, git, tasks, monitors, models, Behavior and MCP with fixed test defaults, plus state extractors and mutation helpers used by sibling modules. These helpers do not validate arbitrary wire input, perform transport I/O, create nested descendants, or prove behavior beyond the tests that consume them.
scenarios: Base session
a sibling test requests a root fixture
it receives AgentId zero, optional identity, /tmp, Ask mode, default models and empty scrollback.
Two roots
a routing test requests owner and active roots
agent zero owns sess-owner while agent one owns sess-active and is selected canonically.
Direct child
a child fixture is requested
the child id is inserted in parent metadata and subagent_views.
Typed builders
a test needs an ACP or Grow lifecycle message
the helper constructs the canonical typed envelope or explicitly shaped JSON with documented fixed fields.
Extractors
a test reads latest events, messages, todo, tool rows or subagent snapshots
the helper projects only its named narrow view of in-memory state.
Base app
a dispatch test requests test_app
it receives a Welcome AppView with deterministic defaults and no implicit agent/session.
Single agent
a test requests test_app_with_agent
AgentId(0) is inserted with an empty scrollback and Scrollback active pane, then selected as the active agent.
Multiple agents
a routing test requests three_agent_app
placeholder agents 1 and 2 exist beside active agent 0 and switch_to_agent can recognize them.
Session defaults
a fixture creates an AgentSession through make_test_agent_session
the session uses the app ACP sender, optional id, default model state, `/tmp`, Ask mode, and deferred CLI model configuration.
Module topology
the test crate is compiled

the cta_e2e, dashboard, jump, modes, notes, permissions, rewind, router, session, settings, status, task_result, transcript, turn, and turn_pipeline modules are included under this shared fixture scope.

requirement: Pager ACP subagent replay disk fixture isolation and snapshots
contract: The shared subagent replay fixture SHALL allocate a temporary Grow home, install it through the test override and clear that override from a Drop guard. It writes an encoded /tmp session directory with canonical summary, forces updates.jsonl to end in a newline, can write a one-event SubagentSpawned timeline with fixed model and transport metadata, and can spawn through grow/session/update with optional prior updates. Snapshot helpers require the child and its lifecycle row to exist and project selected spawn/finish fields; count helpers inspect only tool rows or exact nonblank user prompts. This fixture performs real temporary file writes but does not run session/load transport, test corruption/partial writes, fsync or locking, validate arbitrary timelines, retain the temporary directory, or represent production cleanup.
scenarios: Isolation
a replay disk closure begins and ends
a unique temporary home is installed thread-locally and cleared by Drop.
Updates
child update content lacks a trailing newline
the fixture writes one before saving updates.jsonl beside a canonical summary.
Timeline
a subagent spawn timeline is requested
one fixed Spawned event is serialized as JSONL with test model transport metadata.
Spawn
optional child updates exist before the spawn notification
files are written first and the typed lifecycle then enters the handler.
Snapshots
spawn or finish state is projected
the helper requires existing metadata/rows and returns only its fixed field subset.
Counts
tool rows or exact prompt text are queried
only matching concrete child scrollback blocks are counted, and blank prompt queries return zero.

requirement: Pager ACP workflow title and transient context fixture unit checks
contract: The four direct tests in the shared ACP module SHALL verify that workflow command projection retains name, description and workflowSource, duplicate open-workflow refresh requests coalesce into one FetchWorkflowsList for the owning session, and same-name workflow entries with different description/path project differently. Canonical SessionInfoUpdate title metadata sets generated title, while source user also sets display name. A transient context-pressure SessionInfo update with totalTokens refreshes context used without appending scrollback. These tests use in-memory handlers and do not execute workflow discovery, title persistence, context compaction, modal rendering, transport, malformed metadata, stale sequence ordering, or the test binary.
scenarios: Workflow projection
one project workflow command is projected
name, description and source are retained.
Refresh coalescing
the same open modal refresh is queued twice
one owner-scoped FetchWorkflowsList remains.
Metadata change
same workflow name has different description and path
the projected command collections differ.
Generated title
generated then user SessionInfo titles arrive
generated title follows both and display name is set only by the user source in the sequence.
Context pressure
transient metadata carries totalTokens 123456
context used becomes 123456 and scrollback length is unchanged.

requirement: Pager reconnect reload staging, transcript rollback and todo stash unit checks
contract: reconnect fixtures SHALL exercise begin_session_reload/finish_session_reload through an in-memory AppView and SHALL verify full replay replacement, failed reload rollback, cursor-tail merge, superseded-generation fencing, transient-load cleanup and Plan/todo stash semantics. The checks characterize committed scrollback, reconnect cursor, ACP/Grow highwaters, entry-id allocation, loading status and foreground state; they do not establish a real reconnect transport or persisted session/load behavior.
scenarios: Full replay success
A pre-outage transcript is followed by replay chunks and a successful reload finalization
The replayed transcript replaces the stash, reload status/batch state disappears, the cursor follows the replay tail and the root is Idle.
Reload failure rollback
Partial replay plus live ACP and Grow traffic advances state inside a reload window that then fails
The pre-outage transcript, cursor and both stream highwaters are restored; staged blocks are discarded and later entry ids do not reuse ids allocated by staging.
Cursor-resolved tail
Only a live post-cursor tail arrives and the existing transcript has a running entry
The old transcript is kept, the tail is appended, the old running entry is force-idled, and the next live delta opens one new entry with the ACP highwater advanced.
Generation fencing
A reload supersedes an unfinished reload or interrupts a fresh-view load
Partial staging from the old generation is discarded, stale finalization is rejected, the original stash is recoverable, and transient loading feedback/batches do not leak into committed scrollback.
Todo stash outcomes
Plan updates occur before, during, or not at all during a reload
Failure restores the pre-outage todo pane; a cursor merge keeps an in-window live plan, while a merge without a plan keeps the stashed plan.
sources: SessionReload / PendingStopHooks / PendingForkBanner / AgentView::session_reload / AgentView::workflow_blocks / SELF_ORIGINATED_PROMPT_CAP / REWOUND_PROMPT_ID_CAP

requirement: Pager ACP/Grow event deduplication, replay gating and reconnect cursor unit checks
contract: root event fixtures SHALL send ACP and Grow notifications through the in-memory handlers and SHALL assert per-stream highwaters, applied-only reconnect cursor advancement, replay admission, stale prompt drops and context-token freshness. ACP and Grow highwaters are tested as separate domains; replay is exempt from live highwater seeding, unexpected replay is dropped, and updates without an eventId remain applicable. These are direct reducer checks and do not prove wire ordering, durable replay storage or terminal rendering.
scenarios: Root token routing
A token notification addresses the active root before or after its session_id is assigned
The root context usage is updated in both cases.
ACP highwater
Duplicate or lower event ids, a higher id, an id-less update, and replay ids are delivered

Duplicate/lower live events are dropped without affecting highwater, higher events apply and advance it, id-less updates apply without changing it, and replay does not seed it so a reset-low live id can apply after resume.
Grow highwater isolation
Grow updates are duplicated, stale, unhandled, or delivered before a delayed lower-id ACP chunk

Handled Grow duplicates/lower ids are dropped, unhandled kinds advance neither cursor nor highwater, and a direct Grow id does not suppress a lower ACP event because the streams have separate highwaters.
Applied-only cursor
Plan, background stdout, unexpected replay, duplicate, and stale-prompt updates are delivered
Applied arms advance the reconnect cursor; dropped or unhandled updates leave it unchanged, and replay outside a load window does not append or advance it.
Replay/live cursor ordering
A live Grow update is followed by an older replay update in one reload window
The cursor remains at the live event rather than regressing to the older replay id.
Context freshness
A fresh high-token event is followed by a stale lower-token event, or by a higher event
A deduped stale event cannot regress context_used, while a genuinely higher event updates it and advances the ACP highwater.

requirement: Pager reconnect replay terminal, subagent view and held-model unit checks
contract: reconnect replay fixtures SHALL verify that a replayed subagent spawn hydrates a child view while leaving an unpaired child row unresolved, that a terminal observed in replay prevents reconnect adoption of the running prompt, and that an unknown Grow ModelChanged is ingested into cursor/highwater state until a later catalog update can resolve it. The assertions characterize pager state only; they do not prove leader routing, model catalog RPC, or durable replay persistence.
scenarios: Replayed child spawn without finish
A reload replay contains SubagentSpawned but no SubagentFinished, followed by a live child delta after swap
The child row remains unfinished, its child view is tracked, and the delivered child delta still renders into that view.
Terminal in replay
A running prompt receives a replayed TurnCompleted before reconnect finalization/adoption
The prompt is recorded as terminal in replay, finalization succeeds, adoption is skipped and the root is Idle.
Held unknown model
ModelChanged names an unavailable model and a later update names a known catalog model
The unknown value is held while its event cursor and Grow highwater advance; the later known value applies and advances both markers.

requirement: Pager subagent live lifecycle and owner routing unit checks
contract: 子代理 ACP 单元测试 SHALL 通过内存 AppView 与公共 handler fixture 验证嵌套子代理登记到根 Agent 的扁平 descendant map，子代理 model/agent/activity 与终态字段回写父任务投影；SubagentPermissionDecision 只在父滚动区生成结构化审计块并保留显示标题、访问摘要、原因和结果标签，spawn 传入的 permission/effective mode 独立初始化 child view；普通与 Grow update 两种方法对同一 spawn/finish 生命周期产生等价 Started/Completed 投影。workflow-owned child 不产生孤儿生命周期行；非活动 owner 仍登记和更新而不请求重绘，未知 session 与畸形 params 不修改状态；context compact 也更新其匹配的非活动 owner。测试不执行 ACP transport、leader、真实 child process 或终端渲染。
scenarios: Nested projection
WHEN root spawns child and child spawns grandchild, then child model/agent/progress/finish events arrive
THEN the root owns flat descendant routing, parent SubagentInfo receives the projected fields, and finish marks the descendant terminal.
Permission audit projection
WHEN a registered child emits permission decisions with unavailable, approved, denied, and timed-out outcomes

THEN one structured parent scrollback block is emitted per decision, the compact identity uses the Subagents title rather than the session id, access/reason text is retained, and the outcome labels are preserved.
Mode and method parity
WHEN a spawn supplies independent permission and effective modes, or the same lifecycle is delivered through grow/session_notification and grow/session/update
THEN the child view keeps its own mode and both methods produce the same spawn and terminal snapshots.
Workflow and owner boundaries
WHEN a workflow child, an inactive root, an unknown session, malformed params, or an inactive root's AutoCompactCompleted update is handled
THEN workflow children avoid orphan rows, known inactive owners mutate without redraw, unknown/malformed input is a no-op, and context usage changes the addressed owner.
Activity projection
WHEN a live child chunk and SubagentProgress arrive before SubagentFinished
THEN the mutable child activity label is stamped and later cleared while the immutable Started scrollback row remains intact.

requirement: Pager subagent durable replay, transcript restore and lazy-open unit checks
contract: 子代理回放测试 SHALL 用 `_meta.isReplay` 与 eventId 构造生命周期事件，并用独立临时 grow home 写入 parent timeline、child summary 与 updates.jsonl；测试 SHALL 覆盖 spawn/finish 回放的终态合并、重复事件幂等、finish-before-spawn 顺序、terminal entity 保留、kill orphan 的 fallback/真实状态，以及重连后 child control identity 不被重置。恢复时 SHALL 从 parent 的 canonical spawn fact 找到 direct child 的 owned disk layout，回放 child updates 和 prompt enrichment，按 eventId 高水位消除 live overlap；resume 期间延迟 transcript load 到首次 fullscreen open，finished child 仍可懒加载完整 transcript，prompt echo 只显示一次，已完成回放不会重复，缺 updates.jsonl 为 no-op。测试证据仅覆盖内存 handler 加临时文件 fixture，不证明真实磁盘迁移、ACP transport、进程存活或跨测试并发行为。
scenarios: Replay lifecycle convergence
WHEN replayed spawn/finish events are duplicated, arrive finish-before-spawn, or a replayed child is killed

THEN the entity remains terminal with one Started and one terminal row, an existing terminal's status/counters are preserved, ordering does not append a reversed Started row, and kill finalization uses cancelled only when no real terminal status exists.
Control identity preservation
WHEN a child has an armed dispatch generation and the durable spawn fact is replayed after session reload
THEN the semantic control generation and dispatch token remain identical.
Owned restore and live deduplication
WHEN parent timeline and child updates.jsonl contain a nested spawn plus model/agent events, then the same event is delivered from the live buffer
THEN descendant state, prompt/model/agent enrichment and event highwater restore once, and the replay/live overlap adds no second scrollback projection.
Lazy transcript replay
WHEN a child spawn occurs during parent loading_replay, or a finished child is opened after resume
THEN child updates are not eagerly loaded, opening fullscreen loads the transcript exactly once, the finished child is idle while deferred, and the completed footer is restored on open.
Prompt and empty-log boundaries
WHEN a timeline task prompt is also echoed in child updates, or the child has no updates.jsonl
THEN the task appears exactly once with tool calls retained, while an absent updates file leaves child scrollback empty and marks replay complete without inventing content.

requirement: Pager session control projection live replay and reconnect unit checks
contract: The pager control-state unit tests SHALL establish the following facts. Pending control updates remain transient and the newest revision owns the live status; an Applied terminal for Sampling, Agent or Behavior commits one visible terminal notice and clears the live status, while a stale terminal is ignored. Clean replay hydrates control state without a new notice unless it settles the exact local intent preserved across reconnect. A pre-assignment snapshot seeds the epoch before the session id is bound; a receipt-only historical terminal cannot replace a newer live target; duplicate terminals are single per epoch and a retired epoch cannot append a late terminal. A child terminal retains its supplied durable event id and child replay hydrates silently. These are in-memory handler checks only: they do not exercise ACP transport, persistence, actual control RPCs, terminal rendering, nested descendants or provider behavior.
scenarios: Live transient and terminal projection
A fresh session receives a snapshot, two Pending revisions and the latest Applied terminal, followed by an older Applied terminal.
Only the latest desired target remains in live control status; Pending adds no scrollback row, the latest terminal appends one row and clears live status, and the stale terminal is ignored.
Domain and replay behavior
Fresh Sampling, Agent and Behavior terminals arrive, then historical terminals are replayed with and without an exact pending local intent.
Each fresh domain appends one notice; ordinary replay only hydrates state, while a replay that resolves the exact local intent clears pending state and remains visible.
Reconnect epoch ownership
A control snapshot arrives before session assignment, a receipt-only old target races a newer live target, and terminals repeat across old and new epochs.
The new epoch is accepted after binding, the old receipt cannot obscure the live target, each epoch contributes one immutable row, and a retired epoch cannot append a late row.
Child durable identity
A direct child receives a live control terminal with an event id and then a replayed terminal.
The child row keeps the event id and replay does not add another visible row.

requirement: Pager auto compaction image and child event unit checks
contract: The pager session-event unit tests SHALL establish the following facts. AutoCompactStarted moves the in-flight prompt into the held prompt and marks compaction activity; AutoCompactFailed preserves the held prompt. ImageDropped emits one newline-joined scrollback notice. Successful ImageCompressed is invisible in the TUI in live and replay state, while the empty-image fallback emits a persistent scrollback warning without a toast. Async completion preserves the foreground prompt, applies the latest todo/context state and emits one notification; live synchronous completion is deferred until turn finish, prefers a confirmed context count over a stale estimate, and falls back to the estimate when unconfirmed. Child completion updates both SubagentInfo and the child context numerator, child start does not reset that numerator, a missing child view returns false while still updating existing SubagentInfo, and unknown or unhandled child events return false. The existing command-feedback requirement already covers duplicate replay terminal rows, so this draft does not claim that overlapping replay assertion as new coverage.
scenarios: Compaction start and failure
Compaction starts with an in-flight prompt and then fails.
The prompt is held and removed from in-flight state at start, and remains held after failure.
Image notice projection
Dropped notes, successful compression and re-encode fallback notifications arrive in live or replay state.
Dropped notes are one newline-joined row; successful compression is invisible; fallback is a persistent row with no transient toast.
Async and deferred completion
Async completion races newer todos or an in-flight prompt, or live synchronous completion is followed by context refresh and turn finish.

New todos and the foreground prompt survive, one async notice remains, synchronous output waits for turn finish, and the confirmed count wins over an estimate while an unconfirmed completion uses its estimate.
Child context routing
A child receives compact start/completion, or the child view is missing or the event is unsupported.
Completion updates child view and SubagentInfo context values; start leaves the existing numerator unchanged; missing or unknown targets return false with only the asserted data update.
Unsupported root event
An unrelated session event reaches the root apply_session_event helper.
The helper returns false and does not claim a visible mutation.

requirement: Pager retry state error projection unit checks
contract: The pager retry-state unit tests SHALL establish the following facts. Retrying clears the in-flight prompt without adding a warning, retry activity or failure flag. A failure tagged with an old or already finalized prompt id is ignored. Exhausted rate-limited and non-rate-limited states mark the model failure as reported; an empty rate-limit reason uses the neutral user message, while an API 429 wrapper exposes the server detail. Failed 401, BYOK and generic provider errors remain RetryFailed, BYOK rejection clears the in-flight prompt, context_length becomes ContextTooLarge, and a recent CompactionFailed row suppresses a duplicate context prompt. These assertions are in-memory reducer checks and do not execute retries, providers, diagnostics backends or transport.
scenarios: Retrying and stale failure
Retrying is applied, or a failure carries a prompt id belonging to an older/finalized turn.
Recovery clears the prompt without user-facing failure state, and stale/foreign failure changes nothing visible or in session flags.
Exhaustion and rate-limit text
Rate-limited or ordinary retry exhaustion is projected, with empty or wrapped server reasons.
The failure flag is set, the neutral rate-limit message is used when reason is empty, and the API wrapper is removed while server detail remains.
Provider and context failures
401, BYOK, generic, context_length and prior CompactionFailed errors are projected.
Provider failures remain RetryFailed, BYOK clears the prompt, context_length emits ContextTooLarge, and an existing compaction failure prevents a duplicate context row.

requirement: Pager typed UI notice category and correlation unit checks
contract: The pager typed-notice unit tests SHALL establish the following facts. A command UiNotice without an event id may be delivered twice with the same correlation id and still creates two rows; each row retains Command/Error mapping and has no event id. A lifecycle UiNotice retains Lifecycle/Warning mapping and its recovery details. These tests only exercise in-memory notice projection. The coordination target-row assertion in this file is covered by the existing coordination requirement and is intentionally excluded from this additive draft.
scenarios: Command correlation without event identity
The same command notice is delivered twice without event ids.
The second row is appended, correlation does not act as immutable identity, and the projected notice remains Command/Error with event_id=None.
Lifecycle recovery details
A lifecycle warning notice includes recovery details.
The projected row remains Lifecycle/Warning and preserves the recovery text.
Child command notice identity
A direct child receives a command warning with a durable event id.
The child row retains the Error tone and supplied event id.

requirement: Pager dashboard location picker and git worktree toggle unit checks
contract: Dashboard dispatcher tests SHALL pin location-input expansion, picker-instance scoped completion, foreground-only cwd changes, success/error modal behavior, git ancestry refresh, and the repository gate for worktree mode.
scenarios: Location resolution
absolute, relative, home-prefixed, or blank input is resolved
paths expand against cwd/home and blank input is rejected.
Picker and cwd boundary
a picker is reopened or a cwd change is requested from foreground, background, valid, or invalid state
stale completions are ignored, only foreground valid directories update cwd/root and close, and errors retain the picker.
Worktree gate
cwd git ancestry and the picker or keyboard toggle vary
worktree dispatch persists only inside a git repository and unavailable toggles explain the refusal.

requirement: Pager dashboard worktree session creation and attachment preservation unit checks
contract: Dashboard worktree tests SHALL pin dialog staging versus normal creation, attach and stay-on-dashboard confirmation paths, missing-repository refusal, staged model/effort/plan propagation, image/chip preservation through dispatch, cancellation rewind, deferred clipboard probing, and independent dispatch/peek stashes.
scenarios: Dialog staging
worktree mode is active in or outside a repository and a button or prompt dispatch occurs
repository dispatch opens a label dialog and stashes intent while non-repository creation follows the normal path.
Confirmed creation
a worktree dialog is confirmed with attach true or false
CreateWorktreeSession carries the label/model, replays prompt configuration, and either opens detail or stays on dashboard.
Attachment races
image prompts are stashed, cancelled, resent, or awaiting a clipboard probe
image bytes/chips survive, dispatch waits for the probe, and dispatch plus peek stashes reissue independently.

requirement: Pager dashboard roster source and loading lifecycle unit checks
contract: Dashboard roster tests SHALL pin availability outside leader mode, eager source-specific loading, loading completion on success or failure, storage of local idle sessions, and leader-mode selection between live and local rosters.
scenarios: Open and fetch
dashboard opens with leader mode disabled or enabled
it opens in both cases and fetches respectively local sessions or the live roster, with leader loading visible.
Completion and source
roster tasks succeed or fail and leader mode changes
loading clears and dashboard_roster returns the correct stored source.

requirement: Pager dashboard slash staging and deferred spawn configuration unit checks
contract: Session-less dashboard command tests SHALL pin next-session model, effort, behavior, and permission staging; shared selector input; plan prompt transformation; rejection of unavailable session-only commands; open-time reseeding; live peek response classification; and propagation of staged configuration with serialized first-prompt admission.
scenarios: Command staging
model, effort, plan, clarify, permission, or bare selector commands run
configuration is staged independently for the next session with typed success/error feedback and transformed plan content.
Command rejection
unknown, removed, diagnostic, fork, or compact commands run on the session-less dashboard
no agent spawns, input clears, and the matching error feedback is surfaced.
Spawn configuration
dispatch, new-agent, worktree, or SessionCreated paths consume staged values
model and effort reach creation/deferred switches, behavior is optimistic and deferred, permissions apply, and the first prompt remains parked until authoritative mode update.
Peek activity
turn and tool activity conflict with stale scrollback
live activity determines Working versus Response.

requirement: Pager dashboard new session dispatch focus and attach unit checks
contract: Dashboard dispatch and attach tests SHALL pin one-character minimum input, whitespace rejection, always-new-session semantics independent of selected rows, Enter versus attach behavior, top-level and subagent attachment, lazy child transcript replay, deterministic initial focus, repeat spawning, manual-scroll reset, and unopened-dashboard no-op selection.
scenarios: Dispatch routing
nonempty or empty input is sent with button, top-level, subagent, or no selection
every nonempty dispatch creates a new session, plain Enter stays, attach dispatch opens detail, and whitespace is rejected.
Attach routing
top-level or subagent rows attach
top-level detail and overlay state align; child rows open the parent with child focus and lazily replay deferred child history.
Open and navigation state
dashboard opens or reopens from agent, welcome, empty, or populated state and arrow selection runs
focus resets to new-session semantics, repeat dispatch remains new-session, manual scroll clears, and absent dashboard selection is inert.

requirement: Pager dashboard exit overlay and stop transition unit checks
contract: Dashboard exit and overlay tests SHALL pin return-agent restoration, stale-return fallback, subagent-row restoration, overlay exit to dashboard, idle-session close, only-session refusal, running-turn and compaction cancellation, and pending-stop disarming on overlay movement.
scenarios: Exit restoration
dashboard or overlay exits from agent, welcome, dead-return, or subagent context
it returns only to a live recorded target and restores the relevant child row when available.
Overlay stop
the attached session is idle, sole, turn-running, or compacting
it closes and returns, refuses while preserving the sole session, or cancels active work without detaching.
Pending action scope
mouse exit or cycle moves away from an armed stop
that stop confirmation disarms while unrelated pending actions remain.

requirement: Pager dashboard overlay visible-order cycling unit checks
contract: Dashboard overlay cycle tests SHALL pin wraparound through visible top-level rows, filter and pinned ordering, current-view anchoring, operation after dashboard exit or lazy dashboard creation, and no-op guards for singleton, non-agent, disabled, or hidden-current contexts.
scenarios: Visible cycle
