previous or next cycles across multiple visible agents
navigation wraps in rendered order, respects filters and pins, and anchors on the actually viewed agent.
Lazy attach
cycle begins from an ordinary agent with no open dashboard
a real multi-agent cycle materializes configured dashboard state and attaches the landed agent.
No-op guards
fewer than two visible agents, a non-agent view, disabled dashboard, or hidden current agent is encountered
no arbitrary view switch or dashboard materialization occurs.
Rendered order
agents have different activity order or pinned rows
the returned IDs follow build_rows/render order, with pinned top-level rows first when configured.
Filter projection
DashboardState.filter hides rows
only top-level rows still visible under that filter are returned.
Subagent exclusion
visible rows include child rows beneath a top-level agent
child IDs do not appear in the cycle order.
Overflow exclusion
a parent has a synthetic more-placeholder row
the placeholder is skipped and only the parent top-level ID remains eligible.
No visible attachable rows
the filter hides all top-level rows or the map has no matching rows
the result is empty so the caller can treat cycling as a no-op.

requirement: Pager dashboard rename promotion and reopen state unit checks
contract: Dashboard state tests SHALL pin top-level rename commit/cancel/Esc paths, empty and subagent refusal, header promotion rendering and input routing, in-memory draft/filter preservation across reopen, toggle-close behavior, and stale pin collection.
scenarios: Rename
a top-level rename is typed, committed, cancelled, escaped, blank, or attempted on a child
only a nonblank top-level commit emits RenameSession and changes display name; other paths clear/refuse without mutation.
Promotion CTA
pinned, dismissible, captioned, captionless, or absent header promotion renders
button/caption, hit rectangle, and Ctrl+O routing follow promotion state.
Reopen state
dashboard exits, reopens, opens while open, or contains missing pins
draft/filter memory persists, the second open closes, and stale pins are dropped.

requirement: Pager dashboard delete shortcuts button and list navigation unit checks
contract: Dashboard interaction tests SHALL pin two-step idle deletion with stable next/previous selection, nonduplicated confirmation feedback, shortcuts modal idempotence, create-with-detail attachment, button focus invariants, bounded up/down navigation, and typed state filtering.
scenarios: Idle deletion
Ctrl+X is confirmed on middle or last idle rows
deletion is requested and completion selects the next row or previous fallback without planting duplicate feedback.
Shortcut modal
shortcuts help opens repeatedly or closes
it builds once, preserves query state, and clears on close.
Button navigation
create-with-detail or focus/up/down actions target the virtual new-agent button
view attachment and row/section focus move within bounded list rules.
Filter action
a known state filter is dispatched
dashboard stores the typed state filter.

requirement: Pager dashboard peek recent-line projection unit checks
contract: Dashboard peek extraction tests SHALL pin zero/empty output, placeholder text for tool and background blocks, first-line-only projection, chronological ordering, ANSI stripping, and live activity precedence for response labels.
scenarios: Empty and limits
count is zero or scrollback is empty
no recent lines are returned.
Projection
message, tool, or background blocks are projected
only the first meaningful line or exact placeholder is returned in chronological order.
Sanitization
projected text contains ANSI control sequences
escape bytes are removed while visible content remains.
Pinned current turn
scrollback has older turns, a latest user prompt, and later tool or agent entries
the latest user is painted first and only current-turn body lines appear beneath it.
Fresh user send
the latest entry is a user prompt with no following agent lines
the prompt remains pinned and previous-turn content is not pulled into the body.
Tail truncation
current-turn content exceeds the available rows
a top ellipsis appears below the pin when there is room and the newest command or message lines remain visible.
Dense mode projection
an entry is foldable, a user prompt, a non-foldable block, or hidden thinking is encountered
the corresponding collapse/expanded mode and blank-line filtering rules determine the projected lines.
Empty or invalid area
scrollback is empty, width is zero, or height is zero
paint_peek_live_tail returns without writing a visible row.

requirement: Pager dashboard stop cancellation and delete revalidation unit checks
contract: Dashboard stop tests SHALL pin confirmation expiry, direct subagent kill, post-delete foreground return, roster busy refusal, top-level turn cancellation, background-task stop, queued-prompt drop, confirmation-time busy revalidation, and missing-session-history refusal.
scenarios: Stop by work kind
Ctrl+X targets child, running top-level, scheduled background work, or queued-only work
it respectively emits child kill, cancels the turn, deletes scheduled tasks, or drops queued prompts without arming deletion.
Delete safety
confirmation expires, the row becomes busy, or lacks a session id
deletion rearms or refuses with feedback and never deletes the invalid target.
Completion
a foreground dashboard-owned session deletion completes
the agent is removed and the dashboard becomes active.

requirement: Pager dashboard permission peek reply and attachment unit checks
contract: Dashboard permission and peek-reply tests SHALL pin request-id and row validation, selected permission delivery, idle immediate send versus running queue, image block/chip and rewind preservation, subagent reply refusal, and reject-with-followup metadata.
scenarios: Permission resolution
a matching, stale, or missing-row permission option is selected
matching responses reach the oneshot and dequeue; invalid selections close peek and surface feedback without consuming requests.
Peek reply delivery
text or image replies target idle or running top-level agents
idle replies send immediately, running replies queue, drafts clear, and image/chip state survives whitespace and rewind.
Restricted reply
reply targets a subagent or a rejection carries feedback
child reply is refused and top-level RejectOnce includes followup_message metadata.

requirement: Pager dashboard question peek row visibility and roster attach unit checks
contract: Dashboard question and rendering tests SHALL pin single and multi-question response progression, child-question refusal, peek auto-open and multiline growth, visibility rules for empty local sessions, local-roster reuse, and cross-cwd disk resume.
scenarios: Question progression
top-level Ask questions are answered
single answers submit and clear; multi-question answers advance with draft reset before final submission, while child rows remain parked for fullscreen handling.
Peek rendering
selection appears or clears and reply text gains lines
peek opens/closes with selection and its reply rectangle grows for multiline input.
Row visibility
local sessions are empty-idle, working, titled, or pinned
only unpinned empty-idle sessions are hidden.
Roster attach
roster row matches an existing local agent or only disk history
it reuses and focuses the local top level while clearing child focus, or emits LoadSession with the roster cwd.

requirement: Pager settings registry inventory kind and default end-to-end checks
contract: 设置模态框集成测试 SHALL 双向核对默认注册表与显式 ALL_SETTINGS_EXERCISED 清单；固定 Bool、Enum、DynamicEnum、Int、Group 的键集合与默认值投影，验证初始选择落在 compact_mode、所有顶层 Bool 产生类型化布尔 Action，且同载荷的 SettingValue 变体保持不相等。Group 本身没有标量默认值，子项不作为顶层行。
scenarios: Registry inventory closure
the default registry and the explicit exercised-key matrix are compared in both directions
neither an unexercised registered key nor a stale matrix key is accepted.
Kind catalog
registered entries are partitioned by SettingKind
the pinned Bool, Enum, DynamicEnum, Int, and Group key sets match exactly and no String-kind production entry remains.
Default projection
current_value_for and default_value_for are evaluated from default UI and pager snapshots
each non-group key resolves to the independently pinned bool, enum, string-sentinel, or integer value.
Typed value boundary
top-level Bool rows toggle or equal-looking SettingValue variants are compared
the correct typed setter is returned and Bool, Enum, String, and Int variants remain distinct.

requirement: Pager settings modal lifecycle boolean keyboard mouse and reset end-to-end checks
contract: 设置模态框集成测试 SHALL 固定 Browse 生命周期与基础键鼠语义：F2、Ctrl+,、Cmd+, 关闭，Browse Esc 交由 chrome；Space/Enter 与有效鼠标命中发出对应布尔 setter，contextual_hints 子页可键鼠切换子项；标题、列表外、空 hit-rect 与滚动边界不产生动作。Release 以及会写设置的 Repeat Space/Enter 被丢弃，Repeat 导航保留；d 只为可见可重置设置发出 OpenResetConfirm。
scenarios: Close and fallthrough
close shortcuts or Browse Escape are delivered
explicit close shortcuts return Close while plain Browse Escape remains Unchanged for modal chrome.
Boolean and group activation
a bool or contextual-hints group child is activated by its supported keyboard or mouse path
the matching typed setter is emitted and group Escape returns to Browse.
Mouse boundaries
clicks or scrolling target a selectable row, header, outside area, missing hit rectangles, or list boundary
selection and toggles occur only for valid setting targets and boundary operations stay unchanged.
Event repetition policy
release or repeat key events arrive
release and write-producing repeat activation are dropped while repeat navigation may advance.
Reset targeting
d is pressed on visible scalar settings or a category header
scalar rows emit OpenResetConfirm for their own key and headers remain unchanged.

requirement: Pager settings filter editor navigation cache and rendering end-to-end checks
contract: 过滤集成测试 SHALL 验证 / 进入 FilterFocused，文本、字素、光标、删除与 Ctrl 清除命令按单行查询语义处理；多词查询采用 AND，类别标题仅随命中设置出现，选择只落在可见设置。Enter 保留查询并回到 Browse，Browse Backspace 可继续删查询；g/G、PageUp/PageDown、方向键、鼠标、缓存重建与窄视口渲染都以过滤后的索引为准，无匹配时展示查询。
scenarios: Filter entry and exit
slash opens filtering and Enter or Escape leaves it
query input is consumed without action leakage, Enter preserves the active query, and Escape clears it.
Canonical text editing
grapheme, cursor, delete, line, Ctrl-kill, or unsafe display input is applied
the single-line query follows canonical edit commands and unsafe characters are consumed without insertion.
AND matching and selection
one or more query words narrow the registry
only rows matching every word plus their category headers remain and the selected row stays or clamps to a visible setting.
Filtered navigation and mouse
arrows, page keys, g/G, or mouse hits operate under an active filter
they navigate or activate only visible filtered settings and hidden-row coordinates remain inert.
Cache and render
filtered indices are repeatedly read, the query mutates, or a small viewport renders
unchanged reads reuse the cache, mutations rebuild it, scroll is clamped, and no-match output includes the query.

requirement: Pager settings theme enum preview commit and mouse end-to-end checks
contract: 主题枚举集成测试 SHALL 经生产入口进入 PickingEnum，按注册表顺序预览 theme、auto_dark_theme、auto_light_theme，Enter 用对应 Set Action 提交当前选择，Esc 用 Preview Action 恢复原值并返回 Browse。合成未知 Enum 仅验证结构回退；Browse 鼠标首次选择主题行，而 PickingEnum 内鼠标点击当前保持无动作。
scenarios: Picker entry
Enter activates an enum row
PickingEnum is seeded from the current/default canonical value.
Theme preview
Up or Down changes a preview-capable theme-family choice
the matching PreviewTheme-family action carries the newly focused canonical value.
Theme commit and revert
Enter commits or Escape cancels a theme-family picker
Enter emits the matching Set action, while Escape emits a preview restore and both return to Browse.
Synthetic enum boundary
an unrecognized synthetic preview enum is navigated and cancelled
mode and index transitions are verified but no production Action mapping is claimed.
Theme mouse boundary
a theme row or an open theme picker receives a mouse click
Browse first selects the row without an action and picker clicks remain no-ops.

requirement: Pager settings permission mode canonical picker and ownership end-to-end checks
contract: permission_mode 集成测试 SHALL 固定其 Agent 分类、Shell owner、无预览枚举目录 auto/ask/always-approve，以及 UiConfig 持久默认优先于会话投影的读取语义。键盘和鼠标进入 picker 时按当前默认定位，导航不发预览，Enter 发 SetDefaultPermissionMode，Esc 仅返回 Browse；缺失或无效持久值回退 ask，并核对 canonical 与权限类型投影。
scenarios: Permission metadata
permission_mode metadata is read
it is a Shell-owned Agent enum without preview and exposes the pinned canonical catalog.
Persistent default projection
current_value_for reads explicit, missing, or invalid permission defaults
persistent defaults are shown and absent or unrecognized values fall back to ask.
Picker navigation
keyboard or mouse opens and navigates permission_mode
the picker seeds from the persistent default and navigation changes focus without preview actions.
Commit and cancel
a permission choice is committed or cancelled
Enter emits SetDefaultPermissionMode with the canonical mode and Escape returns to Browse without an action.
Canonical permission mapping
permission-mode canonicals are converted to and from permission kinds
catalog strings round-trip and always-approve projects to its pinned permission kind.

requirement: Pager settings reset overlay expansion and footer rendering end-to-end checks
contract: 设置渲染集成测试 SHALL 验证 reset overlay 仅突出目标行、将其他列表行全部 DIM，并保持提示与 reset/cancel 操作区不变暗；Browse 与 picker 显示 Ask Grow 帮助。Right/l 与 Left/h 以及展开图标切换描述展开，长描述按宽度换行；restart pill 只随已展开的 restart_required 行显示。重置提示包含设置标签、以 Reset 开头并以问号结尾。
scenarios: Reset spotlight
reset confirmation overlays a rendered modal
every non-target list cell is dimmed, the target row is not, and prompt/action rows remain full intensity.
Reset copy
reset confirmation content is built for registered settings
the visible prompt, breadcrumb, reset/cancel shortcuts, label, Reset prefix, and question suffix are present.
Help footer
Browse or PickingEnum is rendered
the Ask Grow footer and example request are visible.
Expansion controls
arrow, vim alias, or triangle controls expand and collapse a row
expanded_keys and rendered description content change together.
Restart indicator
a restart-required row is collapsed, edited, or expanded
the restart pill remains hidden while collapsed and appears when expanded.

requirement: Pager settings dynamic model and integer stepper end-to-end checks
contract: 动态模型与整数编辑集成测试 SHALL 验证 max_thoughts_width 以 120 打开 EditingValue，Up/Down 每次步进 5、Left/Right 每次步进 10 并夹在 40..=500，Enter 发 SetMaxThoughtsWidth，文本键和带修饰 Esc 不修改，普通 Esc 取消。default_model 从 snapshot 构造 DynamicEnum，模型行提交解析后的 ModelId，零号无覆盖行发 ClearDefaultModel；鼠标二次点击可打开 picker/editor，默认投影保持空模型与宽度 120。
scenarios: Integer entry and commit
max_thoughts_width is opened, stepped, and committed
its buffer starts at 120, uses the pinned increments and bounds, and emits SetMaxThoughtsWidth.
Integer rejection and cancel
text keys, modified Escape, or plain Escape reach the integer editor
text and modified Escape are unchanged, while plain Escape returns to Browse without a setter.
Dynamic model commit
default_model picker selects a snapshot model
Enter emits SetDefaultModel with the matching resolved ModelId.
Dynamic model clear
row zero is committed with no current override
ClearDefaultModel is emitted.
Mouse and defaults
dynamic-model or integer rows are clicked twice or defaults are queried
the corresponding editor opens and the empty-model/120 defaults round-trip.

requirement: Pager settings default permission and Mermaid enum end-to-end checks
contract: default_selected_permission 与 render_mermaid 集成测试 SHALL 固定各自分类、Shell owner、无预览枚举目录和默认投影；键盘或鼠标按两阶段/指示器路径进入 PickingEnum，导航不发预览，Enter 分别发 SetDefaultSelectedPermission 或 SetRenderMermaid，Esc 返回 Browse 且不发动作。
scenarios: Metadata and defaults
both enum registrations and current values are inspected
their categories, Shell ownership, no-preview flags, canonical choices, and pinned defaults match.
Keyboard picker
Enter opens either enum and navigation changes its choice
PickingEnum is seeded correctly and navigation yields Changed without a preview Action.
Commit and cancel
a choice is committed or cancelled
the corresponding typed Set action is emitted on Enter and Escape returns without an action.
Mouse entry
an unfocused row body, focused row body, or value indicator is clicked
the first body click selects and a second body click or indicator click opens the picker.

requirement: Pager settings screen hunk CLI and model-family metadata end-to-end checks
contract: 设置集成测试 SHALL 固定 screen_mode、hunk_tracker_mode 的无预览枚举交互与 canonical 目录，Enter 分别发 SetScreenMode/SetHunkTrackerMode，并核对 restart_required；show_tips 与 auto_update 通过键鼠发类型化布尔 setter，属于 Shell 且要求重启，并可被搜索；fork_secondary_model 属于 Models、Shell owner、DynamicEnum、无需重启，读取 UiConfig 非基线值且可搜索，动态模型项使用已知模型校验器。
scenarios: Screen and hunk pickers
screen or hunk tracker mode is opened, navigated, and committed
navigation has no preview and Enter emits its typed setter for a pinned canonical choice.
Mode catalogs
screen and hunk metadata is inspected
their canonical lists, defaults, and restart policy match the registry contract.
CLI boolean batch
show_tips or auto_update is toggled by keyboard or mouse
the matching typed bool setter is emitted and metadata marks both Shell-owned restart settings.
CLI discovery and defaults
the CLI batch is queried by current_value_for or search
default values and expected keywords resolve to those settings.
Model family
fork_secondary_model metadata, current values, validator, and search are inspected
it is a discoverable non-restart Shell DynamicEnum under Models and preserves configured values.

requirement: Pager settings vim mode and text-selection enum end-to-end checks
contract: vim_mode 集成测试 SHALL 通过 Space、Enter 与两阶段鼠标切换，读取 pager snapshot 的已启用值并发相反 setter，同时固定其 Appearance 分类与标签区别。keep_text_selection SHALL 作为 Mouse 分类、Shell owner、无预览枚举暴露 flash/hold；picker 导航不预览，Enter 发 SetKeepTextSelection，Esc 取消，键鼠入口一致，实时 hold snapshot 使 picker 定位 hold。
scenarios: Vim toggle
vim_mode is activated by keyboard or mouse from default or enabled snapshot
SetVimMode carries the inverse current value.
Vim metadata
vim_mode and simple_mode labels are inspected
vim_mode is categorized as configured and its scrollback wording stays distinct from input-mode wording.
Text selection metadata
keep_text_selection metadata is read
it is a Shell-owned Mouse enum without preview and exposes flash/hold semantics plus Shift-drag guidance.
Text selection picker
the enum is opened, navigated, committed, or cancelled
navigation has no preview, Enter emits SetKeepTextSelection, and Escape returns without an action.
Text selection mouse and snapshot
row body/indicator clicks or a hold cache snapshot initialize the picker
mouse entry follows two-stage/indicator rules and hold selects the hold choice.

requirement: Pager settings mouse controls and refresh cadence end-to-end checks
contract: 鼠标设置集成测试 SHALL 固定 scroll_speed 为 Shell-owned Mouse Int 1..=100、scroll_lines 为 1..=10，步进提交分别发 SetScrollSpeed/SetScrollLines，鼠标可进入编辑；scroll_mode 为无预览 auto/wheel/trackpad Enum 并提交 SetScrollMode。invert_scroll 按键鼠切换且默认 false。display_refresh_auto_cadence 按键鼠切换，属于 Shell-owned Appearance Bool，默认 false、要求重启、minimal 隐藏，并从 UiConfig 当前值投影。
scenarios: Scroll integers
scroll speed or line-count rows are inspected, opened, stepped, and committed
their owner/category/bounds are pinned and typed integer setters carry the edited value.
Scroll mode
scroll_mode is inspected or committed
its no-preview canonical catalog is auto/wheel/trackpad and Enter emits SetScrollMode.
Scroll mouse entry
focused integer or enum rows receive their supported mouse activation
they enter EditingValue or PickingEnum.
Invert scroll
invert_scroll is activated from off or on state
keyboard and mouse emit SetInvertScroll with the inverse value and metadata defaults it off.
Refresh cadence
display refresh auto cadence is toggled or read
typed actions reflect the current value and metadata fixes its category, owner, default, restart, minimal visibility, and current-value projection.

requirement: Pager settings thinking suggestions folds and tool grouping end-to-end checks
contract: 尾部布尔设置集成测试 SHALL 验证 show_thinking_blocks、prompt_suggestions、respect_manual_folds、group_tool_verbs 经 Space、Enter 与两阶段鼠标发对应 setter，并从进程缓存或 PagerLocalSnapshot 读取当前值后取反。元数据固定 thinking/tool grouping 为 Appearance Shell-owned 默认 true，prompt suggestions 为 Editor Shell-owned 默认 true，manual folds 为 Appearance Pager-owned 默认 false；Appearance 顺序为 thinking 紧邻 folds 之前、tool grouping 紧邻 folds 之后。
scenarios: Thinking blocks
show_thinking_blocks is toggled from cached off or on
all activation paths emit the inverse typed action and metadata pins its default, owner, category, and order.
Prompt suggestions
prompt_suggestions is toggled from cached off or on
all activation paths emit the inverse typed action and metadata pins Editor/Shell/default-on.
Manual folds
respect_manual_folds is toggled from default or enabled pager snapshot
all activation paths emit the inverse typed action and metadata pins Appearance/Pager/default-off.
Tool grouping
group_tool_verbs is toggled from cached on or off
all activation paths emit the inverse typed action and metadata pins Appearance/Shell/default-on and its registry adjacency.

requirement: Pager scrollback viewport painting and visible search highlighting
contract: Pager scrollback renderer SHALL use precomputed EntryLayoutInfo and usize virtual coordinates to paint only entries intersecting the viewport, preserving logical entry indices through content_y0 and entry_index_base. It SHALL compute slice-end total_height including gaps, report selected geometry and clipping, optionally dim rendered cells from a logical entry onward, and invert regex matches only on the glyph columns of each currently rendered wrapped row. Empty entries or zero-sized viewports return an empty result. ScratchBuffer preparation resizes and resets prior cells before reuse. This file does not prove layout-cache construction, paint-window caller scheduling, regex search indexing/navigation, terminal frame submission, or runtime performance.
scenarios: Viewport intersection
a full list or a caller-supplied paint window intersects the same viewport
visible buffer cells, logical indices, selection geometry and clipping agree while virtual height uses usize coordinates.
Search paint
a regex matches one or more visible rendered rows
exactly the matching display cells on each row are reversed; missing regexes and nonmatches paint no reversed cells.
Selection rectangle
the selected entry is wholly or partly visible
selected_area reports its row-layout selection area and the independent top/bottom clipping flags.
Reuse and empty boundary
scratch storage is prepared or rendering receives no drawable area
stale buffer cells are reset, while empty entries or zero width/height yield the default result.
Zero-sized viewport
the supplied Rect has zero width or height
rendering returns the default output without painting or reading the view mode.
View-mode dispatch
the area is drawable and state.view_mode() is SingleTurn or AllTurns
the pane delegates to the corresponding sticky-header path, with SingleTurn using state.visible_entry_range() and AllTurns using 0..state.len().
Scroll metadata
a drawable render completes
the output carries the scroll offset, viewport height and total height read from state.scroll_info().
Scratch ownership
the caller reuses the supplied scratch buffer across frames
the pane passes that buffer through to the sticky/header render path and does not replace the caller-owned object.
Open state
a search session is opened
the query and match list are empty, the cursor is None and composing is true.
Query result
a valid query is updated and the daemon result is polled
the query is retained, match_count/current/current_index reflect the result and the cursor starts at index zero.
No-match and invalid query
a query has no matches, is cleared, or is malformed
matches and cursor are cleared; a malformed regex remains visible through query and has_error.
Cursor-only edit
a key moves the LineEditor cursor without changing text
the edit is consumed as CursorChanged, request_generation is unchanged and the settled matches remain until the new text scan.
Paste normalization
pasted text contains CR/LF or only CR/LF
line-editor paste normalizes the inserted text, enqueues once for a real text change and ignores a no-change paste.
Viewport graphemes
a long query contains wide, combining and emoji graphemes
query_viewport preserves complete grapheme spans and reports a cursor display column inside the requested width.
Content refresh
entries are appended while a search session remains open
the next query update increments the request generation, resynchronizes the corpus and finds the new entry.
Navigation and accept
matches exist, next/prev or accept is invoked
navigation wraps or no-ops as appropriate, and accept changes composing to false without losing query, matches or cursor.
Highlight state
the query is empty, malformed or valid
highlight_regex is None for empty/error input and is the compiled matcher for a valid nonempty query.

requirement: Pager scrollback folded-run labels and synthetic header selection
contract: Scrollback painting SHALL rebuild verb-run and truncation-fold labels from the current GroupSpan on every frame when spans and the grouping vocabulary are available. A collapsed truncation label describes its hidden prefix, an expanded truncation label describes the whole run, and verb labels remain bounded to their run including eligible hidden thinking and subagent-start members; absent spans or a disabled group-tool-verbs setting retain the plain count fallback. A labeled header SHALL expose one synthetic selectable line under the reserved GROUP_HEADER_RANGE_ID with its hit geometry shifted past diamond chrome, while a plain-count header exposes none. Expanded verb slots SHALL map member zero one row below the independently selectable header. Synthetic headers SHALL not leak hidden content into links, highlights, selectable lines, or media placements. This file does not prove how grouping spans are formed, persisted, toggled, or invalidated.
scenarios: Current run label
a folded verb run or truncation span is painted
the label reflects the bounded current run, its hidden or whole-run scope, and failure/count vocabulary.
Fallback label
truncation spans are absent or grouped tool vocabulary is disabled
the renderer keeps the legacy plain count and does not manufacture a selectable label.
Header copy geometry
an aggregated label is visible
one reserved-range selectable row starts after header chrome and reconstructs exactly the displayed label.
Expanded verb slot
a verb group is expanded
the header and first member occupy separate screen rows and selection ranges.
Hidden-content isolation
an entry slot is replaced by a synthetic header
hidden body links, search matches, selectable lines and media placements do not project onto that header or following rows.
Shared range rendering
SingleTurn or AllTurns mode supplies an entry range
the same render_with_sticky_headers path renders that range and passes the visible range to render_content.
Group span forwarding
content rendering has cached group spans
render_content supplies state.group_spans() and the paint-range start to the delegated renderer.
Synthetic-header boundary
the delegated renderer returns a group-header selection or other post-render projection
the pane preserves the returned projection and does not independently fabricate hidden-member links, labels or media.

requirement: Pager scrollback resolved text-selection geometry and cached boundaries
contract: For every visible non-synthetic selectable BlockLine, scrollback rendering SHALL register logical entry/range/block-line identity, screen position, selectable display columns, derived text and soft-wrap joiner in ResolvedSelectionModel. Top and bottom clipping SHALL admit only visible content rows and exclude vertical padding. Message-style UserPrompt, AgentMessage and Btw blocks SHALL reserve ten columns for timestamps in both cache derivation and VisibleBlockGeometry.content_width. Cached block-specific selection boundaries SHALL be attached only when supplied by the rendered output, remain aligned after clipped prefix rows, and ordinary text without such sidecars SHALL still be selectable without a fabricated boundary. This file does not prove pointer gesture interpretation, multi-range reconstruction outside the exercised helpers, clipboard delivery, or timestamp painting itself.
scenarios: Visible lines
wrapped selectable content is wholly or partially visible
only visible content rows enter the resolved model in increasing screen order with stable logical identity.
Padding exclusion
a block reserves vertical padding
padding rows do not become selectable content lines.
Timestamp width parity
a message-style block is cached and mapped
selection geometry records the same content width used to wrap output after the ten-column timestamp reservation.
Boundary sidecar
cached structured boundaries accompany a clipped visible line
the boundary is keyed to the resolved hit and retains source indentation; ordinary selectable output has no synthetic sidecar.
Cache precondition
render_content runs without a cached entry-layout vector
the explicit layout-cache expectation fails because prepare_layout is required before rendering.
Viewport paint window
a visible range and content viewport are supplied
paint_window determines the bounded paint range and the renderer receives its relative content_y0 and entry_index_base.
Singleton selection
the active selection resolves to one visible entry
the entry area becomes the selection box and top/bottom clipping is retained.
Grouped selection
the active selection spans multiple entries and cached virtual positions exist
the group virtual span is clipped to the content viewport and converted through HorizontalLayout into one selection area.

requirement: Pager scrollback source-aware Markdown hyperlink projection
contract: Markdown hyperlink overlay construction SHALL resolve authoritative targets before clipping and project them through BlockLine link_source coordinates onto only surviving visible source fragments. Wrapped fragments SHALL retain one complete target and hyperlink id while screen rows and columns reflect display width, repeated quote/list chrome is excluded, viewport row/column clipping is enforced, and incomplete paint uses Opaque presentation. Explicit local links may preserve a declared missing target; inferred local paths require the conservative resolver, while known transcript media and cwd-relative project links resolve to complete file targets. Synthetic rows and collapsed or truncated-away content SHALL contribute no source fragments, and explicit targets SHALL suppress overlapping generic rescans rather than duplicate links. Source coordinates remain usize until viewport projection, so long logical lines are not truncated to u16. This file does not prove markdown parsing correctness, filesystem contents after rendering, OSC 8 emission, opener success, or terminal link support.
scenarios: Wrapped source projection
one Markdown target spans wrapped visible fragments
each visible fragment maps to its display cells with the same complete target and id, including CJK and quote/list chrome.
Viewport clipping
source rows or columns fall partly or wholly outside the viewport
only nonempty visible intersections become overlay links and partial paint is opaque.
Local target provenance
Markdown names explicit, inferred, media, absolute or cwd-relative local paths
explicit/known paths keep their complete file target while missing inferred paths are not promoted.
Synthetic and hidden rows
display output inserts headers, truncates input or collapses a body
only source-bearing visible rows project links and hidden text cannot leak into chrome.
No double scan
an authoritative Markdown link overlaps text recognizable by the generic scanner
one semantic link group owns those cells rather than a duplicate generic link.
Source context forwarding
content rendering invokes the lower scrollback renderer
the renderer receives the exact media path list, group-span context and cwd held by ScrollbackPane and ScrollbackState.
Link overlay preservation
the lower renderer returns a link overlay
render_content places that overlay into the returned RenderOutput without rebuilding or filtering its links.
Hidden-row boundary
group or collapsed-row visibility affects link projection
the pane relies on the lower renderer and only supplies the authoritative paint range/group context.

requirement: Pager scrollback generic content and tool-file link ownership
contract: For non-Markdown or otherwise unclaimed selectable regions, scrollback link collection SHALL scan complete logical text across continuation rows but treat selection-range changes, skipped leading continuations, explicit link_target rows, link_source rows and nonselectable chrome as hard boundaries. Visible head and retained tail regions may each yield links; collapsed bodies do not, while visible collapsed headers remain scannable. Tool header link_target metadata SHALL project only onto its selectable path cells after bullets and verbs, preserve the complete file target while clipping before u16 conversion, and drop zero-width intersections. File presentation SHALL be SelfResolvingPath only when painted text can safely identify the target; basename, clipped, duplicate-name or outside-cwd paint remains Opaque and Grow-owned. In official VS Code remote sessions only self-resolving presentation is delegated to terminal recognition. This file does not prove scanner grammar, OS path validity, terminal-native recognition, link click routing, or that a resolved target still exists when activated.
scenarios: Generic region scan
selectable logical text continues across rendered rows
scanning joins only rows in the same region and never bridges chrome, selection ranges, or unavailable source-owned rows.
Display visibility
an execute block is expanded, truncated or collapsed
URLs are emitted only from visible header/head/tail content, with separator and hidden body rows excluded.
Tool path geometry
a Read/Edit header carries an explicit file target
its overlay covers only visible selectable path cells, clips before coordinate narrowing, and retains the complete semantic path.
Remote presentation policy
official VS Code remote resolves a file overlay
only fully self-resolving path paint is delegated; opaque basename or clipped paint keeps OSC/open ownership in Grow.
Bounded link input
paint_window returns a range inside the requested visible range
only entries and layout records from that paint range are passed to the lower renderer.
Tool link output
the lower renderer returns a tool-file or generic content overlay
the overlay is retained in RenderOutput alongside selection and media output.
Ownership boundary
a caller needs terminal link presentation or activation
this pane supplies render-time context but leaves scanning, target validation and activation to other layers.

requirement: Pager scrollback inline media and Mermaid placement geometry
contract: Scrollback rendering SHALL report visible post-flush media and lazy Mermaid affordance placements separately from Ratatui cell painting. Inline-image reservation SHALL fit source dimensions into content width with two-column margin, clamp image height to four through twenty rows, and reserve three additional rows. Visible tool-media placements SHALL crop against the viewport, keep timestamp-reserved columns clear, expose the second output row as a filepath copy target, and mark that an overlay button row is reserved. Non-graphics text fallback SHALL instead expose a centered [Open Image] click rectangle and filepath rectangle with zero image rows and no overlay button row. Mermaid blocks SHALL emit a one-row blank affordance placement carrying source text and SHALL NOT masquerade as inline media. Group-header replacement suppresses both placement families. This file does not prove image decoding beyond test fixture construction, graphics protocol transmission, native-open/copy handlers, Mermaid rendering, or post-flush ordering.
scenarios: Image reservation
inline media dimensions and content width are known
fitted image rows are bounded and total reservation includes the three header/button/spacer rows.
Overlay placement
a tool image intersects the viewport under an inline graphics protocol
the result reports cropped image geometry, filepath hit geometry, full row count and a reserved overlay-button row.
Text fallback
media uses the native-open text fallback
the filepath and centered open-button rows are exposed without claiming an inline image area.
Diagram affordance
an enabled Mermaid fence reserves its action row
one visible blank-row placement carries the source and no inline-media placement is emitted.
Inline media projection
the lower renderer reports visible inline media placements
RenderOutput.inline_media contains that returned collection.
Diagram affordance projection
the lower renderer reports Mermaid or diagram affordances
RenderOutput.diagram_affordances contains that returned collection.
Placement ownership
media or diagram geometry requires source dimensions, viewport cropping or fallback controls
this layer forwards the context and preserves the result while the lower renderer owns the geometry.
Wrap mapping
pre-wrap lines occupy one or more post-wrap rows
the computed end rows point one past each line’s last row.
Multiple diagrams
nonempty ranges appear in document order
one blank non-selectable row and one source-carrying affordance are created per range, with later offsets including earlier insertions.
Wrapped diagram
a diagram body pre-wrap range ends on a line that wraps to multiple rows
the affordance row follows the final wrapped row.
Continuation semantics
an inserted row is created
it is a separator with an empty joiner and is excluded from selection/copy.
Oversized payload
a single completion exceeds 64 MiB
it is rejected and marked failed rather than entering the cache.
Aggregate cap
accepted bytes would exceed 64 MiB
oldest cache keys are removed until the incoming payload fits, then the new path is inserted.
Successful retry
a path previously marked failed later produces valid bytes
the path is cached and removed from the failed set.
Media path link
scrollback contains media_ref_path entries
ensure_media_link_paths records those paths only for the current scrollback generation.
Path copy
a filepath hit is clicked
the displayed path string is sent through copy_to_clipboard and Changed is returned.

requirement: Pager scrollback identity, immutable events and reconnect frontier
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL keep transcript entries in insertion order under non-reused EntryId identity, deduplicate only immutable domain events carrying the same event id, maintain minimal-mode native-scrollback commitment by EntryId, and stage reconnect continuations in a shared monotonic id and invalidation-generation space. A full replay SHALL inherit native commitment only across a semantically equivalent committed prefix, permitting old local notices without durable identity to be skipped but treating durable notices or divergent blocks as a frontier stop. Tail merge SHALL preserve entry ids, running/dirty/committed state and advance both invalidation generations. The bounded expand history retains at most 256 folded committed ids and skips ids no longer present. This file does not prove RenderBlock::replay_equivalent semantics, terminal writes, reconnect caller ordering, or coordination-row merge behavior implemented in the coordination submodule.
scenarios: Immutable event identity
a durable event id is inserted repeatedly, removed, cleared, or rebuilt during merge
one indexed row represents that id while local notices without event ids remain distinct and removal/clear permits a later fresh insertion.
Replay commitment frontier
a rebuilt transcript is compared with previously committed native-scrollback entries
only the committed replay-equivalent common prefix is inherited, old local non-durable notices may be skipped, and durable or branch divergence stops inheritance.
Reconnect continuation identity
a fresh continuation is merged or discarded
EntryIds are not reused, view preferences survive staging, and generation floors advance beyond every state consumers may have cached.
Ordered access and removal
entries are read by index/id or removed
IndexMap order and O(1)-average id lookup remain aligned while auxiliary identity and commit indexes are updated.

requirement: Pager scrollback mutation, materialization and cache invalidation
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL own entry materialization and mutation invalidation: pushes allocate identity, apply the effective Edit display policy, index immutable events, update turns/layout incrementally when possible, and advance content plus link generations. Streaming agent, thinking, execute and hook mutations SHALL invalidate affected render/height state; display, scroll, appearance and viewport-only changes SHALL leave content_generation unchanged. Edit replacement SHALL preserve Edit-to-Edit user mode except an untrusted-summary rising edge, honor pinned folds when configured, and reset genuine kind transitions to the new block default. Stop hooks SHALL attach only to the latest attributable terminal turn marker, with prompt identity required when stamped. Cwd changes invalidate every cwd-dependent entry cache. This file does not prove renderer output, hook execution, tracker call ordering, appearance cache loading, or the incremental layout algorithms delegated to layout.rs.
scenarios: Edit materialization
an Edit is pushed or a placeholder/refinement is replaced
failed edits collapse, untrusted successful summaries expand, the appearance default controls trusted success, and eligible user display choices survive later Edit refinement.
Stop hook attribution
stop hooks arrive stamped, unstamped, repeated, or after interleaved rows
only the latest compatible turn-terminal marker accepts them and same-name or foreign-turn attachment is refused.
Streaming mutation
agent, thinking or execute content changes through typed mutation methods
only compatible existing block kinds mutate, their render/height cache is dirtied, and content/link generations advance.
Generation separation
content, display, scroll, resize or batching changes state
content changes advance both generations while view-only changes advance link geometry without redefining the searchable corpus, and the next layout preparation reconciles dirty or appended heights.

requirement: Pager scrollback running, finish flash and pending-input lifecycle
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL track running entries separately from transcript order, request animation only for running rows overlapping the current viewport, and use an absolute finish-flash deadline for one final visible repaint. Finishing SHALL finalize supported streaming blocks, record completion time, remove running state, apply thinking/tool display policy, dirty layout and advance content generation. Pending-user-input flags SHALL be idempotent, participate in structural grouping, clear in bulk or on entry completion, and remain distinct from running state. Off-screen render-cache eviction SHALL preserve layout geometry. This file does not prove scheduler cadence, real elapsed duration, terminal repaint, tool completion authority, or the eviction/viewport algorithms implemented in layout.rs.
scenarios: Viewport animation gate
running entries move outside or inside a prepared viewport
only visible running rows demand motion frames, with pre-layout state conservatively animated.
Finish deadline
a running row completes and its flash expires or the row is removed
periodic animation stops, one visible expiry repaint is requested, and stale flash ids drain.
Pending input
a row begins, repeats, resolves, completes, or is bulk-cleared from awaiting input
actual flag transitions are reported, group structure is dirtied, and no stale pending mark remains.
Thinking completion mode
streaming thinking was untouched, manually expanded, toggled back, or governed by sticky expansion
completion selects the corresponding collapsed or expanded resting mode.
Live stream timing
a block is created with streaming
elapsed_time_ms reports a nonnegative live duration before finish and finish freezes the local duration when no server value exists.
Replay timing
a block is created with streaming_replay and then finished
no local timer is used, so finish leaves elapsed_time_ms unset for the outer replay completion path to supply server duration.
Server duration precedence
set_elapsed_time_ms supplies Some milliseconds before finish
elapsed_time_ms returns the supplied server value and finish does not overwrite it with local elapsed time.
Incremental content
push_chunk or push_chunk_deferred receives markdown
the corresponding MarkdownContent streaming mutation is used; finish then invokes the full content finish path.
Started state
a block is constructed with started
is_running is true and kind is Started.
Finish transition
mark_completed receives an elapsed duration
the block becomes Completed, is_running is false, and the compact row uses completion wording.
Failure transition
mark_failed receives elapsed and optional termination metadata
the block becomes Failed, is_running is false, and output chooses killed/failed detail from signal and exit fields.
Running visual state
Started is rendered with ctx.is_running true
accent uses theme.accent_running and bullet returns an animated pre-dimmed running color.
Terminal visual state
kind is Completed or Failed
accent is absent and bullet uses theme.accent_success or theme.accent_error respectively.

requirement: Pager scrollback turn, viewport and layout orchestration
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL orchestrate a three-case layout preparation boundary: missing/width-changed cache causes a full rebuild and width-cache invalidation, dirty entries cause incremental height processing with structural or streaming virtual-position repair, and clean stable width recomputes current visible-range height. Follow mode, exact visible measurement and deferred warm-above processing run at that boundary. Viewport snapshots SHALL restore scroll/follow/selection/turn/width state and invalidate layout so the restored width is fully prepared again. Direct scroll positioning clamps to the available range and disables follow. This file does not independently specify navigation, turn detection, selection fixing, grouping, height calculation, sticky layout, or scroll-anchor algorithms located in sibling modules.
scenarios: Layout case selection
width, height, cache presence or dirty-height state changes
width changes take full Case 1, dirty state takes Case 2, and stable clean or height-only changes remain Case 3.
Height and appearance
prompt vertical padding or appended entries change measured content
cached heights and total height reflect the effective appearance after preparation.
Turn navigation projection
prompt-delimited entries are selected or turn navigation moves
turn ranges, current turn, selection and pinned-prompt state remain coherent at the tested boundary.
Viewport snapshot
a temporary guest view mutates width, height, follow, selection, turn and scroll state
restore reinstates the captured interaction state, discards the guest layout cache and rebuilds at the restored width.

requirement: Pager scrollback permission epochs and ordered insertion
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL aggregate subagent permission decisions into one stable running block per primary-turn permission epoch, ignoring intervening UI rows; terminal primary-turn completion seals that group and advances the epoch. Reconnect tail merge SHALL combine same-epoch members into the original open group, seal it when the tail crossed a terminal boundary, and retain post-terminal members in a new epoch. insert_block_before SHALL allocate a unique id, preserve anchor order and selection identity, rebuild positional turn state, pull the minimal commit cursor back to the insertion point, and fall back to append when the anchor vanished. Its uncommitted-anchor precondition is enforced only by debug_assert. This file does not prove permission decision correctness, persistence, primary-turn terminal detection at callers, or release-mode recovery from precondition violation.
scenarios: Open permission epoch
multiple permission decisions arrive around unrelated UI rows before primary completion
one stable running group accumulates the epoch members without reordering those UI rows.
Reconnect permission merge
a continuation contains decisions before and/or after an epoch terminal
same-epoch members merge into the original group, the original seals, and later decisions remain a new running group.
Ordered insertion
a finalized block is inserted before a live uncommitted anchor
it receives a unique id at the anchor position, selection stays with its prior entry, turns rebuild, and the native commit scan cannot skip it.
Missing or committed anchor
the anchor disappeared or was already committed
missing anchors append, while committed anchors violate the documented precondition and panic only in debug builds.
Epoch construction
a block is created with new or new_in_epoch
the first event is retained and the block stores epoch zero or the supplied epoch.
Ordered append
push or extend receives additional decision events
members remain in insertion order and len increases by the appended count.
Member access
member is called with an in-range or out-of-range index
the corresponding event or None is returned without changing the block.
Ownership transfer
take_members consumes a block
all members are returned in original order.
Outcome aggregation
members contain repeated and interleaved outcomes
header_line creates one bucket per outcome in first-appearance order, with each count and the number of distinct child sessions.
Noun/cardinality
a bucket or child set has one versus multiple entries
request(s) and subagent(s) use the matching singular/plural form and no stray separator is emitted for a single bucket.

requirement: Pager scrollback layout cache lifecycle and incremental geometry updates
contract: Pager scrollback state SHALL maintain one width-keyed layout cache whose parallel entry heights, truncated prompt heights, measured flags, virtual offsets, prompt descriptors and group spans are rebuilt from cheap estimates and exposed only as cached views. Invalidation SHALL dirty all entry heights; exact dirty-height updates SHALL refresh prompt metadata, and height-only changes SHALL shift later virtual offsets without recomputing structural gaps. A synchronized single append SHALL measure the new entry exactly, recompute the preceding pairwise gap, append its virtual offset and optional prompt descriptor, while an out-of-sync append SHALL fail so the caller can rebuild. Full and arithmetic rebuilds SHALL reapply hidden-thinking spacing and group folding before deriving total height.
scenarios: Full cache lifecycle
the cache is absent, stale in width/count, explicitly invalidated, or structurally rebuilt
parallel cache arrays, pairwise gaps, group spans, prompt descriptors and usize total height are regenerated from current entries.
Dirty height patch
existing entries are marked dirty without a structural change
they are measured exactly and later virtual offsets plus affected prompt descriptors shift by the accumulated signed height delta.
Streaming append
exactly one entry follows a synchronized cache
the cache remains allocated, the previous gap is corrected, the new exact layout and virtual offset are appended, and a prompt gains a descriptor.
Desynchronization boundary
cache vectors do not end exactly at the appended index
incremental extension returns false and leaves fallback invalidation to its caller.

requirement: Pager scrollback screen-row hit testing sticky prompts and permission members
contract: Pager scrollback hit testing SHALL map only rows inside the scrollback rectangle and entry content spans to logical entries, return no entry for inter-entry gaps, and resolve sticky header rows through the current sticky layout. Entry selection geometry SHALL use the configured horizontal selection area, report top/bottom clipping, and exclude content hidden behind sticky rows while returning pushed or pinned prompt geometry. Permission audit hit testing SHALL map a singleton content row to member zero, treat collapsed and expanded group headers as non-members, and map expanded member rows one-based below the header. Sticky prompt selection SHALL require the current turn prompt at the visible-range start and a positive scroll offset; a short unmeasured resumed prompt SHALL not inherit empty rows from its conservative truncated-height seed.
scenarios: Content row lookup
a row is inside an entry, a gap, a restricted visible range, or outside the viewport
lookup returns the owning entry only for its half-open content rows.
Sticky geometry
scrolling pins or pushes a user prompt
header rows resolve through sticky metadata and content selection areas are clipped below the header with explicit clipping flags.
Permission member rows
a singleton, collapsed group, or expanded permission group is clicked
only the singleton row or expanded one-based member rows resolve to member indices.
Lazy prompt seed
an old one-line prompt is pinned before exact measurement
the visible sticky height is clamped to its full height instead of the maximum truncated seed.
Compact header policy
sticky_headers is disabled or prompt.compact is enabled
the sticky layout is empty and content uses the full supplied area.
Pushed prompt
the sticky layout contains a pushed prompt with visible rows
the header is rendered at its computed screen row, clipped rows are faded, and a selected pushed header produces a top-clipped selection box when clip_top is positive.
Pinned prompt
the sticky layout contains a pinned prompt with visible rows
the header is rendered at its computed row and its selection area is derived through HorizontalLayout with a top-clipping flag only at the viewport origin.
Selection precedence
pushed, pinned and content selection candidates coexist
the returned selection box chooses pushed first, then pinned, then content.

requirement: Pager scrollback lazy viewport measurement warmup and tall-history bounds
contract: Pager scrollback layout SHALL seed bulk history with non-rendering height estimates, measure every visible entry plus only a fixed below margin, monotonically replace estimates with exact heights, rebuild offsets until the visible window settles, and pin the bottom while following or preserve the top while manually scrolled. A one-shot bottom-following resume warmup SHALL measure bounded pages above the viewport, but SHALL skip manual and preserve-scroll modes and defer during width changes until the width is stable. Target-independent visibility gating SHALL fail open for missing or wedged layout state. Offscreen render-cache eviction SHALL retain a padded measurement window and the selected entry while preserving cached geometry. Cumulative virtual positions, scroll offsets and total height SHALL remain usize so sessions beyond 65,535 rows reach their final entry.
scenarios: Bounded lazy resume
a large history is bulk loaded
only the viewport, below margin and eligible warm pages are exactly rendered while far history remains estimated.
Measurement convergence
exact heights reveal more content or a dirty fast-path frame lands on estimated rows
visible measurement iterates to a stable cache and a repeated layout with unchanged dimensions is a no-op.
Warmup policy
bottom-following resume, preserve-scroll mode, manual scroll, active resize, or the stable frame after resize is prepared
above-viewport warming occurs only in the safe bottom-pinned stable cases.
Tall and degenerate content
content is empty, shorter than the viewport, a single tall entry, wedged past its end, or exceeds u16 row capacity
layout remains bounded and panic-free, redraw gating fails open when healing is needed, and the true bottom remains reachable.
Eviction boundary
styled render caches lie outside the padded viewport window
unselected output caches may be evicted without changing height or virtual geometry, while no-layout state evicts nothing.

requirement: Pager scrollback resize anchoring and bounded navigation measurement
contract: Pager scrollback state SHALL capture the viewport top as an entry, logical line and signed wrapped-row offset before width-driven reflow, then restore it from the new layout while clamping the intra-line row to the rewrapped logical line and the final scroll to valid bounds. Manual resize SHALL preserve the viewed content, including a top gap attributed to the entry above; follow mode SHALL repin the bottom. Entry top/center navigation and offscreen selection movement SHALL first measure a viewport-bounded target span, and SingleTurn centering SHALL additionally measure its sticky prompt. Visible upward selection and non-anchored folding SHALL not measure above the viewport or move its top; anchored folding SHALL settle before applying its anchor.
scenarios: Width-stable anchor
a manually scrolled viewport narrows or widens
its entry/logical-line anchor stays at the top and a stale sub-row cannot spill into the next logical line.
Gap and follow boundaries
the top is an inter-entry gap or follow mode is active during resize
the gap remains attributed to the preceding entry and follow mode remains pinned to the new bottom.
Target navigation
top, center, page, or offscreen selection navigation reaches estimated entries
only a viewport-bounded neighborhood is measured before computing the destination.
Fold anchoring
a fold toggles with anchoring enabled or disabled
the visible region is settled before anchored math, while the disabled path leaves the existing viewport top unchanged.
Single-turn sticky input
a far target is centered in SingleTurn mode
both the target window and the turn prompt are exact before sticky-header-aware centering.

requirement: Pager scrollback folded ranges and viewport paint-window selection
contract: Pager scrollback grouping queries SHALL prefer the authoritative folded span after layout and otherwise predict current verb runs with the same member, transparent-thinking and break semantics used by folding; dense runs SHALL exclude verb-claimed entries. Paint-window selection SHALL use binary search over full-history usize virtual offsets, back off for the sole entry straddling the viewport top, return an empty range outside content, and extend any visible synthetic group header through its authoritative verb or truncation span while clamping to the visible range. The returned content origin SHALL be relative to the visible-range base.
scenarios: Group identity
an index belongs to an eager verb fold, dense collapsed run, transparent thinking row, or non-groupable entry
its toggle range follows the authoritative span or the current fold predicate without crossing claimed boundaries.
Viewport intersection
content begins above, at, below, or entirely after the viewport
the paint range includes exactly intersecting entries and reports the first entry virtual origin relative to the visible base.
Offscreen aggregate members
a visible verb or truncation header summarizes zero-height or offscreen members
the paint range extends through the complete span so label computation sees every member.
Range boundary
a group span exceeds SingleTurn or another visible subrange
paint selection clamps the extension to that visible range.

requirement: Pager picker frame and search chrome geometry
contract: Pager shared picker chrome SHALL dispatch Floating, Popup and FullScreen modes to their respective frame layouts, reject areas below each frame's minimum dimensions, and return content and close-button rectangles that match the painted chrome. Floating and popup frames dim and clear their bounded panel; fullscreen frames use a separated title row and may reclaim that row when no title is supplied. Embedded/minimal presentation SHALL use transparent base backgrounds for picker rows and dividers. Search chrome SHALL show a hint only while inactive with an empty query, render active or always-active queries through either the canonical LineEditor viewport or the raw-string compatibility path, and reserve a requested trailing counter only when at least one input/caret cell plus the separator gap remains. Tab and filter chrome SHALL return hit rectangles for only the labels actually painted, with a right-aligned close affordance and active/hover styling. This file does not prove modal embedding policy selection, terminal composition, theme correctness, counter text painting by callers, or that returned hit rectangles receive mouse events.
scenarios: Frame dispatch
a picker frame is requested in Floating, Popup or FullScreen mode with sufficient area
the matching layout paints its documented border/background treatment and returns its usable content and close geometry.
Small frame
the available area is below a frame's width, height or derived inner-content minimum
frame rendering returns None before popup side effects where preflight is implemented.
Search counter reservation
trailing status text and a query share a search row
the counter reservation is kept only if the editor retains at least one caret cell and neither query text nor caret enters the reserved columns.
Search focus presentation
the query is active, nonempty, always-active, or inactive and empty
the renderer selects query/caret or slash-hint presentation according to those states and Unicode display width.
Tab and filter hit geometry
tab labels or a filter indicator fit their chrome row
returned rectangles identify the painted labels while non-fitting tabs have no rectangle.

requirement: Pager picker row painting and visual-row viewport
contract: Picker row rendering SHALL compute and paint one primary row plus collapsed summaries or expanded descriptions and fields using the same display-width wrapping budget. It SHALL distinguish expandable/group and leaf glyphs, preserve indentation, selection, hover, dimming and embedded styling, bound the right label so the left label retains space, render bracket-marked emphasis without brackets, and record an underlined link band only for painted rows of the final expanded description when opted in. Content rendering SHALL handle zero area, loading and empty states without item hits; calculate entry heights again after reserving a scrollbar column; scroll in visual rows around selection or a clamped caller offset; insert spacing before non-leading headers; expose hit rectangles only for selectable rows or explicitly clickable non-selectable rows; and paint a scrollbar when total visual height exceeds the viewport. This file does not prove caller row construction, semantic validity of badges/fields/links, mouse activation, scrollbar visibility policy, or terminal clipping outside the supplied Buffer.
scenarios: Row height parity
summaries, descriptions or fields wrap at the available width
compute_row_height and render_picker_row use corresponding visual-row budgets for viewport placement.
Bounded primary row
a row has competing label, badge and right-label content
the right label is truncated within its budget and at least the allocated left-label region remains available.
Description link band
the final expanded description is configured as a link and is at least partly painted
only its painted visual rows are underlined and returned as the link band; opt-out or full vertical clipping returns no band.
Visual-row scrolling
variable-height entries exceed the content viewport
scrolling, selection centering, hit rectangles and the scrollbar use visual-row heights rather than entry count.
Non-content states
content is zero-sized, loading, or empty
no entry hit rectangles are returned and the applicable spinner or no-match message is the only content response.

requirement: Pager picker state lifecycle and unified render composition
contract: PickerState SHALL keep selection, canonical single-line query/cursor, search focus, expansion, mode, hover, visual scroll and last-render hit geometry as caller-owned state. Default state starts collapsed and unfocused in Floating mode; input_active starts search-focused; reset clears transient query, selection, expansion, hover, focus and hit state while preserving the display mode; clear_query clears query-linked selection, scroll and expansion without clearing tab focus or hit rectangles; set_query delegates newline sanitization and end-cursor placement to LineEditor; and expand_all_for_search marks every current entry index when the count is nonzero. Unified rendering SHALL compose optional frame, tab row, search or title row, filter, divider, pinned note, visual-row content, scrollbar and shortcut row, then return geometry matching the painted controls. Modal helpers SHALL render content without owning outer close/tab/filter chrome and SHALL omit search chrome when requested. This file does not prove host filtering, expansion persistence across rebuilt entry identities, correctness of caller-provided non-selectable arrays, shortcut dispatch, or persistence beyond the in-memory state.
scenarios: State initialization
a picker uses Default or input_active
shared transient fields use the same defaults while only input_active begins with search focus.
State reset
reset or clear_query is applied
query-linked list state is cleared with the documented difference in preserved mode, tab focus and hit geometry.
Canonical query replacement
set_query receives text containing line breaks
the canonical editor removes those breaks and places its byte cursor at the sanitized text end before host filtering.
Selectable clamp
the entry set changes and selection points outside the set or at a marked header
selection is bounded and advanced or rescanned to a selectable entry, or reset to zero for an empty set.
Composite render
optional tabs, title/search, filter, note, entries and shortcuts are configured
each component consumes its assigned rows and the returned PickerHitAreas mirrors the controls and entries painted in that frame.

requirement: Pager picker pointer keyboard and canonical query outcomes
contract: handle_picker_input SHALL clamp selection before dispatch and classify each event as a semantic PickerOutcome so hosts refresh filtering only for QueryChanged. Left-click SHALL close, focus search, change tabs, cycle filters, select rows, or activate explicitly clickable non-selectable rows according to last-render hit geometry; motion SHALL update independent close/filter/row hover and may move valid selection; wheel input SHALL move the visual offset by three rows; resize SHALL request repaint. Keyboard input SHALL ignore releases, route paste through the canonical editor, distinguish cursor-only from text changes, clear selection/expansion/scroll exactly once on text mutation, support search/list/tab edge focus, skip non-selectable entries, prioritize custom action keys over built-ins, expose expand/collapse/copy/tab/filter/mode/submit/close outcomes, and keep direct query editing disabled when disable_search applies. Slash on an empty unfocused always-active picker SHALL focus without inserting, while slash in a nonempty or already-focused query remains literal. This file does not prove clipboard availability or normalization, host application of outcomes, filtering results, entry identity stability after QueryChanged, or that click geometry is current rather than stale.
scenarios: Query activation
printable input or slash reaches hint-based or always-active search outside Vim normal mode
focus and literal insertion follow the hint, empty-query and existing-focus rules.
Query edit classification
LineEditor reports cursor movement, handled no-change or text mutation
the outcome is Changed for visual-only edits and QueryChanged with one list-state reset for text edits.
Paste
a paste event reaches an enabled non-Vim query
sanitized text is inserted through LineEditor, optional hint focus activates, and expansion changes remain a host decision.
List and action routing
navigation, Enter, expansion, copy, action, tab, filter, mode or Escape keys are pressed
non-selectable boundaries and configured precedence determine the corresponding outcome without directly executing host work.
Pointer routing
pointer coordinates intersect current PickerHitAreas
click and hover outcomes use the associated semantic entry indices rather than visual hit-array positions.

requirement: Pager picker Vim normal and search mode transitions
contract: When vim_normal_first is enabled, an unfocused picker SHALL behave as a navigation mode: plain characters and paste do not edit the query, j/k navigate selectable rows and clamp at list edges without automatically opening search or jumping to tabs, and only unbound i or slash enters search when search is enabled. Once search is active, canonical character and paste editing applies; Escape exits search and clears a nonempty query, while Escape in normal mode closes. Up from search may focus a configured tab region; j/Down from that tab focus returns to the list rather than reopening search, and a configured action bound to i takes precedence over Vim search entry. disable_search keeps i and slash inert. These transitions apply with or without the visual slash hint. This file does not prove global Vim-mode configuration, scrollback Vim parity outside this picker, caller tab changes, action execution, or host filtering after the emitted outcome.
scenarios: Normal-mode admission
Vim mode is active and search is unfocused
plain text and paste are ignored while unbound i or slash enters enabled search without inserting text.
Vim navigation
j or k is pressed in normal mode
selection moves among valid rows and remains clamped at top or bottom without edge-cycling into search or tabs.
Search exit
Escape is pressed during Vim search
search focus ends and a retained query is cleared with QueryChanged; Escape from normal mode returns Closed.
Tabs transition
Up leaves Vim search for a configured tab region and j or Down follows
focus moves into the first list entry without reopening search.
Precedence and disabled search
i is a custom action or search is disabled
the configured action wins, or i and slash remain inert respectively.

requirement: Pager extensions modal tabs actions and transient state
contract: 扩展弹窗 SHALL 以 Hooks、Plugins、Marketplace、Skills、MCP Servers 五个标签页为固定循环顺序，并为每页集中发布动作键及稳定的 diagnostics action 名称；完整 cheatsheet 直接覆盖页签键表，紧凑 footer 只显示 action_key_display 可映射的字符（当前 MCP setup 的 s 可解析且进入 cheatsheet/diagnostics，但不进入紧凑 footer）。Space 根据当前行显示 enable、disable 或 enable/disable。状态初始化时各数据源处于 Loading、各过滤器为 All，切页清除与旧索引绑定的输入、设置、消息、pending/result、选择、滚动和展开瞬态而保留搜索词及标签栏焦点；加载中或 pending 时报告动态画面，动作结果仅存活至绝对截止时间。
scenarios: Tab traversal
用户前后切换标签页
顺序在五页首尾循环且 diagnostics tab 与活动页一致。
Action identity
页签渲染 cheatsheet/紧凑 footer 或解析字符动作
cheatsheet 与 diagnostics 覆盖页签键表、解析器支持已声明动作；紧凑 footer 仅纳入有 display 映射的键，Space 文案由当前行启用状态决定。
Transient reset
状态初始化、切页或结果提示到期
数据/过滤初值、切页清理范围和绝对截止时间按状态契约生效。
Inactive surface
the active view is not an Agent or its agent id is absent
the modal dispatcher returns no effects and does not create modal state.
Extensions open
a bound Agent opens a requested extension tab
agents modal is cleared, extensions modal is installed with the trigger recorded, and all tab data plus marketplace fetches are returned.
Picker-deferred session
the Agent has no session id
the modal remains pending and session creation is delegated through skip_picker_and_create_session rather than emitting session-scoped fetches.
Marketplace overlap
a marketplace request is already inflight
no duplicate fetch is emitted; marketplace_refetch_queued becomes true.
Marketplace idle
no marketplace request is inflight
inflight becomes true and exactly one FetchMarketplaceList effect is appended.
Agents modal
config agents opens with an optional initial tab and a bound session
extensions is closed, state is constructed, the tab is selected, and FetchSessionAgentName carries a new metadata revision.
CTA entry
a CTA test needs a plugin row
the helper returns a deterministic marketplace entry with supplied name/status and `plugins/<name>` relative path.
CTA outcome
a CTA test needs success/error/confirmation
the helper returns an ActionOutcome with supplied status/message and both reload/restart flags false.
MCP fixture
an extension test needs a server
the helper returns an enabled server with supplied status, optional plugin source, zero tools, and no setup form.
Reset confirmation
a settings test prepares reset confirmation
settings opens, OpenResetConfirm is dispatched, and the helper asserts ResetSettingsConfirm is active.
Theme isolation
a test touches global theme cache
with_theme_test_env acquires the test lock, resets/seeds auto defaults, selects GrowNight, clears system mocks before and after the callback, then resets the cache.
Mouse capture
a test changes capture state
reset_mouse_capture_enabled stores the requested flag with Release ordering and mouse_capture_is_enabled reads it with Acquire ordering.

requirement: Pager extensions modal inline form editing and path completion
contract: 扩展弹窗内联表单 SHALL 为每字段维护独立的 Unicode 安全单行编辑器、字节光标、焦点和必填规则；Esc 取消，Enter 在必填为空时列出字段名、否则返回前缀与全部字段文本，多字段 Tab/Shift+Tab 循环焦点，单字段 Tab 对光标前路径执行补全；粘贴优先进入表单焦点字段，其次仅在搜索激活时进入查询，并移除 CR/LF。编辑、光标移动及已处理的无变化键要求重绘，未处理键不要求重绘。
scenarios: Validation and focus
表单收到 Enter、Esc、Tab 或 Shift+Tab
必填验证、取消、循环字段焦点或单字段路径补全分别返回明确 outcome。
Canonical editing
用户输入字符、删除、readline/word 快捷键、Unicode grapheme 或粘贴
共享 LineEditor 保持字符边界、光标可见性，并只在文本修改时清除验证错误。
Path completion
光标前文本指向目录或部分文件名
展开 home、忽略隐藏项、排序匹配，并返回唯一项或最长公共前缀；无有效匹配返回 None。

requirement: Pager mCP add and setup form projection
contract: 扩展弹窗 SHALL 将 MCP add 的 `[URL / Command, Name]` 表单转换为启用且 full-access 的 server 配置：HTTP(S) 生成 Streamable HTTP transport，其他输入按空白拆成 stdio command 与 args，空名称从主机有效段或命令派生，空地址拒绝；setup 表单仅接受恰好一个且含选项的字段，已保存值优先于默认值，方向键或 j/k 有界移动，Enter 提交当前选项，Esc 取消。
scenarios: HTTP add
提交 HTTP(S) 地址且名称为空或显式给出
构造 Streamable HTTP 配置并从主机或显式字段确定名称。
Stdio add
提交命令及参数
首 token 成为 command、其余 token 成为 args，server 默认启用且授权全部工具。
Setup selection
server 暴露一个有选项的 setup 字段
保存值覆盖默认值，键盘在范围内选择并可提交键值映射；其他 setup 形状不建立表单。

requirement: Pager hook source grouping filtering and navigation
contract: Hooks 页 SHALL 对 name、event、matcher、command 与 URL 执行大小写不敏感的 substring 优先/有序子序列 fuzzy 搜索，再按启用状态过滤并按 source_dir 合组；搜索期间折叠组强制展开，正常前后导航跳过过滤掉的项并在折叠组间使用首个代表项。来源标签区分用户或项目插件、全局/项目 hooks 与可移除自定义路径，项目 `.grow/plugins` 和 `.grow/installed-plugins` 不得误判为自定义来源。
scenarios: Hook query
查询命中 hook 任一可搜索字段或有序字符子序列
hook 被纳入；空查询纳入全部，无法形成子序列时排除。
Grouped navigation
在启用/禁用过滤和折叠 source group 下前后移动
只返回可见 hook 索引，并跨组选择正确代表项。
Source labeling
source_dir 属于插件、全局/项目 hooks 或其他路径
返回稳定显示标签及仅对自定义路径为真的 removable 标记。

requirement: Pager skill and workflow discovery presentation
contract: Skills 页 SHALL 先按启用状态过滤；非空查询仅以大小写不敏感 substring 匹配 skill 的 label、slash name、说明或作者，名称/作者命中排在仅说明命中之前。插件 skill 保留显示 label 与 slash identity 两种检索入口及插件来源，workflow 仅展示符合小写字母/数字/单连字符命名约束且名称或说明命中查询的项，并以不可选择的 Workflows 分组附带 path/when-to-use 详情。
scenarios: Skill ordering
查询同时命中名称、作者与仅说明
名称或作者命中先展示，description-only 随后，fuzzy-only 字符序列不算命中。
Plugin skill identity
plugin skill 以 label 或 slash name 搜索并应用 enabled 过滤
同一 skill 可被两种身份找到且来源标识为 plugin。
Workflow admissibility
workflow 名称为空、过长、连字符非法或字符集非法
不渲染；合法 workflow 进入 Workflows 分组并可显示元数据。

requirement: Pager installed plugin grouping filtering and display
contract: Plugins 页 SHALL 按 discovery origin 映射到固定排序的 Project、User、具名 Marketplace、Direct installs、CLI override 与 Custom paths 分组；同组保持输入数据顺序，组头显示准确单复数计数并可选择折叠。首次数据到达仅一次性把已知组设为折叠，后续刷新保留用户展开状态；搜索强制打开匹配组，状态过滤移除空组，插件行显示版本、组件摘要、路径、说明和 disabled 状态。
scenarios: Origin grouping
插件来自任一 PluginOrigin
得到固定 rank、稳定 collapse key 与显示 label，并按 rank/label/key 排序。
Collapse and search
组被折叠或查询命中其子插件
常态隐藏子行，搜索时强制显示；同组插件不拆组且兄弟组不受影响。
Status and fields
WHEN过滤 enabled/disabled 并渲染插件
无匹配子项的组消失，行保留数据索引、组件/路径字段和禁用标记。

requirement: Pager marketplace flat indexing navigation and action mapping
contract: Marketplace 页 SHALL 以稳定 flat index 统一计数、选择解析及前后导航：匹配 source 占一个 header 加其插件槽位，不匹配 source 仍保留 `plugins.len().max(1)` 个索引槽但不产生可选项；折叠 source、错误 source 和无插件 source 不暴露子项，搜索按插件名 fuzzy 匹配并强制打开命中 source。当前选择解析为 source header 或对应 source 内 plugin；键位分别映射 install、refresh、update、add source、uninstall 与 remove source，输入值去除首尾空白。
scenarios: Index agreement
多来源、查询、错误或折叠状态改变可见项
count、next、prev 与 resolve 使用同一 flat-index 算法并对同一索引达成一致。
Selection identity
当前行是 source header 或 plugin row
返回 source index 以及 None 或精确 plugin index，越界或隐藏槽返回 None。
Marketplace actions
用户触发 i/r/u/a/d/x
解析为对应 marketplace action，add-source 表单提交裁剪后的 source。

requirement: Pager marketplace catalog component projection
contract: Marketplace catalog 行 SHALL 仅从结构化 PluginComponents 生成折叠摘要与展开字段，覆盖 skills、commands、agents、MCP servers、hooks、LSP servers 六类；展开时每类最多列八个名称并追加剩余计数。空 catalog 只在展开时显示 `no detectable components`，无 catalog 的远程项只在展开时显示安装后可见提示，本地无 catalog 不虚构内容；旧扫描计数字段不渲染，展开时用分类枚举替代折叠摘要且不重复。
scenarios: Collapsed summary
catalog components 非空且行未展开
显示结构化类别计数摘要一次，不显示旧扫描计数或占位符。
Expanded enumeration
行展开
按六个固定类别列名称、每类上限八项并以 +N more 收束，折叠摘要不重复。
Unknown contents
catalog 为空、远程项无 catalog 或本地项无 catalog
仅展开视图显示适用占位语，本地未知内容保持空白。

requirement: Pager mCP server section tool selection and setup rows
contract: MCP Servers 页 SHALL 按来源 section 对过滤后的 server 合组并发布可选择的 section header、server 行及仅对已展开 raw server index 生成的 tool 子行；首次加载默认折叠每个 plugin section 而保留 Local 展开，搜索强制显示 section children。选择解析必须区分 section/server/tool，并从最近的 `mcp-tools:{server_index}` 父行计算 tool index；错误、加载、越界或无父行返回 None。server/tool 行分别显示来源、连接/启用状态、工具计数与描述，setup 只对支持的 server 建立。
scenarios: Section defaults
MCP 列表首次含 Local 和 plugin server
plugin sections 一次性进入 collapsed 集，Local 保持展开；搜索忽略 section collapse。
Tool row identity
raw server index 被加入 tools-expanded
只生成该 server 的 tool 子行，选择子行得到 `(server_index, tool_index)`，header 与无效映射返回 None。
Selectability and status
picker 构建 section/header/tool 行
section header 可键盘选择且普通点击路径可折叠，server/tool 的 enabled 状态驱动 dim/badge 与 Space 文案。

requirement: Pager extensions modal rendering overlays and width safety
contract: 扩展弹窗渲染 SHALL 在终端小于 40×12 时不绘制并清除按钮命中区；正常帧先从当前数据重建标签、字段、原始索引、group key、选择性与 badge，再在成功绘制后原子发布映射，防止早退造成选择与旧映射错位。输入/setup 模式独占内容区并隐藏搜索列表；pending 无目标时覆盖内容区，目标 pending 与完成结果覆盖对应 badge；错误/确认使用换行安全的覆盖层与专属 footer 提示，结果通知使用非覆盖 footer、显示宽度截断和绝对到期。所有裁剪、换行、输入 viewport 均不得切断 UTF-8 或使宽字符溢出。
scenarios: Atomic paint state
数据过滤改变或窗口太小导致渲染早退
footer 使用本帧临时映射，只有成功绘制后提交 clamped selection 与 entry caches。
Mode overlays
WHEN输入、MCP setup、pending、错误、确认或结果提示激活
相应表单/覆盖层/footer 获得唯一视觉所有权且列表、搜索和快捷键按模式隐藏或替换。
Display width
文本含 CJK、emoji、多字节字符或超过区域宽度
wrap、truncate 和 viewport 以字符/显示宽度边界输出，不切断编码。

requirement: Pager dashboard root composition and empty-state rendering
contract: Pager 仪表盘渲染器 SHALL 以 DashboardState 的暂存工作目录、筛选、分组、选中项、peek/attach 状态和 roster 快照构造当前帧；每帧先用主题基础色覆盖完整区域并重新锚定可见选择。attached agent 时只保留顶部 dashboard banner 并把底部交给 agent popup；未 attached 时，peek 在高度允许时替换 dispatch，且依次渲染 header、列表、dispatch/peek、footer，最后由 shortcuts、location 或 worktree modal 覆盖并抑制底层光标。无行时 SHALL 区分加载中、真正空白与筛选无匹配，roster-only 行仍视为可见会话；本文件仅证明 Ratatui Buffer、状态字段和传入闭包的静态渲染行为，不证明事件循环、ACP 数据时序、鼠标/键盘 handler 或真实终端帧提交。
scenarios: Frame composition
a dashboard frame is rendered without an attached agent
