contract: PromptWidget SHALL accept at most ten live images and reject a decodable preview whose width or height is below eight pixels. Each accepted image SHALL receive a monotonically increasing display number, an undo-grouped atomic chip plus separator, a live element binding and a fresh-insertion preview anchor. Reconciliation after text edits SHALL match live records by ElementId, recover redo records by display number, retain removed images in an undo stash capped at twenty with oldest display numbers evicted and cleaned, clear stale hover/preview anchors, and never lower the high-water counter within a prompt lifetime. Cursor, hover and insertion preview lookup SHALL honor atomic-element ownership and dismiss after cursor movement. Submission drain SHALL reconcile against live element ids; text-only extraction SHALL remove only image element ranges. Restoring images SHALL cap input, bind records to the first live chip with the same display number, warn on duplicate or missing identities and advance the counter; chip restore SHALL use captured byte ranges. Explicit resets and abandoned stashes SHALL own temporary-file cleanup. This file does not prove image decoding or encoding, renderer/protocol support, tempfile cleanup success, backend upload, PastedImage Drop behavior for truncated or duplicate inputs, or correctness of externally supplied chip ranges.
scenarios: Insertion admission
an image is too small, exceeds the live cap or is accepted
it is rejected with a user message or receives one monotonic numbered atomic chip and preview anchor.
Edit reconciliation
chip elements are deleted, undone or redone
live images follow ElementId, redo uses display-number identity, removed payloads remain bounded and stale preview facts are cleared.
Submission projection
callers drain images or need text-only feedback
only live chip-bound image records leave the prompt and only image placeholder ranges are removed from text.
Restore binding
chip metadata and image records are restored
captured elements are registered first, records bind by display number within the cap and the counter does not regress.

requirement: Pager prompt geometry, chrome and overlay rendering
contract: PromptWidget SHALL compute desired height from effective content width, prefix, TextArea wrapping, top padding and optional info divider, freeze history-browse text height at one row and clamp to the provided maximum. Drawing SHALL no-op below usable dimensions, fill the selected prompt surface, derive focus or override colors, lay out optional accent/chrome/borders/title/prefix, render TextArea with persistent scroll state, repaint baked chip backgrounds for panel surfaces, and project slash command highlights and argument/inline ghosts using TextArea screen spans. Shell and predicted ghosts SHALL paint only at the eligible cursor with slash ownership taking priority. Empty unfocused prompts SHALL show the caller placeholder. The bottom caption SHALL right-align usage warning, agent, model, styled flags and multiline state within available width; unfocused default surfaces SHALL dim their interior. Paste preview SHALL use the supplied overlay and position-sensitive hint; image preview SHALL return post-flush terminal escapes, and a frame that paints no image SHALL return the overlay-clear escape. Cursor coordinates SHALL be returned only while focused. This file does not prove ratatui or Unicode terminal fidelity, actual image/OSC flush success, overlay ownership across widgets, downstream dropdown rendering, theme accuracy, or live terminal resize behavior.
scenarios: Height request
width, wrapping, browse mode, chrome, info or maximum height changes
the requested height uses effective text width, freezes browse mode and remains within the supplied bounds.
Prompt chrome
a usable area is drawn
configured surface, accent, borders, title, prefix, textarea, placeholder and focused dimming are projected without writing outside the area.
Completion overlays
slash, shell or predicted completion facts are eligible
raw token spans and ghost suffixes are painted with slash ownership suppressing competing ghost text.
Info and media overlays
metadata, paste preview or image preview is present
bounded captions and preview surfaces render, cursor visibility follows focus and image protocol escapes are returned or explicitly cleared.

requirement: Pager modal keyboard and paste routing
contract: The pager AgentView modal router SHALL give an active modal exclusive control of keyboard and paste input, route shared close, tab, shortcut and focus behavior through ModalWindow before modal content, and return an explicit changed, unchanged or action outcome. Picker modals SHALL clear only the query where their policy allows before closing or restoring a saved command palette; remember-note review SHALL save, toggle available raw/enhanced content and scroll with bounded subtraction; usage, shortcuts, memory and settings SHALL delegate their owned submodes; reset confirmation SHALL treat Esc, F2, Ctrl/Super-comma and explicit negative choices as cancel and SHALL accept a reset only from an unmodified matching key; and paste SHALL reach only the active picker or focused shortcuts, memory or settings filter rather than the hidden prompt. This router does not prove ModalWindow, picker, memory, settings, shortcuts or usage helper correctness, action dispatch, note persistence, terminal event decoding or clipboard behavior.
scenarios: Modal-exclusive keyboard routing
a key arrives while an ActiveModal variant is open
shared chrome receives it first where applicable and the surviving event is delegated only to that modal’s content handler.
Layered close and restoration
Esc or a close request occurs in a searchable picker, nested documentation view or saved-palette flow
the query, inner view or modal closes at the documented layer and a saved palette is restored when present.
Confirmation and review controls
reset confirmation or remember-note review receives its supported keys
cancel/reset/save/toggle/scroll outcomes are emitted without modifier ambiguity or underflow.
Focused paste routing
bracketed paste arrives while a modal is active
only a picker query or an eligible focused modal filter consumes the text and other active modals consume it without mutating the prompt.

requirement: Pager command argument session and documentation picker transitions
contract: The pager picker router SHALL filter command-palette rows without selecting section headers, translate palette choices into their corresponding actions, preserve the draft when forwarding slash commands or external editing, and preserve a palette snapshot while entering How-to, resume-session or argument pickers. Argument pickers SHALL choose search/navigation profile from command and phase, filter catalog fields case-insensitively, enter a verified second phase only when suggested rows have effort-style insertion text, step back from that phase before closing, and emit the catalog insertion id trimmed only at the end. Session pickers SHALL build one grouped input map from the effective server-stamped query, support direct and worktree selection, deep search, expand/collapse, copy, guarded deletion and fetch invalidation on close, and keep deletion armed across mouse movement but cancel it on other keys or selection movement. Documentation pickers SHALL filter title or description, open a viewer, scroll it and shuttle the palette snapshot through list/view back navigation. This file does not prove registry suggestion correctness, session search/fetch ordering, session deletion, loading results, worktree creation, document content accuracy or execution of emitted actions.
scenarios: Palette command selection
a selectable command-palette row is chosen
the modal closes or opens the requested nested picker and emits the matching application action while retaining any required palette snapshot.
Argument phase and filtering
an argument picker query, selection or close event occurs
rows filter by matching fields, validated chained phases replace the list, close steps back before dismissal, and a terminal choice emits one slash command with its catalog id.
Session selection and guarded deletion
session-picker navigation, search, expand, worktree, copy, delete or close input occurs
the grouped row map resolves the intended session and close invalidates any fetch whose landing surface disappeared.
Documentation navigation
a guide is filtered, selected, scrolled or closed
the matching viewer/list transition occurs and the original palette can be restored.

requirement: Pager modal mouse routing and action projection
contract: The pager modal mouse router SHALL route chrome hit-testing before modal content, mirror layered close/restoration semantics for picker, documentation and session modals, emit SessionPickerClosed when a mouse close removes that fetch landing surface, and step an argument picker back from a chained phase before dismissing it. It SHALL delegate wheel, row, tab, filter, section and settings interactions to the active modal, map usage-row clicks to copy actions, map reset-confirm shortcuts or close to explicit choices, and use recorded standard-confirm button rectangles for click and hover projection. This file does not prove hit rectangles before a render pass, terminal mouse coordinate translation, downstream mouse helpers, clipboard writes, deletion or setting reset execution.
scenarios: Chrome-first mouse handling
a modal mouse event hits close, tabs, shortcuts, outside chrome or content
ModalWindow resolves chrome first and only unhandled content events reach the active modal helper.
Nested modal close
a picker or document modal closes by mouse
an effort phase steps back, a saved palette or guide list is restored where applicable, and session fetch invalidation is emitted.
Specialized rows and controls
memory, settings, shortcuts, usage or reset content is clicked or scrolled
the owned helper/state produces the corresponding changed or application action outcome.
Standard confirmation hit state
pointer movement or a left click intersects a recorded modal button
hover changes only on key changes and a click is routed as that button’s unmodified key.

requirement: Pager active modal render dispatch and picker geometry
contract: The pager active-modal renderer SHALL render exactly the currently active supported modal into the supplied viewport, reuse the same dispatch for full and minimal hosts, and derive argument-picker focus, sizing, visible-row budget and rich-description wrapping from one profile policy. Command, argument and session pickers SHALL build rows and non-selectable flags consistent with input mapping; session rendering SHALL use the same effective query for local rows, content rows and loading header, record search and item hit areas, and show guarded-delete or normal shortcuts. Documentation, remember-note, shortcuts, memory, settings/reset and usage variants SHALL delegate to their owned renderers; remember-note markdown SHALL cache by width, clamp scroll and select raw or enhanced content. The renderer does not prove terminal cell-width fidelity, markdown parsing, animation timing, theme contrast, downstream renderer correctness, accessibility or equality between render/input maps under concurrent data mutation.
scenarios: Profile geometry
an argument command and phase select a profile
search policy, focus, width, chrome, visible rows and rich summaries follow that profile within the viewport.
Picker row projection
command, argument or session picker state is drawn
visible rows, selection, non-selectable flags, search/loading state and hit areas are derived from the same current state used by input routing.
Session query consistency
server-stamped results or content-search rows are present
effective query gates filtering, headers and row indices consistently for that frame.
Delegated modal rendering
a documentation, note, shortcuts, memory, settings/reset or usage modal is active
its owned renderer receives the current state, geometry, theme and compact policy.

requirement: Pager session picker selection search focus and guarded-delete unit checks
contract: The modal-routing unit suite SHALL verify that session deletion requires d followed by y for the armed row, n or another keyboard action cancels it, mouse movement preserves it, and bare y never deletes. It SHALL verify close emits fetch invalidation, Ctrl-W resolves a worktree selection while search owns focus, server-stamped content matches remain pickable without local title matching while unstamped rows remain locally filtered, and non-vim boundary arrows transfer focus to search with hidden selection until a typed query restores the highlight. These tests do not prove backend deletion, fetch cancellation, worktree creation, deep-search transport, rendered row geometry or global vim-setting isolation under parallel test execution.
scenarios: Guarded deletion
d, y, n, unrelated keys, mouse movement or bare y are sent to the session picker
only an armed d-then-y sequence emits DeleteSession for the captured id and cwd.
Close and worktree actions
Esc closes the picker or Ctrl-W selects while search is focused
SessionPickerClosed or the indexed worktree-pick action is emitted.
Stamped versus local search
the query is or is not stamped by server results
an unrelated title remains selectable only for the stamped result set.
Search focus boundary
Up/Down crosses a non-vim list boundary and text is then entered
focus moves to search, hides row selection, and typing restores meaningful selection.
Picker seed
a test opens a session picker with entries
the active agent owns a modal with those entries and clean search/content/delete state.
Picker entry
a test creates an entry with id and cwd
summary equals id, timestamps are populated, repo_name is `repo`, and optional model/branch/host/detail fields are empty.
System notice extraction
a test asks for the latest or offset system text
the helper indexes from scrollback end and returns Notice text; wrong type or out-of-range index panics.
Toast extraction
a test expects an agent toast
the helper returns AgentId(0)'s message and panics if no toast exists.
Project-picker state
a test requests project_picker_app
Welcome remains active with `/tmp` cwd, project_picker_shown false, and other test defaults.

requirement: Pager command palette vim draft and paste-routing unit checks
contract: The modal-routing unit suite SHALL verify that choosing external prompt editing from the minimal command palette preserves the hidden draft; vim-enabled palettes begin in input mode, clear a non-empty query on the first Escape, enter navigation mode on the next Escape, suppress ordinary typing there, and re-enter search with i or slash; non-vim palettes remain type-to-filter after Escape; and bracketed paste edits only the active query at its cursor while leaving the hidden prompt unchanged and is ignored from inactive vim search. These tests do not prove external editor launch, actual terminal bracketed-paste decoding, command execution, palette rendering or process-wide vim-cache isolation under concurrent tests.
scenarios: Draft preservation
external editing is selected from a minimal-mode palette
the edit action is emitted and the existing prompt draft remains unchanged.
Vim input transitions
Escape, ordinary letters, i or slash are used with vim mode enabled
query clearing, navigation suppression and search re-entry follow the tested two-stage flow.
Non-vim filtering
Escape clears a non-vim query and another letter is typed
the palette remains in search and filters again.
Palette paste ownership
paste occurs in an active query or inactive vim navigation
it inserts at the query cursor only in the active case and never reaches the prompt.

requirement: Pager argument-picker profile geometry filtering and catalog-id unit checks
contract: The modal-routing unit suite SHALL verify that search profiles allocate enough rows for small model lists, navigation profiles omit search chrome, behavior is wider while retaining navigation policy, effort, permission and second-phase model commands remain compact, and long descriptions cap and ellipsize. It SHALL also verify that argument pickers stay type-to-filter after arrow input even when global vim mode is enabled and that selecting a displayed model emits the underlying catalog id rather than its friendly label. These tests do not prove live catalog discovery, every command profile, Unicode display-column wrapping, terminal geometry, slash-command execution or global vim-cache isolation under concurrent tests.
scenarios: Selector sizing
small lists use search, navigation or behavior profiles
chrome, visible rows, width and height follow the tested profile constraints.
Description cap
rich description text exceeds the line budget
wrapping returns at most two lines and marks remaining content with an ellipsis when required.
Filtering despite vim
an argument picker receives arrows and text while vim mode is globally enabled
its query stays active and filters the catalog.
Catalog identity
a model row with a friendly label is selected
the slash action carries its provider catalog id.

requirement: Pager focused settings memory and usage-modal input unit checks
contract: The modal-routing unit suite SHALL verify that settings and memory paste inserts normalized text at the focused filter cursor without mutating the hidden prompt, and that the usage modal closes on Escape, switches tabs through keyboard or recorded tab hits, and maps Enter or a rendered-row click to copying the selected session-information row. It SHALL also verify click-outside dismissal after popup geometry is recorded. These tests do not prove settings persistence, memory search, clipboard writes, live usage data, terminal mouse translation, actual rendering or accessibility.
scenarios: Focused filter paste
settings or memory owns a focused filter and paste arrives after cursor movement
normalized text enters that query at the cursor while the prompt remains untouched.
Usage keyboard controls
Escape, Tab, BackTab or Enter reaches the usage modal
it closes, switches tabs or emits copy for the selected loaded row.
Usage mouse controls
a click hits a recorded row, tab or outside-popup coordinate
it emits copy, switches tab or closes respectively.

requirement: Pager root host lifecycle project discovery and Trajectory execution effects
contract: The pager root effect executor SHALL synchronously project quit, process working-directory changes and best-effort active-session registration, and SHALL spawn project-recents, dashboard-location, card-detail and Trajectory work as TaskResult-producing tasks. Trajectory launch SHALL run the current executable with trajectory <session> --no-open, detach it with null stdin/stdout and piped stderr, accept only a readiness line whose parsed URL starts with http://, fail readiness after ten seconds, retain at most eight startup diagnostic lines and report a later runtime termination through a separate task. This file does not prove process-global cwd safety, source collectors, persisted card data, child cleanup after every abort path or browser/debugger reachability.
scenarios: Quit effect
Effect::Quit is executed
the executor logs the quit and returns true without spawning a task.
Best-effort host mutation
active-session registration or process cwd mutation fails
the failure is warned and execute still returns its normal non-quit result.
Trajectory becomes ready
stderr emits a Trajectory readiness line with an http:// URL before ten seconds
TrajectoryLaunched carries that URL and later termination is monitored independently.
Trajectory readiness fails
the child exits, stderr fails, the channel closes or ten seconds elapse before readiness
TrajectoryLaunched carries a sanitized failure.
Discovery task fails internally
worktree indexing or card-detail blocking work cannot join
the effect returns default empty worktree/detail data rather than a distinct failure TaskResult.
Trajectory ready line
stderr text contains the trajectory readiness prefix and an http URL
the exact URL slice is returned.
Startup failure
stderr text reports a failure without a readiness URL
None is returned.

requirement: Pager session creation loading worktree restoration and fork effects
contract: The pager root executor SHALL create or load ACP sessions with the selected cwd, discovered MCP servers and SessionFlags metadata, and SHALL preflight explicit session ids before creating them. Worktree creation SHALL use grow/git/worktree/create_from_worktree_sync followed by NewSession; worktree resume SHALL use grow/git/worktree/resume_session and project its session id, paths and restore metadata; direct fork SHALL use grow/session/fork and require a returned newSessionId. LoadSession SHALL add grow/restore_code only for Some(true), parse restore and foreground metadata and preserve the requested session id in its TaskResult. This file does not prove worktree filesystem isolation, Git copy semantics, session-id preflight atomicity, MCP server validity or cleanup of a worktree after session creation fails.
scenarios: Explicit id collision
an explicit new session id fails the availability preflight
no NewSession request is sent and a sanitized session failure is returned.
Resume existing worktree session
load_session_id is present
resume_session receives source cwd, copy mode, worktree type, optional restoreCode and gitRef, and its result is mapped to WorktreeForked.
Create worktree session
no load_session_id is present
a worktree is created first and NewSession is issued from the derived session cwd.
Load response
ACP LoadSession succeeds
models, restoration summary/degree and foreground metadata are returned; ACP failure becomes SessionLoadFailed.

requirement: Pager session discovery mutation and information effects
contract: The pager root executor SHALL request session picker, roster and dashboard data through grow/session/list or grow/sessions/list, debounce picker search, and load a persisted title independently. Rename and delete SHALL pass session id plus cwd and treat a non-null response error as failure. Session info SHALL use the typed grow/session/info envelope for agent name, context and formatted display; session usage SHALL parse the bare grow/session/usage response and translate method-not-found to an unsupported-version message. The formatted info SHALL include title when present, shell version, session, cwd, model, optional fingerprint/backend/sandbox, turn and context. This file does not prove picker parsing, persistence freshness, title uniqueness, delete authorization or the accuracy of the hard-coded authentication label.
scenarios: Unfiltered picker
FetchSessionList has no query
the request includes limit 30 and allowRelax true; a query instead supplies query and omits allowRelax.
Malformed dashboard result
the dashboard list response contains an error or ACP fails
DashboardSessionsLoaded carries an empty session list.
Session mutation error
rename or delete returns a non-null error member
the corresponding Failed TaskResult carries its string or JSON representation.
Usage unsupported
grow/session/usage returns method-not-found
SessionUsageFailed reports that the agent version does not support it.
Title hydration
a local summary has a manual title or display title
SessionTitleFromDisk returns the title and whether it was manual; read/join failures become None.
Scope repo
_meta.grow/listScope is repo
ListScope::Repo is returned.
Scope all
_meta.grow/listScope is all
ListScope::All is returned.
Scope default
metadata is absent or has another value
ListScope::Cwd is returned.
Prompt preview
the first prompt record has a multiline text
only its first nonempty trimmed line is returned.
Timeline unavailable
storage returns an error or no timeline
the prompt helper returns None and stats return (0,0).
Stats
timeline events include started turns and tools
the respective counts are returned.

requirement: Pager prompt submission block metadata and reconciliation effects
contract: Plain, structured-block and bash submissions SHALL send ACP PromptRequest with the owning session, promptId and optional screenMode. Plain text SHALL carry skillTokenRanges only when non-empty; bash SHALL use PromptBlockMeta::bash; block/image submission SHALL materialize image blocks off the async runtime and fail locally before ACP send if loading fails. All three SHALL return PromptResponse with the prompt id and an HTTP status extracted from ACP errors, although bash preserves the raw ACP error string while the other paths use format_acp_error. Prompt status reconciliation SHALL query grow/queue/prompt_status by session and prompt id. This file does not prove range validity, image decoding, server-side prompt idempotency, request ordering, prompt execution or reducer handling of late responses.
scenarios: Plain prompt metadata
skill token ranges are non-empty
the single text block includes skillTokenRanges pairs; empty ranges leave block meta absent.
Screen mode correlation
a session screen mode is available
prompt request metadata includes both promptId and screenMode; default test flags omit screenMode.
Image materialization failure
append_prompt_images or its blocking task fails
PromptResponse is returned without sending the ACP prompt and http_status is None.
Prompt RPC failure
ACP rejects a submitted prompt
PromptResponse preserves prompt correlation and the extracted HTTP status when available.
Status parse failure
prompt_status returns invalid JSON
PromptStatusResolved carries a sanitized invalid-response error.

requirement: Pager turn cancellation queue mutation and session control effects
contract: The pager root executor SHALL encode cancel policy in CancelNotification metadata, send plan-mode and queue mutations through their grow extension notifications, and map behavior, model/effort and agent switches to control-correlated completion results. A control response status of superseded SHALL map to Superseded; every other or absent status SHALL mean AuthoritativeUpdatePending. Control failures SHALL preserve whether a terminal update was already published and sanitize their message. Notification transport failures SHALL be warned but still collapse to CancelComplete. This file does not prove queue optimistic-version enforcement, cancel completion, control terminal delivery, mode/model/agent validity or reducer reconciliation.
scenarios: Cancel metadata
optional pause, trigger or pristine rewind flags are enabled
their camelCase keys are added alongside cancelSubagents.
Queue mutation
remove, reorder, clear, edit, hold, release or interject is requested
the corresponding grow/queue notification includes its session and mutation-specific fields.
Superseded control
the control response reports status superseded
the completion result is Superseded; all other statuses await the authoritative update.
Effort patch
SwitchModel is an effort-only patch
it targets the reasoning effort config and requires a selected effort; otherwise it targets the model config.
Notification send failure
cancel, plan or queue notification delivery fails
the executor warns and returns CancelComplete without a failure payload.

requirement: Pager background task subagent scheduler and terminal control effects
contract: The pager root executor SHALL send background-task kill, subagent cancel, scheduled-task delete and terminal-background requests using their respective grow extension methods. Background kill SHALL parse the response into a typed outcome and preserve an ACP transport failure separately; subagent cancel SHALL collapse transport failure to RpcFailed. Scheduler delete and terminal demotion SHALL warn on transport failure and still return CancelComplete. This file does not prove that a remote process stops, scheduled state is deleted, a terminal detaches, late lifecycle events are reconciled or identifiers belong to the supplied session.
scenarios: Background kill response
grow/task/kill succeeds
BgTaskKilled carries the parsed outcome for the session and task id.
Subagent cancel failure
grow/subagent/cancel fails
KillSubagentComplete carries RpcFailed rather than an error string.
Best-effort scheduler control
scheduler delete or terminal background send fails
the failure is only warned and the task completes as CancelComplete.

requirement: Pager compaction prompt history and recap effects
contract: Explicit compaction SHALL call grow/compact_conversation with session and user context and deserialize its status into CompactComplete while preserving foreground tracking. Prompt-history lookup SHALL pass cwd and optional session_id and accept prompts either under result.prompts or top-level prompts; transport or malformed response SHALL yield an empty history. Recap SHALL call grow/recap with the auto flag and report any ACP failure as an optional error without discarding session correlation. This file does not prove the compaction algorithm, token reduction, prompt-history persistence, recap contents or UI application of stale results.
scenarios: Compact response invalid
the compact response JSON or status cannot deserialize
CompactComplete carries an internal ACP error describing the invalid response.
History unavailable
history transport fails or prompts are missing/malformed
PromptHistoryLoaded contains an empty vector.
Recap rejected
grow/recap fails
RecapRequested preserves session and auto and includes a request-failed message.

requirement: Pager memory rewrite save BTW and live interjection effects
contract: Memory rewrite SHALL call grow/memory/rewrite with raw text and context and fall back to the original text for ACP failure, malformed response or missing rewritten content. Global memory save SHALL append in blocking work and report join or storage failure. BTW SHALL query grow/btw and return its answer or the literal No response fallback. Live interjection SHALL materialize any images, represent text-only steering as a single content block, call grow/steer with expected turn and interjection ids, and preserve original input on failure for retry. This file does not prove model rewrite quality, memory file locking, BTW isolation, image placeholder semantics, expected-turn enforcement or server-side insertion ordering.
scenarios: Rewrite fallback
rewrite fails or has no string rewritten value
MemoryNoteRewritten returns Ok with the original raw text.
Memory save failure
the blocking task cannot join or append_to_memory fails
MemoryNoteSaved carries a string error.
Text-only interjection
no content blocks are supplied
grow/steer receives one text content block and no second top-level text channel.
Interjection image failure
image materialization fails
no steer request is sent and InterjectFailed retains text, blocks and images.
BTW missing answer
a successful BTW response lacks result.answer
the displayed answer is No response.

requirement: Pager attachment image diagnostics and changelog effects
contract: Clipboard attachment probing SHALL run in blocking work, discard a stale change-count or non-clipboard bracketed payload, probe raster and file URLs, prepare raster preview and optionally persist agent-prompt images, and fail after the configured timeout. Prompt preview and image-viewer loading SHALL run blocking work and project failure states. Doctor planning SHALL list automatic fixes, select an automatic plan or return a local command, and doctor application SHALL report join and apply errors. Changelog fetch failure SHALL return an empty changelog after warning. This file does not prove platform clipboard trust, image safety, persistence atomicity, diagnostic fix correctness, terminal compatibility or network changelog freshness.
scenarios: Stale clipboard
the current clipboard change count differs from the captured count
the probe returns ProbeDropped without accepting attachments.
Prompt image persistence
raster data targets an agent prompt with an images directory
persistence success returns Image and failure returns PersistFailed.
Probe timeout
blocking clipboard work exceeds the configured timeout
ClipboardAttachmentProbed carries ProbeFailed and no file URLs.
Doctor selection
a fix id has an automatic plan, only a human command or a selection error
DoctorFixPlanned distinguishes Plan, RunLocally and Err.
Changelog failure
blocking fetch cannot join
ChangelogFetched has no markdown and an empty entries vector.
Image batch limit
the supplied image list contains the tested over-limit count
append_prompt_images returns an error before encoding.
Missing or oversized file
an image has no encoded bytes and its session path is missing or exceeds the tested size
append_prompt_images returns an error.
Aggregate size
multiple existing image files exceed the tested aggregate limit
append_prompt_images returns an error.
Placeholder text
ACP content only contains a textual image placeholder and the image list is empty
the original content remains unchanged.
Image count
the explicit image slice contains more than 16 items
the helper returns an error before reading or encoding.
File source
an image has no encoded bytes or its saved path is absent, nonregular, empty, or over the raw limit
the helper returns an error.
Aggregate budget
preflighted images make the estimated encoded bytes plus per-image allowance exceed 64 MiB
the helper returns an aggregate-limit error before the encoding loop.
Changed file
a file read returns a byte count different from its preflighted metadata length
the helper returns a reattach error.
No attachments
the image slice is empty
the incoming ACP blocks are returned unchanged.
Clipboard timeout
the off-thread clipboard probe exceeds the configured timeout
the effect layer uses the 10-second timeout constant.

requirement: Pager UI preference model permission and setting persistence effects
contract: Announcement visibility, memory fullscreen, project-picker opt-out, dashboard state, worktree mode, preferred model and generic settings SHALL be delegated to their persistence helpers or blocking writers. Worktree mode SHALL debug-assert one of two known config keys. Preferred-model persistence SHALL report failure for reducer rollback; generic setting persistence SHALL return the original rollback value on failure. Permission mode SHALL either use the combined persistence-and-notification helper or send grow/permission_mode_changed directly, with direct notification failure reduced to a warning. This file does not prove durable write atomicity, concurrent writer ordering, config schema validation, rollback application or remote permission-mode convergence.
scenarios: Generic setting succeeds
persist_setting completes
SettingPersisted returns the key and requested value.
Generic setting fails
persist_setting fails
SettingPersistFailed returns key, rollback value and error.
Dashboard persistence fails
writing or joining the blocking dashboard task fails
the error is warned and the effect still returns CancelComplete.
Permission notification fails
grow/permission_mode_changed cannot be sent
the failure is warned and no failure-bearing TaskResult is produced.

requirement: Pager MCP plugin marketplace skill workflow and hook administration effects
contract: The pager root executor SHALL expose list and action RPCs for MCPs, hooks, plugins, marketplaces, skills and workflows, deserialize successful extension responses into their typed view models, and return user-facing failures otherwise. Skill toggle SHALL refresh the skills baseline only after a successfully parsed toggle response. Marketplace update check SHALL list update_available plugins, apply their updates serially, collect only typed successful outcomes and notify the session when at least one succeeds. CTA install/reload/MCP probing SHALL preserve agent and plugin correlation, with fixed retry and installed-dismiss delays. MCP upsert/delete/server/tool toggles SHALL send their method-specific field conventions and report their transport result. This file does not prove extension authenticity, marketplace trust, dependency resolution, transactional multi-update behavior, reload completion, MCP process health, skill path scope or workflow execution.
scenarios: Malformed list
an extension list response cannot deserialize
the corresponding Loaded TaskResult carries a generic load failure rather than partial data.
Skill baseline refresh
grow/skills/toggle returns a parseable skills list
grow/skills/refresh-baseline is attempted and its failure is ignored.
Marketplace updates
multiple plugins report update_available
each update is attempted serially and only successful typed outcomes are returned and notified.
CTA timing
CTA MCP retry or installed dismissal is scheduled
it waits the configured fixed delay before fetching or returning the timeout result.
MCP mutation
an MCP server or tool is upserted, deleted or toggled
the matching grow/mcp method receives session, names and requested enabled/config state.
Missing owner
a list/toggle result targets an absent agent or modal
no modal state or unrelated agent is mutated and no effect is emitted.
Hooks result
hooks load succeeds or fails
the owning hooks tab becomes Loaded with all source groups collapsed or Error with the supplied message.
Plugins result
plugins load succeeds or fails
plugin groups are seeded once on success, data becomes Loaded/Error, and pending action/index are cleared.
MCP toggle
toggle fails or succeeds for a bound session
failure stores an Error modal message and clears pending state; success schedules a fresh FetchMcpsList.
Marketplace response
a response arrives while a refetch is queued
inflight is cleared, the queued request is reissued when a session exists, and sanitized response state is installed.
Skills toggle
skills refresh succeeds with fewer items or fails
loaded data is stored and selection clamps to the last item, or an error message is stored; pending state is cleared in both cases.
Marketplace updates
the update list is empty or nonempty
empty input is ignored; nonempty names become a bounded summary notice on the owning agent.

requirement: Pager command bundle catalog and rewind execution effects
contract: Slash-command execution SHALL send grow/commands/execute with command, description and invocation id and return the original request plus any ACP error. Catalog entry, bundle status and available-command refresh SHALL deserialize their typed or command-list payloads, with command refresh collapsing any failure to an empty vector. Rewind point discovery SHALL reject a non-null envelope error; rewind preview and execution SHALL both call grow/rewind/execute, differing by force false/true while preserving the requested mode, and shall reject an invalid typed response. This file does not prove command authorization or execution, bundle cache integrity, catalog source trust, rewind snapshot correctness, destructive rewind safety or stale-result rejection in the reducer.
scenarios: Slash command transport
command execution succeeds or fails
SlashCommandExecuted retains agent, session, original request and an optional ACP error.
Catalog envelope error
bundle entry or status response includes error
the corresponding Failed result carries its string or an unknown-error fallback.
Command refresh failure
grow/commands/list fails or commands cannot deserialize
AvailableCommandsRefreshed carries an empty vector.
Rewind preview
preview is requested
grow/rewind/execute receives force false, target prompt index and mode and returns the typed response with the original target.
Rewind execute
execution is requested
the same method receives force true and a valid response becomes RewindExecuteComplete.

requirement: Pager deep session search and prompt suggestion effects
contract: Deep session search SHALL call grow/session/search with content enabled and retry while the response reports bootstrapping, bounded by a nominal thirty-second deadline with three-second retry intervals. Prompt and plugin CTA debounce effects SHALL wait 50 and 300 milliseconds respectively. Shell suggestions SHALL pass text, cursor, cwd, AI options, session, limit, generation and tokenOnly to grow/suggest and return a result only when the response parser succeeds; prompt suggestion SHALL query grow/suggestPrompt and extract result.suggestion. Suggestion ACP or parse failures SHALL collapse to CancelComplete or None rather than an error-bearing result. This file does not prove ranking quality, privacy of indexed content, hard thirty-second wall-clock completion, cancellation of stale generations, cursor validity, model availability or reducer-side generation filtering.
scenarios: Search bootstrapping
search reports bootstrapping true before the deadline
the executor sleeps three seconds and retries, retaining the most recently parsed results.
Search terminal response
bootstrapping is false
DeepSearchResults is returned immediately with the parsed hits and original sequence.
Shell suggestion unavailable
ACP fails or the parser rejects the response
the task returns CancelComplete without a diagnostic payload.
Prompt suggestion missing
response JSON, result or suggestion is missing
PromptSuggestionLoaded carries None with agent and generation.
Debounce expiry
the fixed timer elapses
the matching generation is returned for stale-result handling elsewhere.
Debounce expiry
the session-search debounce effect runs
the fixed delay is 250 milliseconds before completion.

requirement: Pager resolved selection hit testing and drag edge mechanics
contract: The pager selection geometry layer SHALL group consecutively rendered lines by entry and range identity, preserve stable block-line coordinates across viewport changes, distinguish exact text hits from same-row nearest-column hits, and constrain drag-head snapping to the anchor range. Gap-row ties SHALL prefer the candidate farther from the anchor, an absent range SHALL yield no new head, and hit testing SHALL ignore zero-width spans. Text and block drags SHALL cross their threshold after any one-cell movement. Edge autoscroll SHALL return no state for a zero-height or comfortably interior viewport, select Up or Down within the two-row edge zones or beyond them, and ramp speed through 1, 2, 3 and 5 rows per tick. Block overlay SHALL highlight only visible blocks in the inclusive entry interval. This layer does not schedule ticks, mutate scroll offsets, choose input ownership, copy blocks or prove terminal rendering.
scenarios: Selectable range hit
a pointer is on a rendered selectable row
nearest hit testing returns the exact or closest clamped column, while exact testing can be applied separately for chrome fallthrough.
Anchor-range head snapping
a drag pointer crosses gap rows, other ranges or the last visible line
the nearest visible line of the anchor range is selected, full ties extend away from the anchor, and an absent anchor range returns no hit.
Edge autoscroll
the pointer is near or outside a nonempty content viewport
direction follows the relevant edge and speed increases by distance; an interior pointer or empty viewport produces no state.
Block interval overlay
an active block drag spans visible entry indices
every buffer cell in each included visible block area receives the selection highlight.

requirement: Pager linear selection reconstruction and boundary restoration
contract: Pager linear text reconstruction SHALL normalize forward and reversed endpoints by stable block-line index, include both endpoint columns, select the remainder of the first line, all middle lines and the prefix of the last line, and clamp every column to each line’s selectable display width. Visible-model reconstruction SHALL include only present lines in the anchor range; full reconstruction SHALL traverse complete block output and include only lines with the anchor range id. Both paths SHALL preserve each line’s explicit joiner or use a newline fallback, slice by display columns, and apply registered hidden prefix or suffix boundaries only when the selected slice reaches the corresponding path edge. No selected line SHALL return None, while a selected empty slice may return an empty string. This layer does not load full output, validate boundary registration or deliver clipboard content.
scenarios: Single-line and reversed endpoints
both endpoints are on one line in either order
the inclusive min-to-max display-column slice is returned after width clamping.
Multi-line sweep
endpoints span multiple stable block lines
the first tail, full middle lines and last inclusive prefix are joined in block order.
Visible versus full reconstruction
some selected lines are outside the current model
visible reconstruction returns only present selected lines, while full reconstruction can include matching complete-output lines.
Hidden edit boundaries
a selected slice reaches a registered path edge
its prefix or suffix is restored exactly there and omitted from partial interior slices.

requirement: Pager active and persistent selection overlay projection
contract: Pager text-selection painting SHALL map stable selection endpoints back through the current frame model and highlight only selected display cells. Linear active and persistent selections with identical endpoints SHALL paint the same cells; single-line selections are inclusive, multi-line selections paint the first tail, middle widths and last prefix, and missing entry/range geometry is a no-op. Exact text hit testing SHALL succeed only inside selectable columns on the matching row, leaving accent bars, borders, padding, gaps and other rows available to higher-level handlers. Selection highlighting SHALL use one uniform theme band, remove an earlier reverse modifier, and fall back to reverse video for colorless themes. This layer does not manage selection lifetime, table side-car validity, render ordering, terminal mouse decoding or clipboard delivery.
scenarios: Active and persistent parity
active and persisted linear selections carry the same endpoints
they paint the same current-frame cells.
Stable endpoint projection
a persisted selection is rendered after viewport geometry changes
stable block-line indices are resolved to the current screen positions and only the selected columns are painted.
Missing geometry
the selected entry and range are absent from the frame model
the buffer is left unchanged.
Exact text hit
a pointer is tested for text ownership
only a cell inside a nonempty selectable span returns a hit; surrounding chrome and gaps return None.
Inactive pane
is_active is false
relative_selected is absent and the content post-pass does not paint the selected-entry background or selection box.
Header-owned selection
a pushed or pinned header already owns the selected entry
content selection calculation is skipped to avoid a duplicate selection box.
Collapsed selected row
the active selection is a collapsed ToolCall, Thinking block or multi-entry group
the selected area receives a bg_dark fill clipped to content bounds, with border columns preserved unless configured otherwise.
Persistent output model
the lower renderer supplies selected area and selection model data
the pane preserves selected_entry_area and the delegated model in RenderOutput for later overlay consumers.

requirement: Pager configurable display-column word boundaries
contract: Pager word-boundary recognition SHALL operate in terminal display columns over Unicode grapheme clusters and partition nonzero-width graphemes into Word, Whitespace and configured Separator classes. A selection SHALL expand across the maximal contiguous run of the target class; an empty string returns 0..0 and a column past the text clamps to the final segment. The default separator set SHALL match printable ASCII punctuation except underscore, while configuration loading SHALL read ui.word_separators once per process and fall back to that default on load failure, absence or non-string data. Wide CJK graphemes and combining sequences SHALL preserve display-column bounds. This layer does not reload changed configuration, implement click counting or prove parity with every tmux Unicode behavior.
scenarios: Three-class expansion
a display column lands in a word, whitespace or separator run
the result covers the complete contiguous run of that same class.
Unicode display columns
text contains wide CJK or combining graphemes
returned bounds use terminal display width rather than UTF-8 bytes or scalar count.
Default punctuation policy
default separators are used
printable ASCII punctuation separates words, underscore and digits remain word characters, and whitespace has its own class.
Custom separators and bounds
separators are narrowed, empty or the column lies beyond text
classification follows the provided set and an out-of-range column selects the last segment.

requirement: Pager display-column URL span recognition
contract: Pager URL span recognition SHALL scan case-insensitively for http, https, ftp and file scheme text, compute match bounds in Unicode display columns, and return only the matched URL containing the requested column. It SHALL retain query strings, fragments, ports and balanced closing brackets, strip trailing prose punctuation and unbalanced closing brackets, reject a match reduced to scheme-only text, and return None for unsupported schemes, outside columns, empty text or non-URL prose. Multiple matches SHALL remain independently addressable. This is permissive text recognition; it does not parse or validate URLs, resolve destinations, check safety, handle every URI scheme or open links.
scenarios: Supported scheme span
the requested display column lies within an http(s), ftp or file match
the exact display-column range of that match is returned case-insensitively.
Trailing prose punctuation
regex capture ends in punctuation or an unmatched closing bracket
prose punctuation is removed while balanced brackets inside the URL remain.
Multiple and rich URLs
text contains multiple URLs, ports, queries or fragments
each supported match retains its URL content and only the one spanning the requested column is returned.
No valid span
text is empty, the scheme is unsupported or degenerate, or the column is outside a retained match
no URL range is returned so callers may use word selection.

requirement: Pager table-shaped selection resolution copy and paint
contract: Pager table-shaped selection SHALL resolve an anchor inside detected table cell content to TableCell and escalate to a carried rectangular TableGrid only when the latched head reaches another cell’s content. Border anchors or missing geometry SHALL remain Linear; divider, border and adjacent padding dead zones SHALL preserve the held cell or grid to prevent mode flicker, and returning to anchor content SHALL de-escalate to TableCell. Cell copy SHALL clamp endpoints into the anchor cell band, trim and space nonblank wrapped fragments; grid copy SHALL serialize the carried cell rectangle as TSV. Table overlays SHALL paint clipped nonblank cell-content bands, excluding border rows, junction columns, padding, blank fragments and unselected cells; a table-shaped selection without geometry SHALL paint nothing. This layer does not detect tables itself, validate stale geometry against live output, deliver clipboard text or define the whole-table gesture.
scenarios: Cell and grid resolution
a drag begins in cell content and its head moves within or beyond that cell
it resolves to TableCell or a carried TableGrid with dead-zone hysteresis; border anchors remain Linear.
Cell copy
a TableCell spans one or more wrapped fragments
endpoints clamp to the cell band and trimmed nonblank fragments join with spaces in either endpoint order.
Grid copy
a carried TableGrid spans rows and columns
whole cell values serialize in row order with tab-separated columns and newline-separated rows.
Table paint parity
a table-shaped selection is rendered with matching geometry
only selected content glyph bands are highlighted; without geometry, no misleading linear overlay is painted.

requirement: Pager task pane shell highlighting and finished-row dimming
contract: highlight_bash_command SHALL 在 Windows 首选 powershell grammar、其他平台首选 bash，并在首选失败时回退 bash；输入先附加换行供 syntect 解析，输出逐段删除尾部 CR/LF 并跳过空段。grammar 不存在、高亮报错或没有非空段时 SHALL 返回完整原命令和当前主题 command 前景色。dim_spans SHALL 将每个已有前景色向主题背景混合，缺少前景色时使用 gray；该转换只重建前景样式，不保留原 span 的其他 modifier。
scenarios: Grammar fallback
首选 grammar 不可用但 bash 可用
使用 bash；两者都不可用则单 span 原文回退。
Empty highlighted output
syntect 成功但所有段删除换行后为空
返回原命令而不是空行。
Finished command dimming
无 description 的后台命令已结束
缓存的高亮前景向背景混合后展示。

requirement: Pager background task row normalization and badge formatting
contract: 后台任务行 SHALL 优先采用 trim 后非空 description：普通任务将换行替为空格并加可搜索的 `Task ` 前缀，monitor 使用 `Monitor ` 标签且不执行 shell 高亮；description 缺失或空白时使用 trim 后 command，含换行时只保留首行并加省略号。行数 badge 对零返回空串，按 <1k、<10k、<1M、<10M、其余区间截断为原数、一位 k、整数 k、一位 M、整数 M，truncated 在右括号前加 `+`。后台稳定 id 由 task_id 的 DefaultHasher 结果生成。
scenarios: Description priority
普通任务同时有非空 description 和 command
展示 `Task <单行description>`，command 留给其他查看面。
Monitor row
monitor description 含换行
展示蓝色 Monitor 标签和折叠换行后的说明，不把说明当 shell。
Truncated output
缓存行数为 1234 且 truncated 为真
badge 为 `(1.2k+)`，不四舍五入。
Blank description
description trim 后为空
回退 command 标签路径。
Description priority
a nonempty description accompanies a started, completed, or failed task
the compact line shows the single-line description and omits the raw command.
Command newline normalization
the command contains physical newlines
collapsed output replaces each newline with a space and emits no literal newline.
Completion wording
the task is completed with an elapsed duration
the row says completed in the formatted duration and uses the preferred display text.
Failure wording
the task failed with a known signal or exit code
killed signals use `killed` without parenthesized detail; other failures show signal or exit code detail.

requirement: Pager subagent row state, search and activity projection
contract: 子 Agent 行 SHALL 通过 format_subagent_label 得到类型和说明，以 pending-kill、running、completed、其他终态选择标签颜色并将终态颜色向背景混合。trim 后非空 model SHALL 只进入完整可搜索 label 和右侧 overlay，不进入主体 styled spans。仅 running 且 activity_label 非空时追加灰色活动后缀，并将主体说明截到最多 40 显示宽度；活动文本不进入可搜索 label，终态不得展示残留活动。Agent 稳定 id SHALL 以 `agent:` 和 child_session_id 共同哈希，选择访问器分别暴露 subagent_id 与 child_session_id。
scenarios: Live activity
运行中 Agent 有活动说明
主体说明截宽并追加活动，搜索仍匹配完整原说明和 model。
Finished activity
finished 为真但 activity_label 尚在
不渲染活动后缀。
Model metadata
model trim 后非空
可搜索 label 包含 model，主体标签不内联 model。

requirement: Pager workflow row status and roster projection
contract: workflow 行 SHALL 使用 run_id 的 `workflow:` 哈希作为稳定 id，以 name 作为显示与控制标识；active 行显示运行色、当前非空 phase 和实际 state 等于 `running` 的 roster 数量，零 roster 且无 phase 时显示 running。非 active 行显示下划线替为空格的 status，并按 complete、其他 terminal、非 terminal paused 类状态着色。started_at SHALL 由 frame now 减 live_elapsed_ms_at 重建，stoppable SHALL 复制 can_stop，而 running SHALL 复制 is_active。
scenarios: Active roster
active workflow 有一个 running 和一个 done roster row
后缀只显示 1 agent。
Paused workflow
状态 paused 且 can_stop 为真
行 running 为假而 stoppable 为真。
Elapsed reconstruction
live elapsed 大于当前可减范围
checked_sub 失败时 started_at 回退当前 frame instant。

requirement: Pager scheduled watcher label and countdown projection
contract: scheduled 行 SHALL 将 prompt 按 Unicode char 计数限制为 60，超出时取前 57 chars 加三个 ASCII 点；状态后缀优先级为已链接且运行中的子 Agent `(running)`、provisional id `(starting)`、合法 RFC3339 next_fire_at 的未来/到期判断、最后按 human_schedule 与 created_at 的 interval 近似。非法 RFC3339 SHALL 进入 interval 回退，无法解析 schedule 时无时间后缀。tag 首字符大写，schedule 与 prompt 使用中性颜色；Scheduled 始终属于 Watchers、视为 running，稳定 id 由 `sched:` 与 task_id 哈希。
scenarios: Linked run
last_subagent_id 能匹配运行中子 Agent
显示 running，压过 provisional 或 countdown。
Bad next time
next_fire_at 非 RFC3339 且 schedule 可解析
按 created_at 加 interval 展示 next in 或 due now。
Unicode preview
prompt 超过 60 个多字节字符
在 char 边界截断，不因字节切片 panic。
Unknown schedule
无 next time 且 human schedule 不可解析
不追加运行/排队/倒计时后缀。

requirement: Pager task pane filtering, ordering, grouping and automatic visibility
contract: TasksPane::sync_at SHALL 在主题切换时重建 list style 并清空 shell 高亮缓存，然后收集可见实体：默认只取 running 后台任务/独立子 Agent、所有 scheduled 和非 terminal workflow，show_done 时包含终态；workflow_run_id 非空的子 Agent 独立行始终排除。排序 SHALL 依次为 workflows、subagents、普通 tasks、monitors、scheduled；组内 running 优先，Agent 再按 type_label 升序及 started_at 降序，其他同类型按开始时间降序，最后按 stable_id。显示列表 SHALL 插入 Workflows/Subagents/Tasks/Watchers header，monitor 与 scheduled 共用 Watchers 且 monitor 在前；折叠组只保留 header，组清空时遗忘折叠状态。自动显隐计数 SHALL 排除 replay-restored running 后台项和 workflow child；从零变正时自动打开，从正变零时只在此前自动打开、未聚焦且未 show_done 时关闭。公开 running_count 则包含 replay-restored running 后台项。
scenarios: Default filtering
存在 running 和 done 后台项
默认只收 running，show_done 后收两者。
Workflow ownership
子 Agent 带 workflow_run_id 且对应 workflow active
只显示 workflow 行，running_count 计一次。
Watcher grouping
同时有 monitor 和 scheduled
一个 Watchers header 计数二，monitor 在 scheduled 前。
Replay restore
唯一 running 后台项来自 replay
行仍可收集，但不触发自动打开。
Group repopulation
用户折叠的组清空后再次出现
旧折叠状态已删除，新行展开显示。

requirement: Pager task pane sizing and delegated input
contract: 任务 pane SHALL 使用 NoWrap ListPane，开启搜索、复制和过滤，关闭 follow、wrap toggle、visual select 与 goto-line；`h` 仅在没有输入模式时切换 show_done，其余键、粘贴与鼠标交由 ListPaneState，空 entries 时键盘和鼠标返回 false。滚动幅度 SHALL 在 viewport 高度 0..5 时最多一行、6..10 时最多两行、更高时不额外限制。overlay 隐藏或总视图低于 12 行时 desired_height 为零；可见且空时为一行，非空基础高度至多 min(8, floor(视图高度*0.15))，输入栏或 matcher 存在时再加一行。on_state_change SHALL 在隐藏时关闭输入栏并清除自动打开归因。
scenarios: Short terminal
overlay visible 但 view_height 为 11
desired_height 返回 0。
Search height
非空 pane 打开搜索输入
在基础高度上增加一行，可能达到 9 行。
Small viewport scroll
viewport 高度为 5 且请求滚动 20 行
只向相同方向滚动一行。
History toggle while searching
输入模式已打开并收到 h
不切换 show_done，由 ListPane 处理。
Todo toggle
Ctrl-T arrives while the todo pane is focused
the overlay toggles, state-change bookkeeping runs, and closing returns focus toward Scrollback.
Task group input
Right, Left, Enter, or Ctrl-F arrives with no task list input mode and a group header selected
the group expands, collapses, or toggles without being sent to content editing.
Task viewer action
Enter/Ctrl-F targets a background task with session metadata
a BlockViewerPane is created from its stdout and entry id fallback, the scrollback pane is forced active, and the outcome is Changed.
Task cancellation
x targets a running task, running non-pending-kill subagent, scheduled task, or stoppable workflow
the corresponding KillBgTask, KillSubagent, CancelScheduledTask, or draft-preserving workflow stop action is returned.
Catalog activation
an unmodified Enter targets a catalog entry
ViewCatalogEntry carries that entry kind and name; no selection yields Unchanged.
Delegated content
no router-owned action matches
the selected child pane handles the key and its boolean result is converted to Changed or Unchanged.

requirement: Pager task pane overlay rendering and action hit regions
contract: render SHALL 在 block padding 内绘制列表：空列表按 show_done 区分 `No tasks or agents.` 与运行为空提示；溢出且高度至少三行时仅为实际需要的居中上下箭头保留行，最终 viewport 只准备一次。列表真正溢出且右侧尚有空间时 SHALL 扩一列放 scrollbar；overlay 高度 SHALL 排除搜索/matcher bottom bar，header 占行但不生成按钮。覆盖层 SHALL 清空右端并在被清区域起点原有非空 cell 时于左邻 cell 放省略号；后台和 Agent 均始终有 view，running 时有 kill，scheduled 始终有 kill且仅 linked_subagent 存在时有 view，workflow 仅 is_active 时有 kill。后台右侧显示状态时间和非零 stdout badge；Agent 显示状态时间、model 与 context badge；scheduled 显示 spinner；按钮矩形和 hover id 使用各实体控制标识。
scenarios: Search bar
bottom bar 占用最后一行
overlay 不在该行画 spinner 或按钮。
Non-scrollable long loop
长 scheduled label 接近右侧 kill 按钮
label 在按钮前截断且按钮右侧不泄漏文本。
Bottom of overflow
scroll offset 已夹到末尾
显示上箭头且不显示下箭头。
Running background kill
后台状态 Running 且 pending_kill 已设置
仍保留 kill 按钮以允许重试，并显示 killing 状态。
Scheduled linkage
scheduled 没有关联子 Agent
只登记 kill hit region，不登记 view region。

requirement: Pager task badge and background-row source unit checks
contract: 内嵌单元测试 SHALL 覆盖零值及 k/M 各边界的截断 badge、truncated 加号、后台 command/description/monitor 标签分支、description 换行折叠、类型样式，以及重复构造的 id 和后台/Agent 哈希命名空间样例。这些是直接函数与内存结构检查；不运行 syntect grammar 失败、主题切换、哈希碰撞搜索或测试二进制。
scenarios: Badge boundaries
输入零、千、万、百万和千万级计数
源码断言每个格式区间及加号。
Background labels
说明存在、空白、换行、monitor 或仅 command
源码断言相应单行标签与样式。
Sample identities
同一后台项重复构造或与 Agent 共用字符串
源码断言本次结果相同或不同。

requirement: Pager task pane render, replay and overflow source unit checks
contract: 内嵌渲染测试 SHALL 以 ratatui Buffer 检查 stdout badge 与 truncated 加号、空 stdout 不产生空 badge、replay-restored task 不自动打开而新 live task 会打开、搜索栏不被 overlay 覆盖且增加一行、非溢出长 loop 不越过 kill button，以及列表顶端/底端的居中箭头。这些测试不操作真实终端、鼠标、剪贴板、后台进程、ACP replay 或测试二进制。
scenarios: Output badge
缓存 stdout 行数为 42
buffer 含 `(42)` 或 truncated 的 `(42+)`，空输出不显示 `()`。
Replay edge
先同步 restored running，再加入 live running
前者不打开，后者触发打开。
Overlay geometry
搜索栏、长 loop 和上下滚动分别渲染
buffer 中输入栏完整、按钮后无泄漏、箭头状态匹配位置。

requirement: Pager task grouping, collapse and subagent-row source unit checks
contract: 内嵌单元测试 SHALL 覆盖 running/终态过滤、Agent/Task/Monitor/Scheduled 分组顺序、共享 Watchers header 计数、header 插入、toggle 与定向折叠、空组遗忘折叠、Agent 类型字母顺序，以及类型/model/活动 suffix 的搜索与显示差异。这些测试直接访问模块私有状态，不经过应用按键路由、真实 mouse hit-test、异步子 Agent 生命周期或 test binary。
scenarios: Sorting and grouping
多种任务状态与类型同时同步
源码断言 items 顺序、header 和默认过滤。
Collapse lifecycle
折叠、重复折叠、清空及重建组
源码断言返回值、header 选择与重现时展开。
Subagent presentation
类型、model、活动与长说明变化
源码断言搜索 label 保留完整元数据而显示活动受运行态和宽度控制。

requirement: Pager scheduled and workflow row source unit checks
contract: 内嵌单元测试 SHALL 覆盖 scheduled 未来/过去/provisional/非法时间/未知 schedule 和多字节 prompt 分支，并覆盖 workflow 默认隐藏终态、显示 active phase、排除 workflow child、只计 running roster row，以及 paused/budget-limited 等 can_stop 与 is_active 的区别。这些测试不推进可控时钟、不验证真实 scheduler fire、workflow control dispatch、重复 workflow 名称或 overlay 是否为所有 stoppable 状态提供 kill 控件。
scenarios: Scheduled states
next fire 为未来、过去、非法或缺失
源码断言 countdown、due now、interval fallback 或无 suffix。
Workflow ownership
active run 与其 workflow child 同时存在
只计 workflow 一项。
Workflow control state
状态跨 active、paused、budget_limited 和 terminal 集合
源码断言 TaskEntry.stoppable 复制 can_stop，running 独立复制 is_active。

requirement: Pager permission overlay state sizing and render projection
contract: The pager permission view SHALL represent one queued ACP permission request with independent option focus, optional inline follow-up input, optional bash or MCP scope, planned arguments, subagent provenance and layout cache facts. Scope adjustment SHALL be available only for a multi-token bash selection or an MCP tool with a server prefix. Height calculation SHALL count provenance, title, wrapped command or MCP name, the shared planned-argument row budget, an optional scope hint, options and padding; collapsed planned arguments SHALL use a five-row budget with the last row as a Ctrl-F expansion indicator, while expanded content may grow only to screen height. Rendering SHALL tolerate empty and squeezed areas, reserve option visibility while clipping command/argument rows with an ellipsis, render only the RejectOnce row as an inline prompt in follow-up mode, expose that prompt geometry to its caller, and visually recede the full overlay when unfocused. This layer renders state but does not queue requests, route keys or mouse events, send permission responses, persist rules, or execute tools.
scenarios: Squeezed overlay
the permission area has zero width or height, sits at the buffer bottom, or cannot fit all chrome
rendering returns safely or clips chrome before the reserved scope, gap and option rows without writing below the area.
Collapsed planned arguments
wrapped MCP arguments exceed five visible rows and args_expanded is false
four content rows and the Ctrl-F indicator consume the shared five-row budget while option rows remain reserved.
Expanded planned arguments
args_expanded is true
the 50-percent collapsed cap is lifted, total height is limited by screen height, and area overflow is clipped with an ellipsis rather than hiding the reserved options.
Inline rejection feedback
focus is FollowupInput and a RejectOnce option is visible
the static reject row is replaced by its numbered selected prefix and an InlinePromptArea whose width matches inline_text_width arithmetic.
Adjustable scope
bash has at least two highlighted words or MCP has a server prefix
the chrome includes the left/right scope hint; plain prompts and unqualified MCP tools do not expose it.

requirement: Pager permission option labels and scoped decision presentation
contract: Permission option rows SHALL use one-based shortcuts for the first nine rows, cursor and hover backgrounds, selected and unselected radio markers, and a RejectOnce placeholder or first-line feedback preview. AllowAlways and RejectAlways options with recognized BashCommandPermission metadata SHALL rebuild their visible suffix from the currently selected command words. Recognized MCP metadata SHALL render tool scope as the pretty qualified tool name and server scope as “all tools from <Server>”; an inconsistent server selection without a prefix SHALL fall back to the tool display name. The plain option_label_for_selection projection SHALL use the same dynamic label source as the styled overlay. Unknown, malformed, unscoped or non-always metadata SHALL keep the ACP option name. This file does not prove that the displayed selection is the metadata ultimately returned or persisted by input-routing code.
scenarios: Bash always decision
an always-allow or always-reject option has valid bash metadata and selected words
the metadata prompt prefix is followed by exactly those selected words, with bash syntax styling in the overlay.
MCP tool scope
valid MCP metadata is paired with Tool scope
the suffix uses the pretty “(Server) Action” display name without bash tokenization.
MCP server scope
valid MCP metadata is paired with Server scope and a prefix
the suffix says all tools from the title-cased server; a missing prefix falls back to the tool label.
Reject-once feedback
the RejectOnce row receives blank or nonblank follow-up text
it shows the rejection placeholder when blank and a truncated first-line preview with prompt arrow when nonblank.
Unrecognized dynamic metadata
an option is not an always kind or its metadata cannot be decoded for the active scope
the static ACP option name remains the label.

requirement: Pager permission bash source display wrapping and selection dimming
contract: Bash permission rendering SHALL prefer a nonempty raw command over reconstructed highlight tokens, normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF, trim trailing whitespace per physical line, preserve interior newlines and backslash continuations, and remove trailing blank rows. Raw display SHALL parse the whole script for real shell operator break points and heredoc payload ranges, preserve heredoc body lines, retain operators on the preceding row, skip leading continuation whitespace, and otherwise wrap only at whitespace outside simple single- and double-quoted spans; an unbreakable span may exceed the panel width. Partial selections SHALL map prefix, highlighted and suffix tokens in order across whitespace, continuations and unrepresented shell operators, accept bare or simply quoted tokens only at shell boundaries, and dim unselected regions while reusing the raw wrapping decisions. Mapping failure SHALL reconstruct from highlight tokens and retain dimming instead of presenting the raw command as fully selected. This renderer does not parse or authorize commands, choose the safe scope count, guarantee fit for an unbreakable row, or prove complete shell quoting semantics beyond the tree-sitter helpers and local quote-aware wrapper used here.
scenarios: Raw source available
raw command preparation yields nonempty text
original spacing, physical lines and continuations are displayed instead of a space-joined token reconstruction.
Structured soft wrapping
an overlong physical line has real list or pipeline operators outside quotes and heredoc bodies
rows prefer those parser-derived boundaries, keep the operator on the previous row and strip continuation whitespace.
Free-form shell payload
content is inside a heredoc payload or one quoted unbreakable span
the physical payload line or quoted span stays intact even when wider than the view.
Partial scope mapping
highlight tokens match the raw source in order across operators or continuations
only the selected highlighted prefix remains bright and all other mapped or following regions are dimmed with identical row boundaries to raw rendering.
Mapping mismatch
a highlight token does not match the next shell position
the renderer fails closed to reconstructed tokens and still dims the unselected portion.

requirement: Pager permission overlay geometry MCP scope and planned arguments unit checks
contract: The permission-view unit suite SHALL exercise squeezed-area safety, collapsed and expanded height policy, MCP scope availability and labels, Unicode-width character wrapping, preservation of span text and styles, planned JSON argument highlighting and row budgets, option visibility, and shared plain/styled labels for bash and MCP decisions. These tests do not prove key or mouse routing, response delivery, permission persistence, actual terminal accessibility, every theme, or caller-maintained layout cache invariants.
scenarios: Small terminal geometry
rendering and height helpers receive tiny widths, heights and bottom-aligned areas
the tested combinations do not panic and expanded height stays within the screen while collapsed arithmetic retains its documented minimum floor.
MCP arguments
planned JSON is short, long, exactly at the budget, expanded or area-clipped
wrapping, visible content, Ctrl-F indicator, ellipsis and option reservation match the tested budget boundaries.
Scope labels
tool, server, missing-prefix, bash and plain options are projected
the expected pretty names, all-tools wording, scoped words or original option name are returned.
Styled character wrapping
ASCII, wide characters, empty text and alternating styles cross row boundaries
the counter, plain wrapper and styled wrapper agree on text and row count while styles survive their splits.
Enable-always option
a permission test needs the special global approval option
the queue contains the canonical enable-always id first, a regular allow option second, and reject-once third, with active index zero.
Synthetic options
a test supplies arbitrary option id/name pairs
the helper builds options in input order and classifies only id `reject` as RejectOnce.
Response verification
a permission action is handled
the returned oneshot receiver remains available for the test to verify the ACP response send.
Unbound session
push_synthetic_permission is called for an agent without a session id
the helper panics because synthetic permission requires session identity.

requirement: Pager permission bash display mapping wrapping and manual review checks
contract: The permission-view bash suite SHALL verify raw newline and continuation preservation, newline normalization, parser-derived operator wrapping, protection of simple quoted spans and heredoc bodies, sequential token-boundary mapping, identical quote-aware wrapping for dimmed and undimmed paths, fallback dimming on a mapping miss, selection styling, and panic resistance at tiny widths. Its ignored historic-command harness SHALL, only when explicitly enabled, read the repository fixture, render configured widths and reject delimiter-only breaks or jq “.[] |” splits. Static presence of that harness does not mean it ran or that every historic command and shell grammar is covered.
scenarios: Source normalization
raw commands contain CRLF, trailing newlines or backslash continuations
line endings normalize and useless trailing rows disappear while intentional physical continuation rows remain.
Quote and heredoc boundaries
jq filters, quoted operators or heredoc payloads contain spaces and operator text
the tested content is not split at those internal tokens.
Selection mapping
tokens span continuations and real operators or a later substring resembles the target
only the next valid shell-boundary token is accepted and dimmed rendering retains the same wrapping as raw rendering.
Failed mapping and tiny widths
raw tokens disagree or width is zero through three columns
fallback output keeps an explicit selected/unselected cue and the tested ASCII and Unicode paths do not panic.
Opt-in historic review
the ignored harness is run with PERMISSION_UI_RENDER_REVIEW enabled and optional widths
fixture commands are printed and automatic checks fail on delimiter-only breaks or split jq filter markers.

requirement: Pager scrollback view-range and selectable-entry navigation
contract: ScrollbackState selection SHALL expose AllTurns as the entire entry range and SingleTurn as the current turn prompt_index..end_index；SingleTurn 没有 current_turn 时优先显示首个 prompt 之前的 pre-turn，若不存在 pre-turn 则显示首个 turn，无 turns 时回退全部 entries。set_selected SHALL 只做长度边界过滤并在成功时同步 current_turn，不验证 block 可选性或隐藏高度。select_next/select_prev SHALL 限于当前可见 range，跳过 layout 判定隐藏或 block 不可选的条目；向下越过末项且 follow_by_overscroll 开启时立即进入 follow 并 goto_bottom，向上越界保持原选择。激活 pane SHALL 选择 range 内最后一个 block-level selectable 条目；selection_box 提供借用、替换和 take 接口。
scenarios: Single-turn prelude
没有 current_turn 且首个 prompt_index 大于零
可见 range 为 0..first_prompt_index。
Forward navigation
当前项后只有隐藏或不可选项
若 overscroll follow 启用则进入 follow 并跳底。
Programmatic selection
set_selected 指向范围内但隐藏或不可选项
仍保存该 index；可见性修复属于其他路径。
Selection box ownership
调用 take_selection_box
返回原值并将 state 中字段清空。

requirement: Pager scrollback entry fold mutation and viewport anchor restoration
contract: 选中项 collapse SHALL 仅在 foldable 且尚未处于 block.collapse_mode(is_running) 时生效；expand 仅将 foldable 非 Expanded 项设为 Expanded；toggle 使用 entry.toggle_fold。每次有效单项 fold SHALL 捕获选中项旧 virtual_y、scroll、follow 与 preserve，执行变更并按 Collapsed<Truncated<Expanded 判断是否增长；respect_manual_folds 开启时标记 display_mode_pinned，随后迁移 verb group expansion key、全量重建 layout、按需精测 anchor 周边、清空 dirty heights、恢复锚点并推进 generation。增长且原先 following 时 SHALL 在 respect_manual_folds 下丢弃 follow/preserve；preserve pin 因增长出现可滚动溢出时也丢弃 follow，后续内容不得移动阅读位置。anchor_on_fold 关闭时 SHALL 改用 ensure_selected_visible，且不得把已经关闭的 follow 重新打开。
scenarios: Manual expansion
foldable 条目由低 display rank 变高且正在 follow
开启 respect_manual_folds 时固定 display mode 并退出 follow/preserve。
Anchored shrink
条目缩小且 anchor_on_fold 开启
以 virtual_y 差调整 scroll，保留原 follow 状态。
Preserve overflow
page-flip preserve pin 下展开后 max_offset 越过 pin
scroll 保持 pin，follow 与 preserve 关闭。
No cached anchor
fold 前 layout_cache 没有该项 virtual_y
仍重建布局，但不执行 virtual_y delta 调整。

requirement: Pager scrollback raw and global fold controls
contract: raw toggle SHALL 在选择为普通 group header 时不操作；其他情况下若 index 有效则调用 entry.toggle_raw 并标脏，随后无论是否实际命中条目都重建 layout 并推进 generation。collapse_all/expand_all SHALL 清除所有 entry 的 display_mode_pinned，对 foldable 项分别直接设 Collapsed/Expanded并失效缓存，清空 expanded_groups、标记 gaps dirty 并推进 generation。toggle_expand_all SHALL 仅以是否存在 display_mode 精确为 Collapsed 的 foldable 项决定 expand-all，否则 collapse-all。thinking 全局 toggle SHALL 只处理 foldable Thinking：任一精确 Collapsed 时全部 Expanded，否则全部 Collapsed，同时更新 thinking_display_mode 并清 pins；展开时迁移 verb key 并展开超过 group_max_visible+1 的未 claimed dense groups，收起时清空全部 expanded_groups。thinking_fold_label 使用同一精确 Collapsed 判定。
scenarios: Group header raw
选中被 layout 标记的普通 group header
不切换原 entry raw，也不重建。
Global expansion
任一 foldable 项精确 Collapsed
expand_all 将所有 foldable 项 Expanded 并清全部 pins/group expansions。
Thinking expansion
存在 collapsed thinking 且有 N-more dense run
thinking 全部展开，并为足够长的 dense group 登记首项 id 使成员显现。
No truncation threshold
group_max_visible 为零
expand_all_groups 不登记任何 group id。

requirement: Pager scrollback rendered group-header action semantics
contract: group-header 查询 SHALL 读取当前 layout_cache。is_selected_group_header 对 group_header_count>0 或 group_collapse_header 的槽返回 true，但 expanded verb slot 同时具有 verb_group_header 与 group_collapse_header 时 SHALL 视作 member zero 而返回 false；fold label 对普通 collapse header 返回 collapse、正 count header 返回 expand、expanded verb slot 返回 None。toggle_group_expansion SHALL 只处理当前 layout 认定的 header，按首项 EntryId 增删 expanded_groups并用同一 fold anchor 重建；普通 N-more 展开后清除选择，verb header 展开后保留选择，expanded verb slot 拒绝再次 toggle 以把 Enter/fold 交给 member zero。collapse_group_if_expanded SHALL 通过 group_range_of(selected,true) 找首项 id，移除 expansion、锚定重建并把落入隐藏成员的选择修复到 header。clear_group_expansion SHALL 无条件清空共享 expansion set。
scenarios: N-more expand
选中普通 count header
加入首项 id、锚定重建并清除选择。
Verb expand
选中 folded verb header
加入首项 id、保留 header 选择。
Expanded verb slot
slot 同时是 verb header 和 collapse header
header 查询/再次 toggle 让位给 member zero；Left collapse 仍通过 collapse_group_if_expanded。
Non-header
选中普通可见成员且不在展开组 collapse 路径
toggle 返回 false，不修改 expansion。
Hover eligibility
no entry is hovered, the hovered entry is selected, its block is not one of the supported header-style blocks, or its display mode is not Collapsed
the hover pass returns without changing the buffer.
Hover affordance
a supported collapsed header entry has an on-screen area
the pane paints a blended hover background with optional border inset and invokes the shared indicator helper.
Selected indicator
an active selected entry is foldable and at minimum fold mode
the pane paints the configured indicator on the bullet row, subject to the content-area bounds.
Verb member row
an expanded verb slot is selected or hovered
the indicator row is one below the slot top when the header is visible, and equals the slot top when the header is top-clipped.
Header clipping regression
verb_member_indicator_row is called with plain, expanded-visible and expanded-top-clipped inputs
the helper returns the tested rows 4, 5 and 4 respectively.

requirement: Pager verb-group expansion-key reanchoring
contract: 当 group_tool_verbs 开启且单个成员 display mode 变化时，verb expansion key SHALL 尝试迁移到变化后 run 的当前首项。若变化项不在直接 run 中，扫描 SHALL 穿过 transparent entry，遇 Break 或越界停止；当前首项已有 key 时不变，否则在变化项或当前 run 内部查找一个 stale expanded id，删除旧 key 并插入 current first_id。该迁移只维护当前可识别的一个 stale key，不验证 expanded_groups 中其他孤儿或重复来源。
scenarios: Head opens
expanded verb run 的首成员打开后成为 transparent
key 从旧首项迁移到下一个当前 run anchor。
Head recloses
原首成员重新加入 run
内部 stale key 迁回原首项。
Break boundary
变化项后首先遇到 Break
停止，不把 key 迁到下一独立 run。
Grouping disabled
group_tool_verbs 关闭
不扫描、不修改 expanded_groups。

requirement: Pager scrollback dense-gap and group-range source unit checks
contract: 本文件内嵌测试 SHALL 通过 ScrollbackState 的布局接口覆盖 collapsed groupable 的零间隙、expanded/non-groupable 边界、total-height 与 virtual-y 求和、主要 block 类型的 groupability，以及 group_range_of 在全 groupable 模式和 collapsed-only 模式下的连续范围。测试源码调用 sibling layout/group 实现；不证明 ratatui 实际绘制、终端选择或 test binary 已执行。
scenarios: Dense gaps
连续 collapsed groupable 条目
中间 gap 为零，尾部及 break 边界为一。
Expanded break
collapsed-only 范围中出现 Expanded
该项成为 singleton 并切断两侧 run。
Block taxonomy
stub、prompt、agent、thinking、tool 和 durable terminal notice
源码断言各自 groupable 分类。

requirement: Pager fold anchor, follow preservation and pin source unit checks
contract: 内嵌 harness 测试 SHALL 覆盖 page-flip preserve 下增长 fold 退出 follow、增长导致溢出仍保持 prompt anchor、非 follow 不被重启、收缩 fold 的 follow 保留、finished entry 增长、anchor 关闭分支、respect_manual_folds 关闭的旧行为、follow 关闭后 streaming 不移动 viewport、thinking/global pin 清理范围及 fold 前后 pairwise gap。测试使用内存 harness 和默认/即时布局；不执行真实终端输入、异步流或 test binary。
scenarios: Grow while following
running 或 finished entry 展开
开启手动 fold 尊重时 pin 条目并退出 follow。
Shrink while following
expanded 条目收缩
保持进入操作前的 follow。
Streaming after read intent
展开后继续追加 thinking chunks
follow 未恢复前 scroll offset 保持。
Global controls
thinking-only 与 all-entry fold 操作先后执行
前者只清 thinking pin，后者清全部 pin。

requirement: Pager N-more truncation threshold and hidden navigation source unit checks
contract: 内嵌测试 SHALL 覆盖 group_max_visible 为零、恰为 max+1、超过 max+1 以及位于 history 起止位置的 dense groups，并验证导航跳过 height=0 成员但可停在合成 header。测试直接检查 cache height/header_count；不证明标签文案、鼠标命中、滚动性能或大历史测试二进制。
scenarios: Disabled
