max_visible 为零且有 20 项
所有条目保持可见。
Threshold
group 长度恰为 max+1
不截断；超过时首槽成为 header并隐藏前缀。
Navigation
选择向前/向后越过隐藏成员
落到 header 或可见尾成员。

requirement: Pager verb-run formation, thinking transparency and refold source unit checks
contract: 内嵌测试 SHALL 覆盖 read/subagent verb run 的 singleton 与多成员折叠、execute/edit break、隐藏/展开/运行/结束 thinking 的 transparent 或 claimed 行为、thought 不计工具数量、当前 rendered span 在 refold 前保持 group query 权威、pending input 和 hook chrome 使成员脱组并在状态变化后 refold、增量 push 在 N-more 禁用时仍形成 verb fold，以及 run 末项保留 pairwise boundary gap。测试不覆盖所有工具 verb 分类、真实 tracker/hook 生命周期、并发状态更新或最终渲染文案。
scenarios: Verb boundaries
read run 遇 execute/edit 或 pending/hook member
在边界切分，受保护成员保持可见。
Thinking membership
thought 位于工具前中后或正在 streaming
按显示/运行状态成为 anchor、transparent 行或 claimed 隐藏成员，计数仍只含工具。
Rendered authority
hook 在布局后附到隐藏成员
下一次 prepare 前 group_range 保留屏幕上的旧 span，refold 后才切分。
Incremental fold
已有 cache 后追加 reads 且 N-more 禁用
verb fold 仍立即形成。

requirement: Pager verb-group expansion, rekey and ownership source unit checks
contract: 内嵌测试 SHALL 覆盖 singleton/多成员 verb header 展开收起、Left 从保留选择的 header 收起、page-flip preserve pin、expanded slot 路由 member zero、首项/内部成员开合后的 expansion key 迁移、verb range 排除邻接 dense 成员、claimed entry 阻断 N-more、feature flag 关闭回到普通 truncation、search reveal 解隐藏、Subagent 位于 run 首部/内部，以及 thinking expand-all 与邻接 verb fold 的 key 分离。测试直接操作 state/cache；不证明 app action router、鼠标 header 路由或远程配置持久化。
scenarios: Member-zero slot
expanded verb header 上执行 entry fold
操作首成员且 expansion key 跟随新 anchor，其他成员保持展开。
Claim ownership
verb run 邻接普通 dense group
verb claimed 成员不参加 N-more 范围或 expansion key。
Search reveal
目标在 collapsed verb run 内
登记当前 anchor expansion并使目标可见。
Subagent member
subagent-start 位于 run 首或中间
可作为 anchor/成员一起展开并从成员处收起。

requirement: Pager generic group-header expansion and lifecycle source unit checks
contract: 内嵌测试 SHALL 覆盖普通 N-more header 的展开/收起、header 自身内容替换判定、独立可选择 collapse header、thinking 首项、隐藏 selection 修复、collapse_all/clear/remove 的 expanded_groups 清理、non-header 拒绝 toggle，以及 120 项大 group 展开后除独立 header 槽外全部成员可见。测试不覆盖持久化 expansion、EntryId 复用、并发删除或真实大历史性能。
scenarios: Expand and collapse
选中普通 truncation header
展开时 header 独立占首槽且所有后续成员可见，收起后恢复隐藏前缀。
Selection repair
selection 位于即将隐藏的成员
收起后移到 group header。
Lifecycle cleanup
collapse-all、clear 或删除 anchor entry
对应 expansion state 清除。
Large group
120 项 dense run 展开
首槽为 collapse header，其余 119 项均可见。

requirement: Pager agent catalog modal input bridge
contract: AgentView SHALL delegate agent-catalog key, paste and mouse events only while an agents modal exists. A close outcome SHALL remove the modal. A keyboard ViewAgent outcome SHALL open markdown from its source path when present, otherwise from supplied content, apply the requested title override, and leave the agents modal underneath; absent or unreadable content SHALL leave the line viewer unchanged while still reporting Changed. EditInEditor SHALL emit SuspendForEditor with the path and tab to refresh. Mouse ViewAgent and EditInEditor outcomes SHALL be ignored, while Changed and Unchanged outcomes retain their meaning. This bridge does not load the catalog, render it, launch the editor, validate paths, or prove line-viewer parsing.
scenarios: No agents modal
a key, paste or mouse event reaches the bridge without modal state
the event returns Unchanged and no action is emitted.
View definition
keyboard handling returns a source path or inline markdown content
a successfully constructed line viewer is layered above the still-open modal and receives the requested title.
Edit definition
keyboard handling returns EditInEditor
SuspendForEditor carries the selected path and refresh tab.
Mouse activation
mouse handling reports view or edit
the bridge consumes no view/edit action and returns Unchanged.

requirement: Pager extensions modal input focus folding and diagnostics routing
contract: AgentView extensions input SHALL give modal messages precedence over the in-flight guard: lowercase y confirms a captured Confirmation, while every other key dismisses the message and clears pending badges. Without a message, a pending action SHALL consume every key and only Escape closes the modal. MCP setup and generic input forms SHALL own keys and emit their validated actions on submit; paste SHALL enter only an active form or active search and SHALL be rejected while a message or action is pending. Browse-mode keyboard and mouse SHALL route shared modal chrome before picker navigation, maintain tab focus, search/query, status filters and fold state, and log resolved tab/action/target/enabled diagnostics when available. Group folds SHALL update tab-specific sets, marketplace error-row details, or MCP section/tool state; leaf folds SHALL update expanded rows and clear scroll offsets. Non-selectable masks SHALL reuse same-length render caches or conservatively derive MCP section headers. The mouse path SHALL dismiss a message on any button-down to prevent click-through. This file does not render hit rectangles, decode terminal input, persist fold/filter/search state, or guarantee diagnostic delivery.
scenarios: Modal message
a confirmation receives lowercase y or any other key
y dispatches its captured action; another key dismisses it and clears pending state.
Action in flight
pending_action exists without a message
Escape closes the UI while background work continues; every other key is consumed as Changed.
Form ownership
MCP setup or generic input is active
its handler owns keys, cancel clears the form, invalid MCP submit records Select an option, and valid submit emits the resolved action with an appropriate pending state.
Browse and tabs
chrome or picker returns close, tab, filter, search, fold or action outcomes
modal state follows that outcome, tab switches clean browse state, and actionable keys are resolved for the active tab.
Fold cache mismatch
the render-provided non-selectable masks do not match entry count
only rows whose group keys begin with mcp-section are synthesized as non-selectable and clickable.

requirement: Pager extension action target dispatch pending state and confirmation
contract: The extensions action layer SHALL resolve diagnostic targets from the currently loaded plugin, hook, skill, MCP or marketplace selection and SHALL return no target for loading or stale indices. Executing an action SHALL clear an old result notice, translate the selected entity and desired next state into the corresponding root Action, and stamp tab-level loading or row-level pending labels according to operation scope. Reloads SHALL mark every registry they rebuild as Loading; MCP tool selection SHALL never fall through to a server toggle when its tool indices are stale; managed MCP servers SHALL show a local removal error. Hook group toggles SHALL disable the source when any hook is enabled and enable it otherwise. Destructive MCP, hook, plugin, marketplace-plugin and marketplace-source operations SHALL first store a Confirmation with both target payload and selected-row snapshot, clear prior pending state and link band, and dispatch only on later confirmation; the confirmed pending row SHALL remain the captured row even if selection moves. Plugin uninstall SHALL still send confirmed=false so the server can gate multi-plugin cascades. Missing, unloaded or stale selections SHALL return Changed without dispatch. This layer does not execute actions, verify backend success, refresh result data, enforce server-side confirmation, or reconcile out-of-order completion.
scenarios: Registry-wide refresh
hooks/plugins reload or marketplace refresh is executed
affected tab data becomes Loading and no selected row is decorated.
Entity action
a loaded plugin, hook, skill, MCP server/tool or marketplace plugin is selected
the action carries stable entity identifiers and pending state describes the operation on the selected row when that row already exists.
Stale MCP tool
selected_mcp_tool returns indices absent from loaded server/tool arrays
no server toggle fallback is emitted.
Destructive request
remove or uninstall targets a valid removable entity
the first call stores its exact action and row in a confirmation and emits no backend action.
Confirmation after movement
selection changes before lowercase y confirms
the captured entity is dispatched and pending_entry_index is restored to the captured row.

requirement: Pager extensions action target pending and fold unit checks
contract: The agent-modal unit suite SHALL verify marketplace update and refresh pending policies, plugin update identity, target and resulting-enabled diagnostics for plugin, skill, MCP, hook and marketplace actions, plugin filter reset, group versus leaf expansion, collapsed-hook group targeting, and refusal to resolve loading data or stale MCP tool indices. These tests do not cover every ButtonAction arm, backend execution, diagnostics emission, rendered groups, asynchronous completion or result reconciliation.
scenarios: Update and refresh
plugin or marketplace update and marketplace refresh actions are constructed
stable identifiers are emitted and row-level versus tab-level pending state matches operation scope.
Resolved target
loaded plugin, skill, MCP, hook or marketplace selection is inspected
the expected display target and next enabled state are returned.
Fold and filter
plugin group/leaf expansion or status filter cycling occurs
group and detail state toggle independently and filter changes reset selection.
Invalid backing data
data is Loading or a selected MCP tool index is stale
target resolution returns no target and no enabled state.

requirement: Pager extensions search tab escape and paste ownership unit checks
contract: The agent-modal input suite SHALL verify the staged Escape behavior for active search, retained queries and modal closure; SHALL verify Tab, BackTab and Shift-Tab switch or wrap tabs while preserving an active query; and SHALL verify bracketed paste enters an active extension form after newline normalization without mutating the hidden prompt. These tests do not cover search ranking, mouse tab routing, pending/message paste suppression, Skills slash-only search, vim global-state isolation, multiple form fields or action construction on form submit.
scenarios: Empty active search
Escape is pressed after slash activated search
search deactivates while the modal stays open; a following Escape closes it.
Retained query
Escape is pressed with typed search text
search deactivates first, a later Escape clears the retained query, and only the next Escape closes.
Tab navigation
Tab, BackTab or shifted Tab is pressed during active search
the selected tab moves or wraps while search and query remain active.
Form paste
paste reaches an active MCP modal input while the prompt contains a draft
normalized text enters the field and the hidden prompt is unchanged.

requirement: Pager destructive extension confirmation capture unit checks
contract: The agent-modal confirmation suite SHALL verify that MCP-server removal, hook-source removal, installed-plugin uninstall, marketplace-plugin uninstall and marketplace-source removal produce a confirmation without dispatch; SHALL verify lowercase y dispatches the captured target and restores its original pending row after selection moves; SHALL preserve confirmed=false for installed-plugin uninstall; and SHALL dismiss without dispatch on Escape, n or uppercase Y. These tests do not prove managed-MCP rejection, mouse dismissal, server cascade prompts, actual deletion/uninstallation, failure recovery or authorization.
scenarios: Initial destructive action
each tested destructive button is invoked on a valid target
a typed Confirmation stores the target payload and selected row while pending state is cleared and no action is emitted.
Confirmed after selection moves
lowercase y is pressed after another row becomes selected
the original target is dispatched and the pending badge remains on its captured row.
Plugin server gate
an installed plugin uninstall is locally confirmed
the emitted PluginsAction retains confirmed=false for possible server-side multi-plugin confirmation.
Cancellation key
Escape, lowercase n or uppercase Y reaches a confirmation
the prompt is dismissed and no backend action is emitted.

requirement: Pager startup warning banner selection and diagnostic action construction
contract: Terminal diagnostics SHALL construct ordered, data-only TerminalWarning values for startup and explicit diagnostic paths: tmux, Byobu, Apple Terminal over SSH, WezTerm keyboard, Wayland clipboard, sandbox conflicts, tmux extended keys, and clipboard route preflight are represented by category-specific messages and optional fix metadata. SSH-only welcome summarization admits only DCS passthrough or tmux extended-keys warnings; startup assembly inserts WezTerm, Wayland, and sandbox actionable warnings ahead of the summarized list in that priority order.
scenarios: Unavailable tmux evidence
tmux option probes return unavailable or error results
clipboard and DCS warnings are omitted while independent control-mode evidence may still produce its warning.
Startup assembly
WezTerm, Wayland, or sandbox warnings are present
the corresponding actionable startup warnings are inserted in WezTerm, Wayland, sandbox order before the supplied summaries.
Clipboard preflight
a route/environment is supplied to format_clipboard_diagnostics
the output reports native, tmux, OSC 52, wrap, optional Wayland data-control, and a confirmed/unverified/unavailable status without claiming that a copy occurred.
Startup collection
collect_startup_tui receives a terminal, runtime evidence, control-mode value, and tmux query
the returned ProbeSnapshot contains common terminal facts, the supplied control mode as the sole control-mode fact, and runtime evidence.
Doctor collection
collect_doctor_tui receives a terminal, runtime evidence, and tmux query
the returned DoctorProbeSnapshot combines common evidence with clipboard, host, display, container, and color facts while allowing the tmux backend to provide control mode.
Native tool gate
startup collection runs on a non-Wayland or Wayland display server
the native clipboard tool callback is not invoked for non-Wayland and is invoked once for Wayland.

requirement: Pager small screen and SSH startup tip evaluation
contract: ssh_wrap_hint SHALL return one SshWithoutWrap TerminalWarning only when the session is SSH, no OSC 52 sink is active, and the terminal is not an official VS Code remote; the warning carries the `grow wrap ssh <host>` one-off command and a note directing the user to run it locally.
scenarios: Plain SSH
is_ssh is true, the sink is inactive, and the terminal is not an official VS Code remote
an SshWithoutWrap warning with the wrap command and local-computer guidance is returned.
Already wrapped or VS Code remote
the sink is active, or the terminal is an official VS Code remote, or the session is not SSH
no warning is returned.

requirement: Pager doctor human report fact grouping probe suppression and remediation wording
contract: color_support_warning SHALL omit a warning for truecolor; for None, Apple Terminal, tmux-backed limited color, and other limited color levels it returns a LimitedColorSupport warning with the corresponding message, optional command/config fix, and explanatory note. The warning is an explicit diagnostic result and is not included in collect_startup_warnings.
scenarios: Truecolor
the color level has truecolor support
no color warning is returned.
Limited color
the level is None, Apple Terminal reports Ansi256, or a limited level is observed under tmux or another terminal
a LimitedColorSupport warning is returned with branch-specific remediation metadata.
Startup collection
limited color is present during startup warning collection
the color warning is not added by collect_startup_warnings.

requirement: Shell Cargo.toml feature and entrypoint contract
contract: Cargo.toml SHALL define the shell package as edition/version workspace metadata with default=[], unstable=[], dhat-heap=dep:dhat, test-support=[], and default-bazel=test-support; required-feature gates SHALL remain attached to the fork_copy bench and the five test targets declared in the manifest, while session_list remains ungated. Unix/windows dependency sections and dev-dependencies are part of the static crate boundary; no dependency resolution is inferred.
scenarios: Feature gate
the manifest is read without enabling optional features
default remains empty and only explicitly declared feature relationships are recorded.
Required test target
a gated test or bench target is selected

requirement: Pager follow up response acceptance and pending turn buffer
contract: The pager follow-up projection SHALL establish these facts. AgentView stores displayed follow-up response and suggestion labels separately from shown prompt identity; it also stores an acceptance generation map, a prompt-keyed pending map with FIFO order, and rendered chip rectangles. MAX_PENDING_FOLLOW_UPS is 16. Embedded checks exercise replacement, idempotence, empty retraction, seen-id suppression, current-turn replay, pre-adoption buffering, FIFO eviction, reload preservation and chip hit mapping.
scenarios: Displayed follow-up state
a response has suggestions displayed
response identity, suggestion text, shown prompt identity and chip hit rectangles remain separate state.
Pending adoption race
a stamped follow-up belongs to a prompt that is not yet current
the test path buffers it by prompt id and flushes it after adoption.
Bounded pending map
more than 16 distinct non-current prompt ids are buffered
the oldest pending key is evicted while newer keys remain.
Chip hit mapping
a rendered chip is clicked inside its rectangle
the hit index maps to the full suggestion string and a gap misses.

requirement: Pager action registry exact routing and presentation
contract: The pager action registry SHALL establish these facts. active_contexts_for_pane returns Prompt-focused, Scrollback-focused or agent-level/Always context lists according to the pane. resolve_action maps the pane-safe ActionId subset to InputOutcome::Action and returns none for root-global, modal, queue, dashboard, cancel, quit and other higher-layer actions. Kitty base-key detection recognizes shifted 1 as bang and shifted 3 as hash; remember_mode_enabled reads features.remember_mode and defaults false when unavailable.
scenarios: Pane context projection
the active pane is Prompt, Scrollback or another pane
the returned context order starts with the pane-specific context where applicable and ends with AgentScreen/Always as defined.
Safe action subset
resolve_action receives a navigation or view ActionId
it returns the corresponding AgentView action; root-global or modal-owned ids return None.
Kitty symbol input
a key event uses shifted base 1 or 3
the bang or hash detector accepts it alongside the literal punctuation form.
Remember feature lookup
config.toml is absent, malformed or has a boolean features.remember_mode
the helper returns false for unavailable values and the stored boolean when present.

requirement: Pager simple input mode reconciliation and contextual hint overrides
contract: The pager input-mode projection SHALL establish these facts. PromptInputMode has mutually exclusive Normal, Bash and Remember variants. Normal has no style, prefix, placeholder or prompt-info override and maps send_action to SendPrompt; Bash uses command styling, ! prefix, Run shell command info and SendBashCommand; Remember uses remember styling, # prefix, mode-dependent memory placeholder, Save memory note info and SendRememberNote. Normal never treats an event as an exit key, while Bash and Remember exit on Backspace, Escape, Ctrl-W, Ctrl-U or Ctrl-C.
scenarios: Mode styling
each PromptInputMode requests accent, prefix, placeholder or prompt-info data
Normal returns no override, Bash returns command styling and Remember returns remember styling and the matching multiline placeholder.
Submit action
send_action receives prompt text
the variant selects SendPrompt, SendBashCommand or SendRememberNote while preserving text.
Exit-key policy
Normal, Bash or Remember receives the tested key set
Normal reports no exit keys; Bash and Remember accept the five exit inputs and reject ordinary Enter and letters.

requirement: Pager task-result test: compact_rpc_acknowledgement_does_not_append_another_completion
contract: Compact RPC acknowledgement SHALL not append a second completion row, regardless of whether the request tracked the foreground.
scenarios: Compact acknowledgement
CompactComplete returns Completed
no additional scrollback completion is emitted.

requirement: Pager task-result test: compact_cancel_rpc_does_not_echo_the_backend_terminal
contract: When backend auto-compaction cancellation has already published its terminal notice, the CompactComplete error SHALL clear live state without echoing another terminal row.

exactly the backend terminal entry remains and live status is cleared.

requirement: Pager task-result test: behavior_transport_failure_keeps_first_prompt_local_and_retryable

requirement: Pager task-result test: superseded_behavior_rpc_clears_only_the_matching_local_correlation
contract: A superseded behavior RPC SHALL clear only its matching local control correlation and produce no local scrollback feedback.
scenarios: Superseded behavior control
the completion carries the active control token and Superseded outcome
pending controls are cleared without appending a notice.

requirement: Pager task-result test: trajectory_post_ready_failure_is_visible
contract: A post-ready trajectory runtime termination SHALL surface its message as an agent toast while producing no dispatch effect.
scenarios: Trajectory runtime failure
the trajectory exits with a nonzero status after readiness
the exact termination message is visible in the agent toast.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_planning_promotes_initial_session_binding
contract: Doctor planning SHALL bind the initial target identity to the current session binding when the target was captured before the session became bound.
scenarios: Doctor initial binding
planning completes after the session is first bound
the doctor question target carries the newly bound session id.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_planning_rejects_bind_replace_and_unbind_rebind
contract: Doctor planning SHALL reject a target whose session identity was replaced or unbound and rebound after capture.
scenarios: Doctor stale binding
the captured target sees a replacement or rebinding before plan completion
no doctor modal opens and a session-changed system message is rendered.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_planning_opens_refuses_remote_and_rejects_stale_identity

scenarios: Doctor planning modes
a local plan, remote-run outcome, or stale target is delivered
the modal or instruction is rendered in the matching surface and stale planning is refused.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_apply_completion_prefers_initiator_then_active_and_welcome_fallback
contract: Doctor apply failures SHALL target the initiating agent, then the active agent when the initiator disappeared, and finally the welcome startup warning when no agent remains.
scenarios: Doctor failure routing
the apply result fails under each available target surface
the error is surfaced exactly by the highest-priority remaining surface.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_apply_progress_is_live_only_and_terminal_result_is_typed
contract: Doctor apply progress SHALL remain live-only; its terminal failure SHALL clear live status and append a typed Command/Error notice.
scenarios: Doctor apply terminal
a doctor fix is confirmed and then fails
the transient Applying status never enters history and the typed terminal notice contains the failure.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_apply_reload_success_does_not_claim_live_finding_disappeared

scenarios: Doctor reload resolution
a tmux clipboard fix applies but requires reload
the message includes reload and rerun guidance and omits a zero-issues claim.

requirement: Pager task-result test: doctor_apply_success_only_renders_resolution_instructions

scenarios: Doctor satisfied resolution
an SSH-wrap fix is applied immediately
the agent receives setup and restart instructions without Environment or Findings sections.

requirement: Pager task-result test: stale_workflows_result_does_not_repaint_replaced_session_modal
contract: A workflows list result for a replaced session SHALL not repaint the current extensions modal with stale data.
scenarios: Stale workflows result
the modal belongs to a different session than the result
the modal remains in its loading state.

requirement: Pager task-result test: x11_primary_hint_requires_canonical_full_miss_outcome

scenarios: X11 primary hint eligibility
clipboard paste completes with a non-full-miss or non-X11 outcome
no X11 toast is shown.

requirement: Pager task-result test: wrap_host_image_request_eligible_covers_full_miss_and_attachment_error_only
contract: Host image wrapping SHALL be eligible only for FullMiss and AttachmentRead failures; all other clipboard outcomes SHALL remain terminal local failures.
scenarios: Host image fallback eligibility
a clipboard completion is classified
only the two eligible classes route to the host-image request.

requirement: Pager task-result test: x11_primary_hint_routes_to_originating_agent

scenarios: Originating agent hint
the originating agent differs from the active agent
only the origin agent receives the hint toast.

requirement: Pager task-result test: x11_primary_hint_routes_to_originating_dashboard
contract: X11 primary guidance for dashboard dispatch SHALL route to dashboard feedback rather than an unrelated active agent toast.
scenarios: Originating dashboard hint
a dashboard paste is a full miss on X11
dashboard feedback contains the hint and the agent toast remains empty.

requirement: Pager task-result test: clipboard_failure_routes_to_originating_agent_without_duplicate
contract: Clipboard failures SHALL route to the originating agent and an AlreadyReported failure SHALL preserve the existing toast without duplication.
scenarios: Originating clipboard failure
an agent prompt paste fails
the origin receives the typed error and a previously reported toast is retained.

requirement: Pager task-result test: clipboard_failure_routes_to_originating_dashboard
contract: Clipboard attachment failures for dashboard dispatch SHALL render dashboard feedback and never an unrelated agent toast.
scenarios: Dashboard clipboard failure
dashboard paste attachment reading fails
dashboard feedback contains the failure.

requirement: Pager task-result test: marketplace_list_loaded_sanitizes_components_at_ingestion

scenarios: Marketplace metadata sanitization
a marketplace response contains escape codes and an oversized description
the stored name is clean and the description is bounded to the documented length.

requirement: Pager task-result test: plugins_action_success_sets_result_notice_and_autoreload_preserves_it
contract: A successful row-level plugin action SHALL set a row-anchored result notice, and a subsequent generic auto-reload result SHALL preserve the triggering notice.
scenarios: Plugin action notice
an update succeeds and then registry auto-reload completes
the specific message remains anchored to the acted row.

requirement: Pager task-result test: tab_wide_action_success_sets_tab_wide_result_notice
contract: A tab-wide plugin action SHALL set an unanchored footer result notice carrying its message.
scenarios: Tab-wide plugin notice
a registry-wide action succeeds with no pending row
the result notice has no row index and keeps the action message.

requirement: Pager task-result test: uninstall_result_notice_is_footer_only_not_row_anchored

scenarios: Uninstall notice
an uninstall succeeds and requires reload
the notice has no stale row anchor.

requirement: Pager task-result test: confirmation_required_builds_plugins_confirmation_with_confirmed_true
contract: A plugin action returning ConfirmationRequired SHALL build a confirmation overlay from the exact server message, captured row, and confirmed plugin action.
scenarios: Plugin confirmation
the backend requires confirmation for uninstall
the modal stores the action with confirmed=true and emits no second action.

requirement: Pager task-result test: kill_rpc_failure_does_not_finalize_but_nothing_live_does
contract: A failed subagent cancel RPC SHALL leave a pending row unfinished; a NothingLive outcome SHALL finalize the orphan row.
scenarios: Subagent cancellation reconciliation
cancel first fails and then reports no live process
the first result preserves the row and the second marks it finished.

requirement: Pager task-result test: kill_nothing_live_with_status_stamps_real_terminal_status
contract: NothingLive with a terminal status SHALL finalize the orphan subagent row with that real status instead of flattening it to cancelled.
scenarios: Subagent terminal status
an orphan cancellation resolves with status completed
the row is finished and stores completed.

requirement: Pager task-result test: running_status_shims_only_while_submitting

scenarios: Prompt status turn start
status Running arrives while submitting
the session enters TurnRunning with fresh timing anchors and no matching query.

requirement: Pager task-result test: running_status_skips_shim_when_turn_already_running
contract: A duplicate Running status for an already running turn SHALL refresh timing anchors without rerunning the turn-start shim or clearing follow-up chips.
scenarios: Duplicate prompt status
status Running arrives while already TurnRunning
follow-up chips remain and the status query is retired.

requirement: Pager task-result test: cancel_complete_does_nothing
contract: A CancelComplete task result SHALL be a no-op in the pager task-result reducer.
scenarios: Cancel completion
CancelComplete is dispatched
no effects or visible state change are produced.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_model_rpc_waits_for_authoritative_projection_without_local_notice
contract: A successful model-switch transport acknowledgement SHALL leave the Shell-owned switch pending until authoritative ModelChanged projection; it SHALL not persist defaults or duplicate terminal feedback.
scenarios: Authoritative model projection
RPC acknowledgement precedes ModelChanged
the committed model changes only on the notification and no persistence effect is emitted.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_agent_rpc_waits_for_authoritative_projection
contract: A successful Agent switch acknowledgement SHALL leave the old agent projection until authoritative AgentChanged notification and SHALL not duplicate the durable control notice.
scenarios: Authoritative Agent projection
RPC acknowledgement precedes AgentChanged
the target becomes current only after the notification and scrollback is unchanged.

requirement: Pager task-result test: late_session_agent_name_read_cannot_overwrite_completed_switch
contract: A session-agent metadata read begun before a completed switch SHALL be discarded when it resolves after the authoritative switch projection.
scenarios: Stale agent metadata
an old revision resolves after AgentChanged
the new agent name remains authoritative.

requirement: Pager task-result test: authoritative_agent_projection_releases_the_fenced_prompt
contract: The authoritative AgentChanged projection SHALL release a prompt fenced by the pending agent control once the control domain is committed.
scenarios: Agent control prompt release
a queued prompt waits behind an agent switch
the prompt is emitted only after the authoritative projection.

requirement: Pager task-result test: stale_switch_agent_completion_is_ignored
contract: A switch-agent completion with an invalidated control token SHALL be ignored without changing the agent projection or adding local feedback.
scenarios: Stale Agent completion
the control is invalidated before its RPC completion
no effect or scrollback notice is produced.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_agent_complete_failure_writes_scrollback
contract: A local Agent switch failure without a pre-published terminal notice SHALL append an error Notice naming the target agent.
scenarios: Agent switch failure
the switch RPC fails locally
the failure appears once in scrollback.

requirement: Pager task-result test: shell_owned_control_failure_does_not_duplicate_a_local_notice
contract: A control failure marked terminal_published SHALL not append a duplicate local notice because the durable Shell rejection owns terminal feedback.
scenarios: Shell-owned control failure
a switch failure carries terminal_published=true
scrollback length is unchanged.

requirement: Pager task-result test: authoritative_switch_projections_update_the_exact_subagent_view
contract: Authoritative model and Agent projections SHALL resolve against the exact child session view identified by session id, leaving the root view unchanged.
scenarios: Subagent control projection
controls target a child session
only the child commits model and Agent state and clears its pending controls.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_model_complete_noop_waits_for_shell_notice_and_skips_persist
contract: A no-op model switch SHALL still wait for ModelChanged terminal projection and SHALL not persist a preferred model or emit duplicate feedback.
scenarios: No-op model switch
RPC acknowledgement and matching notification arrive for the current model/effort
pending clears on notification and no persistence effect is emitted.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_model_complete_resolves_effort_from_catalog_meta_session_only
contract: When no effort is requested, model metadata SHALL determine the authoritative session reasoning effort after ModelChanged, while the switch remains session-scoped and does not write config defaults.
scenarios: Catalog effort resolution
the selected catalog model advertises xhigh metadata
the session commits Xhigh on notification and persistence remains empty.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_to_non_reasoning_model_clears_session_effort
contract: An authoritative switch to a model without a reasoning-effort menu SHALL clear the session effort, while transport completion alone leaves the prior effort unchanged.
scenarios: Non-reasoning model
ModelChanged reports no reasoning effort
the committed session effort becomes None without persisting defaults.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_model_complete_failure_pushes_error_and_clears_pending
contract: A local model-switch failure SHALL clear the pending control, preserve the prior committed model, and append one error row.
scenarios: Model switch failure
the model RPC returns a local failure
pending is false, current model is unchanged, and scrollback grows by one.

requirement: Pager task-result test: failed_model_switch_preserves_local_selection
contract: A failed model switch SHALL not roll back an already projected local selection when no speculative rollback is owned by the control correlation.
scenarios: Projected model failure
the selected model is already locally current when the RPC fails
the current model remains selected.

requirement: Pager task-result test: model_switch_succeeds_without_changing_agent
contract: A successful model projection SHALL change sampling state without changing Agent identity, opening a question, or persisting the default model.
scenarios: Model-only switch
a different model is selected and ModelChanged arrives
the model changes, Agent identity remains stable, and no persistence effect is emitted.

requirement: Pager task-result test: switch_model_stays_pending_until_authoritative_projection
contract: Model switch pending state SHALL span dispatch and accepted RPC transport and clear only after ModelChanged projection.
scenarios: Model pending lifecycle
the action dispatch, acknowledgement, and authoritative notification occur in order
pending is true through acknowledgement and false after notification.

requirement: Pager task-result test: sampling_completion_order_keeps_the_latest_model_as_effort_base
contract: Model switch completion order SHALL not regress the effort base: both acknowledgement-first and notification-first orders use the latest model for a subsequent effort change.
scenarios: Sampling completion order
model acknowledgement and ModelChanged arrive in either order
the next low-effort control targets the latest model.

requirement: Pager task-result test: reconnect_terminal_superseded_drains_local_sampling_desired
contract: A terminal Superseded result for the reconnect retry SHALL drain the local desired sampling control without committing the superseded target.
scenarios: Reconnect supersession
a reconnect retry receives Superseded
sampling control is no longer pending and the target is not committed.

requirement: Pager task-result test: model_and_agent_domains_dispatch_independently_but_jointly_fence_prompts
contract: Model and Agent controls SHALL dispatch independently but jointly fence queued prompts until both authoritative projections commit.
scenarios: Joint control fencing
model and Agent switches are pending while a prompt is queued
the prompt remains fenced until both ModelChanged and AgentChanged arrive.

requirement: Pager task-result test: reconnect_generation_discards_old_control_completion
contract: A completion from before session reload SHALL be discarded when a replacement control target has a newer dispatch generation.
scenarios: Reconnect generation fence

the old completion cannot consume the replacement target.

no switch effect and no pending model control are produced.

requirement: Pager task-result test: bundle_status_ready_populates_state

requirement: Pager task-result test: bundle_status_failed_logs_but_keeps_state

contract: An empty available-command refresh SHALL be a no-op and SHALL not advance the generation.
scenarios: Empty command refresh
the refresh contains no commands
state and generation remain unchanged.

requirement: Pager task-result test: delete_session_failed_keeps_all_entries

scenarios: Session deletion failure
deletion returns an error
the picker remains unchanged.

contract: Rename failure SHALL preserve the optimistic local display name and append a system block containing the error.

the name remains visible and the failure is appended.

scenarios: Known setting rollback

scenarios: Unknown setting rollback
persistence fails for an unrecognized key
dispatch returns safely with no effects.

requirement: Pager task-result test: persist_failed_toast_contains_key_and_error

the toast contains all three user-facing details.

both cwd transitions show the guidance.

requirement: Pager task-result test: session_list_empty_without_partial_keeps_generic_toast

a DiffHunk is rendered with DiffRenderConfig::default()
the output has an indented single new-line-number gutter, themed content spans, and no dual-number column.
Independent diff sides
a deleted multiline opener is followed by an inserted code line
the inserted line is highlighted from its own highlighter and does not inherit the deleted side state.
Syntax fallback
the file extension has no syntax or syntect returns no ranges
the line content remains visible with the corresponding plain equal/change style.

requirement: Pager edit hunk separators and gap safety

the next hunk begins eight hidden new-file lines after the previous hunk
the separator reads the configured marker plus “8 unchanged lines”.
Singular gap
exactly one new-file line is hidden
the separator uses “1 unchanged line”.
Unsafe gap
hunks are adjacent, non-monotonic, or the later hunk has no new-file line
the separator remains bare and does not render a negative or guessed count.

Dual-number gutter

equal rows show both columns while delete/insert rows blank the opposite side.
Gutter background

requirement: Pager edit diff regression snapshots and syntax spill protections
contract: The snapshot and focused tests SHALL distinguish cold hunk-only state from full-file state, verify raw syntect RGB differences under the theme lock, and ensure a mid-file closing triple quote corrects subsequent Equal-line styles without replacing displayed hunk text.

a basic, three-digit, reflowed, merged, or dual-number hunk is rendered
the corresponding snapshot shape remains stable.
Syntax spill regression
a hunk starts at a closing Python triple quote after the opener is outside the hunk
file-scoped styles match a full-file walk while hunk-only styles retain the demonstrated cold-start mismatch.
Theme lock
highlight tests run while GrowNight is pinned
raw RGB assertions remain meaningful instead of collapsing under color quantization.

requirement: Agent input behavior-confirmation capture contract
contract: Behavior-switch confirmation SHALL consume the deciding Enter or cancellation event before composer, overlay, or global shortcuts; confirmation selects the target mode, cancellation selects the current mode, and both clear the banner without editing the draft.
scenarios: Confirmation event
a behavior switch banner is active and a key, paste, or mouse event arrives
the event is converted to SetBehaviorMode or Unchanged according to the documented selection boundary.
Confirmation key capture
a behavior-switch warning is active and one of the tested confirmation or cancellation keys arrives in Fullscreen or Minimal mode
the input returns an Action, dispatch emits SwitchBehavior for the expected mode, the draft is unchanged and the warning/pending action is cleared.

requirement: Agent leader-key timeout and continuation contract
contract: The Ctrl-X leader SHALL expire after LEADER_KEY_TIMEOUT and maintain_leader_key SHALL clear an expired start marker while leaving an unexpired marker active.
scenarios: Leader timeout
the leader deadline is reached
the marker is cleared and the event is consumed for that expired sequence.

requirement: Agent goal-detail overlay navigation contract
contract: Goal detail SHALL open only when goal state exists, reset navigation on visibility changes, and clear close-hit state when hidden; toggling SHALL use the same transition.
scenarios: Goal detail transition
goal state is absent, added, or the overlay is toggled
visibility and renderer navigation follow the guarded transition.
Guarded transition
goal detail is requested while goal state is absent or present, or visibility is toggled
visibility is constrained by goal-state presence and a visibility change resets renderer navigation; hiding clears the close-hit state.
Keyboard scrolling
the visible overlay receives Up/k, Down/j, PageUp/PageDown, Home, or another key
the renderer applies the documented saturated delta, resets to zero for Home, or returns false for an unsupported key; Esc/q/g closes the overlay.
Mouse ownership
the visible overlay receives a wheel event, close click, move, paste, or another mouse event
wheel changes overlay scroll, close click/movement updates close handling, and overlay-owned events are consumed without scrolling or editing panes beneath.
Overlay pane isolation
workflows or goal detail owns the fullscreen surface and a wheel event arrives
the underlying scrollback offset is unchanged.

requirement: Agent external prompt editor ownership contract
contract: External prompt editing SHALL report Ready only for a normal focused empty composer, Attachments when text or images exist, PastePending while paste probing/deferred send is active, and OwnedElsewhere for any overlay, mode, subagent, viewer, search, queue, or dropdown that owns input.

an external editor request arrives under a layered AgentView state
the access enum identifies the highest-priority owner.

requirement: Agent pane and Esc ownership predicates contract

the predicate stays false while search, selection, viewers, modes, prompts, or input overlays still own the event.

requirement: Agent focus restoration contract

scenarios: Focus restoration
FocusGained arrives while Scrollback is active
the predicate selects prompt restoration only for the documented state combinations.

requirement: Agent Esc cancel hint contract
contract: The Esc cancel hint SHALL be true only when the app-level owner, Vim/minimal policy, pane, composer mode, viewers, dropdowns, searches, edits, subagent view, and input overlays all permit Esc to cancel the running turn.

the hint bar asks whether bare Esc cancels

requirement: Agent minimal btw ownership and scroll contract

a minimal agent receives Esc, scroll keys, or an occluding surface
the btw panel consumes only eligible events and restores hidden state after delegation.

requirement: Agent layered input routing precedence contract
contract: AgentView SHALL route input through subagent, confirmation, image/gboom/workflow/goal/btw/viewer/modal/permission/plan/rewind/edit/jump/question layers before pane handlers and global registry actions; consumed events return Changed/Action and unconsumed events bubble Unchanged.

an event arrives while one or more overlays or panes are active
the first owning layer handles it and lower-priority composer/global actions do not see the event.

requirement: Agent command picker and selection-context contract
contract: Command picker opening SHALL use workflow run snapshots for child-agent choices, live catalogs otherwise, pass command-specific suggestions and picker profile state, and show a toast when no options exist; selection context SHALL reflect agent, behavior, goal, and permission state.
scenarios: Command picker context
a model/agent/behavior/permission selector is requested
the picker receives the permitted catalog and current context, or a no-options notice is shown.

requirement: Agent action dispatch and child-view boundary contract

scenarios: Agent action mapping
a registered AgentScreen action is invoked

contract: Ctrl-B demotion SHALL preempt active history browse/search without changing its query, selection, mode, draft, or cursor.
scenarios: History search preservation
a running execute tool exists while history browse or search is active

Search activation
activate receives a current composer draft
the state becomes active in search mode and saved_text returns the supplied draft.
Browse activation

Default state

the state is inactive with no results, no saved query/draft, no hover, and no selected history text.

requirement: Pager agent input test: ctrl_b_preempts_file_search_without_mutating_it
contract: Ctrl-B demotion SHALL preempt an active @ file-search dropdown without changing context, selection, draft, or cursor.
scenarios: File search preservation
a running execute tool exists while file search is open
the tool is demoted and file-search state remains intact.
Bounded keyboard movement
move_selection or page_move receives a delta against an empty or populated result list
selection remains within 0..len-1; empty results remain unchanged and page movement never has a zero step.
Viewport containment
ensure_visible receives zero rows or a positive visible height
zero rows leave scroll unchanged; otherwise the scroll offset moves only when the selected item lies above or below the visible window.
Hover bounds
set_hovered receives None, an in-range index, or an out-of-range index
the stored hover is updated only to a valid index or None and the method reports whether it changed.
Hover selection
select_hovered runs with a valid or invalid hover
a valid hover becomes selected and returns true; invalid/missing hover returns false without changing selection.
Visibility and selected result
context/results are absent or present
the dropdown is visible only with both context and nonempty top-k, and selected_result safely returns the current match or None.

requirement: Pager agent input test: ctrl_b_preempts_tasks_search_and_filter_without_mutating_them

scenarios: Tasks search preservation
a running execute tool exists while Tasks search or filter is active

requirement: Pager agent input test: fullscreen_child_ctrl_b_never_demotes_child_or_parent

requirement: Pager agent input test: ctrl_g_toggles_tasks_and_never_demotes

requirement: Pager agent input test: workflow_child_agent_picker_uses_only_run_snapshot_names

scenarios: Workflow Agent picker

scenarios: Child behavior boundary

scenarios: Leader selector routing

requirement: Pager agent input test: leader_continuations_are_case_insensitive

requirement: Pager agent input test: behavior_switch_confirmation_enter_preserves_draft
contract: Confirming a behavior switch with bare Enter SHALL request the target mode without mutating the composer draft or committed behavior mode locally.
scenarios: Behavior confirmation

requirement: Pager agent input test: behavior_switch_confirmation_other_input_cancels_without_editing
contract: Any non-confirming key, paste, or modified Enter during behavior confirmation SHALL cancel back to the current mode without editing the draft or emitting effects.
scenarios: Behavior cancellation
a non-confirming event arrives during the warning

contract: An expired behavior switch banner SHALL clear its target and banner without switching mode.
scenarios: Behavior confirmation expiry

the target and banner are removed.

requirement: Pager agent input test: behavior_switch_confirmation_ignores_key_release
contract: A key-release event SHALL not confirm or cancel behavior switching.
scenarios: Behavior release event
Enter arrives as a key release while the warning is active
the warning remains pending and the outcome is Unchanged.

requirement: Pager agent input test: unknown_leader_continuation_is_consumed
contract: An unknown leader continuation SHALL be consumed, clear the leader state, and never leak its character into the composer or open a modal.
scenarios: Unknown leader key

the draft is unchanged and the leader marker is cleared.

requirement: Pager agent input test: focused_panel_scrolls_with_arrows
contract: A focused scrollable `/btw` panel SHALL consume Up/Down and move its body offset while retaining focus.
scenarios: Btw arrow scrolling

arrow events return Changed and adjust the panel offset.

requirement: Pager agent input test: focused_panel_owns_page_keys_before_prompt_paging
contract: A focused scrollable `/btw` panel SHALL own PageUp/PageDown before prompt conversation paging.

contract: Typing while `/btw` has focus SHALL return focus to the prompt and insert the character without scrolling the panel.
scenarios: Btw typing handoff

requirement: Pager agent input test: arrows_move_prompt_cursor_when_prompt_focused
contract: When the prompt is focused, arrow keys SHALL move the prompt cursor and leave the `/btw` panel offset unchanged.
scenarios: Prompt arrow ownership

requirement: Pager agent input test: nonscrollable_answer_never_captures_arrows
contract: A non-scrollable `/btw` answer SHALL release arrow ownership back to the prompt.
scenarios: Btw non-scrollable answer

focus returns to prompt and panel offset remains zero.

requirement: Pager agent input test: scrollback_pane_does_not_capture_arrows
contract: A `/btw` panel SHALL not capture arrows while Scrollback is the active pane.
scenarios: Btw scrollback boundary
btw is focused but Scrollback is active
the panel offset remains unchanged.

requirement: Pager agent input test: esc_dismisses_panel_and_clears_focus
contract: Bare Esc SHALL dismiss `/btw` and clear its focus.
scenarios: Btw dismissal
the panel is open and focused
btw state is removed and focus is false.

requirement: Pager agent input test: minimal_permission_owns_esc_over_hidden_btw
contract: In minimal mode, a pending permission overlay SHALL own Esc over a latent `/btw` panel and preserve the permission queue.
scenarios: Minimal permission precedence
permission and hidden btw both exist
permission focus changes while btw lifecycle remains active.

requirement: Pager agent input test: minimal_modal_and_viewers_own_esc_over_hidden_btw
contract: Minimal agents modal, block viewer, and goal detail SHALL each consume Esc before a hidden `/btw` panel.
scenarios: Minimal shared overlay precedence

the front surface closes while btw remains active.

requirement: Pager agent input test: minimal_btw_surface_owner_covers_shared_modal_cascade

scenarios: Minimal btw availability

minimal_btw_surface_available returns false.

requirement: Pager agent input test: fullscreen_keeps_btw_first_esc_precedence
contract: Fullscreen routing SHALL let the open `/btw` panel consume the first Esc even when a permission is pending.
scenarios: Fullscreen btw precedence
btw and permission coexist
btw closes while permission remains pending.

requirement: Pager agent input test: minimal_does_not_scroll_unpainted_btw_geometry
contract: Minimal btw scrolling SHALL require paintable geometry; a default/unpainted area cannot change the offset.
scenarios: Btw geometry guard
scroll input arrives before btw is painted
offset remains zero.

requirement: Pager agent input test: esc_over_shadowed_jump_picker_spares_btw_panel

scenarios: Shadowed picker Esc
jump and btw are both open

requirement: Pager agent input test: clicking_panel_refocuses_it
contract: Clicking the rendered btw panel SHALL switch to Prompt, refocus the panel, and allow subsequent arrows to scroll it.
scenarios: Btw mouse focus
a panel click lands inside the rendered area
btw focus and prompt pane become active and scrolling works.

requirement: Pager agent input test: pasting_into_prompt_returns_focus
contract: Pasting into the prompt SHALL return focus from btw to the prompt even for large text.
scenarios: Btw paste handoff
a paste event arrives while btw is focused
btw focus clears.

requirement: Pager agent input test: should_restore_prompt_on_focus_gained_permission_vim_turn_running
contract: FocusGained SHALL restore Prompt when a permission overlay is pending even in Vim mode during a running turn.
scenarios: Permission focus restoration

the predicate is true.

requirement: Pager agent input test: should_restore_prompt_on_focus_gained_permission_non_vim_turn_running
contract: FocusGained SHALL restore Prompt when permission is pending in non-Vim running state.

the predicate is true.

requirement: Pager agent input test: should_restore_prompt_on_focus_gained_idle_non_vim_no_overlay
contract: Idle non-Vim Scrollback SHALL restore Prompt on FocusGained when no modal blocks it.
scenarios: Idle focus restoration

contract: Idle Vim Scrollback SHALL remain in Scrollback on FocusGained without an input overlay.
scenarios: Vim focus restoration

contract: Busy non-Vim Scrollback SHALL not restore Prompt without a needs-input overlay.
scenarios: Busy focus restoration

the predicate is false.

contract: FocusGained SHALL not request restoration when Prompt is already active, even if permission is pending.
scenarios: Prompt focus no-op
Prompt is already active with permission
the predicate is false.

requirement: Pager agent input test: should_restore_prompt_on_focus_gained_permission_with_modal
contract: An active top-level modal SHALL block focus restoration even when a permission overlay is pending.

the predicate is true.

contract: Question input SHALL force Prompt restoration from Scrollback in Vim mode during a running turn.
scenarios: Question focus restoration
a question input overlay is pending
the predicate is true.

requirement: Pager agent input test: should_restore_prompt_on_focus_gained_cancel_turn_vim
contract: Cancel-turn input SHALL force Prompt restoration from Scrollback in Vim mode during a running turn.
scenarios: Cancel focus restoration
cancel-turn confirmation is pending
the predicate is true.

requirement: Pager agent input test: gate_non_vim_true_vim_false_minimal_overrides_vim
contract: Esc cancel hint SHALL be true for non-Vim fullscreen running turns, false for Vim fullscreen, and true for Vim minimal mode.
scenarios: Esc policy mode gate
the same running prompt is tested across Vim/fullscreen and Vim/minimal
the hint follows screen-mode policy.

contract: An app-level Esc owner SHALL suppress the agent-level Esc-cancel hint.
scenarios: App Esc owner

contract: Queued-prompt editing and inline prompt editing SHALL own Esc for discard/dismissal instead of canceling the turn.
scenarios: Edit Esc ownership
either edit state is active during a running turn
the hint is false.

scenarios: Subagent Esc ownership

the hint is false.

scenarios: Agents modal Esc ownership
the modal is active during a running turn
the hint is false.

scenarios: Scrollback search Esc ownership

scenarios: Composer/pane Esc policy

scenarios: Jump Esc ownership

requirement: AgentView SHALL clear ephemeral permission, question, Plan approval, cancel-turn, and descendant interaction state when a transport is replayed or a terminal child session disappears. Permissions removed during cleanup SHALL receive a cancelled response, centralized queue transitions SHALL be resolved when the front changes, question/approval prompts SHALL be restored, and Plan approval viewer/comment state SHALL be dropped.
contract: clear_transport_interactions_for_replay SHALL cancel every queued permission and recurse into subagent views. clear_transport_interactions_for_session SHALL filter only matching session ids, preserve unrelated FIFO entries, return whether any state changed, recurse into descendants, and clear question/approval state only when its source session matches.
scenarios: Replay cleanup
a transport generation is replayed with pending permissions or reverse-request views

Child session cleanup
a terminal child session id is supplied while unrelated permissions remain queued
matching permissions/questions/approvals are removed and unrelated queue entries stay in order.
Front permission removal
the removed permission was the queue front

requirement: AgentView SHALL keep runtime session facts synchronized with ephemeral presentation containers. Permission queue mutations SHALL update pending_permission_count, question replacement/take SHALL update question_pending, and replacement paths SHALL derive facts from the complete resulting queue/view rather than incremental assumptions.

scenarios: Permission enqueue/dequeue
a permission is pushed, popped, removed by index, or the whole queue is taken
pending_permission_count equals the resulting queue length.
Filtered replacement
a queue is replaced after session filtering
the runtime fact is recomputed from the replacement queue.
Question modal replacement
a question view is opened, replaced, or taken
question_pending reflects presence of the current view and the previous value is returned on replacement.

requirement: When a ProjectSelect question is open, AgentView SHALL temporarily restore the stashed composer prompt and forward the event to the normal input router so project-picker backing input edits the composer rather than the picker path field. The question view SHALL be restashed after routing; non-project questions SHALL be restored unchanged and return no outcome.
contract: handle_project_picker_backing_prompt_input SHALL take the question view, guard local_kind=ProjectSelect, restore its stashed prompt, call handle_input, stash the resulting prompt, replace the question view, and return the routed InputOutcome.
scenarios: Project picker backing input
the active local question is ProjectSelect
the event is handled by the composer with the question view restored afterward.
Other question
the active question is not ProjectSelect
the original question view is put back and the helper returns None without routing.
No question
no question view is active
the helper returns None and does not mutate the prompt.

requirement: The active permission view SHALL own keyboard input. FollowupInput SHALL support Esc back to options, Ctrl-C cancellation, multiline Enter routing, submit-to-PermissionFollowup, and prompt editing. Options SHALL support Ctrl-F argument expansion, Tab to scrollback, j/k or arrows, Enter and 1-9 option actions, RejectOnce text entry into followup mode, and left/right scope adjustment for MCP or Bash permissions.
contract: handle_permission_key SHALL operate only on the FIFO front permission and return Changed for consumed view input. Scope arrows SHALL adjust MCP server/tool or Bash highlighted-word count; when the cursor is on a non-scoped option they SHALL move it to AllowAlways, while RejectAlways remains selected when narrowing a deny scope.
scenarios: Followup submit
permission focus is FollowupInput and Enter submits the prompt
an Action::PermissionFollowup containing the current text is returned.
Option shortcut
permission focus is Options and Enter or a valid 1-9 key selects an option
an Action::PermissionSelect with that option id is returned.
Scope adjustment
left/right is pressed with adjustable MCP/Bash scope
the scope or highlighted word count changes and the row policy preserves the intended scoped row.
Reject feedback
the active option is RejectOnce and a non-digit text key is typed
focus changes to FollowupInput and the key is forwarded to the prompt.

requirement: Cancel-turn and Goal interrupt panels SHALL consume their own keyboard and mouse input. Cancel-turn supports navigation, numeric/Enter choice submission, Ctrl-C cancel, Tab to scrollback, and Esc ContinueToRun while refreshing rewind suppression. Goal interrupt supports navigation, numeric/Enter choice submission, Tab/focus controls and an Esc dismiss-only path that closes the panel without cancelling the turn or Goal.
contract: handle_cancel_turn_key and handle_goal_interrupt_key SHALL return Action only for explicit choices/cancel requests, Changed for consumed navigation/dismissal, and Unchanged for unrelated keys. Mouse handlers SHALL update active rows on hit-test movement and dispatch only left-button clicks inside valid choice rectangles.
scenarios: Cancel choice
Enter, 1-4, or Ctrl-C is pressed in the cancel panel
the matching CancelTurnChoice or CancelTurn action is returned.
Goal dismiss
Esc is pressed in the Goal panel
the panel closes, rewind suppression is refreshed, the turn remains running, and no action is emitted.
Mouse choice
a left click lands inside a choice rect
the corresponding modal action is returned and the active index follows the clicked row.
Outside/closed panel
a mouse event lands outside rows or the panel is absent
the handler returns Unchanged without changing modal state.

requirement: The question modal SHALL expose Navigation, InputMode, and PlanAction focus modes. Navigation SHALL support bounded cursor movement, page/half jumps, option toggles/selections, option-key shortcuts, freeform activation, question tab cycling, clipboard copy of option text, fullscreen, cancellation/skip and pane transfer. InputMode SHALL route prompt editing and Enter/newline, save per-question freeform state on exit, and advance or submit. PlanAction SHALL select ChatAboutThis or SkipInterview explicitly with arrows/Enter and return to navigation on Esc.
contract: handle_question_key SHALL preserve per-question freeform text and selection flags across focus changes, clear a single-choice selection when nonblank freeform is selected, call ensure_question_cursor_visible after navigation, and swap/load the freeform slot when changing active tabs. Dismiss/skip shortcuts SHALL route through the dedicated submission helpers.
scenarios: Option navigation
Navigation receives j/k, page, g/G, space, Enter, or an option key
the cursor/selection changes within bounds and Enter or the final option submits.
Freeform entry
the cursor is on a freeform row and a printable key, z, Space, Enter, or its sticky row is activated
the prompt enters InputMode with the tab’s saved text.
Input submit
InputMode receives Enter or a prompt newline event
the current text is saved, the next question is loaded or the full answer is submitted.
Plan action
PlanAction receives arrows, Enter, Esc, Tab, or Shift-X
the explicit action changes, submits partial answers, returns to navigation, or transfers focus as defined.

requirement: Question mouse handling SHALL prioritize navigation buttons, scrollbar, prompt textarea, sticky freeform, and option rows according to the active focus and rendered geometry. Movement SHALL update hover state, scroll events SHALL route to the inline prompt or question list, single clicks SHALL select/toggle, and a second click on the same option within MULTI_CLICK_TIMEOUT_MS SHALL submit or advance.
contract: handle_question_mouse SHALL clear stale scrollback/click tracking on modal clicks, use question_view row helpers with current width/scroll/preview state, keep no_freeform phantom rows inert, and forward drag/up events to the scrollbar or prompt as applicable.
scenarios: Option click
a click hits an option row
the cursor and selection update; a same-row second click within the timeout submits/advances.
Sticky freeform click
freeform is enabled and the click hits its reserved row
the current tab enters InputMode with its saved text; clicking again can clear the freeform selection.
Textarea click
InputMode is active and the click lands in the textarea
prompt mouse handling receives the event and a double click may expand a paste chip.
Hover/scroll
the pointer moves or scrolls over question content
hover state or per-question scroll changes and unrelated regions are consumed without option changes.

requirement: Question scrolling SHALL use the same measured option geometry as rendering. apply_question_scroll SHALL compute visible height from prompt area, focus, preview, phantom freeform and Plan rows, then apply bounded item-delta scrolling. Scrollbar click/drag SHALL map the thumb position back to a clamped content offset, and cursor visibility SHALL be re-established after navigation.
contract: apply_question_scrollbar_click SHALL no-op without a scrollbar rect, use scrollbar_click_to_offset with total and visible heights, and clamp offsets to max_scroll. question_item_at SHALL map screen rows through scroll offsets and exclude chrome, footer, and hidden freeform rows.
scenarios: Wheel scroll
the question list receives a positive or negative delta
the active tab’s scroll offset changes within the measured content bounds.
Scrollbar drag
a valid scrollbar rect receives a click/drag
the offset becomes top, bottom, or the inverse-mapped clamped position.
Cursor visibility
keyboard navigation moves the cursor beyond the viewport
ensure_question_cursor_visible updates the active tab scroll to reveal it.
Chrome hit
a row falls outside the scroll region or in footer/chrome
question_item_at returns None rather than selecting an option.

requirement: Question freeform drafts SHALL be isolated per question tab and synchronized with the prompt widget only when entering/leaving InputMode. Leaving InputMode SHALL preserve nonblank text and selection, clear blank text, reset click timing, and re-entry SHALL retain folded paste chips when the stored slot still matches the live draft. A rewritten slot SHALL replace stale prompt content.
contract: swap_question_freeform SHALL save the current prompt before active_tab changes; load_question_freeform SHALL restore the new tab’s slot with set_text_preserving. InputMode mouse/key transitions SHALL use the existing prompt buffer when unchanged and only perform wholesale replacement when a slot was rewritten.
scenarios: Tab isolation
the active question changes
the previous prompt text is saved under its tab and the next tab’s freeform text is loaded.
Blank exit
InputMode is exited with only whitespace
freeform selection is false and the slot is cleared.
Paste chip round trip
a multiline paste is folded into a chip, then input is exited and re-entered
the chip remains folded while the full text remains available for submission.
Rewritten slot
another surface changes the stored freeform slot while the prompt has an old chip draft
re-entry shows the rewritten text and removes the stale chip.

requirement: Question submission SHALL distinguish Plan actions, external AskUserQuestion answers, and local ProjectSelect/DoctorFix questions. External accepted/cancelled responses SHALL restore the stashed prompt, clear question visual state, pause-duration accounting and emit the appropriate diagnostics. Plan actions SHALL send ChatAboutThis or SkipInterview with partial answers; local project selection SHALL transfer the complete composer snapshot to pending project creation; DoctorFix skip SHALL emit DoctorFixCancelled.
contract: submit_question_answers SHALL consume the question view before branching, save the active freeform slot, handle local_kind without sending an ACP ext response, call translate_local_submit except for DoctorFix cancellation, and avoid synthesizing user input. submit_plan_question_action SHALL build/send the selected ext response, restore/cleanup, and log interview_chat or interview_skip.
scenarios: Accepted external answer
the final external question is submitted without skip
an accepted ext response is sent, the prompt is restored, state is cleaned, and interview_submit is logged.
Skipped external answer
Ctrl-C/Shift-X or a skip path submits an external question
Cancelled is sent and interview_cancel is logged.
Plan chat/skip
PlanAction selects ChatAboutThis or SkipInterview
the corresponding partial-answer ext response is sent and question state closes.
Local question
ProjectSelect or DoctorFix is submitted/skipped
the project prompt snapshot transfers or DoctorFixCancelled is returned through the local translation path.

requirement: dashboard_answer_question SHALL answer only the active external question. A valid option index selects that option; a nonempty freeform string selects Other and clears a single-choice option; empty Other input, missing question view, or local questions SHALL be NoOp. Nonfinal answers advance the active tab, while the final answer sends the accepted response, restores the stashed prompt, clears question state, and returns Submitted.
contract: The helper SHALL take and restore the question view around NoOp cases, preserve the active per-question vectors, pause turn duration on final submission, and never route local ProjectSelect/DoctorFix through the external response sender.
scenarios: Advance peek answer
a valid option or nonempty freeform answers a nonfinal question
the selection is stored and PeekAnswerOutcome::Advanced is returned.
Submit peek answer
the active answer is for the last external question
the accepted ext response is sent, prompt/state are restored/cleaned, and Submitted is returned.
Invalid peek answer
the question is local, missing, or freeform is blank
the question view is preserved and NoOp is returned.

requirement: When another client resolves an interaction, AgentView SHALL dismiss only the matching question, Plan approval, or permission identified by source session and tool call. Question dismissal restores the prompt and cleans view state; Plan approval sends stale cancel, restores prompt, resets comment/viewer state; removing the front permission resolves the queue transition. Nonmatching or absent interactions SHALL be a silent false result.
contract: dismiss_resolved_interaction SHALL check question, Plan approval, then permission queue identity; it SHALL return true only when a matching modal is removed. Permission identity comparison SHALL use both session_id and tool_call_id, and removing a non-front permission SHALL not transition the queue.
scenarios: Question resolution
matching session/tool ids identify the question view
the question is dismissed and true is returned.
Plan resolution
matching ids identify plan approval
stale cancel is sent, prompt/viewer/comment state is cleared, and true is returned.
Permission resolution
matching permission is queued
the item is removed; a front removal resolves transition while a non-front removal leaves FIFO display unchanged.
Stale resolution
ids do not match any visible interaction
false is returned and no modal state changes.

requirement: Question interactions SHALL treat no_freeform modals as fixed-choice surfaces. Hidden freeform rows SHALL not be hit-testable, hoverable, keyboard-addressable by z, or selectable below the final option; the final visible option row SHALL still toggle/select normally. Regular questions with freeform SHALL retain sticky-row click and z activation.
contract: handle_question_mouse, question_item_at, and handle_question_key SHALL jointly apply the no_freeform gate so phantom freeform rows cannot receive cursor, selection, hover, or InputMode state while ordinary freeform questions continue to support the same entry routes.
scenarios: No-freeform gap
a click or hover lands below the final option
the event is inert and no freeform or option selection changes.
No-freeform final option
the click lands on the final visible option row
that option is selected/toggled and focus remains Navigation.
No-freeform z
z is pressed in Navigation
the cursor and focus remain unchanged.
Regular freeform
a normal question receives sticky-row click or z
freeform is selected and InputMode opens.

requirement: Permission option hit-testing SHALL derive the option start row from permission chrome height and return only valid option indices. Permission clicks SHALL select the row on first click and submit only on a same-row second click within MULTI_CLICK_TIMEOUT_MS; clicks on chrome, another row, or after the timeout SHALL reset the pairing without submitting. Ctrl-F and scope arrows SHALL work across option/followup focus as covered by the inline checks.
contract: permission_item_at SHALL use the front permission and shared permission_chrome_height_pub, ignoring columns and rejecting zero prompt areas/out-of-range rows. Mouse routing through handle_input SHALL clear last_permission_click when the intervening click is not the same option row.
scenarios: Chrome-aware hit
permission args are collapsed or expanded
the first option row moves with chrome height and rows map to the expected option indices.
Same-row double click
the same option is clicked twice inside the timeout
the second click emits PermissionSelect for that option.
Different/slow click
the second click targets another row or occurs after timeout
the option is selected but no submission action is emitted.

requirement: The interaction module SHALL preserve the focused regression behaviors pinned by its 30 inline tests: Plan action traversal and partial answers, cancel/Goal mouse-key semantics, permission chrome and scope behavior, fixed-choice no-freeform gating, and paste-chip round trips. These tests are source evidence for interaction state transitions and do not establish compiled, terminal, ACP transport, or downstream action execution behavior.
contract: The inline tests SHALL exercise AgentView state with synthetic panels/frames and direct handler calls, asserting InputOutcome, focus, selection, queue, prompt, and modal state. Dynamic execution, real terminal input, and response receiver delivery remain outside this static audit.
scenarios: Synthetic modal frame
tests construct AgentView state and synthetic Rect/Buffer geometry
handler outputs and state transitions are asserted without a live terminal.
Question chip round trip
tests paste, exit, re-enter, and double-click a question prompt
chip folding, stale draft replacement, and click timer reset remain explicit.
Plan response evidence
tests drive PlanAction Enter through a oneshot receiver
ChatAboutThis/SkipInterview response shapes and absence of synthetic user input are asserted.

requirement: Pager prompt text insertion and deferred send contract
contract: Prompt text insertion SHALL reject absent/whitespace-only payloads, optionally activate Bash for an initial `! ` command, pass accepted text through the prompt widget and suggestion/plugin refresh, and rederive SendPrompt or SteerPrompt actions only after all attachment probes drain. Shared queued edits SHALL reject image attachments with cleanup and a user-facing notice.
scenarios: Text insertion
a nonempty clipboard payload is accepted
the prompt is edited, slash/suggestion state is refreshed, and insertion metadata reports Inserted.
Deferred send
attachment probes remain in flight or a send stash exists
no action is reissued until probes drain; reissued payload is rebuilt from current prompt/image state.
Queued shared prompt
an image is completed while editing a server-backed queued prompt
the temporary image is cleaned up and attachment is reported as AlreadyReported.

requirement: Pager clipboard attachment probe scheduling contract
contract: Cmd/Ctrl-V SHALL classify dropped paths synchronously, otherwise enqueue an off-event-loop attachment probe with an AgentPrompt target, session image directory, source metadata, and change count; plain text with a raster-free snapshot remains synchronous.
scenarios: Path precedence
clipboard text resolves as drop paths
decoded paths/images are handled synchronously and no rival probe is queued.
Raster probe
the clipboard snapshot indicates a raster or empty text needs probing
a ProbeClipboardAttachment effect is queued and no heavy read occurs inline.
Plain text
the snapshot is supported and raster-free
text is inserted synchronously with no probe effect.

requirement: Pager deferred clipboard completion and image/text precedence contract
contract: Deferred attachment completion SHALL decrement in-flight probes, attach a decoded image before any caption, insert carried text only for a no-raster/drop/failure path, classify PersistFailed/ProbeDropped/ProbeFailed distinctly, and rebase late prompt changes onto the project-picker snapshot.
scenarios: Image wins
the probe returns Image with caption text
one image chip is inserted, preview preparation may be queued, and caption text is suppressed.
No raster
the probe returns NoRaster with nonblank text or file URLs
decoded path/text is inserted and completion is Handled.
Project picker
the visible composer belongs to a ProjectSelect question when completion arrives
the late prompt/image is restored into the stashed picker prompt rather than hidden live state.

requirement: Pager wrap-host image paste contract
contract: The wrap-host magic paste protocol SHALL consume valid encoded images into prompt image state and refresh slash context, consume the explicit no-image sentinel as handled-without-text, and leave malformed/nonprotocol text to normal routing.
scenarios: No image sentinel
MAGIC_NONE is pasted
the event is consumed without inserting text.
Malformed payload
a malformed GROW_WRAP_IMG payload is pasted
the payload is consumed without inserting text or image state.

requirement: Pager dropped path classifier and image-cap contract
contract: Drop-style file URLs SHALL be classified before clipboard raster probing, process entries in source-token order, insert images as chips and non-images as canonical path text with trailing spaces, group edits for undo, refresh slash once, notify text changes only for non-images, and enforce the image cap without blocking later non-image paths.
scenarios: Mixed drop
image and non-image paths are pasted
both are handled in source order, only images create chips, and path text is decoded.
Cap reached
additional images exceed IMAGE_CAP
one cap toast is shown, accepted images stop at the cap, and subsequent non-image text still inserts.
Classifier bound
the session is SSH or payload is at least 10 MiB
the drop classifier declines and normal text/probe routing remains available.

requirement: Pager popup paste ownership contract
contract: Plan feedback, permission follow-up, plan approval prompt, and question input paste SHALL share the canonical drop classifier and otherwise insert plain text into the shared prompt; plan preview SHALL decline paste and leave hidden prompt text unchanged.
scenarios: Popup path
a non-image file URL reaches a popup input owner
the canonical classifier inserts decoded path text without a chip or file:// fragment.
Plan preview
paste reaches preview focus
