the event is Unchanged and hidden prompt state is preserved.

requirement: Pager basic clipboard text normalization contract
contract: Clipboard text paste SHALL preserve ordinary text, append to existing prompt text, normalize CR to LF, expand tabs to spaces, represent multiline paste as one paste element, and consume empty clipboard keys without adding text.
scenarios: Plain text
nonempty text is pasted
the prompt contains the text and returns Changed.
Whitespace
empty, whitespace-only, or single-newline text is pasted
no text is inserted while the paste path remains consumed/no-op.
Normalization
CR or tab characters occur
the prompt stores LF and expanded spaces.

requirement: Pager path and file URL paste precedence contract
contract: Image paths SHALL create persisted image chips and preview effects; non-image paths and percent-encoded file URLs SHALL become canonical decoded path text; file-url recovery SHALL handle None/empty clipboard text, multiple files, trailing newlines, unreadable paths, and SHALL not double-insert when synchronous text already classified.
scenarios: Image path
a valid PNG path is pasted
one image chip and preview preparation are recorded.
Non-image URL
a text file URL or percent-encoded path is pasted
canonical path text plus trailing space is inserted with no image chip.
Deferred file URLs
text is None/empty or multiple file URLs arrive at completion
the URL payload is recovered, mixed entries preserve order, and the synchronous classifier prevents duplicate insertion.

requirement: Pager contextual tip and undo routing contract
contract: Paste SHALL retire the clipboard-image tip and image acceptance SHALL preserve its contextual acceptance path; substantial Ctrl-C draft wipes SHALL offer ShowUndoTip, Ctrl-Z SHALL restore only when the active tip is the undo tip, and plan-nudge SHALL fire only for idle Normal-mode planning keywords.
scenarios: Clipboard tip
text, image, or bracketed paste occurs while the image tip is shown
the tip is retired and an image attaches when applicable.
Undo tip
a substantial draft is wiped then Ctrl-Z is pressed
the draft is restored and the undo tip retires; unrelated tips remain.
Plan nudge
a planning keyword is typed in eligible state
ShowPlanNudge is signaled only outside Plan, busy, Bash, feedback, or Remember modes.

requirement: Pager ephemeral tip paintability and terminal-size gate contract
contract: Ephemeral tips SHALL refuse to show, consume seen counts, or start TTL while terminal size is unknown/too short, a resize is awaiting redraw, or any listed overlay/subagent/dropdown occludes the banner; a valid remeasure permits one counted show and size changes invalidate Kitty media ids.
scenarios: Unrenderable surface
an occluding view or insufficient size exists
show returns false, no count burns, and no tip activates.
Resize staleness
a resize is noted before draw remeasurement
show remains gated until note_terminal_size runs again.
Size change
a measured size changes
inline media ids are cleared and terminal staleness ends.

requirement: Pager Mermaid affordance routing and dropdown geometry contract
contract: Mermaid affordance clicks SHALL copy source without rendering, route Open/CopyPath through lazy render, paint a dim label and ordered buttons with hover styling and clipped hit rectangles, while dropdown chrome SHALL anchor above/below the prompt and become flush-left in embedded mode.
scenarios: Copy source
the source button is clicked
clipboard feedback is shown and no Mermaid render is started.
Lazy render
Open or CopyPath is clicked without a cached session directory
the request reaches lazy rendering and reports not ready.
Affordance layout
a row is wide, hovered, or narrow
buttons and hit rectangles match layout, hover only affects the hovered button, and clipped buttons are omitted.
Dropdown geometry
full or embedded chrome is rendered above/below
items occupy the requested side and embedded layout is flush-left.
Wide affordance
label and buttons fit within the row
all fitting labels are painted, button hits are registered, and the source is stored once.
Narrow affordance
a label/button/status segment exceeds the row width
that segment is omitted and no out-of-bounds hit rectangle is registered for it.
Hover styling
the pointer lies within one button rectangle
only that button uses primary bold/underlined style; idle buttons remain gray and the marker/status remain dim.
Rendering state
a Mermaid source has a live worker action
the trailing rendering hint is painted when it fits; otherwise no hint is emitted.
Copy source
CopySource is clicked
the source is sent to clipboard without starting a render; failed delivery writes a structured unified-log error.
Lazy actions
Open or CopyPath is clicked
the source is moved to request_mermaid_render with the matching worker action.

requirement: Pager Kitty inline media transmission and cleanup contract
contract: Inline Kitty media SHALL transmit bytes and place on the first frame, place without retransmission on later frames, and emit deletion escapes that drain own and nested subagent placements according to takeover ownership.
scenarios: First frame
a cached tool image is first placed
the escape contains transmit and place operations.
Repeat frame
the same image is placed again
the escape places without retransmitting bytes.
Takeover cleanup
a parent or child view is closed/taken over
the appropriate placements are deleted and tracking resets without deleting an active child’s own placements.
Cache miss
a placement has no cache bytes and no existing id
build_inline_media_escapes returns None without allocating an id.
First placement
cached bytes exist and the path has no id
the returned escape contains a transmit followed by placement and the id is recorded.
Repeat placement
the same path is placed again
placement is emitted without a second transmit.
iTerm move
the detected protocol is iTerm2 and the screen rectangle differs from the last one
the image is re-emitted for the new rectangle and that rectangle becomes the tracked last placement.
Own cleanup
own ids or active placement state exists
clear escapes are produced for each id and own id/iTerm/last-placement state is cleared.
Nested cleanup
subagent views contain placements
recursive child clear escapes are appended; a child takeover path can leave the child view untouched until it draws.

requirement: Pager clipboard probe context and deferral boundary contract
contract: Cmd-V with raster/empty/failed text SHALL enqueue a probe without inline heavy work, preserve ClipboardKey versus BracketedInserted provenance and synchronous insertion metadata, and carry text-read failure into the deferred context.
scenarios: No raster snapshot
supported snapshot says no raster
paste stays synchronous and no probe call/effect occurs.
Raster snapshot
snapshot contains an image
an AgentPrompt probe effect is queued and caption is not inserted yet.
Source provenance
Cmd-V, bracketed paste, or failed text read is used
the deferred context preserves source kind, text, insertion result, and read failure.

requirement: Pager deferred completion classification contract
contract: Deferred completion SHALL attach images, suppress captions when image wins, insert captions on no-raster miss, preserve captions on dropped/failed probes where source semantics require, reject failed text reads as TextRead rather than FullMiss, decode unreadable file URLs as text, and distinguish Dropped/AttachmentRead/AlreadyReported failures.
scenarios: Image completion
a decoded image is returned with a caption
image attaches and caption is absent.
Miss completion
NoRaster returns with caption
caption inserts and completion is Handled.
Failure classification
probe is dropped, fails, persists unsuccessfully, or text read failed
the corresponding typed ClipboardPasteCompletion is returned without conflating outcomes.

requirement: Pager prompt modal layout safety contract
contract: Question modal layout SHALL clamp reserved chrome so prompt rows never exceed the terminal area, including a fullscreen question input configuration.
scenarios: Question layout
reserved rows exceed the available area
prompt height is clamped and its bottom remains within the terminal.

requirement: Peek panel state refresh preserves draft ownership and invalidates stale interaction
contract: PeekPanelState SHALL keep row identity, live display fields, pending question/permission metadata, focus, option selection, model/mode badge fields, and the dashboard-owned reply outside the panel. new SHALL initialize fields from PeekFields and focus non-vim panels; apply_fields SHALL preserve focus/draft on same-row refreshes, clear selection when request_id or question_id changes, clear vim focus on row change, drop out-of-range selections, and return whether row or concrete interaction identity changed.
scenarios: Same-row live refresh
the selected row remains the same and only status text changes
display fields update while focus, selected option, and the dashboard reply draft remain available and apply_fields returns false.
Interaction rotation
the row stays the same but request_id or question_id changes
selected_option resets and apply_fields returns true so the dashboard can clear the stale draft.
Vim row change
a vim-mode peek moves to another dashboard row
focus is cleared and apply_fields returns true.

requirement: Peek pending permission and AskUserQuestion projection
contract: pending_interaction_peek SHALL project the first matching permission for a session into sanitized question text, option ids/labels, request id, and RejectOnce index. When questions are enabled it SHALL project only supported single-select external AskUserQuestion state, append an Other option unless no_freeform, attach question_id, and prefix multi-question text with active/total position. Subagent peeks SHALL suppress child questions while retaining permissions.
scenarios: Permission projection
a matching permission is present in the session queue
sanitized title/description, scope-aware option labels, request id, and reject index are returned.
Root question
questions are enabled and the active question belongs to the root session
the current single-select question and options are projected with its tool-call id.
Child question
a question belongs to a subagent row
the subagent peek returns no question/options and falls back to reply, while the top-level root question remains visible.
Unsupported question
the question is local, empty, or multi-select
no pending question projection is returned.

requirement: Dashboard peek field computation for top-level, subagent and roster rows
contract: compute_peek_fields SHALL derive a live PeekFields snapshot from the owning AgentView. TopLevel rows use the agent title, latest response type, latest user message, session activity time and root session id; Subagent rows use subagent metadata and child view state, with child response fallbacks and child activity time; Roster-only rows and vanished parents/children SHALL return None.
scenarios: Top-level row
a live top-level AgentId exists
label, status, user message, time-ago and root pending interaction fields are returned.
Subagent row
parent metadata and child session are present
subagent label/status/activity and child permission fields are returned, with child questions suppressed.
Vanished row
the parent, child, or local agent cannot be found
compute_peek_fields returns None so the caller can close the peek.
Roster row
the row is roster-only
no local peek fields are produced.

requirement: Peek live model, agent, permission and plan badge projection
contract: peek_model_and_mode SHALL source the current config badge live. TopLevel uses the agent name/model/effective permission mode/plan mode; Subagent prefers the loaded child model/name and permission mode, falls back to resolved subagent metadata or parent model/name, and never projects child plan mode; unknown or roster rows use Ask with no model/plan and no agent.
scenarios: Top-level badge
a top-level AgentView exists
the badge reflects its live model, agent name, permission mode and effective plan mode.
Loaded child badge
a subagent child view is loaded
child model/name and child permission mode win over parent values.
Unloaded child badge
only subagent session metadata exists
permission mode maps known always-approve/auto/ask strings and model/name fall back to parent.
Missing/roster badge
the row has no local agent
default Ask/no model/no plan badge is returned.

requirement: Peek box geometry and focus-aware rounded rendering
contract: render_peek_panel SHALL render a single rounded box only when the area is nonzero, at least three rows high and twenty columns wide. Focused panels use selection border/caret and preserve bright content; unfocused panels use prompt border, hide caret, retain draft text, show an empty reply placeholder, and blend the content. The result SHALL report caret and reply_rect when applicable.
scenarios: Too-small area
the target area is empty, shorter than three rows, or narrower than twenty columns
the buffer is left without a usable panel and PeekRenderResult is default.
Focused summary
a normal panel is focused
rounded chrome, status/time header, reply prefix/input, and a caret are painted.
Unfocused summary
the panel is unfocused
draft remains visible, empty reply shows the dim placeholder, caret is None, and content is dimmed when color blending supports it.

requirement: Peek config badge precedence and bottom-border placement
contract: paint_peek_config_badge SHALL reuse PromptWidget::render_info_line on the bottom border inside rounded corners. It SHALL omit itself when too small or when no model/flag/multiline signal exists, and flag precedence SHALL be plan over always-approve over auto. The badge SHALL follow panel focus dimming and appear in both summary and pending-question modes.
scenarios: Plan precedence
plan_mode is true while always-approve or auto is also true
only the plan flag is shown.
Permission precedence
plan is false and auto_approve is true while auto is true
always-approve is shown and auto is suppressed.
Auto mode
plan and always-approve are false but auto is true
the auto flag uses the system accent.
No badge
the area is too small or model/flags are empty and not multiline
no info line is painted.

requirement: Peek pending question and permission option rendering
contract: When question is present, render_peek_panel SHALL replace the normal status/body/reply layout with sanitized question text and up to nine numbered options. Focused selected options use the marker/style; unfocused panels show no selected marker. A selected RejectOnce/Other row SHALL render an inline PromptWidget feedback slot with the permission or Ask-specific placeholder, caret and reply_rect, and hide the normal reply row.
scenarios: Permission options
a permission question has numbered options
question text and option labels are painted and the normal reply row is hidden.
Selected option
the focused panel selects an option
that option has the ▸ marker and accent style.
Unfocused question
the selected index exists but the panel is unfocused
all options render unselected and content is dimmed.
Reject feedback
RejectOnce is selected with typed or empty feedback
the inline field shows typed text or the reject hint and returns its caret/rect.
Ask Other
an AskUserQuestion Other row is selected
the inline placeholder says Other (type your own answer), not the permission reject text.

requirement: Peek live-tail middle layout and tight-height preservation
contract: live_tail_middle_bottom SHALL reserve one blank row above reply only when at least two middle rows remain; with only one possible row it SHALL expand through the blank so a live-tail pin/body is not starved. render_peek_panel SHALL paint either the current live tail, an empty hint, or a provided hint within the computed middle area while reply rows grow from the bottom.
scenarios: Tight middle
reply growth would leave only one middle row after a blank
the blank is consumed so both pin and current-turn body remain visible.
Generous middle
at least two middle rows remain with a blank
the bottom excludes one breathing row above reply.
Empty live tail
live tail is provided but scrollback is empty
the configured empty hint or No activity yet is painted when space exists.

requirement: Peek reply height, multiline placement and paste overlay
contract: reply_row_count SHALL delegate to PromptWidget::desired_height with a chromeless style, return at least one row, and cap at MAX_REPLY_ROWS=6. render_peek_panel SHALL grow the reply box upward, report a rect spanning all reply rows, and route overlay_area to PromptWidget so folded paste chips and near-cursor raw previews render consistently with the dispatch prompt.
scenarios: Empty reply
the widget has no text
reply_row_count returns one row.
Multiline draft
the draft contains three lines
the reply grows to at least three rows and every line is painted inside reply_rect.
Over-cap draft
the draft exceeds six rows
reply_row_count saturates at six and the widget scrolls internally.
Paste overlay
a compact multiline paste has an overlay rect
the chip remains visible and preview text is painted above the peek box.

requirement: Peek response status extraction and sanitized recent text projection
contract: extract_last_response_type SHALL use live TurnActivity while running, returning Thinking/Response/Compacting/Retrying/Working or a current tool label, and SHALL scan newest-first scrollback when idle, stopping at the latest user prompt and mapping block kinds to stable labels. extract_last_user_message SHALL delegate to sanitized latest prompt extraction; extract_first_user_message and extract_recent_lines SHALL take first lines, strip ANSI, sanitize control characters, trim, and avoid Rust Debug projections.
scenarios: Running activity
the session is running with a live activity
the live activity is the status source; waiting/no activity returns Working and tool-running can recover a specific current tool label.
Idle scrollback
the session is idle
the newest agent-produced block maps to Response/Thought/tool/subagent/workflow/task/etc. and user prompt forms a turn boundary.
Recent text
recent blocks include ANSI/control text or long bodies
only first-line sanitized projections are returned in chronological order, with no Debug metadata or terminal escapes.

requirement: Peek numeric action routing with stale permission identity
contract: peek_number_key SHALL map valid 1-based keys only when a peek question and option exist. Ask questions emit DashboardQuestionAnswer with row/tool_call_id and either an option index or current reply text for Other; permissions emit DashboardPermissionSelect with row, captured request_id and option id. Zero, out-of-range, missing panel/question, or missing identity SHALL return None.
scenarios: Permission option
n is one through options length and request_id exists
DashboardPermissionSelect carries the snapshot request id and selected PermissionOptionId.
Ask option
the panel is an AskUserQuestion and a normal option is keyed
DashboardQuestionAnswer carries option_idx and empty freeform.
Ask Other
the key targets reject_option
DashboardQuestionAnswer carries option_idx=None and text_without_image_chips from peek_reply.
Invalid key
n is zero/out of range or panel/question is absent
no action is produced.

requirement: Peek render and state regression evidence boundary
contract: The module SHALL preserve the 28 inline regression behaviors for panel geometry, focus, badges, question projection, option selection, feedback placeholders, paste chips, multiline reply sizing and numeric routing. These tests are synthetic Buffer/AgentView evidence for this module; they do not prove a live dashboard event loop, terminal capability, ACP delivery, or PromptWidget implementation.
scenarios: Synthetic render
tests render into Ratatui Buffer with synthetic panel/reply state
rounded layout, text, colors, caret and rect invariants are asserted directly.
Subagent isolation
tests construct parent/child views with a pending child question
child peek suppresses the question while top-level projection retains its own root question.
Action guard
tests exercise zero/missing/out-of-range numeric keys
invalid dashboard actions are rejected without panics.

requirement: Pager ListMatcher matching and navigation contract
contract: ListMatcher SHALL retain raw query/mode/error state, rebuild physical match indices in item order, reset or clamp current_match when data changes, and wrap n/N navigation across matches. Filter mode hides nonmatches while Search mode preserves visibility for highlighting.
scenarios: Matching
substring, regex, or invalid regex is compiled and rebuilt against ListItem::search_text
matching physical indices and regex error state are exposed deterministically.
Navigation
next/previous match is requested from a physical index
current_match advances with wrap-around or returns None when no match exists.
Mode
the matcher is used by filter or search layout
filter mapping hides nonmatches while search retains all visible items.

requirement: Pager ListPane input-bar modes and goto parser contract
contract: ListPane input modes SHALL expose stable prompts and map Search/Filter to their corresponding match modes; goto-line parsing SHALL accept clamped single numbers and ranges, treat an incomplete N- as a single jump, reject invalid text, and enforce start <= end.
scenarios: Mode prompt
the input bar is rendered for Search, Filter, GotoLine, or Comment
the documented prefix is returned and match mode is selected.
Goto line
user text is empty, numeric, ranged, incomplete, reversed, or out of bounds
the parser returns Invalid, Single, or clamped Range according to the syntax.

requirement: Pager ListPane configuration and stable state boundary contract
contract: ListPaneState SHALL own scroll/selection/layout/matcher/input/clipboard state while borrowing items only during layout and actions; default config keeps follow/search/copy/visual/filter/goto disabled except wrap, while streaming enables follow/search/copy/visual/filter.
scenarios: Default config
a static list constructs default configuration
unsupported keys remain unconsumed and follow is forced off.
Streaming config
an append-only list uses streaming()
follow and interactive list features are enabled.

requirement: Pager ListPane scroll and layout geometry contract
contract: ListPaneState SHALL clamp scrolling to content and viewport, support fixed-height NoWrap and variable-height Wrap layout, expose visible ranges/skip rows, keep empty or fitting lists at offset zero, center selected items with clamping, and preserve stable positions across append and prepare cycles.
scenarios: Scroll bounds
scroll up/down, page, half-page, or empty/fitting content is processed
offset remains within [0, max] and no-op cases remain stable.
Layout geometry
fixed, wrapped, or variable-height items are prepared
total height and visible range reflect the selected wrap mode.
Centering
a selected item is centered near the viewport midpoint
scroll is adjusted and clamped at the top/bottom.

requirement: Pager stable selection and selectable-item contract
contract: Selection SHALL be stored by stable item ID, resolve to the current physical/visible index after mutations, auto-select the first selectable item in NAV, skip separators/non-selectable rows, clear or replace removed selections, and select via visible index or y hit only when selectable.
scenarios: Stable IDs
items are inserted, removed, or evicted around a selected row
the same stable id resolves at its new index or selection is replaced when removed.
Selectable navigation
j/k or click crosses non-selectable items
selection skips separators and select_at_y rejects non-selectable rows.
Filter selection
a visible mapping is active
selection APIs operate on visible indices while stable id resolves to physical item.
Selection range
a prompt is rendered across one or more lines
every output line carries selection range 0.
Prefix boundary
a visible prompt, bash prefix, or continuation indent exists
Selectable::Spans starts at the first body span and excludes the prefix/indent.
No prefix
show_prefix is false
the line uses Selectable::All.
Wrapped joiners
one logical line wraps or multiple logical lines are rendered
wrap joiners exist only between wrapped pieces of one logical line; hard breaks have no joiner.

requirement: Pager keyboard navigation and screen-y preservation contract
contract: ListPane keyboard handling SHALL consume j/k, arrows, Ctrl-j/k, Ctrl-d/u, PageUp/PageDown, g/G, Home/End, z, and enabled w according to pane state; viewport scrolling pins the selected item screen row and carries leftover movement past clamped viewport edges to the nearest selectable cursor.
scenarios: Navigation keys
a supported key is pressed
selection or viewport changes and the event is consumed; unknown keys return false.
Screen-y pin
viewport scroll occurs with a selection
selection follows the scroll at the same screen y when possible.
Clamped half-page
the viewport reaches top/bottom before the requested movement is exhausted
the remaining movement advances the cursor and skips non-selectable boundaries.

requirement: Pager layout dirty tracking and item eviction contract
contract: prepare_layout SHALL reuse a clean cache, extend heights incrementally on appends, rebuild on width/wrap/filter changes or shrink/eviction, refilter stale physical indices, and preserve stable selection through item mutations.
scenarios: Clean cache
layout parameters and item count remain unchanged
the existing cache remains valid.
Append/shrink
items are appended or evicted
height cache and visible count update without stale indices.
Width/filter mutation
width or matcher changes
layout is rebuilt and filtered mapping reflects current items.

requirement: Pager follow mode edge and append contract
contract: When enabled, follow mode SHALL hide selection and track the bottom; one-past j/Ctrl-d/PageDown or bottom wheel overscroll enters follow, upward/manual movement exits it, new items preserve edge state but can become selectable, and prepare_layout auto-scrolls follow to the new bottom.
scenarios: One-past
a downward action reaches the bottom and repeats
follow engages only on the subsequent edge action.
Follow lifecycle
follow is entered, scrolled upward, or toggled
selection visibility and follow state transition as specified.
Streaming append
new items arrive while following or at edge
follow scrolls to bottom or NAV moves into new items without spurious reset.

requirement: Pager follow/wrap capability gating contract
contract: Disabled follow SHALL ignore constructor follow, G/End one-past, overscroll, and toggle requests while selecting the last item normally; disabled wrap SHALL leave w unconsumed.
scenarios: Follow disabled
follow actions reach an edge or toggle is requested
follow remains false and NAV selection/scrolling remains available.
Wrap disabled
w is pressed with wrap_toggle_enabled false
the event is not consumed and wrap mode is unchanged.

requirement: Pager explicit follow toggle contract
contract: toggle_follow SHALL enter bottom-follow with no selection when NAV is active and exit to a valid selection when follow is active; follow-disabled configurations make it a no-op.
scenarios: Enter follow
NAV mode toggles follow
offset reaches bottom and selection clears.
Exit follow
follow mode toggles again
NAV resumes with a selection.

requirement: Pager clipboard copy and provider contract
contract: When copy is enabled, y/copy_selected SHALL copy the selected item or visual range through the injected ClipboardProvider and expose a copy toast window; no selection, follow mode, empty/filtered lists, or disabled copy SHALL be no-ops.
scenarios: Single copy
a selectable item is selected and copy is enabled
its content reaches the clipboard.
Provider injection
a custom provider is installed
copy writes to that provider.
No-op boundary
selection is absent, follow/empty/filtered, or copy is disabled
copy returns false and does not write.

requirement: Pager visual selection and range copy contract
contract: When visual selection is enabled, v/Shift-j/Shift-k SHALL enter and extend an inclusive stable-ID range, Esc clears it, search clears it, and y copies the range in item order before leaving visual mode; disabled visual selection leaves v unconsumed.
scenarios: Visual entry
v or Shift-j starts visual mode
an anchor is captured and movement extends the range.
Visual cancel
Esc or search is invoked
visual mode and resolved range clear.
Visual copy
y is pressed with a range
newline-joined selected content is copied and visual mode exits.

requirement: Pager stale-input robustness and comment paste contract
contract: Selection navigation SHALL not panic when the item slice is empty while layout metadata is stale, small viewports SHALL keep the selected item visible through repeated prepare cycles, and list input paste SHALL target only the active input bar, normalize CRLF for search, preserve comment newlines, and reject paste when closed.
scenarios: Stale empty items
selection navigation receives an empty slice after a prior layout
no panic occurs.
Small viewport
render preparation occurs between repeated selection/scroll steps
selection remains visible and scroll advances.
Input paste
search/comment input is active, closed, or receives CRLF
only the active bar changes, normalization follows mode, and closed bars reject paste.

requirement: Pager scrollback turn index and stable turn navigation
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL rebuild turns from UserPrompt boundaries, close completed turns at the next prompt, mark the final turn Running, and derive current_turn from the selected entry or the final turn. It SHALL expose turn lookup/iteration, jump to a turn index, and jump to a prompt EntryId without allowing shifted indices or non-prompt ids to select the wrong block. next_turn SHALL activate the next prompt or re-activate the last prompt; prev_turn SHALL first return from a response to its prompt, then move to the prior prompt or selectable pre-turn content.
scenarios: Turn rebuild
entries contain multiple user prompts and a final open turn
turn ranges cover each prompt-to-next-prompt span, prior turns are Completed, and the final turn is Running.
Stable jump
a captured prompt EntryId still exists after index shifts
jump_to_entry resolves its current index and activates only that turn prompt; missing/non-prompt ids return false.
Forward boundary
next_turn is already on the final turn
the final prompt is reactivated and scrolled rather than failing.
Backward boundary
prev_turn is inside a response or at the first prompt with pre-turn entries
it first selects the current prompt, then selects the previous prompt or first selectable pre-turn entry.
Successful turn jump
JumpPickerSelect receives an existing prompt EntryId
the corresponding prompt is selected, its turn becomes current, the picker closes, and follow mode is off.
Index shift
an earlier entry is removed after picker creation but the target EntryId remains
the target is found at its new index and selected rather than using the stale original position.

requirement: Pager scrollback response-anchor navigation
contract: prev_response and next_response SHALL navigate among the first nonempty AgentMessage of each trailing agent-message run in a turn, skipping structural/session blocks and skipping turns whose trailing work ends in a tool/thinking/subagent/background block. Navigation SHALL require a usable layout and viewport, confine candidates to the visible turn in SingleTurn mode, compare exact sticky-header-adjusted offsets strictly above/below the current scroll, select the anchor, disable follow, and bump generation.
scenarios: Trailing response run
a turn ends with multiple AgentMessage blocks after notices
the first message of that trailing run is the response anchor.
Tool-ended turn
the final turn entry is a tool call with no trailing response
neither response direction finds an anchor.
Exact anchor boundary
the viewport is exactly at an anchor top
K walks to the previous anchor and J walks to the next; the current anchor is not returned again.
No layout
viewport height/width or layout cache is unusable
response navigation returns false without changing selection.

requirement: Pager scrollback manual scrolling and viewport-edge selection
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL support saturating row scroll, half-page movement, top/bottom jumps, full-page movement that subtracts the currently rendered sticky header and keeps a two-row overlap, and viewport-edge selection that picks the first/last selectable visible entry while skipping hidden or nonselectable blocks. goto_top SHALL exit follow and select the first visible selectable; goto_bottom SHALL pin to max offset, enter follow, clear preserve pin, and select the last visible selectable.
scenarios: Manual scroll
scroll_up or scroll_down is called with rows
offsets saturate at zero/max and manual upward movement exits follow.
Page movement
page_up/page_down runs with sticky headers or disabled sticky headers
the delta is content viewport minus header minus two overlap rows, or viewport minus two when no header is rendered, with a minimum of one.
Edge selection
a page lands on a viewport edge containing structural/hidden rows
selection walks inward to the nearest selectable entry covering that visual edge.
Top/bottom gesture
goto_top or goto_bottom is invoked
top selects the first visible item and unfollows; bottom selects the last item, clears preserve pin, and follows the tail.

requirement: Pager scrollback follow mode, overscroll and turn-start policy
contract: Follow mode SHALL represent tail tracking with explicit follow_mode and optional follow_preserve_scroll. A positive scroll_down already clamped at bottom SHALL enter follow on the first fully clamped gesture only when follow_by_overscroll is enabled; a gesture that lands at bottom after moving rows SHALL remain manual until the next clamped gesture. follow_new_turn SHALL page-flip a prompt to the top and arm preserve, preserve existing position for non-page-flip prompts, and arm follow-with-preserve for synthetic/no-prompt turns.
scenarios: Clamped overscroll
the viewport is already at max and a positive scroll-down moves zero rows
follow engages immediately when configured; rows=0 and disabled config do not engage.
Landing at bottom
scroll-down moves real rows and lands at max
follow remains off until a later zero-movement scroll gesture.
Page-flip prompt
a new turn has a prompt and page_flip is true
the prompt is selected/top-pinned, follow is enabled, and preserve remains armed.
No page-flip prompt
a prompt exists but page_flip is false
scroll/follow state is retained while the prompt is selected.
Synthetic turn
no prompt index is available
follow-with-preserve is armed regardless of page_flip.

requirement: Pager scrollback follow toggles and automatic selection
contract: Toggle and follow helpers SHALL provide distinct entry points: toggle_follow flips follow and sends an entering transition to the bottom; enable_follow_mode follows and clears preserve; enable_follow enables follow without moving; enable_follow_with_preserve delays bottom pin for one frame. handle_follow_mode SHALL re-pin to bottom and select the last selectable item only when nothing is selected or follow_auto_select says the current selection is already the tail.
scenarios: Enter follow
toggle_follow is called while manual
the viewport moves to bottom and follow becomes active.
Preserve enable
enable_follow_with_preserve follows after a prompt was positioned
the first follow frame retains the current position until overflow.
Auto-select guard
follow mode is active with a middle selection
new content moves the viewport but does not clobber a deliberate middle selection unless follow_auto_select and tail selection conditions hold.
No-op manual mode
handle_follow_mode runs with follow disabled
the viewport and selection are unchanged.

requirement: Pager scrollback follow preserve re-clamping after content shrink
contract: follow_scroll_to_bottom SHALL handle both normal tail following and page-flip preserve pins. Preserve SHALL remain while new content fits below the pinned prompt, switch to normal bottom-follow once max_offset exceeds the pin, and consume/re-clamp a stale pin when content shrinks so scroll_offset is not stranded beyond total content. Normal follow SHALL always re-clamp to max_scroll_offset, including when content becomes shorter than the viewport.
scenarios: Preserved prompt
new rows still fit below a page-flip prompt
the pinned scroll offset remains unchanged and preserve stays armed.
Overflow after pin
content grows beyond the preserved offset
preserve is consumed and scroll moves to the measured bottom.
Pinned target removed
a tall entry above the pinned prompt shrinks/demotes and scroll_offset exceeds total_height
the stale preserve flag is consumed and the viewport re-pins to max offset.
Plain shrink
normal follow content shrinks below viewport
scroll_offset clamps to zero rather than freezing beyond the end.

requirement: Pager scrollback selected-entry visibility with sticky headers and margins
contract: ensure_selected_visible SHALL keep a selected entry visible in the current visible range using exact layout measurements only when the entry is offscreen. It SHALL account for sticky header height, configured top/bottom margins except at scroll edges, large-entry top anchoring, entry-fit bottom alignment, sticky-header re-evaluation at target, minimum scroll fractions/lines, and follow exit when manual visibility scrolling occurs.
scenarios: Fully visible selection
the selected entry fits inside content bounds including margins
no scroll occurs.
Clipped top
the selected entry starts above the effective content top
scroll moves it to the content top plus margin through sticky-aware fixed-point calculation.
Clipped bottom
the entry fits but its bottom is below the effective bottom
scroll moves just enough to show the bottom unless a sticky header would hide its top, then top-aligns.
Large entry
the entry exceeds available content height
the entry top is shown rather than attempting impossible full visibility.
Minimum movement
a fitting entry needs a small non-edge scroll
the configured minimum scroll distance is applied unless it would hit an edge.

requirement: Pager scrollback exact entry top and center positioning
contract: scroll_to_entry_top SHALL always position a valid entry at the viewport content top below sticky headers; scroll_to_entry_center SHALL measure the target exactly, account for sticky header height, center its entry around the viewport, disable follow, and bump generation. Invalid dimensions, empty state, or out-of-range entries SHALL no-op.
scenarios: Top navigation
a valid next-turn prompt is selected
the entry is placed at the sticky-adjusted content top and follow is disabled.
Center reveal
a valid entry is requested for centered viewing
the entry is measured exactly and the viewport centers it after sticky-header convergence.
Invalid target
the index is out of bounds or layout dimensions are unavailable
no scroll or generation change occurs.

requirement: Pager scrollback search reveal expands and unhides target entries
contract: reveal_entry_line SHALL select a valid entry, build a cache before hidden-group checks on cache miss, unhide a truncated group, expand foldable entries to Expanded, optionally pin the forced expansion when respect_manual_folds is enabled, rekey verb-group expansion ownership, and rebuild layout exactly when display state/cache/heights require it. Out-of-range entries SHALL be a no-op.
scenarios: Collapsed target
a search match is inside a collapsed fold
the entry expands, optionally becomes pinned, layout rebuilds once, and selection follows it.
Truncated target
a match is hidden by group truncation
the containing group is added to expanded_groups and the target becomes visible.
Adjacent verb fold
a dense truncated run abuts a separately claimed verb group
only the dense run is unhidden; the adjacent verb fold remains intact.
Cache miss
layout cache is absent before reveal
the cache is rebuilt before hidden detection so unhide is not skipped.
Invalid target
entry_idx is outside entries
selection, scroll, generation and layout remain unchanged.

requirement: Pager scrollback reveal logical lines through wrapped and nonselectable rows
contract: reveal_entry_line SHALL map the search index logical line through the rendered entry output, not treat each logical newline as one screen row. rendered_row_offset_within_entry SHALL use EntryRenderer::rendered_row_of_logical_line with current width/theme/appearance/cwd, skip nonselectable thinking headers and blank rows, include prior wrapped rows, clamp the nudge to the cached entry height, and clamp final scroll to max offset.
scenarios: Wrapped preceding line
a later logical line follows a line that wraps over many rows
revealing the later line scrolls past all preceding wrapped rows.
Thinking header
a Thinking entry renders a nonselectable header/blank prefix
logical line zero maps after those rows, not to the header.
Past-end line
line_in_entry exceeds the entry height
the scroll nudge clamps to the last rendered row and repeated huge indices agree.
Visible target
the entry is already visible with clean cache heights
reveal changes selection/scroll as needed without rebuilding the whole layout.

requirement: Pager scrollback navigation regression evidence and verification boundary
contract: The module SHALL preserve the 39 inline regression behaviors for turn/response anchors, streaming responses, page and half-page movement, overscroll follow, page-flip preserve, shrink re-clamping, fold/group reveal, wrapped-line mapping, sticky-header page deltas, and viewport-edge selection. These tests are static source evidence and do not prove live terminal event integration or runtime layout backends.
scenarios: Streaming response
an empty streaming placeholder later receives content
response navigation sees the completed/trailing message without rebuilding turn boundaries.
Page selection
a page movement crosses mixed-height entries
selection follows the visual top/bottom edge and subsequent select_next continues from that new selection.
Reveal performance
a target is already visible or requires expansion/dirty-height recovery
layout rebuild count matches the cheap path or exactly one required rebuild.
Sticky header gate
sticky headers are enabled/disabled around a tall prompt
page delta subtracts only a header that the renderer actually paints.

requirement: Mermaid worker queue coalescing and autonomous completion
contract: The Mermaid worker SHALL run independently from the UI thread, coalesce queued jobs by MermaidCacheKey while retaining the newest job for each key, render distinct keys in FIFO order, send a coarse Ready or Failed result, wake the async view after each result, and terminate cleanly when its input channel closes.
scenarios: Coalescing
multiple jobs for one cache key are queued before the worker drains them
only the newest job for that key is rendered and the queue retains one entry per distinct key.
Autonomous work
a job is sent to the worker
a result arrives without a second UI event and Ready reports the persisted output path.
Channel shutdown
the job sender is dropped
the worker exits without publishing work after the receiver is gone.

requirement: Mermaid cache hit validation and atomic PNG persistence
contract: A Mermaid cache entry SHALL count as a hit only when its path is a non-symlink file containing decodable image data; fresh PNG bytes SHALL be written through a sibling temporary file and renamed atomically, and any parent creation, write, or rename failure SHALL yield no usable artifact.
scenarios: Cache validation
the target is missing, corrupt, or a symlink
the worker treats it as a miss and is allowed to render without following the link.
Cache hit
the target is a decodable regular PNG
render_job returns Ready without invoking the render function and reports no fresh write.
Atomic persistence
a render produces PNG bytes and its parent is writable
the parent is created, a temporary file is written, and the final path is atomically replaced.
Write failure
the output parent cannot be created or the write/rename fails
the operation returns Failed and no output path is presented as ready.

requirement: Mermaid source-size and render-outcome gating
contract: render_job SHALL reject a source larger than RenderLimits::max_source_bytes before invoking a renderer, map renderer errors to Failed without writing a PNG, and return Ready plus wrote=true only for a successful fresh artifact.
scenarios: Oversized source
the Mermaid source exceeds the configured byte limit
the renderer is not called, the outcome is Failed, and no PNG is written.
Renderer failure
the render step times out, exits, or reports an error
the outcome is Failed and wrote is false.
Successful render
the render step writes a valid artifact
the outcome is Ready with its output path and wrote is true.

requirement: Session Mermaid cache sweep and disk cap
contract: sweep_session_cache SHALL be safe on a missing directory, remove orphaned `*.png.tmp` and truncated/corrupt PNG entries, ignore non-PNG files, preserve valid PNGs while total size is within the configured cap, and evict oldest PNGs until the cap is met when it is exceeded.
scenarios: Missing cache
the session directory does not exist
the sweep is a no-op and does not create it.
Cleanup
temporary or truncated PNG artifacts are present
those artifacts are removed while unrelated non-PNG files remain.
Capacity
PNG bytes exceed max_bytes
oldest entries are deleted until total PNG bytes are at or below the cap.
Under cap
PNG bytes are within max_bytes
all existing PNG entries are retained.

requirement: Responsive Mermaid render sizing and quality parameters
contract: The render target SHALL derive representative content columns from terminal width after subtracting chrome and timestamp space with a minimum floor, convert columns to oversampled pixels, clamp terminal widths to the configured range, and select bounded terminal or open-viewer RenderParams including theme and surface background.
scenarios: Representative width
a terminal viewport is narrow or wide
content columns never underflow the floor and reserve the fixed chrome/timestamp columns.
Pixel target
content columns are converted to a render width
cell width and oversampling are applied and the result is clamped to MIN_TARGET_WIDTH_PX..MAX_TARGET_WIDTH_PX.
Quality tier
terminal or open rendering is requested
terminal uses the target width and bounded height while open uses the open viewer width/height limits and the selected theme.

requirement: Theme and quality separation in Mermaid cache keys
contract: Mermaid render jobs SHALL carry source, theme, width, quality, and output key information such that different themes or quality/width variants resolve to distinct cache artifacts; an open-viewer request SHALL use the open quality tier.
scenarios: Theme separation
the same source is rendered under dark and light themes
the derived cache filenames and persisted PNG paths differ.
Quality selection
an affordance requests Open output
the render target derives an Open-quality key and uses the open viewer bounds.
Stable key
source, theme, width and quality are unchanged
derive returns equal keys and identical filenames.
Source/theme separation
source or theme changes
the derived key and filename differ.
Width bucketing
terminal widths remain within one eight-column bucket or cross its boundary
the first case reuses a key and the second produces a different key.
Quality separation
quality changes between Terminal and Open
the keys and filenames differ; Open width changes do not affect the key.
Hash collection
a key is inserted into a HashSet
the same key is found and a theme-variant key is absent.
Theme darkness
ThemeKind is GrowDay or another concrete theme
GrowDay is light and every other supported kind is dark.

requirement: Mermaid child command argument contract
contract: The hidden Mermaid render child SHALL require `--out`, accept only light/dark themes, terminal/open quality aliases, decimal `--width`, and optional `--deadline-ms`, apply documented defaults, reject unknown/missing/malformed/non-UTF-8 arguments, and never silently coerce invalid values.
scenarios: Valid invocation
well-formed output, theme, quality, width, and deadline flags are supplied
RenderArgs contains the exact parsed path, booleans, enum, width, and duration.
Defaults
width, quality, or deadline is omitted
width defaults to zero, quality to terminal, and deadline to RENDER_TIMEOUT.
Malformed argv
a required value is missing, a value is non-numeric/unknown, or a flag is unknown/non-UTF-8
parsing returns an error without spawning a child or touching stdin.

requirement: Mermaid child stdin limit and render-to-file core
contract: The hidden child SHALL read UTF-8 Mermaid source through a bounded stdin buffer, reject input beyond RenderLimits::max_source_bytes or invalid UTF-8, render with the selected parameters, and write a decodable PNG; empty/unrenderable source SHALL fail without leaving a PNG.
scenarios: Child rendering
bounded valid UTF-8 source is received by render_child
the shared render core produces a decodable PNG at the requested output path.
Input rejection
stdin exceeds the source cap or is invalid UTF-8
the child returns an error and does not render an unbounded payload.
Empty source
stdin is empty or the source cannot be rendered
render_and_write returns an error and no PNG is created.
Engine path
a cyclic flowchart is rendered
the core returns nonzero dimensions and decodable PNG bytes without panic.

requirement: Mermaid subprocess dispatch and outcome mapping
contract: Production Mermaid rendering SHALL re-exec the current executable through the exact `__mermaid-render` argv[1] gate, pass source through stdin with output/theme/quality/width/deadline flags, suppress child terminal streams, enforce a wall-clock timeout, and map spawn, wait, timeout, missing output, ordinary child failure, signal crash, and watchdog exit into stable failure categories.
scenarios: Dispatch gate
the hidden subcommand appears at argv[1]
the process is routed to render_child; the same token elsewhere does not trigger child mode.
Successful child
a child drains stdin and writes a decodable PNG before the deadline
run_render_command returns success.
Missing output
the child exits zero but writes no decodable PNG
the outcome is `no_output`.
Failure mapping
spawn, wait, timeout, nonzero, signal, or watchdog conditions occur
each condition maps to its documented category without falsely reporting Ready.

requirement: Mermaid child containment watchdog and process backstops
contract: The child process SHALL install containment backstops before rendering: its watchdog deadline SHALL trail the forwarded parent budget by CHILD_WATCHDOG_SLACK, watchdog exit SHALL use CHILD_WATCHDOG_EXIT_CODE, Linux SHALL cap child address space and request parent-death termination, and parent timeout/containment events SHALL remain distinguishable in the result mapping.
scenarios: Watchdog budget
a parent deadline is forwarded to the child
the self-watchdog is strictly later than the parent budget by the fixed slack.
Containment
the child starts on a supported platform
address-space and parent-death protections are installed before engine work where available.
Classification
the child is signal-killed, watchdog-exits, or exits with ordinary render error
the parent maps these to child_crashed, child_watchdog, or child_error respectively.

requirement: AgentView lazy Mermaid request and cache-miss lifecycle
contract: AgentView SHALL derive a render target from the live theme, representative width, source, and Open quality; on a cache miss it SHALL lazily create the runtime, dispatch one MermaidJob, record the requested action, trigger the per-session sweep, and expose a transient Rendering state, while a disk hit SHALL execute the action immediately without starting a worker.
scenarios: Cache miss
an Open or CopyPath request has a session/cwd-backed output path but no valid cache
a job is queued with the click-time key, pending action is recorded, and live motion plus a Rendering toast are observable.
Cache hit
the live target is a valid PNG
the requested action executes immediately, no pending state remains, and no worker runtime is created.
Unavailable session
no session/cwd-backed cache path can be derived
the request reports not-ready/toast and does not claim a render completion.
Cache maintenance
the runtime is first used
the session sweep is scheduled once, preferring spawn_blocking under Tokio and inline otherwise.
Mermaid hit lookup
a Mermaid hit points to a valid source index
the exact source is moved to the action dispatcher.
Stale source index
a Mermaid hit index is absent from the source table
an empty source is supplied to the action dispatcher and the click remains consumed.
Action mapping
the hit kind is Open or CopyPath
the matching MermaidClickAction is used and no direct file operation occurs in this module.
Liveness query
paint requests the rendering state for a source
the result comes from mermaid_is_rendering and is used only for the affordance hint.

requirement: AgentView pending action deduplication and completion reduction
contract: AgentView SHALL deduplicate an identical key/action while allowing a different action for the same key, retain all actions awaiting one result, execute every retained action when a Ready result arrives, remove them when polling, and convert Failed results into a user-facing render error while reporting whether state changed.
scenarios: Deduplication
the same key/action is requested while pending
the request does not enqueue a second action or double-fire after completion.
Multiple actions
Open and CopyPath await the same key
polling removes both and executes them in insertion order.
Ready result
the worker reports a usable path
the selected action opens or copies the path and the pending state settles.
Failed result
the worker reports Failed
all actions for that key are removed and a Could not render diagram toast is shown.

requirement: Mermaid runtime reset and late-result isolation
contract: Beginning a replay/session reset SHALL drop the MermaidRuntime, its receiver, and pending actions so completions from the old session cannot execute actions or mutate the new view; live motion SHALL be true exactly while pending actions remain.
scenarios: Reset
a replay window begins while a render is pending
the runtime is removed and a later old-session send has no live receiver/action.
Liveness
pending actions exist or have all been consumed
mermaid_has_live_motion returns true before settlement and false after completion.
Wake/reduce
the worker publishes a result
apply_mermaid_completions polls the reducer and returns whether visible state changed.

requirement: Source-hash rendering indicator across live layout changes
contract: The transient Mermaid rendering indicator SHALL match pending work by source_hash rather than the full theme/width cache key, so changing theme or width during an in-flight render preserves the indicator for the same source and never marks another source as rendering.
scenarios: Theme/width change
the pending key was derived under one theme/width and the live view derives another
the same source remains marked rendering because source_hash is stable across cache variants.
Different source
a source hash has no pending action
the rendering indicator is false.

requirement: ListPaneState SHALL own scroll/selection/layout/matcher/input/clipboard state while borrowing items only during layout and actions; constructors SHALL apply the requested wrap/follow state subject to configuration, and public accessors SHALL expose stable-ID selection, visible-to-physical mapping, layout metrics, input state, and rendering flags.
contract: new and new_with_config SHALL initialize an empty, dirty layout and in-memory input/clipboard state; follow SHALL be enabled only when requested and allowed by config. Accessors SHALL report cached geometry and stable selection without retaining item slices; select_by_id SHALL defer index resolution until prepare_layout, and to_physical SHALL use the current filter map when present.
scenarios: Construction
a pane is created with wrap/follow flags and a config
state starts empty, layout dirty, and follow is gated by follow_enabled.
Stable selection
a caller sets a stable id before layout
the id is retained and its visible index is resolved on the next prepare_layout.
Filtered projection
a filter map exists
visible indices map through the stored physical index map while unfiltered indices remain identity.
State access
a renderer queries metrics or flags
cached layout, selection, input, scrollbar, search, and highlight-related state are returned without borrowing items.

requirement: ListPane input-bar state SHALL expose mode-dependent bottom-bar sizing, textarea text/cursor rendering, comment multiline capacity, hardware cursor coordinates, and expiring copy-toast state.
contract: bottom_bar_height SHALL reserve one row for search/filter/goto/status and one to five rows for comment input only when the area can retain the list. render_input_textarea SHALL render the textarea, reverse the visible cursor cell, and record its screen position; cursor_position SHALL be unavailable outside an active bar, and maintain SHALL clear an expired toast and report whether redraw is needed.
scenarios: Bar sizing
a comment contains multiple newlines or another matcher is active
the bar height is clamped to one through five rows for comments or one row for other modes, and is zero when it cannot fit.
Cursor rendering
an active textarea is rendered into a nonzero area
the cursor cell is visibly marked and its screen coordinate is available.
Closed cursor
the input bar is closed
cursor_position returns None.
Toast expiry
maintain is called at or after the copy deadline
the toast is cleared and maintain returns true; before expiry it returns false.

requirement: prepare_layout SHALL reuse a clean cache, extend heights incrementally on appends, rebuild on width/wrap/filter changes or shrink/eviction, refilter stale physical indices, and preserve stable selection through item mutations.
contract: prepare_layout SHALL reserve the bottom-bar row, cache per-physical-item desired heights, account for scrollbar width in wrap mode, use incremental append updates when safe, and rebuild for width/mode/filter/eviction changes. It SHALL resolve stable IDs and visual ranges after filtering, clear removed selections, auto-select the first selectable NAV item, maintain follow at the tail, apply scroll anchors, and clamp offsets.
scenarios: Clean cache
layout parameters and item count remain unchanged
the existing cache remains valid while selection and offset are still resolved/clamped.
Append/shrink
items are appended or evicted
height cache and visible count update without stale indices, and a selected stable id is retained or cleared if removed.
Width/filter mutation
width, wrap mode, or matcher changes
layout is rebuilt at the effective width and filtered mapping reflects current items.
Scrollbar width
wrapped content first fits and then overflows
the layout is recomputed at width minus scrollbar columns so wrapped rows are not truncated.

requirement: ListPaneState SHALL clamp scrolling to content and viewport, support fixed-height NoWrap and variable-height Wrap layout, expose visible ranges/skip rows, keep empty or fitting lists at offset zero, center selected items with clamping, and preserve stable positions across append and prepare cycles.
contract: Raw and public scrolling SHALL saturate at valid content bounds; page and half-page movement SHALL use visual lines, visible_range SHALL return item indices overlapping the viewport, first_item_skip_rows SHALL report partial top-row clipping, center_selected SHALL center item midpoints subject to clamping, and scrollbar-oriented proportional movement SHALL select the nearest selectable viewport item.
scenarios: Scroll bounds
scroll up/down, page, half-page, or empty/fitting content is processed
offset remains within [0,max] and no-op cases remain stable.
Layout geometry
fixed, wrapped, or variable-height items are prepared
total height and visible range reflect the selected wrap mode.
Centering
a selected item is centered near the viewport midpoint
scroll is adjusted and clamped at the top/bottom.
Proportional scroll
a scrollbar interaction requests a line delta or percentage
the viewport moves proportionally and the nearest selectable center item is selected.

requirement: Selection SHALL be stored by stable item ID, resolve to the current physical/visible index after mutations, auto-select the first selectable item in NAV, skip separators/non-selectable rows, clear or replace removed selections, and select via visible index or y hit only when selectable.
contract: Selection movement and hit testing SHALL traverse visible indices through the filter map, reject out-of-range or non-selectable rows, update both stable ID and visible index, and keep the selected item within the viewport margin. Clearing selection SHALL also clear visual-range state.
scenarios: Stable IDs
items are inserted, removed, or evicted around a selected row
the same stable id resolves at its new index or selection is replaced when removed.
Selectable navigation
j/k or click crosses non-selectable items
selection skips separators and select_at/select_at_y rejects non-selectable rows.
Filter selection
a visible mapping is active
selection APIs operate on visible indices while stable id resolves to physical item.
Visibility margin
selection moves above or below the viewport
scroll adjusts with an adaptive margin and remains clamped.

requirement: ListPane keyboard handling SHALL consume j/k, arrows, Ctrl-j/k, Ctrl-d/u, PageUp/PageDown, g/G, Home/End, z, and enabled w according to pane state; viewport scrolling pins the selected item screen row and carries leftover movement past clamped viewport edges to the nearest selectable cursor.
contract: handle_key_event SHALL route normal and active-input-bar navigation, consume only supported keys, and leave unknown or disabled-wrap keys unconsumed. Ctrl-j/k, half-page, full-page, and wheel scrolling SHALL preserve the selected screen row when movement is possible and apply leftover movement at clamped edges while skipping non-selectable rows.
scenarios: Navigation keys
a supported key is pressed
selection or viewport changes and the event is consumed; unknown keys return false.
Screen-y pin
viewport scroll occurs with a selection
selection follows the scroll at the same screen y when possible.
Clamped half-page
the viewport reaches top/bottom before requested movement is exhausted
remaining movement advances the cursor and skips non-selectable boundaries.
Input-bar navigation
navigation is pressed while an editor is open
navigation remains available while typing and submit/cancel routing stays mode-specific.

requirement: When enabled, follow mode SHALL hide selection and track the bottom; one-past j/Ctrl-d/PageDown or bottom wheel overscroll enters follow, upward/manual movement exits it, new items preserve edge state but can become selectable, and prepare_layout auto-scrolls follow to the new bottom.
contract: Follow transitions SHALL clear/materialize selection as appropriate, distinguish first edge contact from the subsequent one-past action, use a bounded overscroll threshold for mouse wheel input, and re-pin the viewport on every follow layout while leaving NAV selection available after exit.
scenarios: One-past
a downward action reaches the bottom and repeats
follow engages only on the subsequent edge action.
Follow lifecycle
follow is entered, scrolled upward, or toggled
selection visibility and follow state transition as specified.
Streaming append
new items arrive while following or at edge
follow scrolls to bottom or NAV moves into new items without spurious reset.
Follow disable
the data source stops streaming
disable_follow_permanently clears follow and prevents later edge actions from re-entering it.

requirement: Disabled follow SHALL ignore constructor follow, G/End one-past, overscroll, and toggle requests while selecting the last item normally; disabled wrap SHALL leave w unconsumed.
contract: follow_enabled SHALL gate constructor, explicit toggle, edge engagement, and overscroll behavior; with follow disabled, last-item navigation remains ordinary NAV selection. wrap_toggle_enabled SHALL gate w handling without changing the current wrap mode.
scenarios: Follow disabled
follow actions reach an edge or toggle is requested
follow remains false and NAV selection/scrolling remains available.
Wrap disabled
w is pressed with wrap_toggle_enabled false
the event is not consumed and wrap mode is unchanged.
Wrap enabled
w is pressed with the feature enabled
cycle_wrap_mode records an anchor and changes between NoWrap and Wrap.

requirement: toggle_follow SHALL enter bottom-follow with no selection when NAV is active and exit to a valid selection when follow is active; follow-disabled configurations make it a no-op.
contract: toggle_follow SHALL consult follow_enabled, call engage_follow from NAV, and call exit_follow from FOLLOW so the viewport remains at the tail and a last visible selectable item is materialized on exit.
scenarios: Enter follow
NAV mode toggles follow
offset reaches bottom and selection clears.
Exit follow
follow mode toggles again
NAV resumes with a visible selection when one exists.
Disabled toggle
follow is disabled
state is unchanged.

requirement: ListPane input modes SHALL expose stable prompts and map Search/Filter to their corresponding match modes; goto-line parsing SHALL accept clamped single numbers and ranges, treat an incomplete N- as a single jump, reject invalid text, and enforce start <= end.
contract: Search, Filter, GotoLine, and Comment SHALL have distinct lifecycle rules. Search/Filter SHALL rebuild a regex matcher from the textarea and Search SHALL jump to the nearest match; accepted matchers persist after the bar closes, cancellation clears them, and goto-line SHALL preview, accept, or restore a snapshot using stable IDs and optional source line numbers.
scenarios: Mode lifecycle
search/filter/goto/comment is opened, accepted, cancelled, or closed
the mode-specific matcher, snapshot, visual state, prompt, and persistence rules are applied.
Incremental search
a nonempty Search query changes
the matcher rebuilds and jumps to the nearest match unless current selection already matches.
Goto preview
numeric, ranged, incomplete, reversed, invalid, or out-of-bounds text is typed
selection and centering follow the parser result, while invalid or cleared text restores the snapshot.
Goto accept/cancel
Enter or Esc is pressed
Enter finalizes the current preview and Esc restores prior scroll/selection/visual state.

requirement: When copy is enabled, y/copy_selected SHALL copy the selected item or visual range through the injected ClipboardProvider and expose a copy toast window; no selection, follow mode, empty/filtered lists, or disabled copy SHALL be no-ops.
contract: copy_selected SHALL copy plain item text for a single stable selection or newline-join copy_text for an inclusive visual range after visible-to-physical mapping. Empty text, missing selection, disabled copy, and follow mode SHALL return false; y SHALL arm a 500ms toast only after a successful copy and clear visual mode.
scenarios: Single copy
a selectable item is selected and copy is enabled
its content reaches the clipboard.
Provider injection
a custom provider is installed
copy writes to that provider.
Visual copy
an inclusive visual range is active
items are joined in visible order and copied once.
No-op boundary
selection is absent, follow/empty, or copy is disabled
copy returns false and does not write.

requirement: When visual selection is enabled, v/Shift-j/Shift-k SHALL enter and extend an inclusive stable-ID range, Esc clears it, search clears it, and y copies the range in item order before leaving visual mode; disabled visual selection leaves v unconsumed.
contract: enter_visual_mode SHALL anchor at the current stable id and exit follow first; prepare_layout SHALL resolve anchor/cursor IDs into an inclusive visible range. exit_visual_mode and clear_selection SHALL remove the range, and navigation/search/follow transitions SHALL apply the documented visual-mode suppression rules.
scenarios: Visual entry
v or Shift-j starts visual mode
an anchor is captured and movement extends the range.
Visual cancel
Esc or search is invoked
visual mode and resolved range clear.
Visual copy
y is pressed with a range
newline-joined selected content is copied and visual mode exits.
Goto extension
goto-line is opened from visual mode
the range anchor is preserved and the typed target extends the selection.

requirement: Selection navigation SHALL not panic when the item slice is empty while layout metadata is stale, small viewports SHALL keep the selected item visible through repeated prepare cycles, and list input paste SHALL target only the active input bar, normalize CRLF for search, preserve comment newlines, and reject paste when closed.
contract: handle_paste SHALL return false with no active mode, sanitize single-line Search/Filter/Goto input, preserve multiline Comment text, and apply live matcher/goto updates only for the active mode. Navigation SHALL bounds-check physical indices against the supplied item slice even when cached layout metadata is older.
scenarios: Stale empty items
selection navigation receives an empty slice after a prior layout
no panic occurs and no invalid item is dereferenced.
Small viewport
render preparation occurs between repeated selection/scroll steps
selection remains visible and scroll advances within bounds.
Input paste
search/comment input is active, closed, or receives CRLF
only the active bar changes, normalization follows mode, and closed bars reject paste.

requirement: ListPane mouse handling SHALL prioritize scrollbar clicks/drags over content selection, map content rows to virtual item coordinates, route wheel events over the scrollbar to proportional movement, and release drag state on mouse-up.
contract: handle_mouse_event SHALL consume left-button content clicks, scrollbar clicks and drags, reject unrelated events, and clear scrollbar_dragging on release. handle_scroll_event SHALL use scrollbar percentage movement only when the pointer is inside the rendered scrollbar rectangle; otherwise it SHALL use line scrolling. Scrollbar clicks SHALL scale very tall content before using scrollbar_click_to_offset and dispatch Top/Bottom/Offset to the corresponding state transitions.
scenarios: Content click
a left click lands in the pane on a selectable row
the virtual y is resolved and that item is selected while follow/visual state is cleared.
Scrollbar drag
left down/drag/up occurs inside the recorded scrollbar area
dragging starts, offsets update through the scrollbar mapping, and dragging clears on release.
Scrollbar wheel
wheel input is over the scrollbar
a proportional offset is applied and the nearest center item is selected.
Other wheel
wheel input is outside the scrollbar
normal line scrolling and follow overscroll rules apply.

requirement: The pager SHALL keep process-wide input ownership flags coherent: the `/gboom` game may push and pop an additional Kitty keyboard layer exactly once, mouse capture state SHALL be observable, minimal mode SHALL be tracked separately from styling toggles, and Esc cancellation plus opt-in mouse-reporting behavior SHALL be derived from explicit mode/config inputs.
contract: push_gboom_keyboard_flags SHALL no-op when Kitty flags are unavailable or already pushed, otherwise push disambiguation, event-type, and all-keys escape reporting; pop SHALL balance one pushed layer. Minimal and mouse-reporting atomics SHALL use acquire/release ordering, test overrides SHALL be isolated to test support, and esc_cancels_turn SHALL return true for minimal or non-vim mode.
scenarios: Game keyboard layer
Kitty keyboard protocol is active and the game opens repeatedly
one extra layer is pushed once and later popped once.
Minimal behavior gate
effective screen mode is Minimal
minimal_mode_active is true while style/render toggles are set by the central mode seam.
Esc policy
minimal or non-vim fullscreen is active
a bare Esc is treated as turn cancellation; fullscreen vim keeps the mid-turn swallow.
Mouse toggle gate
the opt-in setting was seeded
the cached flag is available to command routing and the off hint remains stable.

requirement: ScreenMode SHALL distinguish fullscreen, inline, and minimal modes with stable metadata labels; startup SHALL install minimal/native or regular themes before terminal initialization, then resolve a regular theme if a minimal request is downgraded by probing.
contract: ScreenMode::is_fullscreen/is_minimal/meta_label SHALL be pure projections with labels fullscreen, inline, and minimal. apply_screen_mode_globals SHALL centralize minimal behavior gates, engage_startup_theme SHALL select native lock or initial theme, and finish_theme_after_probe SHALL only resolve the deferred regular theme when requested minimal becomes nonminimal.
scenarios: Mode label
diagnostics asks for a screen-mode label
the stable wire label is returned.
Minimal startup
minimal is requested
native theme lock and minimal behavior globals are engaged before terminal init.
Probe downgrade
minimal was requested but effective mode is inline
regular theme resolution without OSC11 is applied after the probe.
Normal startup
inline or fullscreen is requested
the regular initial theme is selected and no downgrade repair runs.

requirement: Leader mode SHALL resolve flags and policy in the order `--no-leader`, `--leader`, eligibility, local config, release remote setting, then default-off; a requested confinement profile SHALL veto an otherwise enabled leader without fabricating a policy-disable reason, and the result SHALL retain both typed reasons.
contract: resolve_leader_mode SHALL return use_leader, policy_disable_reason only for definitive config/remote false, and disabled_by_confinement only when confinement removed an otherwise enabled leader. resolve_use_leader SHALL expose the decision pair, and the sandbox warning SHALL state the requested profile without claiming enforcement while tolerating write failure.
scenarios: CLI precedence
both leader flags are present
no-leader wins and no policy reclaim reason is reported.
Config policy
eligible mode has local use_leader=false
leader is disabled with policy_disable_reason=config.
Confinement veto
leader would otherwise be enabled and a profile is requested
leader is disabled and disabled_by_confinement names that profile.
Unknown remote
remote leader mode is absent or unknown
the default remains off without treating uncertainty as policy disable.

requirement: Startup configuration SHALL choose the first nonblank hunk-tracker mode from CLI, environment, and config, refuse to connect when no valid LLM configuration exists on noninteractive stdin, provide a validated editable template on an interactive terminal, and bound connection attempts by cancellation or timeout.
contract: resolve_hunk_tracker_mode SHALL trim and skip blank values in precedence order. ensure_llm_configured SHALL validate first, fail fast when stdin is not a terminal, otherwise create the config parent/template as needed, resolve VISUAL over EDITOR, open the file, reload effective config, and revalidate. bounded_connect SHALL prioritize cancellation, return the connect result, or report a target-specific timeout.
scenarios: Hunk precedence
CLI, env, and config values contain blanks or values
the first trimmed nonblank value wins or None is returned.
Headless missing config
LLM validation fails and stdin is not a terminal
startup returns an actionable error without creating or opening a config file.
Interactive missing config
validation fails on a terminal
the template is created if absent, the selected editor runs, and the reloaded config must validate.
Connect timeout/cancel
a connect future stalls or the token is cancelled
bounded_connect returns a typed error for the target without stranding startup.

requirement: The pager run entry point SHALL load and validate effective configuration before redirecting native stderr, materialize session startup intent, resolve leader/permission/screen mode, initialize terminal state, connect with bounded cancellation, fall back from a failed leader to the embedded agent, run the root event loop, restore terminal ownership, and preserve update/relaunch/exit outcomes.
contract: run SHALL honor trust and startup intent before event-loop launch, pass resolved ConnectFlags and TerminalState into root::event_loop::run, use a 30-second connection bound, retry embedded connection only for a noncancelled leader failure, flush logs and restore terminal on connect failure, and after the event loop restore terminal before update restart, mode relaunch, resume hint, or error propagation.
scenarios: Configuration gate
effective config cannot load or has no LLM
run returns before terminal ownership is taken.
Leader fallback
leader connection fails while cancellation is not requested
the same connect flags are used for one embedded-agent retry and the result records fallback.
Cancellation
connection or event loop cancellation occurs
terminal/log cleanup runs and cancellation is not mistaken for successful startup.
Exit outcome
event loop returns update, relaunch, exit info, or error
terminal restoration precedes the corresponding return, exec attempt, hint, or error.

requirement: Terminal initialization SHALL enable raw input, select alternate or inline viewport according to ScreenMode, configure focus/paste/mouse reporting and negotiated Kitty flags, apply tri-state cursor blink policy without clobbering inherited terminal style, and downgrade minimal to inline when the inline viewport probe cannot provide minimal semantics.
contract: init_terminal SHALL drain stale input, optionally clear a relaunching minimal screen, enter alternate screen only for fullscreen, enable mouse capture only outside minimal, enable focus and bracketed paste, push negotiated Kitty flags, build the writer-backed PagerTerminal, and return the effective mode. A failed minimal inline probe SHALL retry full-height inline with mouse capture; other inline failure SHALL use a fixed viewport after scrolling up.
scenarios: Cursor default
cursor_blink is None
no cursor style escape is forced.
Cursor explicit
cursor_blink is true or false
blinking or steady block style is selected and teardown knows to restore it.
Minimal probe failure
minimal inline viewport setup fails
minimal downgrades to inline and enables mouse capture for the fallback.
Kitty negotiation
terminal capability detection returns no flags or flags
none are pushed in the former case, otherwise the negotiated layer is pushed and recorded.

requirement: On Windows conhost, native minimal selection SHALL preserve unrelated console-input bits while clearing app mouse reporting, enabling QuickEdit and its extended-flags gate, and enabling window-resize events; the original stdin mode SHALL be captured once and restored at teardown.
