contract: native_selection_mode SHALL be idempotent and mask only ENABLE_MOUSE_INPUT while asserting ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS, ENABLE_QUICK_EDIT_MODE, and ENABLE_WINDOW_INPUT. The Windows implementation SHALL no-op for redirected stdin, snapshot the first mode, avoid replacing the saved mode on repeated toggles, and restore at most once.
scenarios: Native drag selection
conhost input mode is active
QuickEdit is enabled and app mouse reporting is off.
Stale capture state
a prior crossterm capture mode remains
the transform recovers QuickEdit while preserving unrelated bits.
Repeated enable
native selection is enabled multiple times
the transformed mode is stable and the original snapshot remains the teardown target.
Non-console stdin
stdin is redirected
enable/restore performs no console mutation.

requirement: Terminal teardown SHALL stop output safely, emit reset sequences in a defined order, restore cursor/mouse/focus/Kitty/native-selection/raw-mode state, and execute from both normal restore and panic paths even when writer draining fails.
contract: restore_terminal_with SHALL clear fullscreen content when possible, compute inline cursor placement, drain and join the writer before teardown, always invoke teardown, drain residual events, disable raw mode, mark signal restoration, disable crash escape restore, and restore native stderr. emit_terminal_teardown_sequences SHALL clear progress, end synchronized updates before resets, disable mouse/paste and focus, pop game and Kitty layers, restore forced cursor style, leave fullscreen or move/show/write an inline final row, and best-effort restore Windows input.
scenarios: Writer failure
the drain callback returns an error
teardown still runs and the error is returned.
Fullscreen restore
normal fullscreen teardown begins
a final clear is queued and drained before LeaveAlternateScreen.
Inline restore
inline teardown begins
cursor is moved to the bounded final row, shown, and a newline is flushed.
Panic
the panic hook runs while terminal state is owned
the same escape restoration, raw-mode disable, signal mark, stderr restore, and process-scope cleanup execute.

requirement: Terminal titles SHALL strip control characters, fall back to `grow` when empty, truncate Unicode characters before appending ` - grow`, and write through the locked stderr path; exit and relaunch hints SHALL include the correct resume mode/session, optional sanitized summary lines, width truncation, and tolerate broken output pipes.
contract: terminal_title_string SHALL remove every control character, cap the visible title prefix at 74 Unicode characters, and use `grow` for empty results. set_terminal_title SHALL emit SetTitle with the sanitized value. print_exit_resume_hint SHALL print optional title/prompt/response summaries and minimal/fullscreen resume commands with best-effort writes; print_relaunch_failure_hint SHALL print the mode-specific resume command and never panic on write failure.
scenarios: Unsafe title
metadata contains BEL, ESC, or only controls
the emitted title contains no control characters and empty input becomes `grow - grow` internally.
Resume hint
a session exits with minimal or fullscreen mode
the command uses the matching `--minimal --resume` or `--resume` form.
Summary width
summary fields exceed terminal width
each line is Unicode-truncated to its available width.
Broken stderr
writer returns EIO/EPIPE
hints and sandbox notices return without panicking.

requirement: The app entry module SHALL expose the PagerArgs command surface with stable leader/no-leader conflict handling, resume/continue sentinels, worktree/session-id/fork combinations, no-alt-screen and feature-gated flags, command naming/help ordering, and shell-completion parsing.
contract: The re-exported PagerArgs parser SHALL accept documented short/long aliases and preserve session-startup intent boundaries: resume without an ID means most-recent sentinel, continue conflicts with resume, session-id combined with resume/continue requires fork, and the optional chat flag is rejected when its feature is absent. CLI help SHALL retain the Grow TUI header and argument/option/command ordering.
scenarios: Leader flags
--leader and --no-leader are both supplied
clap rejects the conflict.
Resume sentinel
--resume has no ID
resume_most_recent is true and session_to_resume is None.
Session identity
--session-id is combined with resume/continue
startup intent rejects it unless --fork-session is present.
Command surface
the root parser or completions subcommand is requested
the command name is grow, help order is stable, and shell completion parses.

requirement: The app module SHALL preserve its inline regression matrix for terminal mode transforms, teardown ordering injection, cursor policy, bounded cancellation, control-safe title/hints, leader precedence and confinement messaging, hunk-tracker precedence, and the complete CLI/session option surface. These tests are source evidence for the stated boundaries and do not prove a live terminal, ACP connection, external editor, or process replacement.
contract: The 74 inline test functions SHALL exercise pure policy helpers, parser projections, failure-tolerant output writers, Windows bit transforms, and injected teardown callbacks. Feature-gated release tests cover remote leader settings only when enabled; Unix pipe tests cover closed-output handling only on Unix.
scenarios: Pure policy tests
mode, title, hunk, leader, or CLI helpers are exercised
the pinned precedence, sanitization, sentinel, and feature-gate outcomes remain stable.
Async timeout tests
bounded_connect receives a pending future or cancelled token
timeout and cancellation errors are distinguishable.
Teardown failure test
the injected writer drain fails
the teardown callback still runs.
Platform conditional tests
Unix, Windows, or release-dist gates are active
only the applicable platform/policy evidence is claimed.
sources: tests module (74 #[test]/#[tokio::test] functions: asserts_quick_edit_and_resize_clears_mouse_input, preserves_unrelated_bits, idempotent, recovers_from_stale_crossterm_capture_mode, restore_runs_teardown_even_when_writer_failed, cursor_blink_config_maps_to_policy, llm_config_template_explains_both_credential_options, bounded_connect_times_out_when_the_target_stalls, requirement: BlockContent SHALL define the common scrollback rendering contract: content, accent/bullet styling, backgrounds, padding, fold/display modes, selection/grouping, media references, fullscreen preambles, and optional Mermaid/media affordances.
contract: The trait defaults SHALL be conservative and composable: bullet follows accent, accent backgrounds and block backgrounds are disabled, padding/foldability/selectability are enabled with Expanded/Collapsed defaults, finished mode and preamble/media/affordance/open-button outputs are absent, and extra estimated rows are zero. has_vpad SHALL delegate to has_vpad_for using the context appearance.
scenarios: Default styling
a block does not override an optional capability
the documented neutral style, padding, fold, selection, grouping, or media default is returned.
Fold cycle
a block is toggled from Collapsed, Truncated, or Expanded
the default cycle returns Expanded from Collapsed and Collapsed otherwise.
Appearance-aware padding
the caller supplies an AppearanceConfig
has_vpad forwards only the appearance to has_vpad_for.
Optional media
a block has no inline media, diagram, or viewer button
empty/None results avoid rendering or reserving extra rows.
Prefix and wrapping
a plain, bash, cron, multiline, or long prompt is rendered
the selected prefix and continuation indentation are used and visual lines wrap within the requested width.
Collapsed truncation
content exceeds the three-line cap in Collapsed or Truncated mode
the last visible line is rewrapped to reserve the ellipsis and ends with " …".
Exact fit
content fits exactly in the requested line cap
no ellipsis is appended.
Foldability
the prompt has at most three conservative 60-column visual lines or more than three
default mode is Expanded in the former case and Collapsed in the latter.
Fold toggle
current mode is Collapsed, Truncated, or Expanded
next_fold_mode returns Expanded for the first two and Collapsed for Expanded.
Accent disabled
thinking accent_enabled is false or the mode is Collapsed
accent returns None and no accent background is claimed.
Running accent
accent is enabled and the block is running
accent returns the configured color as animated when animate is true, otherwise as a static color, and bullet delegates to that accent.
Finished bullet
the block is not running
bullet returns None and the shared renderer can use its default bullet treatment.
Preamble
a compact preamble is requested
preamble builds the header using an Expanded, bright context even if the original context was muted/collapsed.
Bullet visibility
collapsed or header mode and a configured tool bullet are present
has_bullet reports true; absent bullet glyph or non-header expanded body reports false.
Singleton rendering
the block has one member in any display mode
output contains exactly one compact permission line with selection range zero.
Collapsed group
the block has multiple members and mode is Collapsed
output contains exactly one aggregated header line.
Expanded group
the block has multiple members and mode is Expanded
output contains one header followed by one compact line per member.
Compact geometry
the renderer queries padding/accent/fold/group policies
has_vpad_for is false, accent is None, is_foldable is true only for multi-member blocks, default mode is Collapsed, and is_groupable is false.
Outcome styling
header contains Approved and non-approved buckets
Approved verb uses accent_success, other verbs use accent_error, count spans use gray_bright+BOLD, and punctuation/child suffix use muted style.
Search projection
searchable_text is requested
joined text includes compact/event identity and available audit fields, including latency formatted in milliseconds.
Description preamble
a nonblank description exists
preamble emits description lines in primary color, one separator blank, then the shell command.
Blank description
description is missing or trims to blank
preamble emits only the command with no leading blank row.
Multiline description
description has multiple lines and internal blank runs
each nonblank line remains separate, trailing spaces are removed, and consecutive blank lines collapse to one before the separator.
Multiline command
command contains physical newlines or wraps at the available width
preamble emits `$ ` on the first row and continuation rows with a two-column hang indent, preserving command lines instead of smashing them.
Block policies
the common renderer queries mode/style capabilities
output has one compact line, default mode Collapsed, selectable=true, groupable=true, has_bullet=true, accent/background/padding/raw/fold behavior as implemented, and preamble is available.
Markdown output
a caller requests output for raw, diagram-free, or diagram-bearing content
raw/diagram-free content delegates directly to MarkdownContent, while pretty diagram content uses the combined output and affordance projection.
Block policy
the common renderer queries AgentMessageBlock capabilities
accent is absent, vertical padding is disabled, raw mode is enabled, folding is disabled, and stored image references are returned.
Selectable markdown
wrapped agent markdown is rendered at a narrow width
the underlying MarkdownContent output retains a single logical selection range and selectable lines for the message body.

requirement: BlockContent inline media SHALL reserve trailing image geometry and expose Mermaid affordance rows without forcing output work for non-media blocks.
contract: inline_media_placements SHALL return immediately for blocks without inline_media; for a media block it SHALL build output once to count content lines, ask inline_image_reserved_rows for fitted rows at context width, and return one AnchoredMedia anchored at content_lines+1. Diagram affordances and estimate_extra_rows remain block-specific hooks, while AnchoredMedia carries path/dimensions/type metadata, row offset, and crop rows.
scenarios: Non-media fast path
inline_media returns None
placements is empty without rebuilding output.
Trailing media
a block exposes one InlineMediaInfo
one placement starts one row after the output lines and reserves fitted image rows.
Mermaid affordance
a block overrides diagram_affordances
the caller receives block-relative rows for clickable Open/Copy actions.
Geometry metadata
a placement is returned
info, row_offset, and rows are preserved for layout and terminal image emission.
Display setting
a Mermaid block is rendered under Off, Auto, or On and raw mode is either disabled or enabled
Off or raw output shows the source without a treatment row; Auto/On pretty output adds one non-selectable row per diagram.
Affordance projection
pretty output contains one or more detected diagrams
diagram_affordances returns each source and its own non-selectable row offset in document order while the source code remains visible.
Multiple diagrams
two Mermaid blocks occur in one message
each affordance anchors at its own row and carries only that diagram's source.
Hyperlink mapping
a hyperlink follows a Mermaid block
the inserted treatment row does not create a new logical pre-wrap line and the link remains mapped to its original output row.

requirement: prepend_bullet SHALL add the configured bullet/icon to the first output line with theme-derived or explicit accent color while preserving selection metadata and shifting selectable span coordinates past the prefix.
contract: prepend_bullet SHALL no-op when the configured bullet has no character or output has no first line. Otherwise it SHALL choose the explicit bullet AccentStyle color or gray/gray_bright based on collapsed state, insert a styled `bullet + space` span at index zero, and call shift_selection_metadata_for_prefix with prefix width one.
scenarios: No bullet
configuration has no bullet character or output is empty
output and metadata are unchanged.
Default color
bullet style is None
collapsed output uses theme gray and expanded output uses theme bright gray.
Explicit accent
bullet returns AccentStyle
the explicit color is used.
Selectable output
the first line carries selection metadata
the prefix is rendered and selectable span coordinates remain aligned to body text.

requirement: RenderBlock SHALL wrap all supported scrollback block variants, delegate BlockContent capabilities to the inner variant, prepend bullets through its output path, and use the edit-specific rendered output path when available.
contract: RenderBlock::output SHALL delegate inner output, check has_bullet, and prepend the selected bullet. All other BlockContent methods SHALL dispatch to the matching variant. rendered_output SHALL return generic output for non-edit blocks, but use EditToolCallBlock::rendered_output and apply the same bullet policy for edits.
scenarios: Variant rendering
any RenderBlock variant is rendered
the corresponding inner block output and capability values are returned.
Bullet interception
a variant reports has_bullet
the delegated output receives one configured prefix and adjusted metadata.
Edit rendering
the variant is ToolCall(Edit)
the edit block’s richer RenderedBlockOutput is preserved and bullet styling is applied.
Type mismatch
a caller asks for a variant-specific mutable accessor
None is returned without changing the enum.

requirement: RenderBlock constructors SHALL create the typed user, agent, tool, thinking, notice, lifecycle, background-task, subagent, workflow, side-question, and context blocks while preserving variant-specific metadata, error, output, event ID, and streaming semantics.
contract: Factory methods SHALL map arguments to the corresponding block constructors; failed generic/tool operations SHALL attach the standard failure text, edit factories SHALL preserve paths/hunks/errors or parse the leading edit count, streaming factories SHALL expose mutable inner blocks for chunk updates, and background-task description mutation SHALL be a no-op for other variants.
scenarios: Prompt variants
plain, bash, skill, cron, or interjection prompt is requested
the matching UserPromptBlock mode is constructed, with optional skill token ranges retained.
Tool failure
a generic or detailed tool call has success=false
the typed Other/tool block carries `Tool call failed`.
Edit construction
hunks, an error, or legacy edit info is supplied
the Edit block preserves hunks/error or parses the leading numeric edit count.
Streaming
an empty agent/thinking stream is created
the matching mutable accessor permits chunk/time updates without changing the enum variant.
Task status
background task started/completed/failed is constructed
command, task id, elapsed, exit code, signal, and optional description are retained.
Plain and command variants
plain, bash, cron, or interjection construction is requested
the matching mode flag is set, other prompt mode flags are false, and the text is retained.
Leading skill token
skill text has a first-line command with or without arguments
only the first-line token is stored as a skill range; the remaining argument and later lines remain body text.
Mid-text token ranges
with_skill_tokens receives valid, invalid, boundary-breaking, or overlapping byte ranges
only sorted, non-overlapping ranges on UTF-8 boundaries inside the text are stored.
Copy and identity
copy_text or with_message_id is called
copy_text returns the text clone and with_message_id sets the supplied optional id.

requirement: RenderBlock SHALL expose immutable event IDs and replay equivalence so reconnect/minimal replay can match durable transcript facts without comparing presentation state.
contract: immutable_event_id SHALL return IDs only for Notice, Subagent, and SessionEvent variants. replay_equivalent SHALL require matching variants and compare stable domain IDs when both exist, otherwise compare exact durable source fields or debug representations; presentation state such as fold, selection, or theme SHALL not participate, and differing variants SHALL be false.
scenarios: Durable event ID
a notice/subagent/session event has an event_id
the ID is returned; ad-hoc blocks return None.
Stable replay match
two same-kind blocks have matching domain IDs
they compare equivalent even if presentation fields differ.
Fallback replay match
IDs are absent
the documented source fields or debug value determine equivalence.
Variant mismatch
blocks have different RenderBlock variants
replay_equivalent returns false.

requirement: RenderBlock SHALL classify block kinds for selection, cache invalidation, plan controls, media resolution, accent styling, fullscreen support, copy/drag affordances, and raw-mode mutation.
contract: Type predicates SHALL recognize their exact variants; is_plan_control_tool SHALL match the three supported names only. evict_render_caches SHALL clear markdown wrap caches for AgentMessage, Thinking, and Btw only. accent_color SHALL follow theme and outcome/running state, fullscreen support SHALL combine normal viewers with image references, copy support SHALL be restricted to documented variants, drag selection SHALL exclude stubs, and set_raw_mode SHALL affect only markdown-capable agent/thinking blocks.
scenarios: Type classification
a caller asks for a block-kind predicate
the exact variant classification is returned.
Plan control
an Other tool name is one of PlanControl, plan_control, or Plan: Control
the plan-control predicate is true; other names are false.
Cache eviction
off-screen cache eviction visits a block
only markdown-backed wrap caches are evicted; source data remains.
Viewer support
a block has normal viewer content or image references
supports_fullscreen reports the combined capability while errors/empty outputs follow variant rules.
Raw mode
a markdown block or non-markdown block receives set_raw_mode
agent/thinking state changes; other variants are unchanged.

requirement: RenderBlock SHALL provide state-aware visible copy, raw-or-rendered block copy, metadata copy labels, and full-text search source projections that omit empty fields and align markdown search with rendered plain text.
contract: plain_text_from_output SHALL skip non-selectable lines, derive selection text, preserve line joiners, apply selection boundaries, and return None when no selectable text exists. copy_visible_text_in_state SHALL use rendered output and authoritative boundaries; copy_text SHALL honor raw for markdown and support only documented tool variants; copy_meta/copy_meta_label SHALL expose command/path/url/pattern metadata. searchable_text SHALL join nonempty source fields, omit empty-only blocks, use rendered markdown for AgentMessage/Thinking/Btw, flatten session events, and include structured tool/subagent fields per variant.
scenarios: Visible copy
rendered lines include separators or padded table spans
copy excludes non-selectable/render-only padding and rejoins content with semantic line breaks.
Markdown copy
raw is true or false
copy_text returns source or rendered text according to the markdown block policy.
Metadata copy
a supported tool has command/path/url/pattern metadata
copy_meta and copy_meta_label return the corresponding value/label.
Search index
a block has multiple optional fields or markdown markers
nonempty fields are newline-joined and rendered markdown markers are absent.
Empty source
all searchable fields are empty
searchable_text returns None instead of indexing a blank string.
Ordered matches
indexed entries contain matching text in multiple entries or multiple positions
matches are returned in entry order with the expected EntryId, logical line and byte range.
Multiline metadata
one searchable entry contains repeated matches on later newline-separated lines
line_in_entry advances from zero and byte ranges remain ranges in the entry text.
Rendered Markdown corpus
an AgentMessage phrase crosses Markdown emphasis markers
the searchable rendered text yields the visible phrase match.
Empty or zero-width query
the query is empty or a regex only produces zero-width matches
the index returns an empty match list.
Malformed regex
TextMatcher reports a regex compilation error
find returns no matches.
Smart case
a lowercase, mixed-case or uppercase substring query is applied
matching follows TextMatcher smart-case behavior as asserted by the test.
Non-searchable block
an entry has empty searchable text alongside a searchable entry
the empty entry is omitted from the corpus and only the searchable entry matches.
Generation cache
scroll/viewport state changes without content_generation changing, or content is appended/cleared
sync is a no-op for view-only changes and rebuilds for content changes, updating the corpus accordingly.
Copy Mermaid source
a pretty Mermaid message is copied through RenderBlock::copy_visible_text_in_state
the selectable fence body is copied, including all diagram lines, while the render-only affordance row contributes no text.

requirement: RenderBlock SHALL expose pre-wrap content and authoritative Markdown hyperlinks to callers while retaining image references and media paths for fullscreen/link projection.
contract: with_link_content SHALL provide markdown-backed AgentMessage/Thinking/Btw lines plus hyperlink targets, map UserPrompt text to raw lines with no targets, and return empty slices for unrelated variants. image_references and media_ref_path SHALL delegate to the corresponding block data and only generic Other tool blocks may resolve a media path.
scenarios: Markdown links
a markdown-backed block is queried
pre-wrap lines and hyperlink targets are passed to the callback in renderer coordinates.
User prompt links
a user prompt is queried
raw prompt lines are provided with no hyperlink targets.
Other block
a non-markdown block is queried
empty line/target slices are returned.
Media path
an image-backed generic tool exists
its absolute/derived media path is returned; unrelated variants return None.

requirement: The scrollback block module SHALL preserve its inline regression matrix for media placement, block factories and foldability, fullscreen viewer gating, bullet selection metadata, copy projection, and searchable text across all supported block variants. These tests are source evidence for block-state and projection behavior and do not prove terminal rendering or external clipboard integration.
contract: The 33 inline tests SHALL exercise pure BlockContent/RenderBlock outputs and searchable/copy projections. They cover default media wrapper geometry, stubs, prompts, agent/tool variants, search/list-dir viewer gates, nonselectable/padded-line copy boundaries, bullet metadata, and all structured searchable text variants.
scenarios: Media and factory tests
media/stub/prompt/tool constructors are exercised
the selected variant and basic output/capability invariants remain stable.
Viewer/copy tests
viewer eligibility or visible copy is queried
error/empty and selectable-line boundaries produce the documented result.
Search indexing tests
each structured block variant is indexed
the expected source fields are present, empty-only inputs are omitted, and markdown markers are stripped.
Selected and unselected styling
a prompt is rendered selected or unselected in the regular theme
the pointer keeps the accent-user color policy and selection changes the line band rather than replacing the pointer style.
Native versus RGB band
terminal-native mode, RGB mode, or Reset background is selected
native uses DarkGray/Gray, RGB follows bg_light, and Reset produces no RGB band.
Minimal bolding
prompt styles are requested with terminal_native true or false
prefix, body, and skill styles are bold only in native mode.
Semantic band
a prompt line is rendered with its band
background_is_panel remains false while the line background equals the selected band color.

requirement: Embedded modal rendering and row styling
contract: The modal chrome SHALL support a process-wide embedded mode for minimal UI: embedded rendering fills the supplied area without a popup border or close button, optional titles occupy the first row, and embedded list rows remain transparent while selected text uses the theme fuzzy accent; full TUI mode SHALL retain the centered bordered popup.
scenarios: Mode toggle
embedded is enabled
the modal fills the complete area and embedded returns true.
Embedded frame
a title is present in embedded mode
the title is bold/background-free and content begins below it without border/close chrome.
Row style
a picker requests embedded_row_style
transparent background and accent selected text are returned; full mode returns None.
Full frame
embedded is disabled
the popup is centered and smaller than the supplied area.

requirement: Modal sizing defaults, presets, compact mode, and bounds
contract: ModalSizing SHALL provide stable default, medium, and large presets; compact mode SHALL set v_margin=0, h_pad=1, and v_pad=0 while preserving width/footer fields; compute_modal_dims SHALL clamp width to the terminal area even when min_width is larger.
scenarios: Preset
default/medium/large is selected
documented fractions, limits, margins, padding, and footer rows are supplied.
Compact
with_compact(true) is called
outer margin and content padding are minimized while unrelated fields stay unchanged.
Normal
with_compact(false) is called
the sizing value is unchanged.
Narrow terminal
area width is below min_width
the computed modal width never exceeds area width.

requirement: Modal frame geometry and content/footer contract
contract: render_modal_window SHALL clear and draw modal chrome, store popup and hit rectangles, render optional tabs/divider, reserve padding and dynamically sized footer rows, and return content/footer/inner geometry; areas below 20x6 SHALL clear stale hit state and return None.
scenarios: Too small
computed dimensions are below 20x6
popup, close, shortcut, and tab hit state is cleared.
Full frame
a sufficient full-TUI area is rendered
a centered cleared bordered/title frame and content/footer rectangles are returned.
Tabs
tabs are configured
tab rows and divider consume vertical space before content.
Footer
labels need more rows than footer_lines
footer expands and content shrinks accordingly.

requirement: Tab bar wrapping, styles, and hit rectangles
contract: The tab bar SHALL greedily wrap labels by display width, style active/inactive tabs by focus and embedded mode, clip at the inner right edge without invalid UTF-8, record visible tab Rects, and leave clipped tabs without hit rectangles.
scenarios: Wrapping
labels do not fit on one row
labels wrap in order.
Active
a tab equals active_tab
focused full TUI uses bold primary/visual background; embedded or unfocused uses bold accent without band.
Hit area
a tab is visible
its display-width rectangle is recorded; clipped tabs are None.

requirement: Footer shortcut layout, styling, and hit metadata
contract: render_modal_shortcuts SHALL handle empty areas, greedily wrap with separators, bottom-align and center rows, clip by display width, style key/description halves, highlight hovered labels, and return hit metadata for all rendered shortcuts using the original full-slice index.
scenarios: Empty
area/list is empty
no cells or hits are returned.
Wrapping
labels exceed width
shortcuts wrap bottom-up within height.
Hover
a shortcut is hovered
all visible label cells use bg_highlight and hovered_shortcut tracks its full slice index.
Rendered
a shortcut is visible
ShortcutHitArea includes rect, id, original index, and clickable.

requirement: Shortcut label key/description splitting
contract: split_shortcut_label SHALL split only at the first ASCII space, keep that leading space in the description, preserve later spaces/non-ASCII whitespace, and treat no-space input as key-only.
scenarios: ASCII space
a label contains a space
key is the prefix and label begins with the space.
Multiword
suffix has more spaces
all suffix text remains the label.
Unicode whitespace
tabs/NBSP or arrows occur
UTF-8 remains valid and non-ASCII whitespace does not split.
No separator
input has no ASCII space
the whole input is key and label is empty.

requirement: Centered tip footer fitting and content partition
contract: fit_tip_line SHALL choose the first display-width fitting candidate or truncate the last nonempty candidate; render_centered_tip_footer SHALL truncate/style/center a tip; split_content_for_tip_footer SHALL reserve a tip at height >=3 and a blank gap at height >=6.
scenarios: Fit
a candidate fits
the first fitting candidate is returned.
Truncate
none fits
the last nonempty candidate is width-truncated.
Render
tip exceeds footer width
it is clipped, centered, italic gray_dim on bg_base.
Height
content is short/medium/tall
no tip, tip without gap, or tip with gap is produced.

requirement: Vim navigation search hint
contract: push_vim_nav_search_hint SHALL append a non-clickable `i search` shortcut only when vim mode is enabled and search is inactive, and SHALL otherwise leave the list unchanged.
scenarios: Nav
vim on/search off
the hint is appended.
Search
search active
no hint is appended.
Disabled
vim off
no hint is appended.

requirement: Fold indicator rendering
contract: fold_indicator_span SHALL render a two-column collapsed chevron or expanded diamond plus space, use gray_dim normally and text_primary/bold on hover, and apply optional background; render_fold_indicator SHALL write it and return width 2.
scenarios: Collapsed
collapsed true
chevron plus space is rendered.
Expanded
collapsed false
diamond plus space is rendered.
Hover/background
hover or bg is supplied
style changes accordingly.
Direct
render_fold_indicator is called
buffer is written and 2 is returned.

requirement: Modal keyboard close and fold navigation
contract: handle_modal_key SHALL map Esc to CloseRequested; return Unhandled for unrelated/tab-focused input; otherwise prioritize group collapse/expand, detail collapse/expand, then parent jump based on FoldInfo, with h/l equivalent to Left/Right.
scenarios: Esc
Esc is pressed
CloseRequested is returned.
No fold/tabs
horizontal input has no applicable fold or tabs are focused
Unhandled is returned.
Group
collapsible expanded/collapsed group is focused
Left/h collapses or Right/l expands the group.
Details
group action does not apply and detail state can change
Left/h collapses or Right/l expands details.
Parent
no higher action applies and parent exists
Left/h returns JumpToParent; absent parent is Unhandled.
Precedence
group and detail actions both apply
group wins, then details, then parent.

requirement: Modal mouse close, tab, shortcut, and content routing
contract: handle_modal_mouse SHALL resolve close/tab/shortcut rectangles; left clicks SHALL close on close/outside, return TabChanged only for actual tab changes, activate clickable shortcut ids, and leave content clicks Unhandled. Movement SHALL update hover state and consume chrome or changed-hover events for redraw.
scenarios: Close/outside
left click hits close or misses popup
CloseRequested is returned.
Content
left click is inside popup with no chrome hit
Unhandled is returned.
Tab/shortcut
left click hits a tab or clickable shortcut
TabChanged/ShortcutActivated is returned.
Hover
movement enters/leaves chrome
hover state updates and Handled forces redraw.
Stable/other
movement changes nothing or event is non-left
Unhandled is returned.

requirement: Modal window state initialization
contract: ModalWindowState::new/default SHALL initialize no popup/close/tab/shortcut hit rectangles, active_tab=0, tab_count=0, and no hovered shortcut; with_tabs(n) SHALL allocate n empty tab slots.
scenarios: New/default
a new/default state is constructed
all counters and hit areas have inert defaults.
Tabs
with_tabs(n) is called
tab_count=n and tab_rects has n None entries.

requirement: Session announcement selection, expiry, visibility, and critical precedence
contract: The session announcement selector SHALL consider only visible live critical or promo announcements, skip hidden dismissible entries, retain non-dismissible entries even when their hide key is stored, skip expired entries at draw time, and always select the first live critical before falling back to the first live promo.
scenarios: Critical filter
the list includes info/warning, missing-message, empty-message, and critical entries
the first usable live critical is selected and lower severities/empty entries are ignored.
Hidden selection
the first selected item is hidden
the next unhidden item is selected; hiding all eligible items yields no slot item.
Expiry
an expires_at boundary is reached
the expired item is skipped and the next live candidate is selected.
Priority
critical and promo candidates coexist
critical owns the single session slot regardless of list order; promo takes over only when no critical is selected.
Pinned item
dismissible is explicitly false and its hide key is stored
the item remains selectable; absent/true dismissible values remain hideable.

requirement: Session announcement slash gate, hide keys, critical gate, and banner height
contract: The session predicates SHALL keep `/announcements show` reachable whenever any live critical or promo exists regardless of hidden state, expose live session hide keys for clearing, report whether a critical owns the slot, and derive banner height as 2 for critical, 1 for promo, or 0 when no selectable item remains.
scenarios: Slash gate
live critical/promo entries exist but all are hidden
has_session_announcements remains true.
Hide set
the current time is supplied
session_announcement_hide_keys_at returns hide keys for live critical/promo entries only, excluding info, empty, and expired entries.
Critical gate
a live unhidden critical exists
has_critical_session_announcement is true.
Height
selection is critical/promo/empty
session_banner_height returns 2/1/0 respectively.

requirement: Promo CTA validation, safe URL target, and slot consistency
contract: A promo CTA SHALL be usable only when trimmed label and URL are nonempty and the URL passes the Standard safe-open scheme filter; promo_cta and promo_cta_target SHALL resolve through the current banner slot, return no target when a critical owns it or the promo is hidden/invalid, and expose the owner for dismissibility decisions.
scenarios: Usable pair
label and URL contain nonempty trimmed values with an allowed scheme
the trimmed label/URL are returned as the CTA target.
Partial CTA
label or URL is absent/blank
no CTA target is returned.
Unsafe URL
URL uses file, javascript, custom, or malformed scheme
no button/OSC target/dispatch URL is armed.
Slot owner
a live critical precedes a promo
promo_cta_target returns None until the critical is hidden or expired.
Pinned status
the selected promo is dismissible false
promo_cta exposes an owner whose is_dismissible value enables pinned behavior.

requirement: Promo CTA caption and reservation contract
contract: The CTA helpers SHALL treat a caption as trimmed nonempty decorative text independent of CTA validity, reserve button plus optional caption display width, and keep the caption out of the clickable rect; callers may suppress the caption while retaining the button.
scenarios: Caption normalization
cta.caption is absent, blank, or padded
usable_cta_caption returns None or the trimmed text.
Invalid CTA caption
a URL is absent but caption exists
caption access remains available, but no button or caption is painted without a usable CTA.
Reservation
label and optional caption are supplied
promo_cta_reserve counts `[label]` plus its leading caption space and caption width.
Permission gate
caption_allowed is false
the button remains eligible while the decorative caption is omitted.

requirement: Shared CTA button painting and hit rectangle
contract: render_cta_button SHALL paint a warning-colored `[label]` button with hover background, truncate the button to max_width without overpainting, append a dim caption only when it fits whole, and return a clickable rect covering only the button or None when no cell fits.
scenarios: Normal button
positive width is available
the warning button is painted and its rect covers exactly the displayed button.
Hover
hovered is true
warning foreground and bg_hover are applied.
Caption
caption fits after the button
dim caption text is painted after one space while the rect remains button-only.
Tight width
only part of caption or button fits
caption is dropped whole and button is clipped to max_width.
Zero width
max_width is zero
nothing is painted and no rect is returned.

requirement: Critical banner two-row rendering and reservation
contract: render_banner SHALL paint the selected critical as two rows with an error-red bold `! title`, right-aligned hide button, message indented past the prefix, and dim hide command; it SHALL reserve affordance widths before truncating title/message and reclaim those columns for non-dismissible announcements.
scenarios: Critical row
a live critical has title/message
row 0 uses error-red prefix/title and row 1 uses primary message plus dim hide CTA, with hide/CTA hit semantics as documented.
Long content
title or message exceeds available width
title/message truncate with an ellipsis while `[hide]` and hide command retain their full reserved widths.
Hover
hide_hovered is true
the hide button uses accent_error without DIM.
Pinned critical
dismissible is false
both hide affordances are omitted and title/message reclaim the reserved columns.
Empty critical
title and message are both absent/blank
no banner hits are returned.

requirement: Promo banner one-row rendering and affordance reservation
contract: render_banner SHALL paint a live promo as one row with a validated warning CTA at the left, optional pinned caption, and right-aligned hide command/button only for dismissible promos; promo message text SHALL remain unpainted on the banner, and right-side affordances SHALL retain their full width while the CTA truncates first.
scenarios: Dismissible promo
a usable CTA and hideable promo are selected
the CTA, hide command, and `[hide]` are painted with matching hit rectangles.
Pinned promo
dismissible is false and caption is allowed
the CTA and dim caption paint without any hide affordance.
No CTA
promo has no usable CTA
no CTA button/rect or message is painted; dismissible promos may still show hide affordances.
Narrow row
the reserved hide block leaves little CTA width
hide affordances remain intact, hide CTA may be dropped whole, and the button is truncated instead.
Hover
hide or CTA is hovered
respective error-red or warning/bg_hover style is applied.

requirement: Banner hit metadata and zero-area behavior
contract: render_banner SHALL return BannerHits only for affordances actually painted, with critical rows never exposing a CTA hit; zero-width/height areas and non-session severities SHALL produce default empty hits without painting announcement text.
scenarios: Zero area
render area has zero width or height
default BannerHits is returned and no drawing occurs.
Info-only
only info/warning announcements are present
no banner text or hit rectangles are painted.
Critical
critical is selected
hide may be set while cta is always None.
Promo
promo CTA/hide is actually painted
corresponding rects identify only the clickable button cells.

requirement: BlockViewer ContentLine SHALL adapt styled rendered lines to ListItem with stable pre-wrap IDs, plain search text, and optional full-width backgrounds; TextEndpoint/TextDrag SHALL provide ordered, character-column selections that remain stable across viewport scrolling.
contract: ContentLine::from_lines SHALL preserve each Line, concatenate span content for plain_text, assign the source line index as stable_id, and retain line background. TextDrag::ordered SHALL return endpoints in reading order and is_non_empty SHALL report whether at least one character-column is covered; ListItem accessors SHALL expose these exact fields.
scenarios: Line adaptation
styled lines are converted to viewer items
content, plain search text, zero-based stable ID, and background are retained.
Stable drag order
mouse anchor is after the head
ordered returns the head first without mutating the selection.
Empty drag
anchor and head are equal
is_non_empty returns false.
Search text
a line has multiple spans
search sees their concatenated textual content without style metadata.

requirement: BlockViewerPane SHALL construct configured ListPane viewers for markdown, execute, edit, background-task, web-fetch, read, grep, list-dir, integration-search, use-tool, and plain-text sources, rejecting incompatible or empty viewer requests and preserving source-specific content metadata.
contract: Markdown/execute viewers SHALL enable wrapping, search/filter/copy/visual selection and follow only while streaming; static viewers SHALL disable follow. Read SHALL show error text when content is absent or syntax-highlighted absolute-line content otherwise. Edit SHALL reject empty hunks and build diff metadata; integration search SHALL render limits/results/tool descriptions; use-tool SHALL render input plus output/error; background tasks SHALL retain task_id for central-store refresh; plain text SHALL prepend a styled title and separator with collision-safe IDs.
scenarios: Markdown/execute
entry block is the matching type
a wrapped viewer with configured ListPane state and system clipboard is returned.
Incompatible source
constructor receives another RenderBlock variant
None is returned.
Read error/content
read has an error without content or content with an optional line range
error lines or syntax-highlighted numbered lines are displayed.
Edit empty/nonempty
edit has no hunks or one or more hunks
empty edits return None; nonempty edits expose rendered diff lines and parallel metadata.
Structured tools
integration/use tool fields are present
metadata, arguments, descriptions, outputs, and errors are laid out in styled lines.
Plain/background content
catalog text or task stdout is requested
title/separator or terminal-output lines are represented and task identity is retained.

requirement: Viewer item builders SHALL preserve terminal-output styling, edit diff line metadata, markdown source-line maps, and stable cursor restoration across raw-mode or content rebuilds.
contract: build_execute_items SHALL convert terminal output into styled ContentLines with plain text, stable indices, and dark background. build_edit_items SHALL use the block-owned wide diff renderer, interleave separator metadata, and parallelize each rendered row with optional DiffLineMeta. extract_markdown_lines/generation/source map SHALL read only markdown-capable blocks; source_line_for_id and jump_to_source_line SHALL map stable pre-wrap IDs to the first rendered line at or after the requested source line.
scenarios: Streaming output
execute stdout is present or absent
terminal output rows are converted or an empty list is returned.
Diff metadata
rendered edit lines include hunk separators
separator rows have None metadata and diff rows retain tag/text/old/new line numbers.
Raw toggle restore
a markdown source map changes after rebuild
the saved source line resolves to the first matching new item ID.
Unsupported source map
a non-markdown block is queried
generation/source-map extraction returns None and no jump occurs.

requirement: Viewer ticks SHALL detect generation or stdout changes, invalidate/rebuild layout content, redraw when changed, and on running-to-finished transition disable follow and select the last item by stable ID.
contract: tick and tick_bg_task SHALL compare the stored generation counter (markdown generation or output length), rebuild only the applicable dynamic content, invalidate ListPane layout, and return whether redraw is needed. A running-to-finished transition SHALL permanently disable follow, select the last available item, and request redraw; static viewer kinds remain unchanged.
scenarios: Content generation
a markdown generation or execute output length changes
items are rebuilt, layout invalidated, and tick returns true.
No change
generation and running state remain unchanged
tick returns false.
Finish transition
a running entry/task becomes finished
follow is disabled permanently, the last item ID is selected, and redraw is requested.
Background task
central stdout changes
tick_bg_task replaces terminal-output items and retains task identity.

requirement: BlockViewer SHALL expose kind-specific shortcut hints, close-key detection, raw-mode and metadata-copy requests, edit patch-copy requests, ListPane navigation/search/paste routing, and deferred copy extraction for the caller.
contract: shortcuts_hints SHALL always expose close/search/filter/select/wrap and add r or Y according to viewer kind. is_close_key SHALL recognize Ctrl-F or Esc/q only when no input bar or visual selection is active. handle_key SHALL set pending flags for markdown raw, supported metadata Y, or edit y, otherwise route the unified prepend+body items to ListPane and clear sticky text drag after consumed actions. process_pending_copy SHALL return metadata, full block text, or a range-derived unified patch, clear its pending flag, exit visual mode, and filter empty results.
scenarios: Close gating
Ctrl-F, Esc, or q is pressed with or without input/visual state
only eligible close keys return true.
Raw request
markdown viewer receives bare r
raw_toggle_pending is set and the key is consumed.
Metadata request
supported viewer receives Shift-Y
copy_meta_pending is set for caller-side clipboard handling.
Edit content request
edit viewer receives bare y
copy_content_pending is set before ListPane handles it.
Ordinary navigation
a ListPane key or paste is received
the same unified item space is passed and consumed state clears sticky drag selection.
Pending copy
caller drains pending actions
metadata, block text, or a generated patch is returned and visual state is cleared.

requirement: Edit viewer patch copy SHALL serialize only diff rows covered by the requested item range into a unified patch with correct file headers, hunk starts/counts, prefixes, and newline trimming.
contract: patch_from_range SHALL return None for non-edit/empty metadata or ranges containing no diff rows. It SHALL emit `--- a/path`, `+++ b/path`, derive old/new starts from non-insert/non-delete rows with defaults of one, count old/new rows excluding opposite changes, map Equal/Insert/Delete to space/plus/minus, trim CR/LF terminators, and terminate every emitted row with LF.
scenarios: No metadata
viewer is not an edit or range has no diff rows
None is returned.
Mixed hunk
range contains equal, insert, delete, and separator rows
headers/counts and prefixes reflect only diff rows.
Line terminators
diff text ends in CR/LF
terminators are stripped before exactly one LF is emitted.
Visual edit copy
visual range includes prepended lines
caller adjusts the range before serialization so only parallel diff metadata is read.

requirement: BlockViewer mouse drag SHALL create character-precise stable selections over unified preamble/body items, auto-scroll at content edges, copy off-screen covered text on release, and render visible selection overlays using display-cell and grapheme-aware bounds.
contract: handle_mouse SHALL exclude scrollbar columns from content drags, clear keyboard visual mode on a new left-down, update a stable TextDrag during drag with 1..5-row edge autoscroll, clamp release coordinates, extract copy text on release, and clear selection on other clicks. screen_to_endpoint SHALL map wrapped screen coordinates through joiner widths to logical display columns; col_past_char SHALL advance past the grapheme at a display column; text_for_drag SHALL slice start/end lines and include complete middle lines. render_text_drag_overlay SHALL invert only visible selected cells while preserving off-screen selection for copying.
scenarios: Start drag
left-down is inside content
a stable anchor/head endpoint is created and keyboard visual mode is cleared.
Edge drag
drag moves above/below content
scroll advances by a clamped distance and head maps to the clamped screen endpoint.
Release
left-up follows a nonempty drag
selected text is extracted immediately, drag is cleared, and caller-visible drag_copy_text is populated.
Unicode/wrap
selection crosses wrapped CJK/grapheme content
screen columns map to logical display columns with joiner compensation and grapheme end inclusion.
Visible overlay
a sticky or active selection overlaps rendered rows
only visible cells in the selection range receive highlight.

requirement: BlockViewer render_content SHALL combine preamble and body items in one stable index space, react to theme changes, prepare ListPane layout at the effective scrollbar-aware width, and render content into modal chrome without out-of-bounds handler indices.
contract: render_content SHALL restyle ListPane and rebuild execute/background content when ThemeKind changes, cache prepend lines with high-half IDs, rebuild the unified cache, skip empty/zero areas, perform a scrollbar-width-aware initial layout and a corrective wider layout when wrapped content overflows, then render the same unified vec through ListPane. last_content_area SHALL be updated for mouse hit testing.
scenarios: Theme switch
theme kind changes before render
list style updates and dynamic execute/background items are rebuilt or marked for refresh.
Preamble
modal supplies header lines
header and blank separator items use high u64 IDs and share the ListPane index space with body.
Scrollbar guess
content likely fits or may overflow
layout uses content width first or reserves scrollbar columns, then corrects width if total height proves overflow.
Empty area
content area or unified items are empty
no ListPane render occurs while hit-test area is still updated.
Input consistency
handlers run after render
cached unified items match the prepared layout, preventing prepend/body index drift.

requirement: The block viewer source SHALL preserve its documented ListPane/viewer boundaries: it delegates navigation and filtering to ListPaneState, handles source-specific construction and patch/text selection locally, and exposes pending actions for callers rather than performing external clipboard/raw-mode/entry mutation itself.
contract: All viewer methods SHALL maintain the ownership split represented by the fields and comments: this module owns viewer items, drag geometry, pending flags, and modal render state; callers own entry raw toggles and clipboard side effects. No inline tests are present in this 1,748-line source, so this requirement records source-level boundaries only.
scenarios: Caller action
raw or copy pending flag is set
the caller must consume the flag and perform external mutation/clipboard work.
List navigation
search/filter/scroll keys arrive
ListPaneState remains the navigation owner using the cached unified items.
No inline tests
the source is statically audited
test_count is zero and no runtime behavior is claimed.

requirement: ListPane SHALL borrow a model item slice, carry focus and overlay style configuration through builder methods, and render only into nonzero areas after splitting bottom input/status rows and scrollbar space from the requested viewport.
contract: ListPane::new SHALL start unfocused with default ListPaneStyle; focused and style SHALL return updated builder values. StatefulWidget::render SHALL no-op for zero dimensions, reserve state.bottom_bar_height rows at the bottom, scale total/offset consistently when content exceeds u16::MAX, split the remaining list area through maybe_split_for_scrollbar, store the resulting scrollbar hit area, and render list, indicators, toast, scrollbar, and bottom bar in that order.
scenarios: Widget setup
a caller creates a pane and sets focus/style
the widget borrows the exact items and carries the requested flags.
Zero area
width or height is zero
render returns without indexing or painting.
Bottom bar
input or accepted matcher needs a bar
the list area shrinks and the bar occupies the final rows.
Huge content
total height exceeds u16::MAX
total and offset share a scale so scrollbar position stays proportional.
Scrollbar split
content overflows
the state stores the scrollbar area used by later click/scroll handling.

requirement: ListPane SHALL render content-based items with optional full-width backgrounds, cursor/selection prefixes, NoWrap truncation, or wrapped continuation rows while keeping all writes inside the supplied area.
contract: render_item_framework SHALL paint item.background across the area, choose prefix_cursor/prefix_in_selection/prefix by cursor/selection state, subtract prefix display width, use SafeBuf for prefix/content writes, render one truncated row in NoWrap or word-wrap content in Wrap mode, and leave continuation prefix columns blank. render_items SHALL use a direct fast path for fully visible items and a scratch-buffer blit for clipped items while preserving parent backgrounds where scratch cells are Reset.
scenarios: NoWrap item
content fits or is longer than the row
prefix and content are painted within width and excess content is handled by the ellipsis post-pass.
Wrapped item
wrap mode has multiple desired rows
word-wrapped lines fill allocated rows with content indented after the prefix.
Custom background
item.background returns a color
the complete item area receives that background before content.
Partial visibility
first item is scrolled or bottom row is clipped
content renders in scratch and only visible rows are copied without erasing parent background.
Narrow area
prefix consumes all available width
the content write is skipped safely without out-of-bounds access.

requirement: ListPane SHALL render only the state-visible item range, map visible indices to physical items after filtering, skip stale out-of-range mappings safely, overlay selection background and match inversion after content, and append truncation markers only for true text truncation.
contract: render_items SHALL iterate state.visible_range, translate through state.to_physical, debug-assert but release-skip invalid indices, honor first_item_skip_rows and per-item layout heights, and stop at viewport bottom. Selection overlay SHALL preserve content/foreground/modifiers, show only when focused or configured, and distinguish cursor versus visual-range colors. Match highlights SHALL use the active regex, search column offset, wrap mode, and state.show_highlights. Ellipsis SHALL trigger only when desired_height(area.width) exceeds allocated item height, never for viewport clipping.
scenarios: Filtered range
state has a visible-to-physical map
only matching items are painted in visible order.
Stale shrink
filter and item count changed between frames
invalid physical indices are skipped instead of panicking.
Selection overlay
cursor or visual range is visible
background is applied after item content while style/text remain intact.
Search overlay
matcher has matches
only matched cells receive REVERSED inversion at the correct prefix/wrapped positions.
Truncation
NoWrap allocated height is smaller than desired text height
ellipsis is appended after the last nonspace or replaces the final cell; viewport clipping alone adds none.

requirement: The renderer SHALL show Unicode truncation and scroll-position indicators without corrupting existing backgrounds or merging indicators into adjacent text.
contract: render_truncation_ellipsis SHALL scan the row’s rightmost nonspace cell, append or replace with `…`, inherit the donor foreground, and preserve target background. render_corner_indicators SHALL no-op for zero areas or disabled style, place ▲ when offset is nonzero, place ◆ in follow mode or ▼ when more content exists below, and insert `… ` padding when indicators overwrite content while retaining cell backgrounds.
scenarios: Truncated text
row has text with trailing space
ellipsis is appended using adjacent foreground.
Full row
text reaches the final cell
the final character is replaced by ellipsis with its background preserved.
Scrolled/follow state
offset is above zero or follow is active
top ▲ and bottom ◆ indicators appear.
More content
NAV is not at bottom and content exceeds viewport
bottom ▼ appears.
Indicator collision
corner cells contain text
ellipsis-space padding separates the indicator from content.

requirement: ListPane SHALL render copy feedback, scrollbar styles, and active or accepted input bars in the reserved bottom area with mode-specific labels, cursor rendering, and matcher status alignment.
contract: render SHALL paint a bottom-right `Copied!` toast only while state.copy_toast_active and space permits, then draw styled scrollbar track/thumb from scaled metrics. render_bottom_bar SHALL fill the bar background, label Search/Filter/GotoLine/Comment inputs left-aligned and render the textarea in the remaining area, or right-align a dim `[filter: query]`/`[search: query]` status for an accepted matcher.
scenarios: Copy toast
toast is active and content area is wider than eight columns
Copied! is painted at the bottom right with toast foreground/bold modifier.
Active input
an input mode is open
the correct prompt label and textarea occupy the reserved rows.
Accepted matcher
input is closed but a matcher remains
a dim mode/query status is right-aligned.
Scrollbar style
content overflows or fits
track/thumb are painted through render_scrollbar_styled using pane style colors and stored area geometry.
Comment input
bottom bar height allows multiple rows
the textarea receives the full multiline bar area.

requirement: ListPane rendering SHALL keep desired-height, layout, wrapping, and match-highlight coordinates consistent for long/styled lines, including the two-column scrollbar width reduction and corrective phase.
contract: The renderer SHALL pass the same area width to desired-height and word wrapping for content items; prepare_layout’s scrollbar-aware width must match the content area chosen by render. Match highlighting SHALL align plain search offsets with styled spans and wrapped rows. Long items SHALL clip by viewport without corrupting prefix/layout, and scaled scrollbar rendering SHALL use the same scaled total/offset inputs as layout state.
scenarios: Long wrapped line
content exceeds multiple rows
all desired wrapped rows render when viewport permits and layout height matches wrapping.
Styled search line
content spans have ANSI-derived styles but plain search text
highlight cells spell the matched text at correct wrapped positions.
Scrollbar width
overflow reduces content width by two columns
layout heights are computed at the narrower width so text is not truncated.
Heavy few items
item count does not prove scrollbar but total wrapped height overflows
the corrective narrow-width phase still produces complete content.
Filter shrink
filtered items are removed after a prepared frame
render remains bounded and paints the new filtered rows.

requirement: The list renderer SHALL preserve its inline regression matrix for basic/filtered/selected/empty rendering, scroll clipping, truncation ellipsis, selection-plus-highlight layering, wrapped styled search coordinates, long-line completeness, scrollbar width correction, and filter shrink safety. These tests are source evidence for Buffer-level behavior and do not prove a real terminal.
contract: The 27 inline tests SHALL exercise ListPane StatefulWidget rendering with fixture ListItems, including long tracing lines and styled spans. They establish the documented overlay order and width fixes at the ratatui Buffer boundary; they do not establish crossterm delivery, real terminal glyph width, or external scrollbar input.
scenarios: Basic state
items are empty, selected, filtered, or scrolled
Buffer rows reflect the visible selection/filter state without panic.
Overlay regressions
selection and search overlap or content truncates
background, REVERSED highlight, and ellipsis behavior remain stable.
Wrap regressions
long or styled lines are rendered
height/content and match coordinates remain complete across wrapped rows.
Scrollbar regressions
overflow occurs with many or few heavy items
both width-reduction phases avoid truncation and shrink/filter remains safe.

Stale recents
the picker was interacted with or closed before completion
the completion does not replace user options or mutate session/cwd state.
Draft preservation
a prompt/model/preferred id is supplied before selection
CreateSession carries model and preferred id and the prompt remains attached exactly once.
Duplicate callback
ProjectSelected is dispatched twice
only the first creates a session; the late callback is a no-op.

requirement: Session deletion, exit, titles, and resolver identity remain coherent
contract: ExitSession SHALL unregister the active session and return to Welcome. DeleteSession SHALL emit the requested delete effect; DeleteCurrentSession SHALL require confirmation, cancel the turn/subagents before deleting, and after completion remove only the matching agent while preserving another active agent. Session titles SHALL fall back to a short id, and dashboard persisted top-level/subagent ids SHALL round-trip through SessionIdResolver.
scenarios: Exit
ExitSession is dispatched
UnregisterActiveSession is emitted and Welcome becomes active.
Confirmed delete
current deletion is confirmed
CancelTurn precedes DeleteSession with Welcome continuation.
Completion guard
a delete completion arrives for one of multiple agents
only the matching agent is removed and the survivor remains active; unknown background task completion is ignored.
Title fallback
a session has no prompt
the title is `session ` plus the short session id.
Resolver round trip
top-level or child persisted ids are resolved
live dashboard ids resolve and convert back exactly; absent ids return None.
Dormant roster projection
a picker entry has title, cwd, model, worktree label, timestamp and origin data
the resulting roster row is dormant/nonresident and preserves the tested identity and metadata fields.
Dormant entry
a picker entry supplies identity, location and timestamps
the roster row preserves those fields with Dormant activity and resident=false.
Activity fallback
last_active_at is absent
updated_at supplies last_change_unix_ms.
Blank summary
the summary is empty or whitespace
the roster title is None.

requirement: Dashboard stop interaction deletes the selected row and advances peek selection
contract: DashboardStop SHALL support the real double Ctrl-X input path: the first press arms confirmation, the second emits DeleteSession for the selected top-level row, and completion removes the agent. When peek is open, deleting the selected row SHALL move selection to the next row and subsequent render SHALL follow the new row.
scenarios: Peek open stop
the selected row has an open peek and Ctrl-X is pressed twice
the row is deleted, selection advances one row, and peek follows the new selection.
Top-level confirmation
a top-level row receives two Ctrl-X events through handle_input
the second event emits DeleteSession and the completed deletion removes the target.

requirement: Lifecycle tests define synthetic verification boundaries for dispatch integration
contract: The 70 inline tests in lifecycle.rs SHALL be treated as static evidence for dispatch state/effect contracts only. They construct synthetic AppView, agents, paths, trust stores, dashboard buffers, and test task results; they do not prove compilation, Cargo execution, real ACP delivery, terminal event-loop behavior, filesystem watcher timing, or integration with unexamined callers.
scenarios: Synthetic dispatch
tests call dispatch or dispatch_task_result with constructed state
state transitions and Effect vectors are asserted directly.
Filesystem fixtures
trust/project tests use temp dirs and git markers
identity, cwd, and effect behavior is asserted for the fixture only.
Dashboard input
dashboard tests synthesize Ctrl-X and Ratatui buffers
selection/delete/peek state is asserted without a live terminal.

requirement: Task output line-count badge formatting
contract: format_line_count_badge SHALL return no badge for zero, use exact truncating SI thresholds for raw counts, decimal/whole thousands and millions, and append `+` only when a nonzero rolling buffer is truncated.
scenarios: Zero
count is zero
empty badge is returned even when truncated.
SI scaling
count crosses a threshold
the expected truncated k/M form is returned.
Truncated
buffer dropped data
a plus suffix is added.

requirement: Background task labels, syntax highlighting, monitors, and stable identity
contract: TaskEntry::from_bg_task SHALL prefer trimmed descriptions with a searchable `Task` prefix, collapse description newlines, fall back to a single-line command when absent/blank, syntax-highlight bare commands with dim finished styling, render monitor rows as an accent `Monitor` tag plus neutral description, and hash task ids deterministically in a namespace distinct from agents.
scenarios: Description
a nonblank task description exists
the one-line searchable label and styled Task prefix are used.
Monitor
is_monitor is true
Monitor tag styling is used instead of bash highlighting.
Identity
same task is converted repeatedly or collides with agent id
stable id is deterministic and namespaced.

requirement: Tasks pane overlay status badges and restored-task auto-show
contract: TasksPane SHALL render status icons/spinners, elapsed/killing text, line-count badges and kill/view controls without label bleed; restored replay tasks SHALL not trigger the 0→N auto-open edge while new live tasks do.
scenarios: Output
stdout_line_count is nonzero
compact badge appears beside status/time.
Truncated
stdout was capped
badge has plus marker.
Replay/live
restored and new running tasks are synced
restored task leaves overlay closed; new live task opens it.

requirement: Tasks pane search-bar and scroll-indicator layout
contract: render SHALL keep the ListPane search/filter bottom bar free of overlay controls, add one desired-height row for the bar, truncate scheduled labels before kill buttons, and reserve centered ▲/▼ rows only when content is above/below the viewport.
scenarios: Search
input/filter bar is open
overlay area shrinks below the bar and desired height grows one row.
Overflow
list exceeds viewport
centered down arrow is shown; at bottom only up arrow remains.
Tight row
scheduled prompt is long
text truncates before kill control with no bleed.

requirement: Task synchronization sorting, visibility, and group headers
contract: sync_at SHALL rebuild live task, subagent, scheduled, and workflow entries, hide completed items by default, sort workflow/subagent/task/monitor/scheduled types with running-first/newest/stable tie breaks, combine monitors and loops under Watchers while keeping monitor-before-loop order, insert labeled count headers, exclude workflow-owned child agents, and ignore replay-restored tasks for auto-open counting.
scenarios: Sync
source maps contain mixed task kinds
display items are rebuilt and grouped with headers.
Visibility
show_done is false
only active task/subagent/workflow rows remain.
Workflow child
subagent has workflow_run_id
child is excluded and workflow counts once.

requirement: Task group collapse and selection preservation
contract: toggle_group and set_group_collapsed SHALL hide/show group members while retaining the header, make arrow-style idempotent explicit setting return false when unchanged, preserve header selection after a change, and forget collapse state when a group empties so future items reopen expanded.
scenarios: Toggle
a group is toggled
header remains and items are hidden or restored.
Explicit
same collapse state is set twice
first call rebuilds/returns true; second is a no-op/false.
Empty/repopulate
collapsed group disappears then receives an item
stale collapse is forgotten and new item is visible.

requirement: Subagent labels, model metadata, activity, and styling
contract: TaskEntry::from_subagent SHALL use formatted/capitalized type labels, include description and optional model in searchable text, style running/pending/completed/failed states with appropriate vivid/blended colors, append live activity only to rendered text, and cap the displayed description to preserve activity while retaining full searchable label.
scenarios: Metadata
type/model/description fields exist
label contains normalized type, description, and model where present.
Activity
running activity exists
rendered line appends activity but searchable label does not.
Finished
activity is stale or row is finished
activity suffix disappears and long description is only capped when suffix needs space.

requirement: Scheduled task labels and countdown status
contract: TaskEntry::from_scheduled SHALL capitalize the tag, truncate long prompts safely by characters, show linked/running, provisional starting, RFC3339 future/past, approximate interval, or no suffix according to schedule state, and never panic on Unicode or malformed dates.
scenarios: Future
next_fire_at is future
label shows next-in duration.
Provisional
task id starts provisional-
label shows starting.
Past/bad
time is past or RFC3339 parse fails
due-now or approximate interval is shown.
Unknown/Unicode
schedule is unknown or prompt is multibyte
no invalid suffix/panic occurs and preview remains safe.

requirement: Workflow entries, phases, running-agent suffix, and stoppability
contract: TaskEntry::from_workflow_run SHALL style workflow rows by active/complete/terminal/paused status, include phase and count only running roster agents, derive elapsed time, and set stoppable from can_stop rather than is_active.
scenarios: Active
workflow is active
spinner/running styling and phase/agent suffix are shown.
Roster
mixed running/done workflow agents exist
suffix counts only running agents.
Paused/terminal
can_stop differs from is_active
stoppable follows can_stop and status styling reflects state.

requirement: Tasks pane visibility, dimensions, liveness, and input forwarding
contract: TasksPane SHALL initialize a configured searchable/filterable/copyable ListPane with clipboard provider and centered-indicator style; expose visibility/show_done/live-motion/running count, return zero height when hidden or viewport<12, cap visible height by 8 and 15%, and forward key/paste/scroll/mouse to ListPane while `h` toggles done mode outside input.
scenarios: Hidden
overlay is not visible
desired_height is zero and state input closes on state change.
Visible
running/entries exist
height is bounded and live motion reports running entries.
Input
key/paste/scroll/mouse arrives
ListPane receives it, with h toggling show_done only outside input mode.

requirement: Task selection and action identity projections
contract: TasksPane SHALL expose the selected entry and return task_id only for BgTask, subagent_id/child_session_id only for Agent, while headers and other kinds yield None; TaskEntry SHALL implement ListItem content/prefix/search/stable identity and all entries remain selectable.
scenarios: Selection
a row is selected
typed identity accessor returns its corresponding id.
Other/header
header or unrelated row is selected
inapplicable accessors return None.
List item
list renders/searches
content, prefix, searchable text, stable id, and selectability are provided.

requirement: Overlay controls for workflows, background tasks, agents, and scheduled watchers
contract: The overlay SHALL draw centered status icons and right-aligned elapsed/model/context/countdown text, reserve and clear its width with ellipsis, expose kill/view hit rectangles by TaskEntryId, show kill while running/pending, view for inspectable entries, and style hovered controls with semantic theme colors.
scenarios: Workflow
a workflow row is visible
stoppable active rows get kill hit; completion gets success/error icon.
Task/agent
row is running/done/pending
status/icon/button/elapsed/model/badge overlay is aligned and non-overpainting.
Scheduled
a watcher row is visible
kill always appears and view appears only when linked subagent exists.
Hover
kill/view id matches row
control color brightens and hit rect identifies the entry.

requirement: Scrollback identity, immutable event deduplication, minimal replay frontier, and continuation merge
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL keep transcript entries in insertion order under non-reused EntryId identity, deduplicate only immutable domain events carrying the same event id, maintain minimal-mode native-scrollback commitment by EntryId, and stage reconnect continuations in a shared monotonic id and invalidation-generation space. A full replay SHALL inherit native commitment only across a semantically equivalent committed prefix, permitting old local notices without durable identity to be skipped but treating durable notices or divergent blocks as a frontier stop. Tail merge SHALL preserve entry ids, running/dirty/committed state and advance both invalidation generations. The bounded expand history retains at most 256 folded committed ids.
scenarios: Immutable event identity
a durable event id is inserted repeatedly, removed, cleared, or rebuilt during merge
one indexed row represents that id while local notices without event ids remain distinct and removal/clear permits a later fresh insertion.
Replay commitment frontier
a rebuilt transcript is compared with previously committed native-scrollback entries
only the committed replay-equivalent common prefix is inherited, old local non-durable notices may be skipped, and durable or branch divergence stops inheritance.
Reconnect continuation identity
a fresh continuation is merged or discarded
EntryIds are not reused, view preferences survive staging, and generation floors advance beyond every state consumers may have cached.
Ordered access and removal
entries are read by index/id or removed
IndexMap order and O(1)-average id lookup remain aligned while auxiliary identity and commit indexes are updated.

requirement: Scrollback materialization, streaming mutation, hook attribution, and generation invalidation
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL own entry materialization and mutation invalidation: pushes allocate identity, apply the effective Edit display policy, index immutable events, update turns/layout incrementally when possible, and advance content plus link generations. Streaming agent, thinking, execute and hook mutations SHALL invalidate affected render/height state. Display, scroll, appearance and viewport-only changes SHALL leave content_generation unchanged. Edit replacement SHALL preserve Edit-to-Edit user mode except an untrusted-summary rising edge, honor pinned folds when configured, and reset genuine kind transitions to the new block default. Stop hooks SHALL attach only to the latest attributable terminal turn marker, with prompt identity required when stamped. Cwd changes invalidate every cwd-dependent entry cache.
scenarios: Edit materialization
an Edit is pushed or a placeholder/refinement is replaced
failed edits collapse, untrusted successful summaries expand, the appearance default controls trusted success, and eligible user display choices survive later Edit refinement.
Stop hook attribution
stop hooks arrive stamped, unstamped, repeated, or after interleaved rows
only the latest compatible turn-terminal marker accepts them and same-name or foreign-turn attachment is refused.
Streaming mutation
agent, thinking or execute content changes through typed mutation methods
only compatible existing block kinds mutate, their render/height cache is dirtied, and content/link generations advance.
Generation separation
content, display, scroll, resize or batching changes state
content changes advance both generations while view-only changes advance link geometry without redefining the searchable corpus, and the next layout preparation reconciles dirty or appended heights.

requirement: Running lifecycle, finish flash, pending input, and display-mode policy
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL track running entries separately from transcript order, request animation only for running rows overlapping the current viewport, and use an absolute finish-flash deadline for one final visible repaint. Finishing SHALL finalize supported streaming blocks, record completion time, remove running state, apply thinking/tool display policy, dirty layout and advance content generation. Pending-user-input flags SHALL be idempotent, participate in structural grouping, clear in bulk or on entry completion, and remain distinct from running state. Off-screen render-cache eviction SHALL preserve layout geometry.
scenarios: Viewport animation gate
running entries move outside or inside a prepared viewport
only visible running rows demand motion frames, with pre-layout state conservatively animated.
Finish deadline
a running row completes and its flash expires or the row is removed
periodic animation stops, one visible expiry repaint is requested, and stale flash ids drain.
Pending input
a row begins, repeats, resolves, completes, or is bulk-cleared from awaiting input
actual flag transitions are reported, group structure is dirtied, and no stale pending mark remains.
Thinking completion mode
streaming thinking was untouched, manually expanded, toggled back, or governed by sticky expansion
completion selects the corresponding collapsed or expanded resting mode.

requirement: Layout preparation, viewport snapshots, turn projection, and scroll geometry
