contract: ScrollbackState SHALL orchestrate a three-case layout preparation boundary: missing/width-changed cache causes a full rebuild and width-cache invalidation, dirty entries cause incremental height processing with structural or streaming virtual-position repair, and clean stable width recomputes current visible-range height. Follow mode, exact visible measurement and deferred warm-above processing run at that boundary. Viewport snapshots SHALL restore scroll/follow/selection/turn/width state and invalidate layout so the restored width is fully prepared again. Direct scroll positioning clamps to the available range and disables follow. Turn ranges and selection remain coherent at the tested prompt-delimited boundary.
scenarios: Layout case selection
width, height, cache presence or dirty-height state changes
width changes take full Case 1, dirty state takes Case 2, and stable clean or height-only changes remain Case 3.
Height and appearance
prompt vertical padding or appended entries change measured content
cached heights and total height reflect the effective appearance after preparation.
Turn navigation projection
prompt-delimited entries are selected or turn navigation moves
turn ranges, current turn, selection and pinned-prompt state remain coherent at the tested boundary.
Viewport snapshot
a temporary guest view mutates width, height, follow, selection, turn and scroll state
restore reinstates the captured interaction state, discards the guest layout cache and rebuilds at the restored width.

requirement: Permission epochs and ordered insertion preserve transcript and native commit invariants
contract: ScrollbackState SHALL aggregate subagent permission decisions into one stable running block per primary-turn permission epoch, ignoring intervening UI rows; terminal primary-turn completion seals that group and advances the epoch. Reconnect tail merge SHALL combine same-epoch members into the original open group, seal it when the tail crossed a terminal boundary, and retain post-terminal members in a new epoch. insert_block_before SHALL allocate a unique id, preserve anchor order and selection identity, rebuild positional turn state, pull the minimal commit cursor back to the insertion point, and fall back to append when the anchor vanished. Its uncommitted-anchor precondition is enforced only by debug_assert.
scenarios: Open permission epoch
multiple permission decisions arrive around unrelated UI rows before primary completion
one stable running group accumulates the epoch members without reordering those UI rows.
Reconnect permission merge
a continuation contains decisions before and/or after an epoch terminal
same-epoch members merge into the original group, the original seals, and later decisions remain a new running group.
Ordered insertion
a finalized block is inserted before a live uncommitted anchor
it receives a unique id at the anchor position, selection stays with its prior entry, turns rebuild, and the native commit scan cannot skip it.
Missing or committed anchor
the anchor disappeared or was already committed
missing anchors append, while committed anchors violate the documented precondition and panic only in debug builds.

requirement: Pager terminal marker stop hook stash identity folding
contract: Stop hook batches SHALL be accepted only for the newest eligible turn-terminal marker: stamped batches require a matching prompt id, unstamped batches are tail-only, newer terminal markers stop the walk, and a repeated hook name is refused. Accepted hooks attach to the marker, force collapsed presentation unless pinned, and standalone lifecycle hooks form collapsed tool-like rows.
scenarios: Hook attribution
a stop or stop_failure batch is stamped, unstamped, interleaved or repeated
only the attributable latest terminal marker accepts it and the same event name cannot be attached twice.
Hook presentation
accepted hooks are attached or a lifecycle hook is pushed
hook data is retained and the marker defaults to collapsed unless display mode is pinned.

requirement: Quit, update restart, and screen-mode relaunch safety
contract: dispatch SHALL unregister active sessions before Quit/RestartForUpdate, mark update restart intent, and allow screen-mode relaunch only when all agents/subagents have no unsettled turn/replay/reload work; blocked relaunches toast, permitted relaunches record session/control handoffs before quitting.
scenarios: Quit
quit or update restart is requested
sessions are unregistered and Quit is emitted.
Relaunch
work is unsettled or settled
blocked requests toast; settled requests capture handoffs and quit.

requirement: Session lifecycle, worktree, load, picker, and card routing
contract: The router SHALL delegate session creation/exit/delete/load/fork/worktree/picker actions, initialize new-worktree dialog state, and toggle session/content card expansion while loading missing card detail with generation/session/cwd context.
scenarios: Lifecycle
a session action arrives
the matching lifecycle handler receives arguments.
Card
a card is expanded
expanded state toggles or missing detail emits LoadCardDetail.
Delete arm
the selected map item points to a valid fuzzy session or content hit
PendingDelete captures the backing session id and cwd; headers, missing rows and invalid indices return None.
Delete confirmation
an armed delete receives unmodified y, n or another key
y returns Confirm with the payload, n returns Cancel, another key returns Disarmed, and the arm is cleared in all three cases.
Delete event gate
the pending state is absent or the event is modified, non-press or non-key
PendingDeleteKey::NotArmed is returned and the arm is not consumed.
Selection re-anchor
picker rows are rebuilt after filtering/content changes
a matching stable id is selected first; otherwise a selectable fallback near the old index is chosen and scroll delta is clamped.
Worktree shortcut
Ctrl-W is a press and the selected map item is valid
Fuzzy returns its original index, Content returns cloned session id/cwd, and empty/header/missing data returns Unavailable.
Expansion sync
the picker query or server query stamp changes
the effective query drives a rebuilt map and expansion keys are remapped to backing indices.
Loading spinner gate
entries are absent/empty or visible and loading varies
the spinner is active only for loading with no visible entries.
Deferred startup
session_startup_allowed is false when LoadSession is dispatched
the request is stored as DeferredSessionStartup::Load and no effect is returned.
Existing session
an agent already owns the requested session id
the existing agent is selected with SwitchCause::Load and no new agent or LoadSession effect is created.
New load
no existing agent owns the id and startup is allowed
a new AgentView begins replay, receives app prompt/configuration gates and bootstrap commands, and emits Effect::LoadSession with the requested id and cwd.
Picker resolution
a selected picker row resolves locally in the current cwd or another cwd
normal loading receives None or the original cwd respectively; an unresolved id produces a toast and no effect.
Worktree pick
a selected picker row is chosen for a worktree
dispatch_new_worktree_session receives the selected session id after the picker state is cleared.
Content pick
a deep-search hit is selected
welcome picker fields are reset and the same local/original-cwd resolution, existing-session focus, or local-miss behavior is used.

requirement: Prompt, queue, focus, and scrollback navigation routing
contract: dispatch SHALL route prompt/follow-up/slash-preserving/bash/interject/steer/clear/history actions, map shared queue mutations to active-session effects or no-op without a session, switch active panes, open scrollback search, and perform navigation/scroll/fold operations with selection clearing where required.
scenarios: Prompt
prompt/queue/navigation action arrives
specialized handler or scrollback mutation runs.
Shared queue
active session exists
matching Queue effect carries session id; otherwise no-op.

requirement: Scrollback fold, raw, debug, copy, export, and viewer actions
contract: The router SHALL mutate selected scrollback fold/raw/expand state, toggle mouse/scroll/fps diagnostics and notices, delegate copy/assistant/export/transcript actions, expand groups before opening a block viewer, and ignore extension modals when plugins are disabled.
scenarios: Fold
fold/view action arrives
scrollback state changes and viewer opens only if no group expansion consumed it.
Debug
debug action arrives
state toggles and notices/logging update.
Selected block copy
a selected entry is visible and has copyable content
the block text is copied in its raw/pretty mode; a background task uses current central stdout.
Hidden or empty block
no entry is selected, content is group-hidden, or copied text is empty
the dispatcher returns without clipboard mutation.
Assistant ordinal
the requested ordinal exceeds available assistant messages or the selected text is empty
a notice explains the count or empty content and no file/clipboard delivery occurs.
Export file
Markdown content exists and a file path is supplied
tilde expansion, parent directory creation, and file writing occur; success or failure is recorded as a notice.
Transcript pager
minimal mode or a nonminimal mode receives OpenTranscriptPager
minimal mode arms the incremental minimal request; other modes write a temporary Markdown file and set pending pager path/ANSI state.
Block viewer
a selected block has normal fullscreen content, image-only content, or unsupported image graphics
the appropriate BlockViewerPane is installed, native media is opened, or image support is guarded.

requirement: Extensions, MCP, hooks, plugins, skills, and model controls
contract: For active bound sessions, extension/MCP/hook/plugin/skill actions SHALL emit matching effects and loading states; inactive/sessionless actions SHALL no-op; model, effort, and agent changes SHALL defer before binding or enqueue session control after binding, gated by reconnect.
scenarios: Bound
active agent has session id
matching effect includes agent/session/action.
Unbound
agent/session is absent
no effect is emitted or control is deferred.
MCP list request
a session id is supplied
the request method is the shell LIST constant and params decode to that sessionId.
Wrapped ACP detail
invalid-params data contains message and promptUsage
the message detail is returned.
Rate limit fallback
a rate-limit error has no usable detail
the canonical rate-limit user message is returned.
MCP request
a session id is supplied
the extension request method is the shell LIST constant and its parameters decode to that sessionId.
Wrapped detail
InvalidParams data contains a message-bearing detail
the detail text is returned directly.
Rate-limit fallback
a rate-limit error has no usable detail
the rate-limit user message is returned and sanitized.
Technical error
an ordinary ACP error contains protocol or internal service jargon
the replacement and truncation rules of sanitize_user_error are applied.

requirement: Announcements, task controls, catalog, and status actions
contract: The router SHALL persist changed announcement hide/show state, open only the validated current promo CTA, delegate turn/task/subagent/scheduled controls, and route bundle/catalog/session/tutorial/trajectory/context/usage/queue/task/plan actions with active-session guards for trajectory.
scenarios: Announcement
hide/show/CTA action arrives
hidden ids persist only on changes and CTA uses validated slot target.
Trajectory
no active session exists
toast is shown and no launch effect is emitted.

requirement: Behavior, notes, settings, themes, preferences, and modal routes
contract: The router SHALL delegate behavior/plan/remember/BTW/recap actions, every settings setter/toggle/preview, and settings/palette/help/reset modal actions to their dedicated handlers so persistence and UI state remain centralized.
scenarios: Behavior
mode/note/recap action arrives
specialized handler runs.
Setting/modal
setter or modal action arrives
corresponding setting or modal handler runs.
Slash gate
auto_mode_gate is enabled or disabled and permission modes change
always-approve remains offered; /auto is offered only while the gate is enabled.
Permission cross-switch
the user submits /always-approve, /auto or the same command again
the active session switches to the requested mode, clears the opposite mode and remains stable on re-selection.
Session notification
SetPermissionMode changes the active session to always-approve or ask
one NotifySessionPermissionMode carries the canonical value and session id while the default permission mode remains unchanged.
Plan-aware warning
always-approve is enabled while confirmed or optimistic Plan mode is active
the plan-aware toast is shown; without Plan the destructive always-approve warning is shown.
Queue drain safety
always-approve is enabled with one or more queued permission requests
the queue is emptied, AllowOnce options receive Selected responses, and the armed double-click tracker is cleared.
No AllowOnce fallback
a queued permission exposes AllowAlways and RejectAlways but no AllowOnce
the drain sends Cancelled instead of selecting a more-permissive or permanent option.
Duplicate enable
a second always-approve dispatch occurs after a new permission arrives or with no state transition
newly queued work is still drained, one session notification/toast is re-emitted, and no redundant PersistPermissionMode effect is emitted by PermissionSelect when the flag is already on.
No active agent
SetPermissionMode(AlwaysApprove) is dispatched from Welcome with no active agent
no effect or shared default/UI mutation occurs.

requirement: Permissions, URLs, links, trust, search, and content session routing
contract: Permission actions SHALL delegate; OpenUrl SHALL distinguish file paths from URL opening with failure toasts; OpenLink SHALL resolve OSC8 file/URL targets; link cycling mutates the active agent; trust/deep-search/content-session/delete actions are guarded and stale picker deletion is ignored.
scenarios: URL
file/URL/link action arrives
safe opener or file opener runs with appropriate toast.
Delete
session picker entry is stale
no delete effect is emitted.

requirement: Fork, doctor fixes, memory, external editor, and dashboard entry
contract: Fork/new-session answers SHALL apply persistent worktree choices; DoctorFix confirmation SHALL validate session binding, show progress, and emit ApplyDoctorFix or warning; memory/editor actions SHALL require a bound session/empty editor slot; dashboard entry/exit/dispatch actions SHALL delegate.
scenarios: Doctor
fix target is stale/current
warning or ApplyDoctorFix with progress feedback results.
Memory/editor
session/editor is unavailable/available
send/editor request is guarded and duplicate editor request is prevented.

requirement: Dashboard, goal/workflow, task-result, rewind, and jump routing
contract: Dashboard actions SHALL delegate attach/dispatch/stop/delete/reorder/overlay/location/permission/question/reply operations and mutate local filter/focus state; TaskComplete SHALL enter task-result handling; goal/workflow toggles update active view state; rewind/jump actions delegate picker/confirmation flows.
scenarios: Dashboard
dashboard action arrives
matching handler/state mutation runs.
Goal/replay
goal/workflow/rewind/jump action arrives
view state or specialized flow changes.

requirement: Extension action-result reconciliation
contract: dispatch_action_result SHALL clear pending state and show errors for failures, record time-limited success notices, request reload when required, otherwise refresh hooks/plugins/marketplace/MCP lists, and turn ConfirmationRequired into a confirmation modal with confirmed uninstall action.
scenarios: Failure
extension result is Err or terminal failure
pending state clears and modal error is shown.
Success
result succeeds
notice and reload/list refresh effects are emitted.
Confirmation
confirmation is required
confirmation action/pending row is stored.

requirement: Sleep-inhibitor synchronization after dispatch
contract: After every non-early-return action arm, dispatch SHALL call sync_sleep_inhibitor(app) before returning effects; explicit guard returns intentionally bypass this tail.
scenarios: Normal
arm completes normally
sleep inhibitor is synchronized.
Guard
arm returns early
defined guard result is returned immediately.

requirement: Task results route session, worktree, fork, picker, roster, search, and dashboard completion states
contract: dispatch_task_result SHALL route session/worktree creation and failure, fork readiness/failure, loaded sessions, session titles, session lists, project-picker recents, dashboard location/session lists, session search debounce, card detail, roster, and dashboard task results to their domain handlers. Direct roster/dashboard loading updates SHALL replace the corresponding in-memory collection and clear its loading flag; stale or unknown task targets SHALL produce no effects.
scenarios: Session lifecycle
a session/worktree/fork/load result arrives
the matching lifecycle handler receives every payload including models, cwd, restore metadata and foreground state.
Picker/search
recents, search debounce or card detail completes
the session/load handler receives its agent, picker, query, sequence or generation identity.
Roster/dashboard
roster or dashboard sessions complete or fail
collections/loading flags update locally and failures are debug-only no-op state cleanup.
Title from disk
a nonblank title result arrives
manual titles fill display_name only when absent while generated_session_title is updated.
Session search
FetchSessionList receives a query
the wire request includes query, limit and cwd without allowRelax, and the loaded result echoes query/seq with non-relaxed scope.
Session browse
FetchSessionList has no query
the wire request omits query, enables allowRelax, and a grow/listScope repo response yields relaxed scope.
Session list failure
the list request returns an error
SessionListFailed echoes the original query and sequence.
Workflow list
FetchWorkflowsList receives an agent and session id
the wire request contains sessionId without cwd and the result retains both identities.
Search debounce
DebounceSessionSearch receives query and sequence
the task result echoes both values after the tested delay.

requirement: Prompt status results reconcile watchdog state, durable terminal boundaries, and queued follow-ups
contract: PromptStatusResolved SHALL ignore results for a different current prompt, adopt server Running timing only once, release locally drained prompts on Queued, finalize durable Terminal results through the agent turn finalizer, and recover Unknown/error outcomes to Idle with a toast and queue drain unless a currently running turn should only refresh liveness. Control completions SHALL honor stale control tokens and authoritative-update-pending semantics; successful behavior transport alone SHALL not commit a mode. Compact, cancel, subagent-kill, background-task, changelog and preferred-model results SHALL update their targeted local state without fabricating duplicate terminal events.
scenarios: Stale prompt status
the result prompt id differs from current_prompt_id
the result is ignored without clearing current status.
Running/queued
a current prompt is submitting and status is Running or Queued
turn timing or local submission state is updated once and queue/peek page-flip behavior is preserved.
Terminal/unknown/error
a matching prompt is terminal, Unknown, or query fails
durable finalization or Idle recovery occurs; the latter shows the error and drains queued prompts.
Control completion
SwitchAgent/Behavior/Model result is stale, authoritative-pending, or failed
stale/authoritative responses are suppressed; compatible failures become terminal notices and deferred controls drain only when safe.

requirement: Clipboard and image task results apply target ownership, host-image fallback, and stale overlay guards
contract: ClipboardAttachmentProbed SHALL apply the local attachment to the original AgentPrompt or dashboard target, drain deferred sends, optionally request a host image only for FullMiss or recoverable AttachmentRead failure from a clipboard key, suppress duplicate X11/failure toasts when that request is emitted, and otherwise report target-specific failures. ImageViewerLoaded SHALL require the current overlay owner id, route root versus child viewers, apply loaded data, or close and toast on failure. Prompt image preview completion remains a no-op.
scenarios: Clipboard success
a probe result targets an existing agent/dashboard
attachment completion is applied to that target and deferred sends are drained.
Host fallback
clipboard-key completion is FullMiss or AttachmentRead failure
the wrap host-image request may be emitted and the corresponding local failure/X11 hint is suppressed.
Missing target
the target agent/dashboard no longer exists
completion is Dropped and no send effect is created.
Stale image load
owner_id does not match the active viewer
the image result is ignored; matching success applies data and matching failure closes with a toast.

requirement: Doctor and session metadata results are gated by target identity while failures reach the correct surface
contract: DoctorFixPlanned SHALL validate cwd, session binding epoch and optional session id before delivering a listing, opening a plan question, displaying a local command, or reporting a preparation error; a stale target SHALL produce a cancellation warning. DoctorFixApplied SHALL clear live feedback and deliver formatted success/error text. SessionInfo success SHALL require the current session and metadata revision before applying name/context, while context and failure paths follow their dedicated nonce/modal handling; rename, usage and delete results update scrollback, modal data, rosters, agents and dashboard selection as appropriate.
scenarios: Stale doctor target
cwd/session/epoch no longer matches
the fix is cancelled with a warning and no plan is opened.
Doctor plan
a valid plan result is Listing, Plan, RunLocally, or error
the corresponding notice, question, local instruction, or formatted error is delivered.
Metadata revision
SessionAgentNameResolved or SessionInfoComplete has stale identity/revision
no agent metadata is applied.
Delete completion
a session delete completes with Stay, Welcome, or Dashboard
pickers/rosters/agents are cleaned, unregister effects are emitted, and dashboard neighbor/focus or Welcome transition is selected.
Usage/context
context or usage succeeds/fails with a nonce
the dedicated status handler applies only the permitted live/modal projection.
Provider identity
session info reports the provider BYOK backend
the formatted text includes Auth method: provider BYOK.
Resolved model
resolved model differs and the display flag is enabled
the requested and resolved models appear in the documented parenthesized form.
Resolved model hidden
display is disabled or requested and resolved ids match
the resolved id is absent or not repeated in parentheses.
Model fingerprint
a fingerprint exists with catalog visibility enabled or a coding slug
Model Hash is shown.
Fingerprint hidden
a noncoding model has a fingerprint but the catalog flag is disabled
Model Hash is absent.

requirement: Extension, CTA, catalog, bundle, and command-refresh results update only their owning UI projections
contract: Extension and catalog task results SHALL clear pending modal actions where applicable, project success/error into TabDataState, retry or advance plugin CTA phases through the dedicated CTA handlers, and preserve session/plugin identity checks defined by those handlers. AvailableCommandsRefreshed SHALL replace command facts only when nonempty and bump generation while refreshing workflow capabilities. Bundle status SHALL replace cache/version/agent/skill facts; catalog entries SHALL open a plain-text block viewer for the active agent or append a load-failure notice.
scenarios: Extension list
MCP, hooks, plugins, skills, workflows, marketplace or toggle results arrive
the matching modal/handler stores Loaded or Error data and clears pending action state as defined.
MCP setup
setup succeeds or fails for an existing modal/session
pending fields clear, errors remain in the modal, and success schedules a fresh MCP list fetch when bound.
CTA lifecycle
install/reload/catalog/debounce/dismiss results arrive
the corresponding CTA handler or phase timeout runs and unrelated agents remain untouched.
Command facts
a nonempty command refresh arrives
the session command list and generation update and workflow capabilities refresh.
Bundle/catalog
bundle or catalog result arrives
bundle facts replace in memory and active-agent catalog content opens in a block viewer or a notice records failure.
Success status
a marketplace outcome has Success status
marketplace_outcome_succeeded returns true.
Failure status
a marketplace outcome has InternalError status
marketplace_outcome_succeeded returns false.
Update dispatch
marketplace listing contains an update-available plugin and its update action fails
one matching update action is observed, the task result carries the tested agent id, and no success notification is sent.
Install error projection
the matched CTA install returns a transport error
the owning CTA enters Error with the plugin name and exact install message.
Reload error projection
an install requiring reload is followed by a reload transport error
the owning CTA enters Error with the plugin name and exact reload message.
MCP error projection
an AwaitingMcps CTA receives a transport error
the owning CTA enters Error with the plugin name and exact MCP message and the extensions modal remains absent.
Success status
the marketplace outcome status is Success
the helper returns true.
Failure status
the marketplace outcome status is not Success
the helper returns false.
Reload preservation
a marketplace response arrives after the first load
existing marketplace row/source collapse sets remain unchanged while the new sanitized data is loaded.
Initial marketplace load
marketplace data is still Loading when a successful response arrives
each source and its plugin rows are inserted into collapsed indices, including an extra slot for empty/error sources.
Pending action release
a plugins, marketplace, or skills result arrives
pending_action and pending_entry_index are cleared on the owning modal.
MCP follow-up
a bound MCP toggle succeeds
the result handler returns a FetchMcpsList effect tied to the same agent/session.

requirement: Interjection, slash-command, recap, note, trajectory, and rewind results preserve optimistic or reviewable state
contract: InterjectFailed SHALL requeue the original text, wire blocks, explicit images and constructed chip ranges at the front with requires_review=true when the agent still exists, without mutating the composer. Slash command errors SHALL distinguish already-published/unknown outcomes from rejected requests: unknown outcomes become live feedback, while rejected commands append a terminal notice. Trajectory, recap, memory-note, BTW and interject queue results delegate to their domain handlers; rewind and deep-search results route to their handlers and clear failed state as specified.
scenarios: Interject failure
an interjection or image preparation fails
a new local queue id holds the original payload and explicit image chips for review.
Slash transport ambiguity
an error lacks proof of rejection
live feedback says outcome is unknown and no competing terminal is appended.
Slash rejection
the server rejects invalid request/params/method
live feedback clears and a command terminal notice explains the sanitized reason.
Rewind/search/note
deep-search, rewind, BTW, memory-note, trajectory or recap results arrive
the corresponding handler updates the targeted UI and no unrelated agent receives the result.
Skill token ranges
plain prompt content receives nonempty token ranges
text is unchanged and meta.skillTokenRanges contains the byte pairs.
Empty metadata
plain prompt content receives no ranges
meta is absent.
Screen mode metadata
prompt request meta receives a configured or absent screen mode
promptId is always present and screenMode is present only when configured.
Canonical interjection content
an interjection has text with no blocks or has supplied blocks
params use the canonical content array and omit the parallel text field.

requirement: Prompt and shell suggestion debounce results respect agent mode and generation while preserving pending-tab behavior
contract: SuggestionDebounceExpired SHALL delegate generation-gated prompt suggestions. ShellSuggestionsLoaded SHALL only update an existing Bash-mode agent, project the parsed response into the controller, restore the current request text, and consume a pending Tab by emitting shell completion. PromptSuggestionLoaded SHALL update the suggestion controller and visibility gate for the owning agent. Transport/parse failures are handled by their task producer and CancelComplete remains an acknowledgement with no state mutation here.
scenarios: Shell result
a Bash agent receives a valid suggestion response
suggestions load for that agent/request and an armed pending Tab may emit shell completion.
Wrong mode/agent
the agent is missing or not in Bash mode
the result is ignored without effects.
Prompt suggestion
a prompt suggestion result arrives
the controller loads it for the agent and refresh/log visibility are recomputed.
Debounce
prompt or CTA debounce expires
the corresponding generation-aware handler is invoked.
Newest update
a queued burst contains multiple queries and two Some corpus values
drain_to_latest keeps the newest query/generation and newest Some corpus.
Corpus carry-forward
a later Update carries corpus=None after an earlier Some corpus
the earlier corpus remains available while the later query/generation wins.
Stop priority
Stop follows a queued Update
drain_to_latest returns stop=true without applying a later scan.
Stale snapshot rejection
the daemon snapshot has an old generation, mismatched query or an ABA intermediate query
poll returns false and leaves matches/cursor unchanged until the current generation/query arrives.
Stable cursor
poll observes the same request generation repeatedly after navigation
poll returns false and does not snap the cursor back to the first match.
Coalesced end-to-end burst
several query updates are sent without polling and corpus content is unchanged
the worker reuses its held corpus, superseded snapshots are ignored and the final query result is applied.

requirement: Setting persistence results rollback typed values or preserve optimistic best-effort state
contract: SettingPersisted SHALL only trace success and return no effects. SettingPersistFailed SHALL call apply_setting_rollback with the provided canonical rollback value, scrub the error for a toast, and return any rollback companion effects. SettingPersistFailedBestEffort SHALL keep the optimistic in-memory value, emit no rollback effect, and show only the scrubbed failure toast.
scenarios: Persist success
a setting write succeeds
the result is traced and no UI effect is produced.
Ordinary failure
a typed setting write fails with rollback value
the matching setting state is rolled back, a sanitized error toast is shown, and companion effects are returned.
Best effort failure
a best-effort write fails
the optimistic state remains and only the sanitized failure toast is shown.

requirement: Task-result utility helpers unregister sessions, route clipboard notices, and deliver doctor messages safely
contract: unregister_session_effect SHALL create one UnregisterActiveSession effect only for Some session ids, while unregister_all_active_sessions SHALL enumerate every bound agent. Clipboard notice helpers SHALL route messages to the owning agent or dashboard. current_doctor_target SHALL accept only matching cwd/session/epoch bindings (or the documented pre-bind transition), and deliver_doctor_message SHALL prefer the requested agent, then active/first agent, else append a startup warning with severity derived from notice tone.
scenarios: Unregister
a session id is present or absent
one exact unregister effect or an empty vector is returned; bulk enumeration covers all bound agents.
Clipboard target
a paste hint/failure targets an agent or dashboard
the toast/info message reaches that surface when it still exists.
Doctor destination
preferred agent exists, active agent exists, or no agent exists
message is appended to the preferred/active/first scrollback or to startup warnings.
Lock-free unregister
a registered session is unregistered with an available lock
the registry becomes empty.
Contended unregister
the registry lock is held by another owner
the helper returns within the tested deadline and leaves the entry for crash collection.
I/O failure
the registry root cannot be used as a directory
the helper returns without propagating a panic.
Removed
the active-session registry removes the requested id
the helper returns without a warning.
Lock contention
try_unregister_in reports false
the helper returns and records that crash collection will reap the entry later.
I/O error
try_unregister_in returns an error
the helper warns and does not propagate a panic.

requirement: Typed confirmation, cancel, reset, and Goal-interrupt choices expose stable labels and results
contract: ModalConfirmation<R> SHALL resolve only keys declared by its typed options. EditConfirm SHALL provide y/save, n/discard, x/delete and dynamic labels that distinguish save/discard from send when drain is blocked. ResetSettings SHALL provide y/reset and n/cancel with stable footer ids. CancelTurnChoice SHALL expose four ordered choices. GoalInterruptChoice SHALL offer pause-only when no turn is active and pause/stop-turn/(optional) stop-subagents when a turn is active, with labels matching the semantic action.
scenarios: Edit confirmation
a key is pressed in the edit modal
the matching typed result resolves and labels reflect whether sending is blocked.
Reset confirmation
reset settings is opened
y resolves Reset, n resolves Cancel, and the footer ids remain 1 and 2.
Goal interrupt
an active Goal has zero or more running subagents
choices include only meaningful pause/stop actions and labels identify their scope.

requirement: ActiveModal models picker, documentation, settings, memory, note, usage, and confirmation contexts with reversible palette state
contract: ActiveModal SHALL represent every supported modal context with its associated picker/window/content state. PaletteSnapshot SHALL preserve command-palette entries and PickerState for return from ArgPicker or picker flows. hint_pairs SHALL expose only blocking confirmation options; other modal variants SHALL return no bar hints. message SHALL provide context-sensitive titles, including model reasoning-effort submenus and Settings/Usage/DocViewer titles. Reset prompt/breadcrumb SHALL resolve registry metadata and defaults, returning None for unrelated or unknown keys.
scenarios: Palette return
an arg picker or doc picker was opened from the palette
the saved entries and picker state are retained for restoration on Esc.
Blocking modal
EditConfirm or ResetSettingsConfirm is active
hint_pairs returns typed key/label pairs; picker/read-only modal variants return empty pairs.
Context title
a modal variant is active
message returns its appropriate title or dynamic prompt.
Reset text
the modal carries a registered or unknown setting key
prompt/breadcrumb show the label/default for a known key and return None for unknown/non-reset variants.

requirement: Command palette entries are grouped, mode-filtered, searchable, and routed to registered commands or tool tabs
contract: default_palette_entries SHALL build grouped Session, Context, Model & Input, Tools and Other entries with slash commands, shortcuts, palette-only actions and tool-tab targets. Unsupported slash commands SHALL be removed for the active ScreenMode, EditPromptExternal SHALL appear only in Minimal mode, and every remaining slash row SHALL name a registered command. filter_palette_entries SHALL case-fold query text, match labels or shortcuts, and retain a section header only when that section has a matching item.
scenarios: Fullscreen palette
the palette opens in Fullscreen
dashboard, session, model, tool, settings, documentation and registered slash rows are available.
Minimal palette
the palette opens in Minimal
mode-gated theme/agents/tutorial rows are removed while mode-agnostic rows remain and external prompt editing is present.
Search
a nonempty query matches an item label or shortcut
the matching item and its section header are returned; unrelated headers are omitted.
Tool routing
Hooks/Plugins/Marketplace/Skills/MCP entries are selected
each entry carries the corresponding ExtensionsTab.

requirement: Confirmation overlay dims the background and produces bounded clickable button hit regions
contract: render_modal_overlay SHALL dim the supplied background area, render the active modal message and available key/label pills in the bar, apply hover styling to the matching key, and return button rectangles with their keys. Zero-height or too-narrow bars SHALL render no buttons. Button layout SHALL stop when the next pill would exceed bar width and use Unicode display width for sizing.
scenarios: Normal overlay
a blocking modal and sufficiently wide bar are rendered
background cells are dimmed, message/buttons are styled, and hit rectangles correspond to visible options.
Hover
hovered_key matches a visible option
that button uses hover background while other buttons retain normal styling.
Small bar
bar height is zero or width is below the minimum
no buttons are returned and no out-of-bounds button geometry is produced.

requirement: Cancel-turn and Goal-interrupt panels compute bounded geometry and render focused choices
contract: cancel_turn_panel_height SHALL cap the fixed four-choice panel to the screen-dependent 33–80% range. goal_interrupt_panel_height SHALL size to four rows plus up to three choices and apply the same screen caps. Both renderers SHALL clear and repopulate button rectangles, draw an accent bar/title/options, mark the active choice with a filled marker and focused background, and blend the panel when unfocused; Goal interrupt text and choice set SHALL remain distinct from ordinary cancel semantics.
scenarios: Cancel panel
four cancel choices are rendered
height is fixed at nine rows when the screen permits and each choice has a hit rectangle/selection marker.
Goal panel
one, two or three Goal choices are rendered
the title and height reflect whether a turn is active and whether subagents can be stopped.
Tiny terminal
screen height is small
height is clamped to the screen cap without overflowing the area.
Unfocused
panel focus is false
the panel remains readable but is blended to show it is not the active input target.

requirement: Documentation picker and viewer support responsive tips, filtering, scroll input, cached markdown, and palette return
contract: howto_list_modal SHALL open a DocPicker with all docs, default list focus and selected index zero while retaining an optional previous palette. apply_doc_scroll SHALL map arrows/vim/page/home/end to saturating u16 offsets; signed and mouse deltas SHALL use saturating arithmetic and report only handled wheel events. render_doc_picker_overlay SHALL filter title/description, adapt narrow descriptions, render modal chrome and a width-fitting docs tip. render_doc_viewer_overlay SHALL cache MarkdownContent output by content width, clamp scroll to visible lines, render the selected slice, and support caller-supplied shortcuts such as tutorial next-topic hints.
scenarios: Doc key scroll
a viewer receives arrow/vim/page/home/end input
the offset moves by the documented increment or clamps to zero/u16::MAX and handled status is true.
Mouse scroll
a wheel event arrives
ScrollUp/Down move three lines; unrelated mouse events return false.
Picker open
how-to guides are requested
a DocPicker opens on Getting Started with search inactive and optional palette snapshot.
Picker render
the docs picker has a query or narrow viewport
only matching docs are shown, descriptions adapt, and the footer tip fits without exceeding width.
Viewer render
content width changes or scroll exceeds available lines
Markdown is reparsed only for the new width, visible lines render, and scroll is clamped.

requirement: The agent viewer module SHALL keep ownership boundaries explicit
contract: AgentView::handle_mouse SHALL own cached hit-region priority, AgentView focus and overlay transitions, InputOutcome action/change production, and delegation to the Todo, Queue, Prompt, Tasks, Catalog, scrollback and modal components. A scrollback block viewer receives scrollback mouse events through its own handler, while prompt and list panes retain their content-state ownership. This source contains no inline test module.
scenarios: Cached control priority
a left-button event lands in a cached AgentView control rectangle
the first matching control performs its state transition or returns its Action and the event does not fall through to a pane.
Pane delegation
a left-button event lands in Todo, Queue, Prompt, Tasks, Catalog or Scrollback
AgentView selects the corresponding active pane, delegates pane-owned work, and returns the pane outcome boundary used by this handler.
Modal ownership
scrollback is active while a block viewer exists
the event is passed to handle_block_viewer_mouse and ordinary scrollback selection setup is skipped.
Prompt ownership
a prompt click edits text or pairs as a double click
PromptEvent editing refreshes slash state and suggestion notification, while a double click may open a line viewer or expand a paste element.

requirement: ListPane mouse handling SHALL prioritize scrollbar clicks/drags over content selection, map content rows to virtual item coordinates, route wheel events over the scrollbar to proportional movement, and release drag state on mouse-up
contract: AgentView::apply_scrollbar_click SHALL return false when no rendered scrollbar exists or its height is zero. Otherwise it reads scrollback total and viewport heights, scales totals above u16::MAX, maps the screen cell through scrollbar_click_to_offset, and dispatches Top, Bottom or a scaled offset to ScrollbackState. The parent mouse handler focuses scrollback, marks scrollbar_dragging on a scrollbar press, and clears the flag on left release.
scenarios: Unavailable scrollbar
the cached scrollbar rectangle is absent or has zero height
apply_scrollbar_click returns false without changing scrollback.
Top or bottom click
scrollbar_click_to_offset returns Top or Bottom
goto_top or goto_bottom is called.
Offset click
scrollbar_click_to_offset returns an offset
set_scroll_offset receives that offset multiplied by the same scale used for tall content.
Very tall history
total_height exceeds u16::MAX
the mapping uses a positive scale and a u16 scaled total before converting the resulting offset back to scrollback units.
Drag lifecycle
a left press hits the scrollbar and a later left release arrives
scrollbar_dragging is set for the gesture and then cleared on release.

requirement: Literal follow-up and cancel picker focus
contract: dispatch SHALL send a follow-up chip literal directly through SendPrompt without reopening project selection, and CancelTurn SHALL move focus to the prompt picker when cancellation originates from scrollback.
scenarios: Follow-up chip
a follow-up chip is submitted
exactly one SendPrompt effect carries the chip text and project picking is bypassed.
Cancel turn
CancelTurn is dispatched while scrollback has focus
the active pane becomes Prompt and the picker receives focus.

requirement: Session load restore, model, behavior, title, replay, cwd, and reload-window reconciliation
contract: SessionLoaded SHALL apply restored model and restore metadata, show a restore summary when present, hydrate disk titles and prompt history, register the active session, preserve a new-session model default when the loaded session omits a model, reconcile deferred behavior before prompt draining, resolve the agent cwd from session/origin/process cwd, finish replay-transient entries, and keep an already-open reload window gated until the deferred load result is reconciled.
scenarios: Restored session
SessionLoaded includes restore_summary and restore_degree
the summary is appended to scrollback, restore_degree is stored, and title/history/registration effects are emitted.
Model default
the loaded payload has no model while a new-session default is set
the new-session default remains unchanged.
Deferred behavior
a session has deferred behavior and reload is being reconciled
matching behavior is reissued or unresolved behavior is reissued before pending prompts drain.
Title hydration
disk title is auto/manual/blank
auto titles leave display_name unset, manual titles restore only cold cache state, and blank titles are ignored.
Cwd fallback
session cwd is present or absent
the agent uses the resolved session cwd or process cwd fallback.
Reload gate
SessionLoaded or SessionLoadFailed arrives during an open reload window
loading_replay remains true and reconciliation is deferred to the reload window.
Full worktree restore
codeRestored, restoreSummary and a recognized restoreDegree are present
all three values are returned.
Partial or absent restore
only codeRestored is present or no codeRestore object exists
restored is false when appropriate and summary/degree are None.
Unknown restore degree
restoreDegree or degree is not recognized
the degree is None.
Structured foreground
grow/foreground has all tested identity fields
the parsed foreground retains each field.
Legacy foreground
only grow/runningPromptId is present
no foreground identity is adopted.
Full restore
all restore fields contain recognized values
the three values are returned.
Absent restore
the result or _meta lacks the restore object
restored is false and summary/degree are None.
Unknown degree
restoreDegree or degree is not recognized by the target type
the degree is None.
Structured foreground
grow/foreground contains the structured snapshot
the snapshot is returned.
Legacy foreground
only a runningPromptId-style field is present
no foreground snapshot is returned.
Reload gate
SessionLoaded arrives while an open reload window defers the result
the handler returns without binding or draining the session.
Restore metadata
a loaded session includes models, restore degree/summary, and optional foreground snapshot
the agent stores the metadata, renders a restore notice when the summary is present, and adopts the foreground only when its identity is accepted.
Replay finalization
no foreground prompt is adopted
root and descendant scrollbacks finish all running entries before normal effects are scheduled.
Control reconciliation
a bound view has deferred model or behavior state without a matching pending control
the exact session control is enqueued before prompt queue draining; existing pending controls are not duplicated.
Post-load effects
a load completes
title hydration, prompt history, agent-name metadata, optional plugin CTA, active-session registration, readiness notification, and descendant restoration are scheduled as applicable.

requirement: Session load failure, extension refresh, and bootstrap command seeding
contract: SessionLoaded SHALL surface restore failures as a warning and reset absent restore metadata; a pending extension refresh SHALL emit exactly the five extension-list fetches and clear its flag, while SessionLoadFailed SHALL clear the flag without fetching; loading a session SHALL seed available commands from bootstrap ACP commands.
scenarios: Restore failure
restore_summary carries a failure marker
a warning banner is shown.
No restore
a subsequent load has no restore summary/degree
no restore summary is shown and stale restore_degree is reset.
Extension refresh
pending_extensions_fetch is set
FetchSkillsList, FetchWorkflowsList, FetchMcpsList, FetchHooksList, and FetchPluginsList are emitted and the flag clears.
Load failure
SessionLoadFailed arrives with the flag set
the flag clears and no extension fetches are emitted.
Bootstrap commands
bootstrap_acp_commands contains a command
the loaded session receives the command and generation.
Bootstrap commands
app bootstrap commands are present when a placeholder AgentView is created
the session receives those commands with generation one.
Extension refresh on success
pending extension fetch is set and an extensions modal exists when SessionLoaded completes
the flag is consumed and modal tab fetch effects are appended.
Extension refresh on failure
SessionLoadFailed arrives while extension refresh is pending
the flag is cleared and no extension fetch effects are emitted.
Failed load retry
a created agent fails to load outside a reload deferral window
the eager session id is unbound, a failure event is added, and a later pick can retry instead of focusing the failed surface.

requirement: Resume session identity and agent ownership
contract: LoadSession SHALL reuse a known session identity by issuing LoadSession rather than CreateSession, focus an existing open-session owner, create a new agent only for an unknown session, avoid rearming stale overlays, preserve the existing owner on duplicate loads, focus a dashboard row when an attached target is stale, and retry LoadSession after a prior load failure.
scenarios: Known identity
resume targets a known session id
LoadSession is emitted and CreateSession is absent.
Open owner
the target session is already attached to an agent
the existing agent is focused without creating or unbinding ownership.
Unknown identity
resume targets a session never opened
a new agent is created after the load effect.
Stale target
the attached target is stale or overlay state is stale
the dashboard row is focused and stale overlay state is not rearmed.
Retry
the first load fails and resume is requested again
LoadSession is reissued.

requirement: Pending first prompt, selection anchoring, title loading, and stale running cleanup
contract: Session load completion SHALL drain a pending first prompt to the front of the prompt queue, leave the queue unchanged when none exists, clear orphaned first prompts on load failure, reanchor grouped selection to a valid row or empty state, use a loading title when no session id exists, and clear stale running replay entries after SessionLoaded.
scenarios: Pending first prompt
pending_first_prompt is present at load completion
it is moved to the front and the field is cleared.
No pending prompt
pending_first_prompt is absent
no queue item is added.
Failed load
SessionLoadFailed arrives with an orphaned prompt
the orphan is cleared.
Grouped selection
the grouped selection map has a row or is empty
selection lands on a valid row or is safely cleared.
Untitled entry
an agent has no session id
entry_title returns the loading title.
Stale replay
scrollback contains running entries before SessionLoaded
running entries are finished and no longer animate.
Pending first prompt
pending_first_prompt exists at SessionLoaded
it is enqueued at the front and removed from the field before queue draining.
Stale replay
no accepted foreground snapshot is present
root and child running entries are finalized so the loaded view no longer animates stale replay work.
Delete from both pickers
a session id is removed while modal and welcome picker data are present
matching entries and content hits disappear from both surfaces and selection is moved to a selectable map slot.
Header anchor
the prior selected map slot is a nonselectable grouped header
selection moves backward to a selectable row, or to the first selectable row if no earlier row exists.
Empty map
reanchoring receives no rows
scroll offset is cleared and selected is set to zero.

requirement: Project picker selection, freeform, opt-out, and persistence
contract: Project selection input SHALL translate skip to the original cwd, use an explicitly entered path when no option is selected, let a freeform path override dont-ask, report no picker when disabled, persist the dont-ask choice, use a selected recent project path, and persist the disable flag when ProjectSelected is dispatched.
scenarios: Skip
the project picker answer is skipped
ProjectSelected uses the original cwd.
Freeform
no option is selected and a path is entered
the entered path is used.
Override
a freeform path is entered with dont-ask enabled
the freeform path wins.
Disabled
project picker is disabled
needs_project_picker is false.
Dont ask again
the answer requests dont-ask
the disable flag is set and persisted.
Recent project
a recent project option is selected
that project path is used.
Missing timestamp
a local picker row has no updatedAt
the row is excluded.
Missing canonical title
a Build row has updatedAt but no canonical title
the row is excluded.
Fresh canonical row
sessionId/title/updatedAt are valid and updatedAt is within 30 days
one SessionPickerEntry is emitted.
Missing timestamp
updatedAt is absent or invalid
the row is dropped.
Expired row
updatedAt is older than the 30-day cutoff
the row is dropped.
Missing title
canonical title is absent or invalid
the row is dropped.
Created fallback
createdAt is absent or invalid
created_at equals updated_at.
Skill title
title contains supported skill XML wrappers
summary uses extracted display text, then empty summaries are filtered.

requirement: Minimal-mode welcome card behavior
contract: NewSession SHALL queue the welcome card only in minimal screen mode and SHALL leave welcome_pending false in inline/non-minimal mode.
scenarios: Minimal
NewSession runs in ScreenMode::Minimal
minimal_state.welcome_pending becomes true.
Non-minimal
NewSession runs outside minimal mode
the welcome card is not queued.

requirement: Deep-search debounce and stale sequence handling
contract: TriggerDeepSearch SHALL arm a debounce for an eligible query even when title hits exist, ForceDeepSearch SHALL bypass the debounce and search immediately, short queries SHALL clear results and invalidate an armed debounce, and debounce expiry SHALL search the current query while dropping stale sequence results.
scenarios: Debounce
an eligible build-mode query is triggered
DebounceSessionSearch is emitted and content loading is set.
Force
ForceDeepSearch is dispatched for the current query
DeepSearchSessions is emitted immediately with the next sequence.
Short query
the query becomes shorter than the minimum
results/loading are cleared and the old debounce cannot search.
Stale expiry
a debounce expires after the query changes
only the current sequence/query searches; stale expiry is ignored.

requirement: Modal deep-search sequence and picker-surface validation
contract: Session-picker deep-search debounce expiry SHALL validate the sequence counter belonging to the active modal surface, and closing the modal SHALL invalidate its armed debounce even when its sequence collides with the welcome picker counter.
scenarios: Modal expiry
the active modal picker owns the armed sequence
matching expiry emits DeepSearchSessions for the modal query.
Modal close
the modal closes while debounce is armed
the modal sequence is invalidated and expiry emits no stale search, even on counter collision.

requirement: Session picker close, loading cancellation, and list response races
contract: SessionPickerClosed SHALL dismiss the welcome/modal picker and invalidate only the loading/search state appropriate to that surface; it SHALL preserve a plain list fetch when closing a build-mode modal, ignore stale list responses, preserve an in-flight deep-search spinner across a matching plain-list response, and apply rapid plain fetches last-write-wins.
scenarios: Welcome close during load
the welcome picker is loading and Esc closes it
entries/loading are cleared and a late response cannot resurrect the picker.
Spinner-only close
the welcome picker has only loading state
Esc dismisses the spinner and picker.
Modal close with plain fetch
a build-mode modal closes while a plain fetch is in flight
the plain fetch sequence remains valid and its response lands.
Concurrent search/list
deep search is loading while a matching list response arrives
entries update while deep-search content loading remains true until its own response.
Rapid fetch
two plain list fetches race
only the latest sequence writes entries.
Short query
a picker query trims to fewer than two bytes
content results and loading are cleared and no search effect is returned.
Debounced query
a longer query changes without force
content loading is marked and a DebounceSessionSearch effect carries the current query and sequence.
Forced query
a longer query changes with force
DeepSearchSessions is emitted immediately with the incremented sequence.
Stale completion
a debounce or result arrives with a sequence different from the live picker
no effect is emitted and no results are written.
Surface ownership
a modal picker is open, or only the Welcome view is active
modal state is updated first; otherwise only the live welcome state can accept deep results or card details.
Dismissal invalidation
the welcome picker is dismissed while a plain list or deep search is loading
plain and deep sequences/loading flags are invalidated so late work cannot resurrect the picker; modal dismissal does not bump the welcome list sequence.
Picker creation
ShowSessionPicker is dispatched
a SessionPicker modal with default picker state and empty loading/search fields is installed before list fetch dispatch.

requirement: Memory entries are grouped, labeled, formatted, and previewed with bounded file reads
contract: build_entries SHALL transform MemoryFileInfo values into Global, Workspace, and Sessions sections, add headers only for nonempty sections, format byte sizes and relative modification times, preserve file/source metadata, and list session logs newest-first. MemoryModalState::new SHALL initialize browsing state, skip leading headers, and load the selected file preview. Preview loading SHALL read UTF-8 files, show a fixed too-large message above 1 MiB, and leave missing/unreadable files without a preview.
scenarios: Entry grouping
global/workspace/session file metadata is supplied
headers and file rows appear in section order, with session rows reversed and metadata formatted.
New modal
entries are loaded into MemoryModalState
selection lands on the first non-header and its preview is loaded/reset.
Large file
the selected file exceeds 1 MiB
preview content is the explicit too-large message without reading the file body.
Missing file
metadata/read-to-string fails
preview is absent and the renderer shows No file selected.

requirement: Memory filtering preserves matching section headers and keeps selection/preview state coherent
contract: MemoryModalState SHALL cache filtered entry indices, match query text case-insensitively against file labels and source names, retain a section header only when a member matches, and invalidate/recompute the cache after query or entry changes. Selection SHALL skip headers, clamp when filters shrink, reload preview only when the selected file changes, and clear preview when no entries remain.
scenarios: Filter match
a query matches a file label or source
the filtered list contains the matching file and its section header.
Selection navigation
next/previous or select_at targets a header, same index, or out-of-range index
headers and invalid/same selections are rejected; valid file selection updates preview.
Filter edit
text changes or paste changes the query
cache and selected entry are recomputed once and preview scroll resets only on text changes.
Cursor-only edit
the query cursor moves without text change
filtered indices and preview scroll remain unchanged.

requirement: Memory keyboard routing supports browse navigation, canonical filter editing, copy, toggle, fullscreen persistence, and session-only deletion
contract: handle_memory_key SHALL ignore key-release events, route FilterFocused input to the line editor while keeping Enter focused and Esc returning to Browse, and route Browse keys for j/Down, k/Up, page movement, / or unmodified i search, trailing-grapheme backspace, y path copy, t memory toggle, and Ctrl-F fullscreen persistence. x SHALL arm double-press deletion only for session entries; while confirming, x removes the entry/file and any other key cancels. Modified i and removed Ctrl-D/Ctrl-U preview shortcuts SHALL be no-ops.
scenarios: Browse navigation
j/k, arrows, PageUp/PageDown or backspace is pressed in Browse
selection/query changes are applied and preview follows valid selection.
Filter focus
text, paste, Enter, Esc, cursor or grapheme editing arrives
canonical line editing handles the input, text changes invalidate filtering, Enter stays focused, and Esc preserves query while exiting.
Memory toggle
t is pressed
memory_enabled flips immediately and a draft-preserving /memory on/off action is returned.
Fullscreen
Ctrl-F is pressed
fullscreen flips and PersistMemoryFullscreen carries the new value.
Delete
x is pressed on session/global/confirming state
only session rows arm confirmation; second x deletes the row/file, while any other confirmation key cancels.
Copy
y is pressed on a file row
the path is copied and the outcome is Changed.

requirement: Memory mouse routing selects files and scrolls or jumps list and preview independently
contract: handle_memory_mouse SHALL hit-test rendered list, preview, and scrollbar rectangles. Left click on a list file row SHALL select it; headers/outside areas SHALL remain unchanged. Wheel events over the list SHALL move selection by three non-header entries and refresh preview; wheel events over preview SHALL move preview_scroll by three bounded lines. Click/drag on list or preview scrollbars SHALL map the pointer to a clamped offset, selecting the first visible file for list jumps.
scenarios: List click
a left click lands on a rendered file row
the corresponding filtered file is selected and preview reloads.
Header/outside click
a click lands on a section header or outside both panes
state and selection remain unchanged.
List wheel
ScrollUp/Down occurs over list or list scrollbar
selection moves across non-header rows and preview follows.
Preview wheel
ScrollUp/Down occurs over preview or preview scrollbar
preview_scroll changes by three and stays within available range.
Scrollbar jump
drag/click lands at top/bottom/offset of a scrollbar
scroll offset is mapped and clamped; list selection moves to the first visible file.

requirement: Memory modal rendering adapts split/fullscreen layout and preserves list/preview scroll geometry
contract: render_memory_modal SHALL use ModalWindow chrome with persisted fullscreen or compact sizing, collapse to list-only below 80 columns, split wider content into a 40% list and preview pane, store hit-test rectangles, render search placeholder/cursor, section headers, selected rows, metadata/truncation, and scrollbars. The preview SHALL wrap MarkdownContent to available width, reserve scrollbar width when needed, clamp preview_scroll, and render the visible lines; missing preview SHALL show a centered message.
scenarios: Narrow layout
content width is below the split threshold
only the file list is rendered and preview geometry/scrollbar is cleared.
Wide layout
content width permits preview
list/preview rectangles and separator are stored and both panes render.
List row
a header, selected file, long label, or delete confirmation is visible
header/selection/meta/delete hint styles and width-safe truncation are used.
Preview wrap
wrapped content exceeds viewport
total lines and scrollbar are recomputed at narrowed content width and scroll is clamped.
Unicode query
filter text includes CJK/combining/emoji and cursor is near the edge
viewport preserves grapheme boundaries and cursor remains visible in the rendered filter row.

requirement: Memory shortcut footer reflects mode, memory state, fullscreen state, and Vim search affordance
contract: build_shortcuts SHALL expose browse navigation/search/copy/delete/toggle/fullscreen/close hints, label the memory toggle with its current on/off state, switch the fullscreen hint between normal/fullscreen, append the shared `i search` hint in Browse, and expose only type/Esc hints in FilterFocused or x/any-key hints in ConfirmingDelete. The current memory fullscreen preference SHALL be read from the hints.memory_modal_fullscreen config value and default false.
scenarios: Browse footer
Browse mode is rendered with memory enabled/disabled or fullscreen on/off
toggle and fullscreen labels describe the current state and navigation actions are listed.
Vim navigation
Vim mode is enabled
Browse shortcuts include `i search`.
Filter/confirm footer
filter or delete confirmation is active
only mode-appropriate type/Esc or x/cancel hints are advertised.
Preference
config contains or omits hints.memory_modal_fullscreen
load_fullscreen_pref returns the boolean value or false when unavailable.

requirement: Memory display helpers remain Unicode-safe and use bounded human-readable metadata
contract: truncate_to_width SHALL cut only at a valid display-width boundary through the shared byte-offset helper. file_label SHALL use the final path component with lossy fallback, format_size SHALL emit B/KB/MB with one decimal above the unit threshold, and format_modified SHALL map missing/future/sub-minute to just now then minutes/hours/days.
scenarios: Width truncation
ASCII, multibyte or grapheme text is truncated
the returned slice never exceeds max display columns and does not split a multibyte boundary.
Metadata
size or modified timestamp falls in a boundary range
stable human-readable units and relative labels are returned.

requirement: Typed context snapshot and header model summary
contract: ContextInfoBlock SHALL retain the typed ContextInfo snapshot and active model name, and build_lines SHALL render a Context header, a blank separator, the used/total token summary with a precise percentage, and the model caption in that order.
scenarios: Header
a context snapshot and model are supplied to ContextInfoBlock::new
the first lines are Context, a blank line, the token summary, and the model name.
Large total
the total context reaches the million range
the summary uses the large-count formatter while retaining the token suffix.
Precision
used and total are 36,700 and 1,000,000
the summary shows 3.67% rather than the pre-rounded integer usage_pct.

requirement: Token and percentage formatting boundaries
contract: Token and share formatters SHALL handle zero totals safely, preserve raw counts below 1,000, use one-decimal k values through 99,499, switch to half-up integer k at 99,500, use one-decimal m values at one million for large summaries, render category shares with one decimal below 10%, whole percentages at or above 10%, and floor tiny nonzero shares at 0.1%.
scenarios: Token cutovers
fmt_tok/fmt_tok_big return the stable compact representation at each boundary.
Zero window
total is zero
precise_usage_percent returns 0.0 and percent_of_window returns `-`.
Category share
part is zero, tiny nonzero, under 10%, or at least 10%
percent_of_window returns the expected 0.0%, floored 0.1%, decimal, or whole-percent form.

requirement: Auto-compact estimate and warning guidance
contract: build_lines SHALL compute the auto-compact threshold with ceiling arithmetic from the live snapshot threshold, show the remaining token estimate below threshold, switch large remaining values to m notation, show a warning that compaction triggers next turn at or above threshold, and show the manual `/compact` tip only in the 80%-to-threshold band.
scenarios: Below threshold
usage_pct is below auto_compact_threshold_percent
the output includes `Auto-compact at X% · ~N tokens remaining` using ceiling threshold arithmetic.
Large window
the remaining estimate reaches millions
the estimate uses fmt_tok_big and displays m notation.
At threshold
usage_pct equals or exceeds the configured threshold
the output says auto-compact triggers next turn and omits the manual tip.
Warning band
usage_pct is at least 80% but below threshold
the warning tip suggests `/compact`; below 80% or at/above threshold it is absent.

requirement: Categorical 100-cell context usage bar
contract: build_lines SHALL render exactly 100 categorical cells, partitioning used capacity left-to-right into system, message, and reasoning/overhead bands and the remainder into free capacity; token estimates SHALL be clamped so category bands cannot exceed used cells, tool-definition tokens SHALL stay out of the bar, and a zero total SHALL render all cells as free.
scenarios: Normal usage
used and total have a nonzero ratio
the bar contains used cells followed by free cells and the used count equals the rounded used/total ratio.
Overlapping estimates
system/message estimates exceed used
the used band does not overshoot used capacity.
Tool definitions
tool-definition tokens are large
tool definitions are shown outside the bar and do not create tool glyph cells.
Zero total
total is zero
the bar still has 100 cells and all are free.
Full usage
used equals total
all 100 cells are used and none are free.

requirement: Usage legends, details, and aligned columns
contract: build_lines SHALL render system, messages, optional reasoning/overhead, and free legend rows plus tool-definition and usage-category information rows; RowLayout SHALL measure rendered labels/counts, right-align token and percentage cells, align detail counts, and keep informational rows out of the categorical bar.
scenarios: Overhead legend
used exceeds system plus messages
a Reasoning/overhead row shows the residual token count.
Tool/category details
tool definitions or Skills/MCP categories have counts
rows show labels, compact tokens, percentages, and detail nouns with aligned counts.
Column alignment
rows have different token, percentage, or count widths
the rendered numeric and detail columns line up and single-digit counts receive leading padding.
No bar pollution
information rows are present
the bar cell count remains 100 with zero tool/category cells.

requirement: Responsive wide and narrow bar geometry
contract: BarLayout SHALL select the wide 5x20 shape at terminal widths of 50 columns and above and the narrow 10x10 shape below 50, while both shapes retain 100 cells and each row stays within its configured cell limit.
scenarios: Wide layout
width is at least NARROW_BREAKPOINT
WIDE has five rows of twenty cells.
Narrow layout
width is below NARROW_BREAKPOINT
NARROW has ten rows of ten cells.
Bar rendering
a chosen layout is rendered
the bar has the expected number of nonempty rows, exactly 100 cells, and no row exceeds its row length.

requirement: Responsive legend wrapping and theme colors
contract: Legend rendering SHALL use the secondary text color for labels in both layouts, keep each wide legend category on one line, and split narrow legend categories into a label row followed by a one-space-indented numeric/detail row.
scenarios: Wide legend
bar layout is WIDE
each legend label and its numeric data share one line and labels use theme.text_secondary.
Narrow legend
bar layout is NARROW
each category occupies two lines, the data row starts with exactly one space, and labels use theme.text_secondary.

requirement: Theme-reactive BlockContent output and truncation contract
contract: ContextInfoBlock::output SHALL resolve the current theme on every redraw, choose a responsive bar from BlockContext.width, wrap styled lines to the available width, mark rendered lines with selection range 0, enforce max_lines by retaining content plus a muted ellipsis and span selection range, provide an empty line fallback, and expose compact nonselectable, nongroup-foldable metadata while remaining groupable.
scenarios: Normal output
output is requested with a BlockContext
styled context lines are wrapped to width and returned as BlockLines with selection ranges.
Line budget
max_lines is set below rendered length
the output is truncated to the budget, appends a muted ellipsis to the last retained line, and limits its selectable span range.
Empty budget
max_lines is zero or rendering yields no lines
a safe empty line is returned.
Block metadata
the scrollback block is queried for presentation flags
it reports no accent, no vertical padding, no raw mode, not foldable, not selectable, and groupable.

requirement: Sticky prompt descriptors and rendered-header helpers preserve height, clipping, and scratch-buffer invariants
contract: PromptDescriptor SHALL carry entry index, virtual Y, full and minimum heights, and sticky eligibility. RenderedPrompt::visible_height SHALL saturating-subtract clip_top from render_height, and needs_scratch_buffer SHALL be true exactly when clipping is required. StickyHeaderLayout SHALL expose header presence, content start/height, pinned/pushed entry positions, gap rows, and content-to-scroll mapping without exposing renderer internals.
scenarios: Rendered prompt
a header has render_height and clip_top
visible_height is render_height minus clipping with saturation and scratch buffering is requested only for positive clipping.
Empty timeline
no prompts or no scroll has been passed
layout is default with no header and zero header rows.
Header helpers
a pinned/pushed layout is queried
content height/start, pinned/pushed rows, gaps and entry identity report the computed geometry.

requirement: Sticky headers select the last eligible prompt and apply gradual collapse bounded by configured and inline heights
contract: compute_sticky_layout SHALL find the last sticky prompt with y_virtual below scroll_offset, ignore non-sticky prompts for pinning while allowing them to push an earlier sticky prompt, and compute a 1:1 gradual collapse from full_height down to min_height. min_height SHALL be floored to one row and capped by full_height; the resulting render height SHALL also be capped by viewport_height.
scenarios: Just past prompt
scroll has passed a sticky prompt by a small amount
the prompt is pinned at full_height minus rows scrolled past.
Minimum floor
scroll passes enough rows to collapse below min_height or min_height is zero
render_height stops at configured min_height, at least one row.
Stale minimum
min_height exceeds full_height
the pinned render height never exceeds full inline height.
Non-sticky prompt
a non-sticky prompt is scrolled past
it can push the prior sticky prompt but never becomes pinned itself.

requirement: Sticky push transitions keep gaps in content, clip only visible prior content, and hand off to the next prompt smoothly
contract: When the next prompt approaches the current header, compute_sticky_layout SHALL emit a pushed RenderedPrompt with the prior prompt's visible rows and clip_top, leave the approaching prompt inline until it is scrolled past, and return no header when only the gap or the next prompt's row occupies the top. Pushed render_height SHALL be min(full_height, collapsed render_height), preventing inflated padding for short prompts and preserving truncated rendering for long prompts. Once the next sticky prompt crosses the top, it SHALL become pinned.
scenarios: Push begins
the next prompt lies within current header plus gap
the prior prompt is pushed and the next remains inline.
Gap only
the next prompt is at row zero or only the inter-entry gap is visible
no sticky header is emitted.
Short prompt
prior full_height is below collapsed minimum
pushed render_height uses full_height and clip_top exposes real content.
Long prompt
prior full_height exceeds collapsed render height
pushed render_height uses collapsed height and clips from the top.
Handoff
the next sticky prompt has crossed the top
the next prompt is pinned with its own gradual collapse.

requirement: Sticky scroll mapping preserves bottom-line continuity during c-j/c-k and gradual collapse
contract: StickyHeaderLayout::scroll_for_content SHALL add header_screen_rows to the logical scroll offset, and content_height SHALL subtract the header from viewport height. During gradual collapse, header shrink and scroll offset changes SHALL preserve the viewport bottom-line invariant; during reverse c-k transitions header rows SHALL change smoothly, scroll_for_content SHALL not increase in the tested reverse sequence, and adjacent small prompts SHALL expose actual content rather than inflated empty padding.
scenarios: Forward scroll
the viewport scrolls past a prompt while its header collapses
bottom_line equals scroll_offset + viewport_height - 1 and scroll_for_content stays constant until the minimum is reached.
Reverse scroll
c-k moves from the next prompt toward the previous one
pushed visible rows grow one at a time, header row changes are at most one, and content mapping remains continuous.
Small adjacent prompts
several short prompts approach each other
the pushed header uses real full heights and exposes bottom content without empty inflated rows.

requirement: Sticky header hit mapping identifies pinned/pushed content and separates gaps from prompt rows
contract: entry_at_header_row SHALL return the pushed or pinned entry index only for visible prompt rows, returning None for inter-header/after-header gaps and out-of-range rows. header_entry_area SHALL return start row, visible height, and pushed flag only for a visible matching prompt. A pinned-only header SHALL place the prompt at row zero with a trailing gap; a pushed/pinned layout SHALL separate the two regions with a gap.
scenarios: Pinned hit test
a row falls inside a pinned prompt, trailing gap, or after the header
only pinned rows resolve to the pinned entry; gaps and outside rows return None.
Pushed/pinned hit test
both regions are present
pushed rows resolve to the earlier entry, the gap resolves None, and pinned rows resolve to the later entry.
Entry area
a matching/nonmatching entry is queried
visible matching prompts return geometry with pushed status; absent/hidden entries return None.

requirement: Welcome state routing and terminal overlay cleanup
contract: render_welcome SHALL apply the current theme/background and margins, render the top bar, route TrustState::Pending to the folder-trust gate and all other states to the authenticated home/picker view, and return a paired post-flush overlay clear whenever the selected renderer did not supply one.
scenarios: Trust pending
trust_state is Pending
the trust renderer receives the workspace, selection, compactness, and frame.
Authenticated
trust_state is Done
the normal hero or session picker renderer is selected.
Overlay cleanup
a renderer returns no post-flush escape
render_welcome attaches terminal overlay::clear() to the result.

requirement: Folder trust gate content, menu, version, and safe stacked geometry
contract: render_welcome_trust SHALL center the directory trust question, workspace path, two-line security warning, and y/n menu, render the full version badge, return menu hit rectangles, and use WelcomeLayout::compute_stacked to preserve the version row while dropping the logo when the chrome cannot fit or when compact mode is active.
scenarios: Normal gate
a wide non-compact trust area has room
logo, trust message, y/n menu, and in-bounds version row are rendered.
Overflowing gate
message and menu consume the available height
the logo is dropped before clipping the version row.
Compact gate
compact is true
the logo is omitted while the menu remains available.
Trust copy
a workspace path is supplied
