the centered warning says Grow may run or modify directory contents and poses security risks.

requirement: Authenticated home hero menu and quit shortcut policy
contract: render_welcome_done SHALL render the borderless home hero with New worktree, Resume session, and Quit actions, omit a prompt/changelog/bottom version footer, and choose ctrl+d for VS Code-family terminals while using ctrl+q elsewhere; menu hit rectangles SHALL be returned and shortcut placement SHALL keep the menu clear of the right screen edge.
scenarios: Home baseline
the authenticated home has no picker
the rendered screen contains the three actions and no prompt placeholder, Beta marker, or Changelog row.
Terminal family
the terminal is VS Code-family or ordinary
Quit uses ctrl+d or ctrl+q respectively.
Wide hero
a wide terminal lays out logo and text side-by-side
shortcut text remains at least five columns from the screen edge.

requirement: Responsive welcome layout sizing and tip-slot precedence
contract: render_welcome_done SHALL reserve content height for startup warnings, picker rows, menus, announcements, and tips; show the session picker in compact full-area mode when entries are loading/present, suppress the bottom tip while the picker is shown, and give pending update notifications precedence over random tips in the bottom slot.
scenarios: Picker mode
session_picker is present or loading
the layout reserves picker height, hides home menu/logo through the picker renderer, and omits the bottom tip.
Loading picker
session picker loading is true
one loading row is reserved.
Tip precedence
no picker is shown and pending_update_version is present
the bottom slot renders the update version and ctrl+u restart hint.
Random tip
no update is pending and a tip exists
tip_height/render_tip use the inset available width.

requirement: Welcome version badges and hover styling
contract: render_version_badge SHALL render Grow with the current version and channel in the right-aligned Full mode, or Grow with the current version without channel in left-aligned HeroInline mode; hover_style SHALL promote hovered clickable blocks to text_primary while preserving the supplied base style otherwise.

requirement: Session picker effective-query filtering and content-header gate
contract: render_session_picker SHALL use the effective server-fetched/query value for both fuzzy session filtering and content-search header/row gating, so a live re-search with an equal entries_query does not add a stale Searching header while unstamped loading does; rendered content rows SHALL be deduplicated and indexed after fuzzy rows.
scenarios: Stamped search
content loading is true and entries_query equals the live query
the picker renders server-fetched rows without a Searching session content header.
Unstamped search
content loading is true, query is nonempty, and entries_query is absent
the Searching session content header is rendered.
No query
the effective query is empty
content results do not create content rows/header.
Substring filter
a local session id or summary contains the lowercased query, or the query is empty
the entry is included; an ordered-character-only match such as rc against rust-check is excluded.
Server-filtered query
entries_query trims equal to the live query
effective_filter_query returns empty and a content-only server result survives local filtering.
Stale/unfetched query
entries_query is absent or differs from the live query
the live query remains the local filter and an unrelated title can be excluded.
Content deduplication
a content hit has a session id already present in fuzzy rows
the hit is omitted; a unique hit is appended with its original hit index.
Empty query gate
query is empty while content results exist or content loading is true
no content header or content row is added.
Loading header
query is nonempty, content loading is true and no content hit is available
a single non-selectable loading header is inserted.
Flat header placement
flat mode contains fuzzy and unique content rows
the content header appears after fuzzy rows and before content rows.
Empty entries
entries are None or an empty slice
the virtual/entry map is empty.

requirement: Grouped session picker headers, repo pinning, and row indentation
contract: render_session_picker SHALL optionally group resume entries by repo_name, emit one non-selectable header per group, pin the current working-directory repository group ahead of the remaining alphabetical groups, preserve selectable rows beneath headers, and indent grouped rows by one level; empty input SHALL produce no entries or non-selectable indices.
scenarios: Multiple groups
entries belong to multiple repositories
each group has one header and headers sort alphabetically unless the current repo is pinned first.
Current repo
cwd resolves to one group
that group is the first header.
Single group
all entries share a repository
exactly one header precedes all selectable rows.
Empty
no entries are supplied
the picker entry and non-selectable lists are empty.
Row presentation
a grouped row is rendered
its indent is one.
Repository label
cwd has two or more normal components, one component, root, empty input or deep path
the short label follows the tested final-two, single-component, root and unknown rules.
Alphabetical grouping
grouped entries belong to multiple repositories and no current repo matches
headers are alphabetical and each following row points to the original entry index.
Current repo pin
current_repo matches one group
that group header and its rows move to the front while remaining groups stay alphabetical.
Grouped row presentation
filtered grouped entries are converted to PickerEntry rows
each group has a non-selectable Header and each session Row has indent one and selection derived from grouped position.
Empty grouped input
no entries are supplied
both grouped map and rendered grouped row/non-selectable collections are empty.

requirement: Resume picker row construction, expansion, and shortcut surface
contract: render_session_picker SHALL construct PickerRow data from filtered SessionEntryData, retain selection/expansion/fields/badges, append content matches with match badges and snippets, expose Esc/Enter/worktree/navigation/filter shortcuts, and configure picker input so `e` expands a selected row while `e` becomes query text when search input is active.
scenarios: Normal selection
picker input is not active and e is pressed
the picker returns Expand for the selected entry.
Search selection
picker input is active and e is pressed
the picker returns QueryChanged and appends e to the query.
Rendered rows
session entries/content hits exist
rows carry their built labels, fields, badges, snippets, selection and expansion state.
Shortcuts
fullscreen picker is rendered
back/select/worktree/navigate/filter hints are present and vim mode is read from appearance cache.
Session row defaults
a session summary is empty or activity timestamps differ
the row uses (no prompt) and a right-aligned relative time based on last_active_at with updated_at fallback.
Expanded session fields
a selected backing row is expanded and optional metadata exists
the owned field list includes the documented identity/time/model/host/count/detail values, with prompt preview width-limited.
Content row data
a unique content hit has summary, timestamp and snippet data
the row carries summary/right time, content-based expansion key, selection offset and a first nonempty snippet preview capped at 80 characters.
Expansion remap
a nonempty query produces fuzzy and content map items
state.expanded is replaced with original fuzzy indices and CONTENT_EXPAND_OFFSET plus content hit indices; an empty query clears it and stops.
Content header label
loading and has-content-rows combinations vary
loading produces the spinner text, settled rows produce Extended search results and neither produces an empty label.

requirement: Announcement, promo CTA, startup warning, and tip rendering
contract: render_welcome_done SHALL render startup warnings in the hero error slot with severity-aware colors, pass announcements and expansion/CTA state into the hero, return announcement truncation/click and promo CTA rectangles, and render either the pending-update banner or random tip in the bottom slot.
scenarios: Announcement
an announcement is supplied on the authenticated home
its title/message appears in the hero info slot, a click rect is returned, and no changelog fallback is used.
Startup warning
startup_warnings contain a selected warning
the message and optional action are centered with warning/info color and spacing.
Promo CTA
promo_cta is Some(label)
hero reserves a CTA row and reports its clickable rect.
Update/tip
pending update or random tip occupies the tip slot
update text/ctrl+u or the random tip is rendered with the configured inset.

requirement: Session picker hit areas and render-result ownership contract
contract: WelcomeRenderResult SHALL expose menu rectangles, optional session-picker hit areas, announcement and promo hit rectangles, announcement truncation state, and post-flush overlay ownership; the trust gate returns only meaningful menu rects while the authenticated picker returns picker hit areas and the home hero returns menu/announcement/CTA rects.

requirement: Rewind wire models and phases preserve mode, conflict, prompt, and draft context
contract: RewindPointInfo, RewindPointsResponse, RewindResponse and RewindConflictInfo SHALL deserialize camelCase payloads with unknown fields rejected. RewindMode SHALL map All, ConversationOnly and FilesOnly to stable wire/display labels. ConflictDisplay SHALL map deleted_externally/created_externally/modified_externally to deleted/added/modified and unknown types to conflict. RewindState constructors SHALL initialize CancelOffer or ModeSelect with anchor, target, file-offer, draft and selected-prompt context.
scenarios: Wire payload
rewind points/response/conflict JSON is received
camelCase known fields deserialize and unknown fields are rejected.
Mode mapping
a mode is sent to shell or displayed
wire_value is all/conversation_only/files_only and display is human-readable.
Conflict label
a conflict type is known or unknown
the corresponding stable label is produced, with unknown values becoming conflict.
State setup
cancel or mode selection opens
phase starts at active index zero and retains anchor/draft/target context.

requirement: Rewind keyboard input maps each phase to explicit dismiss, navigation, mode, confirmation, and execution intents
contract: handle_rewind_key SHALL consume release events and route key presses by phase. Picker SHALL support j/k/arrows, Enter selection and Esc dismissal. CancelOffer SHALL map y to cancel-turn-and-proceed, n/Esc to dismissal, and Enter/navigation to cursor actions. ModeSelect SHALL support a/all, b/c conversation-only aliases according to inline/classic row layout, f only for an offered enabled files-only row, navigation, Enter and Esc. Confirm and ConversationOnlyConfirm SHALL map y/Enter to confirmation, Backspace to mode select, and Esc to full dismissal. Loading/Previewing SHALL only accept Esc; Executing SHALL consume input; Error SHALL dismiss on Esc/Enter.
scenarios: Picker
a point picker is focused
navigation moves, Enter emits PickerSelect for the selected prompt, and Esc dismisses.
Inline mode select
offer_files_only is false
b/c select conversation-only, f is consumed, and hidden files-only cannot be reached.
Classic mode select
file changes are offered and available
a/c/f and Enter produce the selected mode while navigation clamps to offered rows.
Confirm
a confirmation phase is active
y/Enter confirms, Backspace returns to mode selection, and Esc dismisses directly.
Passive/error phase
loading/previewing/executing/error receives input
only documented dismiss or no-op consumption occurs.

requirement: Rewind cursor movement and activation clamp to visible options and mirror Enter semantics
contract: move_cursor SHALL clamp picker, cancel, mode and confirmation active indices to the currently offered option range, including omitting disabled/hidden files-only rows. set_rewind_cursor SHALL report only actual changes and apply the same clamps for mouse hover/click. confirm_cursor SHALL translate active rows to CancelTurnThenProceed, Dismissed, SelectMode, Confirm, ConversationOnlyConfirm or BackToModeSelect. rewind_activate SHALL select the current picker point, dismiss errors, or delegate to confirm_cursor for other interactive phases.
scenarios: Keyboard clamp
cursor moves beyond the first/last option
active_idx remains within the offered rows.
Mouse clamp
set_rewind_cursor receives an out-of-range index
the index is clamped and bool reports whether state changed.
Activation
Enter/click activates current phase
the resulting RewindInput matches the phase’s Enter semantics.
Empty/passive
there are no picker points or phase is noninteractive
activation is Consumed and no invalid index is produced.

requirement: Rewind hit testing and overlay height track visible rows, optional file sections, and bounded lists
contract: rewind_row_at SHALL reject zero/tiny/outside areas and map only selectable rows for Picker, CancelOffer, ModeSelect, Confirm, ConversationOnlyConfirm and Error. Hidden or disabled files-only rows SHALL have no hit target. Confirm hit rows SHALL account for up to five clean/conflict file rows, overflow summary rows, and a separating gap. Loading/Previewing/Executing SHALL expose no rows. rewind_overlay_height SHALL mirror render geometry, shorten inline mode by one row, cap list overlays through ListOverlay, and include screen-independent content plus chrome.
scenarios: Picker hit test
a pointer lands on title, point, past-last, or outside area
only point rows return their point index.
Mode hit test
files-only is hidden or disabled
index 2 has no clickable row; inline mode is one row shorter.
Confirm rows
clean/conflict file lists are empty or populated
radio rows are located after bounded file/overflow rows and optional gap.
Passive phase
loading/previewing/executing is shown
no row is selectable and height is the passive two-row panel plus chrome.

requirement: Rewind overlay rendering presents phase-specific prompts, files/conflicts, radio focus, and unfocused dimming
contract: render_rewind_overlay SHALL no-op for zero-height or too-narrow areas, paint the panel background/accent bar, render phase-specific loading/picker/cancel/mode/preview/executing/confirm/conversation-only/error text, truncate confirmation prompt previews to available width, cap clean/conflict lists at five with +N more rows, render disabled rows dimmed, highlight the active focused row, and blend the panel when unfocused. key_label SHALL render Esc/Bksp sentinels as readable labels.
scenarios: Mode rendering
classic or inline mode selection is shown
titles and a/b/c/f radio labels match whether file-only is offered.
Confirm rendering
files/conflicts or no files are present
mode-specific title, file/conflict rows, overflow counts, confirm/back controls and warning text render.
Unfocused panel
focused is false
the rendered overlay is blended toward its background.
Special keys
radio key is Esc or Backspace sentinel
key_label renders Esc/Bksp rather than control characters.

requirement: Doctor fix registry and identifier resolution
contract: The Doctor fix registry SHALL expose canonical diagnostic ids, short handles, labels, and commands for SSH wrapping plus the three tmux options; resolve_fix_id SHALL accept either the short handle or canonical id, human_fix_command SHALL produce the handle command, automatic_fix_choices SHALL enumerate the registry, and unknown ids SHALL return UnknownId.
scenarios: Canonical id
a canonical or short id names a registered fix
the same DiagnosticId is returned and its human command is available.
Registry completeness
all registered fixes are enumerated
each handle and canonical id resolves to its own spec/command.
Unknown
an unregistered id is requested
resolution fails with FixError::UnknownId and no human command exists.

requirement: Automatic-fix applicability and local-versus-remote availability
contract: Automatic fix listing SHALL derive from report findings and planner applicability; SSH wrapping SHALL be marked RunLocally for SSH/official VS Code Remote contexts, while applicable tmux fixes remain Here even inside an SSH session, and absent automatic remediation or failed planning SHALL omit a choice.
scenarios: Local SSH wrap
a report finding has SSH automatic remediation on a local terminal
the SSH fix is listed as Here.
Remote SSH wrap
terminal/report indicates an SSH or official VS Code Remote session
the SSH fix is listed as RunLocally and no local plan is required.
Remote tmux
a tmux option finding is applicable in an SSH session
the tmux fix remains available Here.
No remediation
finding has no automatic remediation
the finding contributes no automatic fix.

requirement: SSH-wrap planning by shell and execution context
contract: plan_ssh_wrap SHALL reject Windows, official VS Code Remote, SSH sessions, unsupported shells, and unsafe environment paths; for Bash, zsh, and fish it SHALL select the shell-specific config path and exact managed alias, configure a validator when available, preserve SSH behavior caveats, and report an explicit manual one-off command for unsupported/manual use.
scenarios: Shell paths
Bash, zsh, or fish is selected
the plan targets .bashrc, .zshrc, or .config/fish/config.fish and uses the exact alias syntax.
Remote/platform
the environment is remote, official VS Code Remote, or Windows
planning fails with the corresponding safety error before mutation.
Unsupported shell
SHELL is not Bash/zsh/fish
planning returns UnsupportedShell with the one-off wrap command guidance.
Caveats
an SSH plan succeeds
the plan records new-shell activation, command bypass, ControlPersist/ssh -f/~^Z limitations, and customization review.

requirement: Tmux fix applicability, scopes, physical paths, and managed blocks
contract: plan_tmux_option SHALL require a tmux-backed, non-screen Byobu, tmux-report, finding, and positive evidence gate; it SHALL choose the physical .tmux.conf or validated BYOBU_CONFIG_DIR/.tmux.conf path, create an independent managed item with the option’s correct scope/value, and allow each option to coexist in one managed namespace.
scenarios: Option specs
clipboard, DCS passthrough, or extended keys is selected with matching evidence
the plan uses the exact option line and independent terminal diagnostic id.
Physical path
plain tmux or Byobu tmux is active
the requested path is a concrete .tmux.conf path without ~; missing Byobu config returns ByobuConfigUnavailable.
Managed coexistence
multiple tmux fixes are applied sequentially
one grow doctor namespace contains one block per option and each outcome requires reload.
Non-applicable evidence
multiplexer/backend/support/finding/value gates fail
planning returns TmuxNotApplicable.

requirement: Safe directory, preview, quoting, and reload instructions
contract: Fix path handling SHALL accept only non-root absolute directories without dot components, control characters, or tilde; preview paths SHALL render CommonMark-safe code spans and symlink requested/target/backup paths, shell_quote_path SHALL reject newline/CR/NUL, and reload_instruction SHALL emit a safely quoted tmux source-file command or a detach/reattach fallback.
scenarios: Unsafe directory
HOME or BYOBU_CONFIG_DIR is relative, root-only, dotted, control-containing, or tilde-based
SafeAbsoluteDirectory::parse rejects it with UnsafeDirectory.
Quoting
a tmux path contains spaces, quotes, backticks, or newline
the reload command shell-quotes/escapes valid paths, uses a sufficient CommonMark delimiter, and falls back for unsafe newline paths.
Preview
a planned change uses requested, symlink target, or backup paths
format_fix_preview renders each path safely and explains the target/backup/write state.

requirement: Tmux scanner parsing and direct assignment safety
contract: The direct tmux scanner SHALL ignore comments, user options, option lookalikes, conditional/native blocks, local or targeted window assignments, and unrelated commands; recognize supported server/window scopes and separators; classify healthy values as Healthy; and fail closed with ExistingCustomization for conflicting, ambiguous, unterminated, targeted-server, prefixed-command, or malformed assignments.
scenarios: Healthy assignments
a direct assignment uses an allowed scope/value for the spec
scan_direct_tmux_option returns Healthy.
Conflict
a direct assignment sets an unhealthy value
the scanner returns ExistingCustomization and persistent verification is false.
Ignored/local
the text is comment, @user option, conditional/block, lookalike, local window, or unrelated command
the target remains Absent.
Ambiguous syntax
command/option prefixes, extra/missing args, unterminated quote/escape, or target ambiguity is present
the scanner fails closed with an ExistingCustomization detail.

requirement: SSH customization conflict detection and managed-state verification
contract: SSH planning and managed_alias_configured SHALL detect direct POSIX aliases/functions and fish aliases/functions for the exact ssh name while ignoring comments, near-name tokens, and Grow-managed blocks; existing customizations SHALL be preserved, and a later unmanaged conflict SHALL make a managed alias unconfigured.
scenarios: Existing customization
a non-comment alias or function defines exact ssh
planning returns ExistingCustomization without changing the file.
Whitespace/boundary
declarations vary in shell whitespace or use ssh_wrap/sshuttle
exact ssh forms are found while near-name forms are ignored.
Managed-only
the file contains only a matching Grow managed alias and comments
it is considered configured/idempotent.
Later conflict
a matching managed block is followed by an unmanaged ssh alias/function
managed_alias_configured returns false.

requirement: Validator discovery and validated-source conflict policy
contract: Validator discovery SHALL prefer an executable explicit shell path, resolve basename-only shells through PATH, reject non-executable explicit paths without substitution, and managed planning SHALL inspect the exact validated source snapshot, fail closed on non-UTF-8 content, and reject stale plans before conflict policy or mutation.
scenarios: Validator path
SHELL is an executable path or basename
the explicit executable is used directly; basename resolves to the first executable PATH candidate.
Invalid explicit shell
SHELL names a non-executable path
resolution returns None rather than substituting another same-basename binary.
Stale source
the config changes after planning
apply_fix returns Managed/TmuxManaged StalePlan and leaves the changed content intact.
Non-UTF8
source bytes are invalid UTF-8
planning returns Managed UnsafePath before alias conflict handling.

requirement: Transactional apply, idempotence, outcomes, and persistent verification
contract: apply_fix SHALL apply managed SSH/tmux plans transactionally, verify the requested postcondition, return Applied or AlreadyConfigured with changed/backup paths and activation semantics, preserve the planned shell on SSH outcomes, and verify persistent tmux state while treating SSH persistence as requiring the shell-aware alias check.
scenarios: SSH apply
a valid SSH plan is applied
the alias is verified, outcome status/changed path/shell are recorded, and activation is SatisfiedNow.
Tmux apply
a tmux plan is applied or already healthy
the option is verified, status is Applied/AlreadyConfigured, and activation is RequiresReload.
Idempotent
the requested setting is already exact
no write/backup is reported and verification succeeds.
Postcondition failure
the config changes unexpectedly or the managed result cannot be verified
apply returns the specific postcondition/stale error and does not claim success.

requirement: Diagnostic report filtering and user-facing fix messages
contract: configured_report SHALL remove only the exact SSH-wrap finding when configured, format_fix_success SHALL describe the specific applied/already-configured option, backup, and reload/new-shell activation, and format_applicable_automatic_fixes SHALL render local versus remote commands or a no-fixes message.
scenarios: Unconfigured report
configured is false
the SSH-wrap finding remains.
Configured report
the verified planned alias is configured
the exact SSH-wrap finding is removed.
Success message
an outcome is Applied or AlreadyConfigured
the message includes path, backup when present, and activation/reload guidance.
Preview
a plan targets a new, existing, or symlinked file
the preview explains text, physical target, backup behavior, caveats, and tmux reload limits.

requirement: Shell alias expansion and explicit bypass behavior
contract: The generated Bash, zsh, and fish aliases SHALL expand `ssh -p 2222 host` to the exact argv `wrap ssh -p 2222 host`, while `command ssh ...` SHALL bypass the alias and invoke the underlying ssh executable directly.
scenarios: Wrapped invocation
a supported shell sources the generated alias and invokes ssh
grow receives argv wrap, ssh, and the original options/host in order.
Explicit bypass
a command uses command ssh
the underlying ssh executable runs without the grow wrapper.
Alias syntax
fish is available
fish alias behavior matches POSIX expansion and does not leave an ssh environment variable.

requirement: Shared UI setting resolvers
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The settings boundary keeps current-session permission changes out of the settings modal's captured future-session snapshot, while SetDefaultPermissionMode changes only the future-session default, updates the current UI canonical value and emits PersistPermissionMode with no session id. permission_mode_toast returns the tested brand strings for Ask and AlwaysApprove. SetTheme("auto") commits the literal auto setting, updates current_ui.theme to auto and enables the auto-mode cache after the mocked dark system appearance resolves the concrete palette.
scenarios: Settings snapshot isolation
a Settings modal is open and current-session permission changes to AlwaysApprove
the modal remains open, its pager default snapshot stays false, its UI snapshot stays None and only the session flag changes.
Future default
SetDefaultPermissionMode(AlwaysApprove) is dispatched
the active session stays unchanged, the default becomes always-approve, current UI reflects it and a sessionless PersistPermissionMode is emitted.
Toast vocabulary
permission_mode_toast is requested for Ask or AlwaysApprove
the exact success or destructive warning string is returned.
Auto theme commit
SetTheme("auto") runs under the mocked Dark system appearance
one PersistSetting stores the enum auto, current_ui.theme is auto and the theme cache reports auto mode enabled.

requirement: SessionEvent SHALL model terminal turn outcomes, compaction/retry/context failures, hook annotations, model availability, memory saves, and manual/automatic recaps with structured fields, and message SHALL render each variant with the documented duration, token, error-category, path, model-switch and recovery text.
contract: SessionEvent SHALL preserve optional elapsed values for completed/failed turns, format durations through format_duration, show unknown completion duration as Turn completed., include compaction before/after tokens and optional seconds, use the structured error_type to label RetryFailed as a model request failure, make ContextTooLarge actionable with /new, pass HookAnnotation message through, append a model switch only when new_model_id is nonempty, abbreviate memory paths and include /memory to view, and use the same Recap — label for manual and automatic recaps. Token counts below 1000 remain integers and counts at or above 1000 use one decimal k notation.
scenarios: Turn outcome
a turn completes, is cancelled, halted, or fails with/without elapsed time
the message uses the matching human-readable outcome and duration form.
Compaction outcome
compaction completes with token counts and optional elapsed milliseconds, fails with an empty or nonempty error, or is cancelled
the message reports the token delta/seconds, terse failure, appended curated error, or cancellation.
Retry and overflow
a retry failure has no error type, has a structured error type, or the context is too large
the row says Retry failed, Model request failed, or offers /new recovery as appropriate.
Session adjuncts
the event is a hook annotation, model-unavailable notice, memory save, or recap
the event message exposes the supplied annotation, switch/re-auth reason, abbreviated path and trigger, or stable recap label.
Token boundary
a token count is below, equal to, or above the thousand threshold
format_tokens uses plain decimal below 1000 and one-decimal k notation at/above 1000.

requirement: SessionEventBlock SHALL carry an optional immutable event_id, typed event, stop/stop_failure hook batches, and optional prompt_id, with constructors that initialize empty metadata or attach hook batches only to turn-terminal events.
contract: new SHALL create a block with event_id=None, no stop hooks and prompt_id=None. with_stop_hooks SHALL retain the supplied groups and prompt id and debug-assert that nonempty groups belong to a TurnCompleted, TurnCancelled, TurnHalted or TurnFailed event. has_stop_hook_content SHALL return true only when at least one attached run is not Skipped, while skipped-only groups remain inert.
scenarios: Plain block
a caller constructs a SessionEventBlock with new
the typed event is retained and IDs/hooks/prompt association start empty.
Terminal hook attachment
a caller attaches stop groups to a terminal event
the groups and prompt id are retained for later summary/detail rendering.
Skipped hooks
all attached hook runs have HookRunStatus::Skipped
the block reports no hook content and remains non-interactive.
Mixed hook status
at least one attached run is Success, Blocked, Failed or otherwise non-skipped
the block reports hook content and exposes the fold/selection affordance.

requirement: Non-recap SessionEventBlock output SHALL render the event message as a compact wrapped informational block, assign a common selection range to text lines, color actionable context/compaction failures with the warning theme, and remain raw-mode and vertical-padding neutral.
contract: output SHALL route Recap to recap_output, otherwise style ContextTooLarge and CompactionFailed with Theme::warning and all other events with Theme::muted, wrap single- and multi-line text to BlockContext.width, synthesize an empty selectable line if wrapping returns none, append stop-hook decoration, and give ordinary text lines selection range 0. has_vpad_for and has_raw_mode SHALL both return false; is_groupable SHALL return true.
scenarios: Ordinary event
a non-recap event has a message that fits or exceeds the content width
the message is rendered in muted style and word-wrapped to the supplied width.
Actionable failure
the event is ContextTooLarge or CompactionFailed
the text and accent use the theme warning color.
Multiline message
the message contains newline-separated text
each source line is wrapped independently through the common wrapping helper.
Empty wrap result
the wrapper yields no lines
one empty BlockLine with selection range 0 is retained.
Block flags
a renderer queries vertical padding, raw mode or groupability
the block reports compact/no-raw/groupable behavior.

requirement: Recap session events SHALL render as a tool-style, foldable presentation with a bold non-selectable Recap header, muted body, collapsed first-line preview, and a loading-only header while generation is running.
contract: recap_output SHALL show only the header while ctx.is_running; in collapsed mode it SHALL append the trimmed first summary line, truncate to ctx.content_width and make only the preview span selectable; in truncated/expanded modes it SHALL add a non-selectable blank separator and wrap each summary line to max(ctx.width-2,20). Empty or whitespace-only summaries SHALL not acquire interactive affordances. Finished expanded recaps use a static neutral tool accent; loading recaps use an animated gray accent; collapsed idle recaps have no accent/bullet, and has_bullet follows the configured tool bullet character.
scenarios: Expanded recap
a nonempty recap is rendered in Expanded or Truncated mode
a bold Recap header, decoration gap and wrapped muted body lines are produced.
Collapsed preview
a multiline nonempty recap is rendered collapsed
one truncated line shows Recap plus only the trimmed first line, with preview-only selection.
Loading recap
a recap is running or has an empty loading summary
only the header is shown and a gray animated sidebar/bullet signals progress.
Empty recap
the summary is empty or whitespace-only after trimming
the block is not selectable or foldable.
Copy boundaries
expanded recap body lines are selected
header and gap remain decoration while every body line shares selection range 0.

requirement: Turn-terminal SessionEventBlock rows SHALL integrate non-skipped stop and stop_failure hook runs as right-justified summaries and optional expanded detail without contaminating marker text selection.
contract: append_stop_hooks SHALL skip empty/skipped-only batches or absent summaries, append a single-line summary inline only when marker text plus two spaces plus summary fits the width, preserve marker spans/selection_text for drag-copy, and otherwise place a right-justified non-selectable summary line below the marker (including wrapped markers). In non-Collapsed mode it SHALL append per-hook detail; multiple groups retain event-name sections, while a single group uses the compact detail renderer. Hook-bearing markers start Collapsed and are foldable/selectable; skipped-only markers stay plain.
scenarios: Inline summary
a single-line terminal marker has enough width for the hook summary
the marker remains one line, the summary is right-justified and only marker spans are copyable.
Narrow marker
the marker width leaves no room for the summary
the summary moves to its own right-justified decoration line.
Wrapped marker
a long TurnFailed marker wraps even though its first line might fit
the summary is placed below all marker text rather than mid-paragraph.
Collapsed details
a hook-bearing marker is collapsed
the summary remains visible but per-hook names/details are hidden.
Expanded details
a hook-bearing marker is expanded
hook output is appended; multiple stop/stop_failure groups retain labeled sections.

requirement: SessionEventBlock interaction predicates SHALL expose folding/navigation only for nonempty recaps or terminal markers with hook content, keep ordinary informational events non-interactive, and apply the documented accent/bullet policy.
contract: is_foldable and is_selectable SHALL be the disjunction of recap_has_body and has_stop_hook_content. default_display_mode SHALL be Collapsed for hook-bearing markers and Expanded otherwise. accent SHALL return an animated gray recap accent while running, a static neutral tool accent for finished expanded recaps, a static warning accent for ContextTooLarge/CompactionFailed, and None for other events. bullet SHALL delegate to accent except for collapsed idle recap, where it is absent; has_bullet SHALL additionally require the configured tool bullet character.
scenarios: Ordinary event
a terminal event has no hook content or a non-recap event is displayed
it is neither foldable nor selectable and has no accent/bullet.
Hook marker
a terminal marker has at least one non-skipped hook
it is foldable/selectable and defaults to Collapsed.
Actionable warning
ContextTooLarge or CompactionFailed is queried
a static warning accent is returned.
Finished recap
a nonempty recap is expanded or collapsed while idle
expanded uses the neutral tool accent and collapsed suppresses accent/bullet.
Running recap
a recap is still running
animated gray accent and matching bullet are returned.

requirement: SubagentInfo lifecycle fields and elapsed display semantics
contract: SubagentInfo SHALL be the shared child-session state keyed by child_session_id, preserve identity/provenance/permission/worktree/activity/usage fields, report is_running as the inverse of finished, measure live elapsed time from started_at, and prefer authoritative duration_ms for finished display while falling back to wall-clock elapsed when absent.
scenarios: Running
finished is false
is_running is true and display elapsed uses live elapsed from started_at.
Finished with duration
finished is true and duration_ms exists
display_elapsed/display_elapsed_at use the recorded milliseconds.
Finished without duration
finished is true but duration_ms is absent
display elapsed falls back to elapsed since started_at, saturating at the supplied clock for display_elapsed_at.

requirement: Child replay eligibility and one-shot replay gate
contract: subagent_child_needs_replay SHALL return true for an empty child scrollback or one containing only UserPrompt blocks, and false once substantive blocks such as tool calls exist; ensure_subagent_child_replayed SHALL replay only when the child has not been marked replayed and still needs replay, then mark the flag even for no-op/missing transcripts.
scenarios: Empty/prompt-only
child scrollback is empty or contains only UserPrompt
the child is eligible for inherited replay.
Substantive content
a tool-call block is present
the child is not replayed again.
Already replayed
child_updates_replayed is true
ensure_subagent_child_replayed leaves the child scrollback unchanged.
No-op transcript
the transcript is missing or empty
the replay attempt marks the child replayed but does not claim a parsed update.

requirement: Streaming inherited transcript replay and memory release
contract: replay_inherited_updates SHALL load the effective Grow home, stream typed updates from the child updates log into the child session with replay metadata, no-op safely on missing/read errors, log failures, and release retained memory exactly when ReplayEmission::Emitted is returned.
scenarios: Replay updates
a child updates log contains parsed session updates
each update is passed to handle_update with is_replay metadata and emitted replay memory is released.
Missing/error
the child session or updates file cannot be read
the function returns without panicking or releasing memory for a non-emission.
Empty
the file yields zero updates
the function does not purge retained memory.

requirement: Durable spawn enrichment and child-view projection
contract: enrich_from_timeline SHALL best-effort load the parent identity-bound Timeline from the effective Grow home, find the matching SubagentSpawned event by subagent_id, and copy prompt, child cwd, and optional worktree path; missing/malformed timelines SHALL leave the info unchanged. enrich_projected_subagent SHALL reject mismatched child ownership and update both the flat info and existing child view cwd/worktree projection for a matching spawn.
scenarios: Matching timeline
the parent timeline contains a matching spawn fact
prompt, child_cwd, and worktree_path are populated.
Missing/malformed
the timeline file is absent or invalid
the existing SubagentInfo fields remain unchanged.
Projected child
the root index has a matching child and view
the child info is enriched and its AgentView cwd/worktree state is corrected.
Mismatched owner
subagent_id does not match the durable fact
the enrichment is ignored.

requirement: Breadth-first descendant state restoration
contract: restore_descendant_state SHALL rebuild nested child state after root load by reading durable immediate-parent spawns breadth-first, projecting replayable lifecycle notifications (spawn/progress/finish/model/agent changes) through the normal descendant replay handler with isReplay metadata, enriching discovered children, avoiding duplicate visits, and restoring the root loading/replay cursor flags afterward.
scenarios: Root unavailable
the root agent or session id is absent
restoration returns without mutating the app.
Direct children
root replay already projected direct child ids and durable root spawns exist
matching children are enriched, queued, and the root replay gate is held during traversal.
Nested lifecycle
a child timeline contains lifecycle/control notifications
notifications are re-associated with the parent session and routed through handle_descendant_state_replay; discovered durable children are queued.
Completion
the breadth-first walk ends
previous loading_replay is restored and replay_live_cursor_seen is reset.

requirement: Finished child finalization and deferred-open completion
contract: ensure_subagent_child_replayed SHALL finalize a finished child using its recorded duration, finish the tracker and all running scrollback entries, append exactly one TurnCompleted footer, finish running entries for an idle parent, and avoid closing a child turn while the parent turn/cancellation remains active.
scenarios: Finished child
child info is finished with duration_ms
the child tracker/scrollback are finalized and a TurnCompleted event carries the elapsed duration.
Running parent
the parent turn is running or cancelling
the child is replayed without forcibly finishing live running entries.
Idle parent
the parent is not running
remaining child running entries are finished after replay.

requirement: Subagent metadata, context badges, labels, and canonical title
contract: Subagent display formatting SHALL render optional model metadata with parentheses and middle-dot joining, abbreviate general-purpose to general while passing through known/custom types, show resumed/forked context badges only, choose a meaningful subagent type before a leading nonempty description tag and finally General, capitalize the label, strip a used tag prefix from the description, and preserve empty/unclosed prefixes.
scenarios: Model metadata
model is absent or present
format_subagent_meta returns empty or ` (model)`.
Type label
type is general-purpose, known, or custom
format_type_label returns general or the original type.
Context badge
context_source is resumed, forked, new, or absent
only resumed/forked produce badges.
Label precedence
type is meaningful, or default with a valid tag, or neither
format_subagent_label returns capitalized type/tag/General in that order.
Description cleanup
description has a valid, empty, or unclosed bracket prefix
valid tags are stripped and used as fallback labels; empty/unclosed forms remain unchanged.
Canonical title
label and cleaned description are combined
format_subagent_title returns label alone for empty description or `Label description` otherwise.

requirement: Subagent activity status labels and bounded tool subjects
contract: format_activity_label SHALL map tracker activity states to concise labels: Thinking, Responding, Compacting, Retrying (attempt/max), and Waiting reason labels; tool-running activity SHALL prefer a nonempty description subject, otherwise use Running tool or the first title line, truncate by character count at MAX_ACTIVITY_SUBJECT_CHARS with an ellipsis, and preserve multibyte character boundaries.
scenarios: Core states
activity is Thinking, Responding, AutoCompacting, or Retrying
the expected concise status label is returned.
Waiting
waiting reason is subagent, task output, or a named subject
the reason label is returned with the expected ellipsis/subject.
Tool title
tool title is empty, short, multiline, exactly at, or beyond the limit
the result uses Running tool, first line, full boundary-length title, or a character-safe ellipsis truncation.
Description override
tool-running description is nonempty
the waiting-for-subject formatter takes precedence over the title.

requirement: The borderless welcome hero SHALL select a logo presentation tier from content width and height, degrading from big side-by-side to small side-by-side, stacked small, and text-only while never showing a logo that cannot fit the complete content block.
contract: candidates SHALL use measured logo dimensions plus H_PAD, V_PAD and RIGHT_COL_MIN gates: big requires at least 143 columns and 39 rows, small side-by-side at least 113 columns and 26 rows, stacked small at least 54 columns and 26 rows, otherwise TextOnly. compute_hero SHALL try candidates in that order, account for menu, error, tip and announcement reservations, and fall back to TextOnly when fixed rows leave no fitting logo mode. HeroMode exposes SideBySide(LogoSize), Stacked(LogoSize), and TextOnly.
scenarios: Big logo
the content area meets both big width and height gates
SideBySide(Big) is selected.
Small fallback
one big dimension is short but the small side-by-side gates fit
SideBySide(Small) is selected.
Stacked fallback
side-by-side does not fit but the small stacked gates fit
Stacked(Small) is selected with the logo above the text group.
Text-only fallback
the area is too narrow/short or tip/error rows consume the available height
TextOnly is selected and the logo rect has zero height.
Measured assets
logo resource dimensions or padding constants determine the thresholds
the gates derive from active asset dimensions rather than hardcoded art assumptions.

requirement: compute_hero SHALL produce vertically centered, borderless hero geometry with stable version, subtitle, info, menu, tip and error rectangles for side-by-side, stacked and text-only modes.
contract: fixed_below SHALL reserve tip_height plus one gap row only when a tip exists. The text group SHALL be capped at STACKED_TEXT_WIDTH after horizontal padding in stacked/text-only modes. Side-by-side SHALL allocate the left column as max(half content width, logo width plus horizontal padding), center the logo in it and vertically center the text group; stacked SHALL center the logo and use one separator row before text; text-only SHALL center only the text group. Rectangles with absent sections SHALL be zero, and section order SHALL be version, subtitle or info, then menu.
scenarios: Side-by-side geometry
a wide/tall area selects a side-by-side mode
the hero fills its slot, the logo is centered in the left column, and text begins at the column split.
Stacked geometry
a medium area selects stacked mode
the small logo is horizontally centered and text begins one row below it at the stable width cap.
Text-only geometry
no logo fits
the text group is centered and its width shrinks to available content after padding.
Section order
no announcement is present
version, subtitle and menu have increasing rows and info is zero; with announcement, subtitle is hidden and info occupies that slot.
Fixed rows
tip or error height is nonzero
the layout reserves their rows and centers the remaining hero without overflowing the content area.

requirement: render_hero SHALL render the selected logo, inline version badge, optional subtitle, announcement info slot and menu without borders, and return menu, announcement and promo CTA hit geometry plus truncation state.
contract: render_hero SHALL derive hover position only when interactive, render the logo only for nonzero logo geometry using the selected LogoSize art, use HeroInline version badge mode, draw the fixed subtitle when present, call announcement rendering only when info has height and an announcement exists, and render menu only when menu has height. HeroRects SHALL report menu_rects, announcement_truncated, optional announcement_rect and optional promo_cta_rect.
scenarios: Borderless hero
a normal hero is rendered into a Buffer
logo/text/menu content is drawn without border glyphs.
Interactive hover
interactive is false or true with a mouse position
hover styling is suppressed or forwarded to menu/announcement painters accordingly.
Menu hit areas
menu rows are rendered
one menu rectangle per row is returned in row order.
Announcement hit areas
announcement content fits or truncates
the full text area and truncation flag are returned when shown.
Optional sections
logo, info or menu are absent
their painters are skipped and the corresponding hit collections/rects are empty.

requirement: The welcome announcement renderer SHALL display optional title and message text within its area, cap collapsed messages to two wrapped rows, show an ellipsis when content overflows, and brighten only genuinely expandable or expanded content on hover.
contract: render_announcement_block SHALL color critical titles with accent_error and other titles with warning, truncate title text to area width, wrap message by Unicode display width, use at most two message rows when collapsed and all available rows when expanded, return whether rows were omitted, and use hover_style only when expanded or the wrapped message exceeds max_lines. A short fitting announcement SHALL remain non-interactive-looking on hover. render_wrapped_text SHALL clip the final visible row to width minus one column before painting a styled ellipsis and SHALL never draw when max_lines or width is zero.
scenarios: Collapsed overflow
a long announcement is collapsed
title plus at most two message rows are shown, the final row has an ellipsis, and truncated is true.
Short message
the announcement fits within its rows
no ellipsis is drawn, truncated is false, and hover does not brighten the message.
Expanded message
expanded is true and enough rows exist
the full wrapped message is shown without an ellipsis or truncation.
Expanded clamp
expanded is true but the area is still too short
the visible rows remain in bounds and the final row keeps the ellipsis.
Hover affordance
the mouse is over an overflowing or expanded message
message and ellipsis use the bright hover style; a noninteractive short message stays gray.

requirement: The welcome hero SHALL keep announcement layout pre-pass row accounting identical to rendering, reserving a spacer and CTA row whenever a promo label is supplied and preventing message text from painting over the button.
contract: announcement_text_rows SHALL count an optional title plus wrapped message rows, capped at two unless expanded. announcement_desired_rows SHALL add ANNOUNCEMENT_CTA_ROWS (spacer plus button) only when has_promo_cta. info_slot_height SHALL clamp desired announcement rows to remaining slack after error, base hero and fixed-below rows and require one spacer row before info. render_announcement_with_cta SHALL shrink text_area by the reserved rows, place the CTA after drawn text plus a spacer only when it fits, return the text area/truncation/optional button rect, and show a caption only for non-dismissible announcements when a usable caption exists.
scenarios: No CTA
an announcement has no promo label
the full info area is available to text and no CTA rect is returned.
CTA reservation
a promo label is supplied
two rows are reserved so text cannot overlap the spacer/button area.
Pinned caption
a non-dismissible announcement has a usable CTA caption
the button row includes the dim caption and the returned rect covers only the button.
Dismissible promo
a dismissible announcement has a configured caption
the button remains bare and the caption is omitted.
Insufficient space
the computed slack cannot hold the info slot
info height is clamped or zero and the hero remains within the content area.

requirement: The hero wrapping helpers SHALL split whitespace-delimited text by Unicode display width, preserve over-wide single words as clipped render lines, and provide shared row counts for layout and drawing.
contract: wrap_lines SHALL return no rows for width zero or empty/whitespace-only input, join words with one space while the accumulated Unicode width fits, and emit an over-wide word as its own line for the renderer to clip. wrapped_line_count SHALL report the resulting row count as u16. render_wrapped_text SHALL use these rows, honor max_lines, and return whether omitted rows existed.
scenarios: Single line
short text fits the width
one row is drawn and remaining rows stay empty.
Multiple rows
words exceed the width
words wrap into multiple nonempty rows without drawing beyond max_lines.
Empty input
text is empty or whitespace-only
no rows are produced and no pixels are written.
Zero limits
width or max_lines is zero
render_wrapped_text returns false without drawing.
Wide word
one token exceeds width
it remains a single over-wide logical line and is clipped by the renderer before the ellipsis when truncated.

requirement: Deferred model and reasoning-effort resolution
contract: take_deferred_model_switch SHALL prioritize a stashed model/effort, resolve a CLI effort token only when the stashed effort is absent, report typed unsupported/unknown/no-active-model errors without dropping a stashed model, and omit a no-op switch when the resolved effort already equals the active model state. apply_deferred_model_switch SHALL consume the stash and apply_deferred_switch_outcome SHALL publish one typed control notice for an effort error.
scenarios: Effort only
a CLI effort token is supplied with an active model
the canonical/remapped token resolves, equal effort is skipped, and unsupported/unknown tokens return the typed error.
Stashed model
a stashed model exists with missing/invalid/unsupported effort
the model switch is preserved and effort is resolved or reported without dropping the model.
No active model
only a CLI effort token exists and no current model is available
NoActiveModel is reported.
Apply error
a deferred outcome contains an effort error
one control notice explains the error and retry guidance.

requirement: New session creation initialization and ready effects
contract: dispatch_new_session_inner_with_id SHALL unregister the previous active session, choose the active/session cwd and inherited worktree/permission state, create an empty placeholder with copied prompt/gate/plugin/bootstrap state, seed MCP progress and prompt-history loading when it can create immediately, and emit CreateSession with model and preferred session id. SessionCreated SHALL bind the session id, apply session models without overwriting the app new-session default, drain queued prompts only after deferred controls/reconnect barriers, fetch history/agent metadata/commands/marketplace/optional CTA, fetch pending extensions, register the active session, notify readiness, and keep minimal-mode resume messaging accurate.
scenarios: New session
a new session is dispatched
a new AgentView is focused with empty scrollback, prompt focus, bootstrap commands generation one, inherited permission/worktree state, and the expected CreateSession effect.
Session ready
SessionCreated supplies an id/models
the agent binds the id, session models update only the agent, fixed readiness effects are emitted, and optional plugin CTA is gated by the app flag.
Queued prompt
a prompt was queued before creation
the queue drains into SendPrompt unless reconnect/deferred Behavior holds the admission boundary.
Extensions
pending extension fetch is set
five extension list effects are emitted and the flag clears; without the flag none are emitted.
Minimal mode
a new session is created in minimal mode with multiple agents
the banner advertises /resume rather than /agents.

requirement: Worktree session creation, cwd projection, and queued startup
contract: dispatch_new_worktree_session SHALL require a git ancestor, preserve deferred worktree/load/label/ref/preferred-session intent while startup is gated, create a placeholder in CreateWorktree/RestoreWorktree command state with inherited app settings and optional prompt, and switch focus to it. WorktreeSessionCreated SHALL bind the id, mark worktree state, use the returned session cwd (including subdirectory offsets), finish the command/turn, show a ready notice, apply deferred controls, drain queued prompts, fetch metadata/extensions, register the session, and notify readiness.
scenarios: Create worktree
cwd is inside a git repository and startup is allowed
one placeholder agent and one CreateWorktreeSession effect are returned.
Non-git
cwd has no git ancestor
no agent/effect is created and a warning is recorded.
Worktree ready
WorktreeSessionCreated returns root and session cwd
the session uses the exact session cwd, worktree flag, ready notice, and readiness effects.
Queued prompt
a prompt is queued before worktree creation finishes
it is sent after WorktreeSessionCreated and the queue clears.
Deferred gate
startup is not allowed
worktree/load/ref/label/preferred id are stashed and no effect is emitted.

requirement: Session and worktree creation failure cleanup
contract: handle_session_failed and handle_worktree_session_failed SHALL distinguish orphan placeholders from existing/forked agents: remove orphan agents and return to Welcome or a surviving agent with deduplicated startup warning/toast, while retaining non-orphan agents, clearing loading/MCP/extensions/live feedback, finishing commands/turns, clearing pending prompts/banners, and appending a TurnFailed event with elapsed time.
scenarios: Orphan failure
a placeholder without session id/fork parent fails
the placeholder is removed, welcome/fallback focus is restored, and the failure is surfaced as a startup warning or fallback toast.
Existing/forked failure
an existing or forked agent fails
the agent remains, loading/command state clears, and TurnFailed is appended without deleting the agent.
Worktree failure
worktree creation fails
the same orphan/non-orphan policy applies with a Cannot create worktree warning.

requirement: Trust gate persistence and deferred startup replay
contract: dispatch_trust_folder SHALL persist a still-valid folder identity before resolving trust, keep TrustState::Pending and toast when the folder changed, and finish_trust SHALL mark Done only when startup is allowed. drain_startup_actions SHALL consume all deferred session/worktree/fork/new/prompt/dashboard fields exactly once and replay the correct dispatcher while preserving preferred ids, labels, refs, and prompts.
scenarios: Trust required
trust is pending
session_startup_allowed is false and new/startup actions remain gated.
Trust accepted
workspace identity still matches
trust is persisted, state becomes Done, and deferred startup actions replay.
Stale trust
workspace identity changed or persistence fails
state remains Pending and a review/reopen toast is shown.
Deferred intents
fork/load/new/worktree/preferred/prompt/dashboard intents coexist
all startup fields are cleared and each intent is routed once with the correct arguments/effect.

requirement: Project picker gating, selection, prompt preservation, and cwd synchronization
contract: dispatch_new_session SHALL open the project question when required and avoid duplicate placeholders; skip/selection paths SHALL restore the stashed prompt/model/preferred id, create exactly one session, update app/agent/dashboard cwd and git state, optionally persist picker disablement, and ignore late recents or duplicate selections after the picker is closed.
scenarios: Non-project startup
cwd needs a project picker
NewSession creates a placeholder and opens ProjectSelect before CreateSession.
Picker recents
the picker is untouched and recents complete
recent directories are merged; after user navigation or picker closure, stale completion is a no-op.
Prompt preservation
a prompt arrives while picker is open
it is attached/stashed behind the picker and later restored without premature submission.
Selection
a project path is selected
cwd/session cwd/dashboard snapshot and SetWorkingDir/CreateSession effects use the selected canonical path.
Duplicate selection
a second selection arrives after create is armed
it is a no-op and cannot consume a second create token or apply disablement.

requirement: Exit and delete session lifecycle effects
contract: dispatch_exit_session SHALL unregister the active session, return to Welcome, and clear picker/exit state. Delete confirmation SHALL require an active session, offer Delete/Cancel, cancel without effects, and on confirmation cancel the turn/subagents, kill running background tasks, toast progress, and emit DeleteSession targeting Welcome; completion SHALL clean up and guard absent sessions.
scenarios: Exit
an active session exits
the session is unregistered, Welcome is shown, and picker/exit state resets.
Delete prompt
an active session is present or absent
the delete question opens or a no-session toast is shown.
Confirm delete
delete is confirmed
CancelTurn, KillBgTask for running tasks, and DeleteSession effects are emitted.
Completion
deletion completes
the agent is removed and Welcome transition is safe/idempotent.

requirement: Sessionless input and permission/behavior control dispatch
contract: Sessionless SendPrompt SHALL queue text without emitting an effect, sessionless follow-up submission SHALL preserve chips and avoid SendPrompt, and control dispatch SHALL preserve auto/always-approve exclusivity, defer Plan behavior until a session exists, emit SwitchBehavior for an active idempotent transition, and ignore unknown background-task completions.
scenarios: No session prompt
session_id is absent
SendPrompt queues one prompt and emits no effect.
No session follow-up
follow-up chips exist without a session
SubmitFollowUp emits no SendPrompt and keeps chips.
Permission modes
AlwaysApprove is enabled after Auto
the auto display flag clears because always-approve wins.
Behavior mode
Plan is chosen without/with a session
a new session is started with deferred Plan, or an active session emits SwitchBehavior once.
Unknown task
BgTaskKilled names an unknown session
no effect is emitted and unrelated task state is unchanged.

requirement: Session identity and title fallback integration
contract: The session lifecycle dispatch SHALL preserve an actionable short title/identity fallback for newly created sessions without prompts and keep dashboard/session identity resolvers round-trippable for top-level and subagent rows.
scenarios: Untitled session
an agent has a session id but no prompt/display name
the entry title falls back to the short session id.
Top-level resolver
a persisted top-level session id is mapped to a live agent
resolve/to_persisted round-trip and absent ids return None.
Subagent resolver
a child session is registered under a parent
the persisted parent/child identity round-trips to the live dashboard row.

requirement: Dashboard stop integration through lifecycle dispatch seam
contract: The dispatch integration exercised alongside session lifecycle SHALL move dashboard selection/peek after deleting a selected top-level row and require a second Ctrl+X through handle_input to confirm deletion, preserving delete_confirm until dispatch consumes it.
scenarios: Peek close
dashboard peek is open on the selected row
DashboardStop deletes the selected row and moves selection/peek to the next row.
Double stop
Ctrl+X is pressed twice through handle_input
the first press arms confirmation and the second emits DeleteSession; completion removes the target.

requirement: ExecuteToolCallBlock SHALL retain the full command source, optional header display, description, error, streamed output, timing, bash-mode flag and elapsed state, with constructors and mutators that preserve incremental output and terminal timing semantics.
contract: new SHALL initialize command with empty optional fields, bash_mode=false and header_display=None. with_error/with_description/with_output SHALL replace the corresponding field. push_output SHALL append chunks to existing output or create it. finish SHALL be idempotent, storing start.elapsed milliseconds only when started_at exists and elapsed_ms is unset. set_error SHALL finalize elapsed time on first error mutation when started_at exists, then replace the error. is_success SHALL mean error.is_none; elapsed_ms SHALL return stored milliseconds or live elapsed milliseconds; copy_text SHALL render terminal output to plain copyable text or return empty when absent. command_display SHALL prefer header_display while command remains the full searchable/copy source.
scenarios: Initial block
a command is constructed before execution starts
command is retained with no output/error/timing and no header override.
Streaming chunks
output arrives in one or more chunks
chunks are appended in order and the block exposes the combined output.
Finish timing
a block has started_at and is finished repeatedly
elapsed_ms is captured once and later finish calls do not replace it.
Error mutation
set_error is called while a timed block is running
elapsed time is finalized before the supplied optional error is stored.
Copy source
copy_text is requested with terminal output or no output
terminal control sequences are converted to plain text or an empty string is returned.
Header override
header_display contains a peeled command
header helpers show the override while command remains the full searchable/copy source.

requirement: Execute headers SHALL support Shell and Label styles, description-first titles, user-bash markers, command highlighting and prefix-aware selection while preserving physical/soft-wrapped command structure.
contract: description_display SHALL trim and newline-collapse descriptions, treat blank descriptions as absent, and strip a leading Run or Running word for Label titles only when followed by whitespace or end. Shell headers use a dim dollar-space prefix; Label headers use bold Run plus optional muted user marker, with command text highlighted when applicable. A description renders as the title plus a secondary dollar command when included; without a description the command is a single logical header line. label_title_line and shell_command_line flatten embedded newlines for one-line paths, while push_command_soft_wrap and push_header_lines use permission-panel wrapping, hang continuations under the prefix, exclude prefix spans from selection, and preserve newline joiners.
scenarios: Description-first label
Label style has a nonblank description and command is included
Run title appears first and a secondary dollar command line follows.
Description-first shell
Shell style has a nonblank description
plain title appears without a Run prefix and the command follows with dollar.
Collapsed description
a description exists and collapsed rendering hides the command
only the description title is emitted.
User bash label
bash_mode is true with a description
the title contains Run user marker and both prefix spans are excluded from copy selection.
Command soft-wrap
expanded/truncated output has a long or multiline command
operator-aware continuation rows are indented beneath the prefix and carry newline joiners.
Run prefix cleanup
description begins with Run, Running, runtime, or another word
only Run/Running with a boundary is stripped; runtime and unrelated text remain.

requirement: ExecuteToolCallBlock SHALL render command headers, errors, and terminal output according to display mode, with bounded first/last output previews, explicit hidden-line markers, terminal-native output styling, selection ranges and dark panel backgrounds.
contract: render_with_truncation SHALL always render expanded/truncated headers with the command, append nonempty errors only when output is absent using accent_error and a separator, append nonempty output after a separator using render_terminal_lines and primary foreground, and wrap output to max(width-2,20). When truncation is Some(first,last) and total rows exceed first+last, it SHALL emit first rows with range 1, a non-selectable hidden-lines marker, and last rows with range 2; fitting or unbounded output uses range 1 for all rows. Output rows retain wrapping joiners and panel background theme.bg_dark.
scenarios: Error-only result
output is absent and error is nonempty
the expanded body shows a blank separator and red error lines.
Output result
output is nonempty
terminal control sequences are rendered into primary-styled wrapped rows after a separator.
Truncated preview
output exceeds configured first plus last rows
first and last windows are shown with a nonselectable hidden-line marker and distinct selection ranges.
Fits preview
output does not exceed the truncation threshold
all rows are shown with one stdout selection range.
Empty fields
output is None/empty or error is empty
the corresponding body section is omitted while headers remain.

requirement: The Execute block SHALL expose mode-specific rendering and fold transitions that distinguish agent tools from user-initiated bash commands, preserving user choices for agent tools and showing full output for completed bash commands.
contract: output SHALL use collapsed mode for title density, truncated mode with configured first_lines/last_lines, and expanded mode without output truncation. is_foldable SHALL be true when a meaningful Label-stripped description, output, or error reveals additional content; a bare Run/Running description alone is not foldable. next_fold_mode SHALL cycle non-bash Collapsed to Truncated and Truncated/Expanded to Collapsed, but bash Collapsed directly to Expanded. collapse_mode SHALL use Truncated for running bash and Collapsed otherwise. Agent default is Collapsed and finished mode is None; bash default is Truncated and finished mode is Expanded.
scenarios: Agent default
an agent Execute block is created
it starts Collapsed and does not auto-expand on completion.
User bash stream
a bash_mode block is running
it starts/uses Truncated so output streams and the fold cycle can jump to Expanded.
User bash completion
a bash_mode block finishes
finished_display_mode requests Expanded to reveal the full output.
Agent preservation
the user manually changed an agent tool mode
finished_display_mode is None so the existing choice is preserved.
Foldability
a block has a real description, output/error, or only a bare Run/Running description
the first cases are foldable; bare prefix-only descriptions are not.

requirement: ExecuteToolCallBlock SHALL expose configurable accent state and stable block presentation flags for the shared scrollback renderer.
contract: accent SHALL return None when execute accent_enabled is false; otherwise errors use a static accent_error, running blocks use an animated configured running_accent, and finished successes use a static accent_success. has_vpad_for and has_raw_mode SHALL return false, and background SHALL return BlockBackground::None.
scenarios: Accent disabled
execute accent_enabled is false
no accent is returned regardless of running or error state.
Failure
accent is enabled and error is present
a static error accent is returned.
Running
accent is enabled and the block is running without error
an animated configured running accent is returned.
Success
accent is enabled and the block is finished without error
a static success accent is returned.
Presentation flags
the renderer queries padding, background or raw mode
the block reports no vertical padding, no background and no raw mode.

requirement: ExecuteToolCallBlock preamble SHALL provide a text projection of the header and error-only content for consumers that need a compact non-block representation.
contract: preamble SHALL build header lines using the configured execute header style and include the command, then append a blank line plus accent_error-styled error lines only when output is absent and error is nonempty. It returns Some(Text) for the block even when no error is present.
scenarios: Header preamble
a caller requests preamble for a successful or running block
the configured header text is returned as Text.
Error preamble
output is absent and a nonempty error exists
the text includes a blank separator and styled error lines.
Output suppresses error
output exists alongside an error
the preamble omits error lines under the output-present rule.

requirement: Worktree fork completion, eager identity, and restore reporting
contract: WorktreeForked and ForkSessionReady SHALL eagerly bind the child session id, set loading_replay, mark worktree state, retarget the session cwd/file search, emit LoadSession for the new id, and surface successful restore summaries or failed restore summaries as mutually exclusive success/warning notices while storing restore_degree; ForkSessionFailed SHALL leave the placeholder available for failure handling.
scenarios: Fork ready
a worktree fork completes
the child is bound before LoadSession and uses the returned session cwd/worktree state.
Restore success
code_restored is true with a summary
a Code restored notice and restore degree are stored.
Restore failure
code_restored is false with a nonempty summary
a warning notice contains the failure detail and no success notice appears.
Fork session ready
a non-worktree fork returns a new id/cwd
LoadSession uses the new id/cwd, loading replay is enabled, and file search follows cwd.
Fork failure
fork creation fails
no effect is emitted and the placeholder agent remains.

requirement: Fork dispatch guards, modal policy, and resolved effects
contract: dispatch_fork SHALL reject Welcome/no-session/non-git worktree requests with no effect and appropriate toast, choose immediate ForkSession/CreateWorktreeSession for explicit flags, skip the worktree question in non-git cwd, open a four-option Fork modal only when Ask policy and git context require it, refuse to overwrite an existing question, and dispatch ForkAnswered back through the resolved path.
scenarios: Invalid context
fork is requested from Welcome or before session id exists
no agent/effect is created and the active agent receives a still-being-created toast when applicable.
Explicit worktree
worktree=true in a git cwd
CreateWorktreeSession is emitted without opening a modal.
Explicit cwd fork
worktree=false
ForkSession is emitted without a modal.
Non-git
worktree=true or Ask mode in a non-git cwd
worktree request is rejected synchronously; no-flag request skips the meaningless modal and forks in cwd while preserving directive.
Ask mode
worktree preference is Ask in a git repo
a four-option Yes/No/Always/Never local Fork question opens and refuses to replace an existing ACP question.
Answered
ForkAnswered selects a worktree/cwd branch
the corresponding CreateWorktreeSession or ForkSession effect is emitted with the directive.

requirement: Fork child projection, attachment, markers, and inherited setup
contract: A successful fork SHALL create a child agent linked by forked_from, switch active view to the child, repoint dashboard attachment only when it referenced the parent, preserve unrelated/stale attachment state, append a parent marker with an optional directive, defer the child banner with the full parent session id and worktree mode, show transient worktree progress without transcript pollution, stash the directive as pending_first_prompt, and inherit appearance/plugin visibility.
scenarios: Child ownership
fork succeeds
the child records the parent id and becomes active.
Dashboard attachment
dashboard is attached to parent, unattached, or attached elsewhere
only parent attachment follows the child; other states remain unchanged.
Parent marker
directive is present or absent
the parent gets Forked: directive or exactly Forked, with no obsolete /forward text.
Deferred banner
child is starting
pending_fork_banner stores the full parent id and worktree flag.
Progress/directive
worktree start or directive is supplied
progress is live-only and directive is parked for first prompt.
Inherited display
app appearance/plugins are configured
the child receives prompt compactness and plugin visibility state.

requirement: Child fork marker copy and navigation guidance
contract: build_child_fork_marker SHALL include the child and full parent session ids, advertise /agents only when supplied for a non-worktree capable surface, include the shared-cwd caveat only for in-cwd forks, and advertise /resume instead of /agents in minimal mode.
scenarios: Worktree marker
worktree=true
the banner identifies both sessions and omits the shared-cwd line.
Shared-cwd marker
worktree=false
the banner is two lines and explains that both agents share cwd.
Dashboard disabled
no dashboard tip is supplied
/agents is omitted while ids/caveat remain.
Minimal mode
/resume is supplied
/resume is advertised and /agents is absent.

requirement: Fork and new-session persistence modes without cancelling the old turn
contract: ForkAnswered and NewSessionAnswered SHALL persist Always/Never choices under the correct config key, route Always to CreateWorktreeSession and Never to ForkSession/CreateSession, and create the new child/session without cancelling an existing running turn; direct Always/Never preferences SHALL skip the modal.
scenarios: Fork preference
fork mode is Always/Never
the modal is skipped and the matching worktree/cwd effect is emitted.
Persist choice
ForkAnswered includes Always/Never
the in-memory mode and fork_worktree_mode persistence effect update.
New session answer
the old agent turn is running
CreateSession/CreateWorktreeSession is emitted and no CancelTurn is sent; old turn remains running.
New session preference
new-session mode is Always/Never
the modal is skipped and the matching creation effect is emitted.

requirement: Fork question answer translation
contract: translate_local_submit for LocalQuestionKind::Fork SHALL map option 0 to worktree=true, option 1 to worktree=false, option 2 to worktree=true plus WorktreeMode::Always, and option 3 to worktree=false plus WorktreeMode::Never while preserving the stashed directive.
scenarios: Yes
selection is option 0
ForkAnswered carries worktree=true and the directive.
No
selection is option 1
ForkAnswered carries worktree=false and no directive when absent.
Always
selection is option 2
ForkAnswered carries worktree=true and persist Always.
Never
selection is option 3
ForkAnswered carries worktree=false and persist Never.

requirement: Displaced local fork modal notice
contract: When an ACP ask-user question replaces a local Fork modal, the handler SHALL preserve the new ACP question without local kind and append exactly one system notice explaining that `/fork` was cancelled because another question opened.
scenarios: Modal displacement
an active local fork question is replaced by an ACP question
the ACP question becomes active and one exact cancellation notice is appended.

requirement: AgentView SHALL resolve a session plan artifact under the session cwd namespace, prefer nonblank approval-carried plan content for previews, and fall back to the session plan.md file when the approval payload is absent.
contract: plan_file_path SHALL require a session_id and derive sessions_cwd_dir(cwd)/session_id/plan.md. plan_body_for_preview SHALL return nonblank plan_approval_view.plan_content first, otherwise read the derived file best effort and reject blank content. plan_preview_available SHALL reflect whether a usable body exists. is_plan_viewer SHALL recognize only LineViewerKind::PlanPreview; is_casual_commenting SHALL additionally require no plan approval view, a plan viewer, and a casual_commenting_range.
scenarios: Approval content
approval state carries nonblank plan_content
that content is returned without reading the session file.
Artifact fallback
approval content is absent/blank and session identity exists
plan.md under the session cwd namespace is read best effort and nonblank content is returned.
Missing plan
no approval content, no readable nonblank artifact, or no session id
preview availability is false.
Viewer identity
line viewer kind is PlanPreview or another kind
is_plan_viewer is true only for PlanPreview.
Casual state
approval view is absent, PlanPreview is open and casual range is armed
is_casual_commenting is true; approval view or missing range makes it false.
