contract: BlockOutput::mark_link_sources SHALL capture each rendered row's logical pre-wrap line index, source columns, and display offset before later header/quote transformations; hard-break rows SHALL advance the logical line while soft-wrap joiners SHALL extend the current line by joiner width. prewrap_index_per_row SHALL produce the same logical-line index sequence for a row slice. selectable_cols_usize SHALL be used to anchor selectable content, with non-selectable rows yielding no source range.
scenarios: Hard and soft rows
rows contain None or Some joiners
hard breaks increment the pre-wrap index and soft continuations remain on the current source line.
Source columns
a wrapped row has a joiner and selectable spans
the sidecar records joiner-adjusted source columns and display_start.
Row index projection
a row slice is traversed
prewrap_index_per_row returns one index per row with increments only at hard breaks.

requirement: Selection boundary sidecars and rendered output conversion
contract: SelectionBoundary::apply SHALL concatenate optional prefix, selected text, and optional suffix in the requested order with capacity sized for included components. SelectionBoundaries SHALL represent an empty entry list as None, preserve immutable Arc-backed entries, and retrieve a boundary by exact output line index. RenderedBlockOutput SHALL pair BlockOutput with default empty boundaries and convert from a plain BlockOutput without changing its lines.
scenarios: Boundary selection
prefix/suffix inclusion flags vary
the resulting string includes exactly the requested boundary components around selected text.
Sparse lookup
entries are empty or contain line-indexed Arc boundaries
empty sidecars return None and populated sidecars return only an exact line match.
Plain conversion
a BlockOutput is converted to RenderedBlockOutput
the lines are preserved and boundaries start empty.

requirement: Clipboard delivery classification
contract: The diagnostics view SHALL derive ClipboardFacts from the snapshot route and environment through native_clipboard_preflight and expected_delivery, preserving native/tmux/OSC52 route flags, native tool, OSC52 capability, wrap sink, display/container/Wayland state, and the delivery classification. ClipboardRecovery SHALL classify Confirmed, Unverified, and Failed delivery by SSH/container/local context and expose the legacy fix command for the compatible facts field. Confirmed delivery produces no clipboard finding; unverified or unavailable delivery produces a manual finding with boundary-specific guidance, while VSCode-family SSH OSC52 and iTerm2 OSC52 permission caveats are separate Recommendation findings when their route predicates match.
scenarios: Confirmed delivery
expected_delivery returns Confirmed
ClipboardFacts.delivery is Confirmed, the compatibility fix may be absent, and clipboard_findings emits no base delivery finding.
Unverified remote delivery
delivery is Unverified and the terminal is SSH or a no-display container
facts retain the Unverified classification and legacy fix while a manual finding explains that the outer clipboard cannot be confirmed and gives the corresponding wrap/minimal guidance.
Failed delivery
delivery is Failed in SSH, container, or local context
the matching unavailable recovery class supplies the context-specific fix and a manual clipboard finding with backup/minimal guidance.
Terminal-specific caveat
an SSH VSCode-family terminal uses OSC52 without a wrap sink, or iTerm2 uses OSC52 under SSH/non-local native preflight
the report adds the named recommendation for non-ASCII OSC52 or iTerm2 clipboard permission.
Fact-only failed delivery
a report initially has no findings but its clipboard delivery is changed to Failed
issue_count returns one, format_doctor prints the Clipboard issue notice, and the no-issues message is absent.

requirement: Keyboard capability host scope
contract: Diagnostic facts SHALL derive keyboard rescue information from keyboard_capabilities_for_host using the host OS stored in the snapshot, and SHALL only include KeyboardFact when modifier delivery benefits from rescue or Enter needs rescue. Newline fallback SHALL be suppressed for a confirmed WezTerm Kitty-keyboard warning or for the unavailable-kitty-flags WezTerm shape guard; otherwise Shift+Enter unavailability maps to VTE, xterm.js VSCode-family, or no-Kitty-protocol facts. The formatter is outside this file; this module only constructs the snapshot-host-scoped fact and finding inputs.
scenarios: Snapshot host scope
the current process host differs from snapshot.host_os
keyboard capability classification and the resulting keyboard fact use snapshot.host_os rather than the process host.
No Kitty evidence for WezTerm
WezTerm has unavailable Kitty flags and its shape is recognized
the view suppresses the ordinary newline fallback and does not invent a WezTerm Kitty finding.
Ordinary xterm.js fallback
a VSCode-family terminal lacks Shift+Enter support without a WezTerm suppression
facts.newline is XtermJs and the report contains a Recommendation with Alt+Enter guidance.
Known WezTerm evidence
Kitty flag evidence is available and the WezTerm warning is produced
the warning finding is retained and the newline fallback remains suppressed while the warning note carries the backslash guidance.
Explicit target keyboard fact
DiagnosticFacts contains KeyboardFact with HostOs::Macos and Cmd Dropped/Opt Native
format_doctor emits the exact keyboard line with OS rescue active and still reports No issues found.

requirement: The tutorial overlay SHALL model List, Topic, and Guide screens, mark successfully opened topics as viewed for the current launch, reset scroll/cache/modal chrome on screen transitions, and resolve a Go deeper guide only when its referenced document exists.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: TutorialState::new starts on List with empty viewed/picker, fresh ModalWindowState, zero scroll and no cached lines. open_topic bounds-checks, inserts the index into viewed, enters Topic, and resets scroll/cache/window; back_to_list returns to List with the same resets; open_guide checks TUTORIAL_TOPICS[index].go_deeper through docs::find_doc before entering Guide. TutorialOutcome distinguishes Consumed from Closed. Default delegates new.
scenarios: Fresh tutorial
the overlay is opened
screen is List, no topics are viewed, picker selection starts at zero, and no markdown cache exists.
Open topic
a valid list index is selected
screen becomes Topic, the index is marked viewed, and scroll/cache/modal state reset.
Invalid topic
an out-of-range index is requested
state is unchanged and no topic is marked viewed.
Guide reference
a topic has a go_deeper title resolving through docs::find_doc
screen becomes Guide for that topic with fresh scroll/cache/window.
Missing guide
a topic has no resolvable guide
d leaves the current Topic screen unchanged.
Back transition
a topic or guide is closed through its local back path
state returns to List or originating Topic respectively and resets document state.

requirement: The tutorial List screen SHALL consume all key, mouse, and paste input while open, use a non-searchable fixed topic picker, open the selected topic on selection, close on picker/chrome close, and prevent typing or paste from creating an invisible query.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: list_picker_config disables search, search hints and filtering while retaining picker navigation and selection. handle_list_input gives modal close-button mouse precedence, consumes key releases, swallows Event::Paste before picker routing, and maps PickerOutcome::Selected to open_topic, Closed to TutorialOutcome::Closed, and all other outcomes to Consumed. Alphabetic list keys therefore do not alter picker.query.
scenarios: List navigation
Up/Down or picker navigation arrives on List
the fixed picker selection changes and the event is Consumed.
Open selected topic
Enter yields PickerOutcome::Selected(i)
the selected topic opens and is marked viewed.
Typing
a printable letter arrives on List
the event is consumed and picker.query remains empty.
Paste
a bracketed or ordinary paste arrives on List
the event is consumed before picker handling and no hidden query is created.
Close button/Esc
modal chrome or picker reports close
TutorialOutcome::Closed is returned.
Release event
a key release arrives
the event is consumed without changing picker state.

requirement: Topic and Guide screens SHALL consume all input, give modal chrome first ownership, scroll document content through shared document helpers, and route Esc/close, Left/Right, and d according to screen semantics without allowing printable typing to escape.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: handle_topic_input and handle_guide_input consume key releases and all non-key/mouse events. They call modal key/mouse handlers first; CloseRequested returns Topic-to-List or Guide-to-originating-Topic, and Handled stops further routing. Topic Right opens the next bounded topic or returns to List at the end, Left opens the previous topic but saturates at the first, d opens a resolvable guide, and remaining keys/mouse wheel use apply_doc_scroll/apply_doc_mouse_scroll. Guide has no linear topic navigation and scrolls only its how-to document.
scenarios: Topic Esc
Esc or modal close occurs on a topic
the topic closes to List and the event is Consumed.
Guide Esc
Esc or modal close occurs on a guide
the guide closes back to its originating Topic.
Next topic
Right is pressed before the final topic
the next topic opens and is marked viewed.
End of tour
Right is pressed on the final topic
the overlay returns to List rather than indexing past the catalog.
Previous topic
Left is pressed on a non-first topic
the previous topic opens; Left on the first topic is a no-op.
Document scroll
Up/Down/page/home/end or mouse wheel arrives after chrome
shared document scroll helpers update saturating scroll and the event remains consumed.
Typing on topic
a printable character arrives on a topic
the screen stays active, scroll/navigation state is not replaced by search, and the event is consumed.

requirement: Tutorial rendering SHALL render the active topic or guide through the shared markdown document viewer, reuse cached pre-rendered lines by width, expose next/done and go-deeper shortcuts for topics, and keep the modal title from duplicating a leading Markdown H1.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: render_tutorial selects the active screen and returns safely for invalid/stale indices or missing guide docs. Topic builds a next hint or done hint, conditionally adds d go deeper, adds Esc list, strips the first `# ` line through topic_body, and calls render_doc_viewer_overlay_with_shortcuts with st.cached_lines/scroll. Guide resolves docs::find_doc and calls render_doc_viewer_overlay with the document title/content and the same scroll/cache. The shared viewer owns markdown wrapping/clamping and modal geometry.
scenarios: Topic rendering
screen is a valid Topic
the title/body render through the shared viewer with scroll/cache and contextual next/done, guide, and Esc shortcuts.
Guide rendering
screen is Guide and the reference resolves
the guide document title/content render through the shared viewer.
Missing guide render
screen is Guide but docs::find_doc returns None
render_tutorial returns without attempting invalid content access.
Stale index render
screen contains an invalid Topic index
render_tutorial returns safely.
Heading de-duplication
topic content starts with `# Title`
topic_body removes the first heading and leading newlines before viewer rendering.
Non-heading content
content has no leading H1
topic_body returns it unchanged.

requirement: The tutorial List renderer SHALL draw Welcome chrome and intro copy, show explored progress and topic navigation shortcuts, adapt title/blurb layout below the narrow threshold, mark viewed topics with success badges, delegate rows to the picker content renderer, and register one hit area per topic.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: render_list computes `{viewed}/{topic_count} explored`, configures centered modal sizing with compact support, paints two intro lines plus a gap, returns when no content height remains, and treats widths below 64 columns as narrow. Wide rows use title plus right_label blurb; narrow rows put blurb in description_lines and expand each row. PickerEntry rows carry selected state, viewed check badge, success badge color, no search/collapse fields, and render_picker_content_with_scrollbar_x receives modal inner scrollbar x. Returned content hit rectangles and entry indices populate PickerHitAreas with empty close/search/tab/filter rects.
scenarios: Progress display
topics have been opened in the current launch
the footer shortcut reports the viewed count over total topics and rows show check marks for viewed indices.
Wide list
content width is at least 64 columns
each row keeps the blurb as a right-aligned label.
Narrow list
content width is below 64 columns
the blurb moves below the title as a description line and rows use expanded layout.
Empty body
intro consumes all available content height
render_list returns without building row hits.
Hit areas
the list has visible topic rows
picker.hit_areas contains one item rectangle and entry index per tutorial topic.
Compact modal
compact is enabled
modal sizing is passed through with_compact while content and hit mapping remain consistent.

requirement: The tutorial implementation SHALL be covered by inline behavior checks for list/topic/guide transitions, viewed marking, bounded linear navigation, scroll and typing consumption, guide absence, heading normalization, paste suppression, list hit areas, and topic render smoke behavior.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The 12 inline tests invoke handlers and renderers with synthetic state/events. They assert exact TutorialScreen/TutorialOutcome transitions, viewed set growth across the full tour, first-topic Left saturation, scroll changes, empty picker query after typing/paste, guide resolution assumptions from the topic catalog, topic_body output, one hit rectangle per topic, and no-panic topic rendering. This audit records assertions without claiming test execution.
scenarios: Open and viewed
Down then Enter is sent on a fresh list
selected topic opens and its index is viewed.
Close sequence
Esc is sent from Topic then List
first Esc returns to List and second Esc closes.
Guide flow
d is sent on a guided topic then Esc
Guide opens and returns to the originating Topic.
Full tour
Right is sent through every topic
each topic is viewed and final Right returns to List.
Input suppression
typing or paste is sent on List/Topic
all input is consumed and list query remains empty.
Rendering evidence
List/Topic are rendered into a Buffer
list hit areas are populated and topic rendering completes without panic.

requirement: Other tool block state, output capture, image detection, and timing
contract: OtherToolCallBlock::new SHALL initialize the name and summary with no error/output/coordination/image references and no local timing. with_error/with_output SHALL update the corresponding state; set_output_text SHALL replace output and recompute image references from the complete text. is_success SHALL mean error is absent. set_error and finish SHALL capture elapsed milliseconds once when started_at exists, while elapsed_ms SHALL expose the stored value or a live duration.
scenarios: Construction
an unknown tool block is created
optional output, error, coordination, image, and timing fields are empty.
Output replacement
text is set or replaced
the stored output is replaced and image references are re-extracted from the new text.
Error/timing
an error or completion arrives for a running block
the error is updated and elapsed time is finalized without overwriting an existing duration.

requirement: Coordination-aware media precedence and inline image presentation
contract: A coordination row or the named coordination tools list_active_sessions, ask_session, and get_inquiry SHALL treat image references as attachments to text: media_ref_path, inline_media, and inline_open_button return None so the structured inquiry output remains visible. Other tools SHALL expose the first detected image path, return inline media only when dimensions are known, and expose an open-button path only when inline graphics overlay is inactive. Media output SHALL render a header and percent-decoded filepath, preserve the stored path for actions, use a character-boundary middle ellipsis when too wide, and add a centered Open row when appropriate.
scenarios: Coordination image
coordination output contains a raw or markdown image reference plus Question/Answer/Status text
image references are detected but no media-only path, inline media, or open button replaces the text details.
Ordinary image
a non-coordination tool output contains an image reference
the first image path is available for media/open behavior and running collapse starts in truncated mode.
Inline media dimensions
the first image has dimensions or lacks them
InlineMediaInfo is returned with path/size/alt text only when dimensions are present.
Media header
an image block is rendered
the header and decoded filepath are shown, stored path is unchanged, and optional Open button rows are added only when overlay is inactive.

requirement: Other tool collapsed header labels, summaries, and width limits
contract: collapsed_line SHALL split a name containing `: ` into a bold label and text content, otherwise render the full name bold; muted mode SHALL dim both while retaining label boldness. A non-empty summary SHALL be appended with two spaces only when it fits the requested width (or always when width is absent), and the complete line SHALL be passed through truncate_line when a width is supplied.
scenarios: Labeled name
name contains `: `
label and content are separate styled spans with a trailing label space.
Summary fit
summary is non-empty and width is supplied
summary is included only if the byte-length fit check passes; the line is then width-truncated.
No width
summary is non-empty and no width is supplied
the full summary is appended.
Muted collapse
collapsed rendering requests muted style
all text uses muted style and label remains bold.

requirement: Other tool expanded output, error wrapping, and structured Q&A rendering
contract: For non-media blocks, collapsed output SHALL contain only the width-aware header. Truncated and Expanded modes SHALL use an unmuted full header, wrap each error line to the context width, and render output either as numbered question/answer pairs when the parser recognizes AskUserQuestion text or as a blank separator plus muted generic wrapped lines. Empty answers SHALL display `(no answer)`; answered pairs SHALL use the user accent arrow.
scenarios: Collapsed
the block has no media and mode is Collapsed
one collapsed header line is emitted.
Error
error text contains one or more lines in Expanded/Truncated mode
each error line is wrapped to context width and appended after the header.
Structured Q&A
output matches a recognized Q&A format
questions are numbered and primary-colored, answers use a user-colored arrow, and missing answers use dim `(no answer)`.
Generic output
output is not recognized as Q&A
a blank separator and muted wrapped output lines are emitted.

requirement: AskUserQuestion output parser format recognition and annotation cleanup
contract: parse_ask_user_qa_pairs SHALL recognize the answered sentence format with quoted question/answer pairs and its canonical suffix, return no pairs for the declined format, and recognize plan-mode bullet output only when the Questions asked marker and quoted bullets are present. It SHALL strip selected-preview and user-notes annotation suffixes from answers, map `(No answer provided)` to an empty answer, tolerate a missing answer line as empty, and return an empty vector for unknown or malformed prefixes while retaining pairs parsed before a later malformed segment.
scenarios: Answered sentence
output starts with `User has answered your questions: ` and contains quoted pairs
each quoted question/answer pair is returned and display-only annotation suffixes are removed.
Declined
output starts with `User declined to answer`
no Q&A rows are returned.
Plan mode
output contains `Questions asked` and quoted bullet questions
Answer lines map to answer text, `(No answer provided)` maps to empty, and missing/unrecognized next lines produce empty answers.
Unknown/malformed
the prefix/markers are absent or a pair cannot be parsed
the parser returns no rows, or only pairs already parsed before the malformed remainder.

requirement: Other tool accent, bullet, folding, and neutral block protocol
contract: OtherToolCallBlock SHALL use no accent for ordinary collapsed blocks, otherwise select error red, running animated, terminal coordination success, or normal tool accent in precedence order. Error bullets are always red; coordination bullets follow coordination accent; ordinary collapsed bullets are absent and expanded/running bullets inherit accent. Blocks have no vertical padding, semantic background, or raw mode. Foldability depends on output/error; default mode is Collapsed, ordinary running tools cycle Collapsed→Truncated→Expanded, non-running/coordination tools toggle Collapsed↔Expanded, and collapse_mode chooses Truncated only for running ordinary tools.
scenarios: Accent precedence
error, running, terminal coordination, or ordinary tool state applies
the highest-priority matching accent style is returned, with animation only for running ordinary tools.
Bullet
error, coordination, collapsed ordinary, or expanded ordinary state applies
the bullet is red, coordination-colored, absent, or inherited respectively.
Folding
a block has output/error and is running or coordination
is_foldable reflects content; next_fold_mode and collapse_mode choose the documented running versus non-running cycle.
Protocol
the renderer asks for padding/background/raw/default mode
false/None/Collapsed protocol values are returned.

requirement: Image reference exposure and text/media action routing
contract: image_references SHALL expose the block-owned detected image slice in insertion order. media_ref_path, inline_media, and inline_open_button SHALL all defer to prefers_text_output before inspecting image_refs, so coordination and inquiry text cannot be replaced by media actions; ordinary image tools SHALL retain the first reference for downstream media and open-button routing.
scenarios: References
output text contains zero or more detected image references
image_references exposes the stored slice without reparsing.
Text-priority tool
coordination or a named inquiry tool has an image reference
all media action accessors return None while text output remains eligible.
Ordinary media
a non-priority tool has an image reference
the first reference drives media_ref_path and eligible inline/open action routing.

requirement: Appearance thinking conversion and fixed flags
contract: Thinking rendering SHALL honor the effective thinking appearance for header brightness/muting, body blend, body_dim_italic, truncated line count, and collapsed expand hint. The collapsed hint is appended only when collapsed_expand_hint is enabled, the mode is Collapsed, and the complete hint fits the content width; it is dim and never creates a second row. Body styling SHALL clear inherited line backgrounds, blend toward the theme defaults using bg_blend, and add DIM plus ITALIC except on legacy Windows consoles when body_dim_italic is enabled. Default appearance leaves reasoning spans unmodified by these emphasis attributes.
scenarios: Default body style
default appearance renders expanded reasoning
reasoning spans do not gain DIM or ITALIC solely from ThinkingBlock.
Native palette emphasis
body_dim_italic is enabled while the terminal-native palette lock is active
every rendered reasoning span receives DIM and ITALIC, preserving the distinction when color blending is a no-op.
Fitting expand hint
collapsed_expand_hint is enabled in Collapsed mode and the hint fits
the header contains the dim `(ctrl+e to expand)` affordance on the same single row.
Narrow or inapplicable hint
the hint does not fit, the mode is Expanded/Truncated, or the body is empty
the header remains unchanged and no extra row or misleading hint is emitted.
Header selection/muting
a collapsed header is selected, muted, or configured bright
header_line chooses primary bold for selected/configured bright cases unless muted, otherwise muted bold, with elapsed detail styled muted.

requirement: TableGeometry SHALL recognize only complete box-drawing top/divider/bottom border rows with consistent junction glyph families, tolerate leading spaces and blockquote bars, and calculate junction positions in Unicode display columns rather than bytes or scalar indices.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: grapheme_cols iterates extended graphemes, skips zero-width clusters, accumulates saturating UnicodeWidthStr columns, and records the first character. parse_border_row accepts optional prefix chars before the first corner, then requires the family-specific middle/corner glyphs and horizontal bars through a closing corner with at least two junctions; trailing text, wrong glyphs, unclosed rows, or inconsistent families return None. is_prefix_char permits only spaces and the quote bar.
scenarios: Top/divider/bottom rows
a line uses matching box-drawing corners/junctions/horizontal bars
parse_border_row returns the junction display columns and corresponding BorderKind.
Quote prefix
a table is rendered after a blockquote bar and spaces
the prefix is ignored and grid junctions begin at the table corner column.
Wide glyphs
content before/within a grid contains CJK or emoji graphemes
junction positions and cell clicks use display columns.
Malformed border
a row has wrong junctions, trailing content, missing close, or fewer than two junctions
the line is rejected as a border.
Zero-width grapheme
a grapheme has zero display width
it does not create a fake column or junction.

requirement: TableGeometry::detect SHALL require the anchor to lie inside a fully enclosed grid, derive one junction set from the anchor or a bounded upward border search, validate every intervening row outward to matching top and bottom borders, and group contiguous content lines into non-empty logical rows.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: detect reads the anchor line first; a border fixes junctions directly, while a content anchor searches upward at most MAX_JUNCTION_SEARCH=400 lines and stops on missing data or a non-prefix prose line. It walks up to a Top and down to a Bottom, rejecting a premature opposite border, Other row, inconsistent junctions, unclosed grid, or missing line. It records line_range as top..bottom+1 and pushes each contiguous Content run between borders into rows; no rows returns None.
scenarios: Content anchor
at_line is a content line inside a closed table
the nearest valid top/bottom borders are found and geometry is returned.
Border anchor
at_line is a matching border line
the same grid is detected and line range includes both borders.
Outside grid
at_line is prose above or below the table
detect returns None.
Wrapped row
one logical cell row spans several content lines
the contiguous lines become one row range and cell text can join fragments later.
Inconsistent junctions
a divider or content row does not match the anchor junction set
the entire detection fails closed.
Unclosed/malformed grid
a bottom border is missing or an Other line interrupts the walk
detect returns None rather than guessing geometry.
Long prose search
no border appears within the bounded upward prefix search
detect stops and returns None without scanning unbounded text.

requirement: Detected table geometry SHALL expose half-open grid extent, column/row counts, content row lookup, per-column interior bands, and cell hit testing in display-column space; border rows and outside coordinates SHALL return no cell while junction clicks snap to an adjacent cell.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: line_range returns top border through one past bottom; n_cols is junction count minus one and n_rows is logical row count. row_of_line returns a row only for content lines; row_lines returns that row range. band returns the strictly interior display columns between flanking bars, including padding. cell_at returns None for non-content rows or columns outside the outer junctions; a junction uses the cell on its right except the closing border, which uses the final cell.
scenarios: Grid extent
a table has top/bottom borders and logical rows
line_range includes the full grid, and n_cols/n_rows match junctions and content runs.
Content lookup
a line is inside a logical row
row_of_line returns the row index and row_lines returns its contiguous range.
Interior band
a column index is requested
band spans display cells strictly between its two boundary bars.
Content hit
a display column lies within a cell
cell_at returns the expected row/column CellRef.
Junction hit
a click lies exactly on an internal or closing bar
internal bars snap right and the closing bar snaps left to the final cell.
Border/outside hit
a click lies on a border row or beyond grid columns
cell_at returns None.

requirement: TableGeometry::latched_cell_at SHALL preserve a held cell across border rows, divider rows, junctions, and one-column padding dead zones, move only when the pointer enters another cell interior, and clamp row/column movement beyond the grid to the nearest edge.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: latched_cell_at resolves the row from row_of_line when on content, clamps above/below the grid to first/last logical row, and otherwise preserves held.row. It resolves the column through interior_col_at; columns outside the outer junctions clamp to first/last, while bars and padding inside the grid preserve held.col. The returned CellRef therefore implements dead-zone hysteresis and symmetric release into neighboring content.
scenarios: Content transition
the pointer enters another row or another column interior
the latch moves to that row/column.
Divider/border dead zone
the pointer is on a divider or border row
the held row is preserved rather than snapping to the next row.
Column padding dead zone
the pointer is on a junction or one-cell padding
the held column remains unchanged.
Above/below edge
the pointer leaves the grid vertically
the row clamps to first or last logical row.
Outside horizontal edge
the pointer leaves the grid horizontally
the column clamps to first or last column.
Symmetric release
a held right cell moves back into left cell content
the latch returns to the left cell only after entering its interior.

requirement: Cell copy SHALL slice each wrapped content line to the cell band in display columns, trim padding, skip empty fragments, and join nonblank fragments with spaces; grid copy SHALL serialize an order-independent rectangular cell range with tab-separated columns and newline-separated rows while flattening embedded tabs.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: cell_text obtains the selected column band, iterates the logical row line range, reads available source lines, calls slice_display_cols, trims fragments, skips empties and inserts a single space between retained fragments. grid_tsv normalizes endpoint order by row/col, calls cell_text for every rectangular cell, replaces tabs inside cell text with spaces, joins cells with tabs and rows with newlines.
scenarios: Single cell
a cell contains one padded content fragment
cell_text returns trimmed text without border/padding.
Wrapped fragments
a logical row spans multiple content lines
nonblank fragments join with one space and blank companion cells are skipped.
Reverse endpoints
grid_tsv receives endpoints in reverse row/column order
the output is normalized to top-left through bottom-right order.
Rectangular grid
a range spans multiple rows and columns
each row is newline-separated and cells are tab-separated.
Embedded tab
cell source contains a tab character
the tab is flattened to a space so TSV shape remains stable.
Missing source line
text_at returns None for part of a row
the missing fragment is skipped without failing the entire copy.

requirement: The table geometry implementation SHALL preserve a linear-selection fallback whenever grid proof is incomplete, while accepting valid stray bar content and wide-glyph tables without misclassifying cell boundaries.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Detection returns None for plain prose/rules, inconsistent junctions, unclosed grids, or anchors outside the table. A bar glyph inside a content cell is not a junction unless it occurs at the known junction column, so it remains part of cell_text. Unicode display-column arithmetic keeps wide names addressable, and the inline suite records exact expected ranges/cell values for these boundaries.
scenarios: Plain prose
input contains prose or a horizontal rule without enclosing corners
no TableGeometry is returned and caller can use linear selection.
Stray content bar
a content row contains an extra bar away from known junctions
the grid remains valid and the extra bar is included in the cell text.
Broken divider
a divider junction is misaligned
detection returns None rather than using a partial grid.
Wide cell text
a cell contains CJK display-wide characters
cell lookup and text extraction use terminal display columns and return the expected cell.
Inline evidence
the 12 tests exercise valid, invalid, wrapped, quoted, wide and copy cases
the expected geometry/copy behavior is pinned; this audit does not claim execution.

requirement: Group span kinds and binary containment lookup
contract: GroupSpan SHALL describe an entry-index range, fold kind, and expansion state; GroupKind SHALL distinguish VerbRun member counts from Truncation participant/hidden counts. span_containing SHALL binary-search sorted disjoint spans, treat ranges as half-open, and return only the span whose range contains the requested index.
scenarios: Verb span
a verb run is represented
the span carries its walked range, VerbRun member count, and expanded state.
Truncation span
a dense run exceeds its budget
the span carries participant and hidden counts.
Containment
an index is before, inside, at the end of, or between sorted spans
only an index inside a half-open range returns that span; gaps, ends, and empty input return None.

requirement: Group rebuild reset and setting-consistent projection
contract: apply SHALL clear every layout entry's group_header_count, group_collapse_header, and verb_group_header before each rebuild, read group_tool_verbs and show_thinking_blocks once, scan with those same settings, project the returned spans, and return the authoritative spans for storage in the layout cache.
scenarios: Rebuild
a layout cache contains stale group flags
all group flags are reset before scanning and projecting.
Settings snapshot
appearance settings are loaded for a rebuild
both scan and projection use the same group-tool/show-thinking values.
Cache result
the scan completes
the exact sorted spans are returned to the caller.

requirement: Fold scan precedence, claimed entries, and sorted disjoint spans
contract: scan SHALL run verb grouping before truncation, mark verb members/thought members as claimed, let claimed entries break truncation runs, append truncation spans over the remaining entries, and sort the combined spans by start index without overlap.
scenarios: Precedence
entries contain a foldable verb run followed by a dense run
the verb span is emitted first and the later truncation span starts after its claimed range.
Overlap prevention
multiple fold families are adjacent or separated
returned spans are sorted by range.start and no pair overlaps.
No groups
inputs are empty or no fold family crosses its gate
scan returns no spans while leaving projection inputs for the caller.

requirement: Verb run discovery with transparent thoughts and expansion identity
contract: scan_verb_runs SHALL find maximal runs through scan_run_forward only when group_tool_verbs is enabled and the run folds. Member and ThoughtMember entries SHALL be claimed; Transparent entries remain unclaimed and inside the span; trailing transparent thoughts remain outside scan.end. The VerbRun member count SHALL count label-bearing members, and expansion SHALL be keyed by the first entry id.
scenarios: Verb grouping enabled
group_tool_verbs is true and a run folds
a VerbRun span covers the walked range, claims member arms, counts members, and records first-id expansion.
Verb grouping disabled
group_tool_verbs is false
no verb spans or claims are produced, so members may flow into truncation.
Transparent thought
a collapsed/hidden or live thought appears inside a run
the transparent row keeps its own row and is not counted/claimed as a member; trailing transparent rows stay outside the span.
Expanded verb
the first entry id is in expanded_groups
the span is marked expanded while retaining the same range/member count.

requirement: Budget truncation discovery with hidden-thinking transparency
contract: scan_truncations SHALL consider only collapsed groupable entries not hidden by the current thinking setting, skip hidden-thinking entries without breaking a run, stop at claimed/non-transparent breaks, and emit a span only when participants exceed max_visible + 1. The span range includes the dense walk, participants counts eligible entries, hidden equals participants - max_visible, and expansion is keyed by the first participant.
scenarios: Budget gate
participants are at or below max_visible + 1
no truncation span is emitted and existing layout remains untouched.
Over budget
a dense unclaimed run exceeds the threshold
a Truncation span records its full walk, participants, hidden count, and first-id expansion.
Hidden thinking
hidden thinking is interspersed in a dense run
the run remains contiguous, hidden thoughts neither count nor receive projection writes.
Break
a claimed entry or visible non-groupable/non-collapsed entry occurs
the truncation run ends before the breaker.

requirement: Verb run layout projection and gap ownership
contract: project_verb_run SHALL make the first member a synthetic verb header: collapsed height 1, expanded height 2 with group_collapse_header, and a saturated member count. Collapsed non-first claimed members SHALL have height 0 while their internal gaps are zeroed except the last claimed boundary; expanded members keep normal heights. Transparent entries keep rows and only donate their trailing gap while collapsed.
scenarios: Collapsed verb run
a VerbRun is not expanded
the first member is a one-row header, other claimed members hide, and only the run-internal gaps are zeroed.
Expanded verb run
the first id is expanded
the header height is 2 and all member rows retain their normal heights.
Transparent member
a transparent thought/opened member is in the span
its row remains, member count is unchanged, and its gap is adjusted only in collapsed mode.
Count saturation
members exceed u16 range
group_header_count is capped at u16::MAX.

requirement: Truncation layout projection and collapse header counts
contract: project_truncation SHALL render expanded groups as a standalone collapse header on the first entry with height 1, count participants - 1, and no trailing gap while preserving all following entry heights. In collapsed mode it SHALL skip hidden-thinking rows, make the first participating entry the `hidden - 1` header, hide the remaining hidden participants with zero counts/gaps, and leave the visible tail untouched.
scenarios: Expanded truncation
the span is expanded
entry 0 becomes a one-row collapse header counting all remaining participants and every later row keeps its normal height.
Collapsed truncation
the span is collapsed
the first participating entry shows hidden - 1, subsequent hidden participants have height 0/count 0, and visible tail rows are unchanged.
Hidden thought in span
a hidden thought lies among participants
the thought is skipped for both count and writes, preserving its seeded layout.

requirement: Single projection writer for fold flags and layout consequences
contract: project_to_layout SHALL dispatch each authoritative span by GroupKind and be the only path that writes group heights, gaps, header counts, collapse-header flags, and verb-header flags. Its projection SHALL preserve unrelated seeded layout data for entries outside the affected fold and for transparent/visible tail entries.
scenarios: Span dispatch
spans contain VerbRun and Truncation variants
the matching projection routine applies only that family's layout shape.
Untouched entries
an entry lies outside a span or is a transparent/visible tail row
pre-existing height/gap and non-group metadata remain unchanged.
Combined transcript
verb and truncation spans coexist
both shapes are projected without overlap and the fold headers expose their respective counts.

requirement: 根dispatch SHALL 在本地回合短暂Idle但共享队列仍有条目时把新prompt路由到服务器并追加乐观队列回显；rename SHALL 更新本地display_name；ConfirmResetSetting 的 Reset SHALL 恢复Settings弹窗并递归发出对应类型setter及PersistSetting。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: SendPrompt在shared_queue非空且pending为空的Idle窗口中产生带新prompt_id的Effect::SendPrompt，不设置current_prompt_id或本地运行态，并将新项排在既有shared entries之后。dispatch_rename_session返回单一效果且更新Agent显示名。Bool/Enum reset分别通过SetCompactMode(false)/SetTheme("grownight")产生PersistSetting，重置内存值并在Bool场景刷新Settings ui_snapshot。
scenarios: Idle with shared queue
Agent本地Idle、current_prompt_id为空、pending为空而shared_queue已有q1/q2
新c经服务器SendPrompt发送，回显追加在队尾且本地仍不运行。
Rename session
dispatch_rename_session接收新名称
Agent本地display_name同步为该名称并返回一个效果。
Reset shared Bool
compact_mode先设为true后选择Reset
持久化false、内存值为false、Settings modal仍打开且snapshot为false。
Reset shared Enum
theme先设为tokyonight后选择Reset
持久化注册默认grownight且内存theme恢复grownight。

requirement: 状态入口 SHALL 对欢迎页、minimal和完整Agent视图执行不同的Usage/Context/SessionInfo路由：无active Agent的ShowUsage静默无效；minimal保留单一scrollback-intent fetch且不打开modal；完整视图打开Usage modal、激活请求tab并同时请求三类数据。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: ShowUsage在无active agent时返回空effects；在minimal中只产生nonce=0的FetchSessionUsage/ShowContextInfo/ShowSessionInfo对应效果且不创建active_modal；完整模式为Agent替换为Usage modal，分配非零fetch_nonce，初始tab按Action选择，并依次产生同Agent/session/nonce的FetchSessionUsage、ShowContextInfo、ShowSessionInfo。完整打开不改变scrollback；Context和SessionInfo入口同样支持请求tab，minimal各自产生单一nonce=0请求。
scenarios: Welcome no-op
没有active Agent时dispatch ShowUsage
不产生效果。
Full usage open
完整Agent视图dispatch ShowUsage
Usage modal打开在Usage tab，nonce非零，三种fetch按固定顺序发出且transcript长度不变。
Requested tab
完整Agent视图dispatch ShowContextInfo或ShowSessionInfo
modal激活对应tab但仍请求全部三类数据。
Minimal usage
minimal模式dispatch ShowUsage
只保留FetchSessionUsage nonce=0，modal保持关闭。
Minimal context/session
minimal模式dispatch ShowContextInfo或ShowSessionInfo
只保留对应单项nonce=0效果且modal保持关闭。

requirement: minimal更新通知 SHALL 在存在active Agent时提交一个系统scrollback block；无Agent时安全无操作。OpenTutorial SHALL 无effects地在非minimal应用层打开/关闭overlay。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: commit_minimal_update_notice仅依赖active Agent，新增一条系统block并包含版本与restart提示；无Agent不panic且不要求session。OpenTutorial首次设置tutorial为Some，再次清除tutorial，两次effects均为空；该测试文件证明其在默认完整模式可用，minimal gate的完整契约由生产status实现和已有delta给出。
scenarios: Update notice with agent
active Agent存在并提交版本9.9.9
scrollback增加一条系统block，文本含Update available: v9.9.9和restart to apply。
Update notice without agent
无active Agent提交通知
安全返回且不panic。
Tutorial open/close
连续两次dispatch OpenTutorial
第一次创建overlay且无effect，第二次关闭overlay且仍无effect。

requirement: Usage modal异步结果 SHALL 以open epoch和session identity保护当前modal，丢弃关闭重开后的旧结果及错误session结果；有效结果只填modal tab，modal内容不得写入transcript，失败写入当前tab Failed状态。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: 每次打开Usage modal分配新nonce；SessionInfoComplete携带旧nonce时即使Agent和modal仍存在也返回空effects且保持Loading，当前nonce才生成Loaded rows。SessionUsageComplete需session_id匹配当前session，错session保持Loading且不改scrollback。SessionInfo/Context/Usage三类成功填充相应Loaded数据，失败结果写入对应UsageTabData::Failed(error)，整个modal填充过程保持scrollback长度不变。
scenarios: Close and reopen
第一次打开得到nonce1，关闭后重开得到nonce2，迟到结果仍带nonce1
旧结果被丢弃，重开modal的SessionInfo保持Loading。
Fresh session info
重开结果携带当前nonce2和匹配session
SessionInfo tab变为Loaded并出现Session ID=test-session行。
Wrong usage session
Usage结果session_id不同于Agent当前session
Usage仍为Loading且transcript不变。
Modal fill
三个成功结果都携带当前nonce
Usage、Context、SessionInfo均Loaded，scrollback没有新增block。
Failed session info
SessionInfoFailed携带当前nonce和boom
SessionInfo tab变为Failed("boom")。

requirement: minimal模式下nonce=0的SessionInfo、ContextInfo和SessionUsage结果 SHALL 继续投影为各自scrollback block，而非modal数据。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: 在ScreenMode::Minimal中，SessionInfoComplete追加一条包含返回text的system block，ContextInfoComplete追加一条structured context block，SessionUsageComplete追加一条包含Session usage的system block；每个结果分别令scrollback长度增加一。测试通过nonce=0及fixture Agent验证该兼容投影。
scenarios: Session info scrollback
minimal模式收到nonce=0 SessionInfoComplete
追加Session info block且包含原始Session info block文本。
Context scrollback
minimal模式收到nonce=0 ContextInfoComplete
追加一条结构化context block。
Usage scrollback
minimal模式收到nonce=0 SessionUsageComplete
追加一条system block且文本含Session usage。

requirement: CopyUsageModalValue SHALL 在没有匹配打开的Usage modal时无操作，不产生clipboard effect。
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: 根dispatch接收仅含row index的CopyUsageModalValue时，若Agent没有active Usage modal，返回空effects；该测试只覆盖无modal边界，不证明Loaded行、active_tab或多Agent选择策略。
scenarios: No modal copy
Agent存在但active_modal为空，dispatch CopyUsageModalValue(0)
返回空effects且不执行复制。

requirement: Diagnostic snapshot fixture composition and runtime evidence mapping
contract: The test snapshot helpers SHALL construct DiagnosticSnapshot from terminal, tmux, Wayland, runtime, clipboard, host, display-server, and color inputs without querying the host. snapshot SHALL default to MacOS/unknown display server/TrueColor and a fixed all-capabilities ClipboardRoute; snapshot_for_host SHALL default Wayland probes to non-Wayland/unavailable; runtime helpers SHALL encode fullscreen available, caller-provided kitty evidence, and caller-provided xtversion while preserving Unavailable as absent TUI xtversion.
scenarios: Default snapshot
a test uses snapshot or snapshot_with_wayland
the helper injects deterministic MacOS host, unknown display server, TrueColor, clipboard route, and Wayland defaults.
Host override
a test uses snapshot_for_host or snapshot_with_wayland_for_host
the supplied HostOs and Wayland facts reach DiagnosticSnapshot unchanged.
Runtime evidence
kitty/xtversion are Available or Unavailable
TuiProbeEvidence maps Available xtversion to Some and Unavailable to None while runtime keeps the original evidence.
Runtime evidence conversion
a TuiProbeEvidence value is converted into DiagnosticRuntimeEvidence
fullscreen_active, kitty_flags_pushed, and xtversion are each retained as RuntimeEvidence::Available values.
Snapshot composition
a caller assembles ProbeSnapshot, CommonProbeSnapshot, StandaloneDiagnosticSnapshot, or DoctorProbeSnapshot
the snapshot carries the supplied terminal reference and typed tmux, Wayland, runtime, clipboard, host, display, container, and color facts without performing additional probes.
Typed fact representation
a probe outcome is available, unavailable, unsupported, or an error
the TmuxProbeResult-bearing fact fields preserve that typed outcome for downstream diagnostics.

requirement: Stable warning category identifiers
contract: Every WarningCategory exercised by the diagnostics view SHALL map through id_for to its stable public DiagnosticId string, preserving the terminal/notification/sandbox namespace and kebab-case identifier across schema changes.
scenarios: Category mapping
all listed WarningCategory variants are converted
the exact 13 stable IDs are returned in declaration order and none is missing.

requirement: Stable finding identities, dispositions, facts, and automatic remediation commands
contract: view SHALL emit stable DiagnosticId/disposition pairs and compatible fact fields for the supplied terminal/tmux snapshot. Tmux clipboard issues SHALL remain Issue while Iterm2/SSH caveats are Recommendation; clipboard delivery/native preflight SHALL reflect the route and host. Automatic remediation metadata SHALL use the canonical fix IDs and `grow doctor fix terminal.*` commands without changing the report schema, and a healthy tmux snapshot SHALL remove the three tmux findings.
scenarios: Finding identity
Iterm2 SSH tmux has clipboard disabled and SSH wrap context
findings appear in stable order with terminal.tmux-clipboard Issue plus Iterm2 permission and SSH wrap Recommendations.
Clipboard facts
the report is built from a confirmed route
delivery is Confirmed and native_preflight is RemoteOnly.
Automatic fixes
tmux clipboard/passthrough/extended keys are unhealthy
the three canonical fix IDs and commands are attached.
Healthy tmux
extended keys are on, clipboard is external, passthrough is all
the three tmux finding IDs are absent.

requirement: Unavailable and error probe evidence remains honest and fail-open
contract: view SHALL preserve unavailable, unsupported, and error probe evidence in probe_notes while avoiding findings that require unproven facts. Runtime-unavailable WezTerm/kitty evidence SHALL not invent a wezterm-kitty finding; known control-mode facts may still produce their finding. Clipboard/Wayland error and unsupported states SHALL remain ordered notes with status and message while findings stay empty when no actionable fact is proven.
scenarios: Runtime unavailable
WezTerm runtime kitty/xtversion evidence is unavailable
no terminal.wezterm-kitty finding is emitted, control-mode remains reportable, and three runtime probe notes are retained.
Probe error/unsupported
tmux clipboard probe errors, passthrough support is Unsupported, and Wayland data-control is unavailable
findings remain empty while six ordered probe notes preserve Error message, Unsupported status, and probe names.
Non-tmux fail-open
collect_common receives a terminal that is not tmux-backed
all TmuxProbeFacts fields are Unavailable and the TmuxOptionQuery receives no calls.
Support-gated option
tmux allow-passthrough support is Unsupported, Unavailable, Error, or Available
the support result is retained and the option value is respectively not queried or mapped to the backend's typed result.
Wayland gate
standalone_data_control or collect_common runs with is_wayland=false
the data-control result is Unavailable and no Wayland data-control probe is attempted.

requirement: WezTerm and newline fallback require affirmative keyboard evidence
contract: The diagnostics view SHALL leave newline unset and suppress terminal.wezterm-kitty when kitty keyboard evidence is unavailable, including local and SSH WezTerm identified through xtversion. Non-WezTerm terminals SHALL retain the ordinary XtermJs newline fallback with a Recommendation containing Alt+Enter guidance. Available WezTerm evidence SHALL retain the finding and include the backslash-then-Enter remediation note.
scenarios: Local WezTerm unknown
brand/env are WezTerm and kitty evidence is unavailable
newline is None and no wezterm-kitty finding is emitted.
SSH xtversion WezTerm
SSH terminal has xtversion WezTerm but kitty evidence is unavailable
newline is None and no wezterm-kitty fallback is inferred.
Non-WezTerm
VS Code lacks kitty evidence
newline is XtermJs for VS Code and the newline fallback recommendation mentions Alt+Enter.
Affirmative WezTerm evidence
WezTerm has available runtime evidence
newline remains None, wezterm-kitty finding exists, and its note names typing backslash then Enter.

requirement: Clipboard delivery findings own remediation while compatibility facts remain stable
contract: Clipboard delivery state SHALL be exposed as a fact with a compatible fix string, while the view presents the actionable delivery finding and does not duplicate the legacy `fix` doctor output row. Unverified SSH delivery SHALL recommend wrap/minimal guidance; failed non-native delivery SHALL recommend minimal mode; the finding note SHALL be non-empty.
scenarios: Unverified SSH delivery
SSH route is unverified on Linux
delivery is Unverified, the compatibility fix is `grow wrap <ssh command> or /minimal`, and a named finding has a non-empty note.
Failed delivery
a VTE-like terminal has no native/tmux/OSC52 route
delivery is Failed, the compatibility fix is `/minimal`, and a named finding owns remediation without a legacy fix line.

requirement: Named terminal-specific clipboard caveat recommendations
contract: For SSH sessions, Iterm2 SHALL produce its permission recommendation and VS Code-compatible terminals (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed) SHALL produce the VSCODE_SSH_NON_ASCII recommendation with the requested guidance. Ghostty SHALL not receive that VS Code-specific finding.
scenarios: Iterm2 SSH
brand is Iterm2 over SSH
the Iterm2 permission finding is a Recommendation containing Settings guidance.
VS Code family SSH
brand is VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or Zed over SSH
the shared VSCODE_SSH_NON_ASCII finding is a Recommendation containing /minimal guidance.
Ghostty SSH
brand is Ghostty over SSH
the VS Code-specific finding is absent.

requirement: Keyboard fact and doctor formatter honor the snapshot host
contract: The diagnostics view and format_doctor SHALL use the HostOs carried by the DiagnosticSnapshot rather than the process host: MacOS snapshots retain a keyboard fact and mark the formatted report with OS rescue active, while non-MacOS snapshots omit the keyboard row and its marker.
scenarios: MacOS snapshot host
snapshot_host is Macos
keyboard.fact.os equals Macos and formatted output contains `(OS rescue active)`.
Non-MacOS snapshot host
snapshot_host is Linux
keyboard facts are absent and formatted output contains no keyboard row.

requirement: VisibleLink SHALL represent one logical clickable target as one or more screen-row rectangles, answer half-open coordinate hit tests, and identify only bare URL paint when total painted display width equals the URL display width.
contract: contains SHALL return true when col lies in [x,x+width) and row in [y,y+height) for any rect, otherwise false. looks_like_bare_url_text SHALL return false for non-URL LinkTarget variants and compare the summed rect widths with unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr::width(url); short labels and citation blocks therefore do not qualify even when they target a URL.
scenarios: Half-open hit
pointer is at a link start, last valid cell, end column, wrong row, or before the start
start and last valid cells hit; end, wrong row, and before-start miss.
Bare URL paint
URL target rectangles total exactly the URL display width, including multiple wrapped segments
the link is classified as bare URL text.
Short label or citation
painted width is shorter or wider than the URL display width
the link is not classified as bare URL text.
Non-URL target
target is a File link
bare URL classification returns false.

requirement: VisibleLinkMap::rebuild SHALL clear the previous frame, store the supplied scrollback generation, reserve for overlay and citation inputs, resolve every target through terminal context, discard targets without an open target, and retain valid citation links alongside markdown overlay links.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: rebuild delegates to rebuild_for_context with the process terminal context. rebuild_for_context clears links before setting generation, pushes overlay links with presentation-aware resolve_link_target_for_context, then resolves citation targets as Opaque and appends only entries whose open_target is Some. Official VS Code remote sessions exclude self-resolving file overlays while retaining opaque web links; file target provenance remains the original absolute path and OSC8 conversion is delegated to the shared resolver.
scenarios: Rebuild replaces frame
map has old links and receives a new overlay/generation
old links disappear, new links remain, and generation becomes the new value.
Citation inclusion
valid citation URL is supplied with an overlay URL
both links are present and independently hit-testable.
Remote editor ownership
official VS Code remote terminal receives SelfResolvingPath file link plus opaque web link
the file link is absent from activation map while the web link remains.
File provenance
overlay carries a File target with a path containing spaces
visible target keeps the same path and shared resolution produces a percent-encoded file URL.
Empty rebuild
overlay and citations are empty
map is empty and link_at returns None.

requirement: Overlay projection SHALL skip zero-width segments, create one-row rectangles for positive spans, and merge consecutive same-id segments only within the current rebuild or append batch so wrapped fragments of one logical document link share a VisibleLink.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: push_overlay_links computes width with saturating_sub and drops width zero. With merge_from=0 during rebuild, a segment with Some(id) merges into the immediately preceding entry only when that entry has the same id; with append, merge_from is the pre-append length so the new batch cannot merge into the scrollback prefix or an earlier batch. Different ids and None ids always remain separate, and the first matching entry wins for overlapping screen rectangles.
scenarios: Zero width
col_start equals col_end
segment is omitted from links.
Wrapped same id
two positive overlay spans on different rows use the same id in one overlay
one VisibleLink holds two rects and both row segments hit.
Different ids
adjacent wrapped spans use different ids
two logical VisibleLink entries remain.
No id
same URL spans multiple rows but id is None
each segment remains a separate entry.
Overlap precedence
two links overlap at one screen coordinate
link_at returns the first entry in iteration order.

requirement: VisibleLinkMap SHALL append overlay sources without changing generation, merge wrapped segments only within that appended source, and support truncating the appended suffix before re-appending the current frame overlay.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: append_from_overlay records the current map length and invokes push_overlay_links with that merge boundary and the current terminal context; it does not alter generation. truncate keeps only the first n logical links. Therefore per-document ids that collide with a scrollback prefix do not merge, while same-batch wrapped segments do; truncating to the saved prefix removes stale BTW/overlay entries and permits the replacement source to be appended.
scenarios: Append collision
scrollback prefix and appended overlay both use id 0
the entries remain separate and the prefix keeps precedence at its own row.
Append wrapped batch
empty/rebuilt prefix followed by two same-id wrapped segments
one appended VisibleLink contains both rectangles.
Replace suffix
old appended overlay exists, then map is truncated to prefix and a new overlay is appended
old suffix no longer hits and the new overlay is hit at its row.
Generation stability
append is used after a rebuild
generation remains the rebuild generation until a later rebuild.

requirement: VisibleLinkMap SHALL expose generation and staleness so a frame link map can be rejected whenever scrollback generation differs, while a rebuild at the current generation marks the map fresh and a same-cwd update does not create a false stale state.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Default generation is zero, so is_stale(nonzero) is true before a rebuild. rebuild stores the supplied generation; is_stale returns generation != current_generation. ScrollbackState cwd changes advance its generation only when the cwd actually changes; the map is stale before rebuilding for the new cwd and fresh after rebuilding, while setting the same cwd again leaves the generation unchanged.
scenarios: Initial map
new map is compared with generation 1
map is stale.
Fresh generation
map is rebuilt at generation 1 and compared with 1
map is not stale.
Changed generation
map is rebuilt at 1 and compared with 2
map is stale.
CWD transition
scrollback cwd changes from /other to /worktree
old map is stale before re-resolve; rebuilt map reflects changed presentation ownership and is fresh.
Idempotent cwd
same cwd is set again
generation does not change and the map remains fresh.

requirement: Search block state, output modes, match mutation, and timing
contract: SearchOutputMode SHALL parse only `files_with_matches` as FilesWithMatches and `count` as Count, defaulting all other/missing values to Content. SearchToolCallBlock::new SHALL initialize an empty successful result with default metadata and no local timing; with_matches/set_file_matches SHALL replace count and grouped matches; with_error/set_error SHALL update failure state; timing finalization SHALL be idempotent and elapsed_ms SHALL expose stored or live duration.
scenarios: Output mode parse
raw output_mode is files_with_matches, count, another string, or absent
the corresponding mode is selected and unknown/missing values use Content.
Match mutation
match count and file matches are supplied
the block stores the new count and grouped results.
Error/timing
a block is marked failed or a running block finishes
is_success reflects error absence and elapsed time is captured once.

requirement: Search match summaries by output mode
contract: match_summary SHALL return `(no matches)` for zero Content/Count results and `(no files)` for zero FilesWithMatches results. Content mode SHALL distinguish singular match, plural matches, and multiple files; FilesWithMatches SHALL interpret match_count as file count; Count SHALL report matches across the maximum of file_paths and file_matches when multiple files exist.
scenarios: No results
match_count is zero
Content/Count show `(no matches)` and FilesWithMatches shows `(no files)`.
Content mode
one or many matches span one or many grouped files
the summary uses singular `(1 match)`, plural match count, or `matches in N files`.
Files mode
FilesWithMatches has N files
the summary uses `(1 file)` or `(N files)`.
Count mode
Count has file paths/grouped files
the summary uses `matches across N files` for multiple files and singular/plural match text otherwise.

requirement: Search header semantics, path scope, width budgeting, and selection
contract: header_line SHALL render `Search ` followed by a glob as the unquoted search term when pattern is empty or `.`, otherwise a quoted pattern; a supplied glob is rendered as an additional `in` scope for real patterns and the path is rendered after it. The summary is last, width-constrained paths are shortened with reserved summary budget, summaries are included only when they fit, and the final line is truncated to width. header_block_line SHALL make only the term span selectable with TOOL_HEADER_RANGE and selection_text SHALL be the promoted glob or raw pattern.
scenarios: Trivial pattern
pattern is empty or `.` and glob exists
the glob is shown as the colored unquoted search term and selected text.
Real pattern/glob
a non-trivial pattern and glob exist
the pattern is quoted, glob is shown after `in`, and path follows as the final scope.
Width-constrained path
a path and width are supplied
the path is shortened using the remaining budget after search term/summary, and the whole line is width-truncated.
Header copy
the rendered header is selected
only span 1..term_end is selectable and copied text excludes label/path/summary.

requirement: Search metadata projection for mode and non-default input filters
contract: metadata_line SHALL always render a mode key (`pattern`, `files`, or `count`) and SHALL append file type, case-insensitive, and multiline flags as comma-separated key/value fields in that order when present. The glob is intentionally omitted because it is rendered inline in the header; values use primary styling and labels use muted styling.
scenarios: Default metadata
no optional filter is set
the line contains the mode field only.
Filtered metadata
file_type, case_insensitive, and/or multiline are set
each active field is appended once in stable order with `key: value` formatting.
Glob metadata
a glob is set
the metadata line omits it because header_line owns glob presentation.

requirement: Search result output for content, file-only, count, empty, and error cases
contract: output SHALL render a collapsed width-aware header only in Collapsed mode. Expanded and Truncated modes SHALL render an unmuted header, separator, metadata, then results: grouped file paths and numbered trimmed match lines for file_matches; file paths alone for FilesWithMatches; and path/count split at the last colon for Count. A result set with no paths/matches SHALL show `(no results)`, while result rows SHALL carry panel backgrounds and inter-file blank separators.
scenarios: Content results
file_matches is non-empty
each file is a panel path row followed by `line number  content` rows with trailing match whitespace trimmed.
File-only results
file_matches is empty, file_paths non-empty, and mode is FilesWithMatches
each path is rendered as an indented panel row.
Count results
file_paths contain `path:N` and mode is Count
the final colon separates path-colored file text from primary-colored `:N`; paths without a colon remain wholly path-colored.
No results
both result collections are empty and match_count is zero
metadata is followed by an indented muted `(no results)` hint.
Expanded/truncated
mode is Expanded or Truncated
the same metadata/results projection is used; only the outer display mode/header fold differs.

requirement: Search block fold and neutral visual protocol
contract: Search blocks SHALL have no accent line, show a red error bullet only when error exists, use no vertical padding, semantic background, or raw mode, default to Collapsed, remain foldable whenever successful even when no matches are present, and toggle non-collapsed modes back to Collapsed while Collapsed advances to Expanded. An errored Search block SHALL not be treated as a normal fullscreen viewer by the surrounding RenderBlock.
scenarios: Visual protocol
the renderer queries accent/bullet/padding/background/raw mode
accent is None, bullet is error red only, padding/background/raw are disabled.
Foldability
a search succeeds or has an error
successful blocks are foldable even with no results; errored blocks are not.
Fold cycle
current mode is Collapsed, Truncated, or Expanded
Collapsed becomes Expanded and either non-collapsed mode becomes Collapsed.
Fullscreen eligibility
a matched or errored search block is wrapped in RenderBlock
matched search has a normal fullscreen viewer while errored search has none.

requirement: Search indexing and Grep viewer dispatch integration
contract: The surrounding RenderBlock/search integration SHALL expose search pattern, file path, and matched line content through searchable_text, and OpenBlockViewer on a matched Search block SHALL consume the block without emitting an effect and open a Grep viewer for the selected entry.
scenarios: Search indexing
a search block contains pattern, file path, line number, and content
searchable_text contains the pattern, path, and matched content.
Open viewer
a matched Search block is selected and OpenBlockViewer is dispatched
no effect is emitted and the agent opens ViewerKind::Grep.

requirement: AgentView SHALL enter inline edit only for an existing ordinary UserPrompt with a resolvable shell prompt index; bash, cron, interjection, missing entries, and missing rewind targets SHALL be rejected. A successful entry SHALL capture stable EntryId, prompt index, original text, textarea state, select and center the entry, and dismiss a stale jump picker.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: enter_inline_edit is idempotent while an edit exists and returns true without replacing it. For a new edit it resolves the entry by index, requires RenderBlock::UserPrompt, rejects is_bash/is_cron/is_interjection, resolves shell_prompt_index_at, dismisses the jump picker, initializes TextArea with the full original text and cursor at text.len(), stores hit rects as None, selects the entry, and centers it. exit_inline_edit takes the state and clears ScrollbackState inline_edit_height; the feature master switch INLINE_EDIT_ENABLED is false and gates external entry points while leaving these methods and tests wired.
scenarios: Ordinary prompt entry
entry 0 is a plain UserPrompt followed by an agent message
editing begins, original/textarea text and prompt_index are captured, and the entry is selected.
Non-editable prompt
entry is bash or cron
enter_inline_edit returns false and no state is created.
Interjection or no rewind target
prompt is an interjection or shell index lookup fails
entry is rejected so a wrong prompt cannot be rewound.
Re-entry while editing
inline_edit already exists
method returns true and preserves the existing editor state.
Jump picker conflict
a stale jump picker is open before entry
picker is dismissed before editor state becomes active.

requirement: While editing, bare Enter SHALL trim the candidate for validation, close with no action when empty or unchanged after trim, and return InlineEditSubmit when changed; Esc or Ctrl-C on an empty textarea SHALL discard. Other keys, including modified Enter, SHALL be forwarded to the textarea and consumed as Changed.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: handle_inline_edit_key returns Unchanged when no editor exists. Bare Enter compares trim() against original.trim(); empty or equal calls exit_inline_edit and returns Changed, while changed text returns Action(Action::InlineEditSubmit) and keeps state for dispatch. Esc with no modifiers, or Ctrl-C only when textarea.text() is exactly empty, exits and clears height. All other keys are passed to TextArea::input. The module does not perform rewind/resubmit itself; dispatch consumes InlineEditSubmit.
scenarios: Unchanged submit
editor text remains the original prompt
Enter closes editing, emits no action effect, and clears layout override.
Empty submit
editor text is whitespace only
Enter closes editing and never submits an empty prompt.
Changed submit
editor text differs from original
Enter returns InlineEditSubmit while keeping inline_edit active for dispatch.
Escape discard
edited text exists and Esc is pressed without modifiers
editor closes, transcript prompt remains unchanged, and height override clears.
Text input
ordinary character key is pressed
textarea receives the character and state remains consumed/Changed.
Busy entry
session state is TurnRunning before entry
editor still opens; busy cancellation is deferred to submit dispatch.

requirement: While editing, scroll wheel SHALL scroll the transcript by three rows per event; a left click inside the rendered textarea SHALL move its cursor and clear selection; a left click elsewhere inside the overlay SHALL be consumed without dismissal, while a click outside the overlay SHALL discard the edit.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: handle_inline_edit_mouse handles ScrollUp/ScrollDown before requiring editor state. For a left Down it first maps the pointer through last_text_area and TextArea::buffer_pos_at_screen; a valid position clears textarea selection, sets cursor and returns Changed. If no textarea hit, last_rect containment determines whether to retain the edit; an outside click calls exit_inline_edit and swallows the click. Other mouse events return Unchanged, and no real terminal mouse capture is established here.
scenarios: Wheel up/down
editor is active and transcript receives scroll events
scrollback moves by three rows and outcome is Changed.
Textarea click
left click falls inside last_text_area at a valid buffer position
selection clears, cursor moves, and editor remains active.
Overlay click
left click misses textarea but is inside last_rect
event is consumed and editor remains active.
Outside click
left click is outside last_rect
edit is discarded and the click is still consumed.
Unhandled mouse
mouse event is not wheel or left Down
outcome is Unchanged.

requirement: Per-frame inline edit layout sync SHALL resolve the stable EntryId, compute a minimum one-row textarea height at the available content width, reserve that height for the edited entry, and return the first following entry index; when the entry disappears it SHALL exit editing and clear the override.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: sync_inline_edit_layout returns None without an active edit. It re-resolves entry_id through index_of_id, exits and clears height when absent, computes width from entry_text_column_width minus prompt-arrow display width with saturating_sub and max(1), computes textarea.desired_height(width).max(1), stores (entry_id,height), and returns idx.saturating_add(1) so callers dim content below the edited entry. Height follows multiline text and transcript replacement abandons the editor.
scenarios: Single-line reserve
active entry is present with one-line text
inline_edit_height stores the entry id and height 1, and returned dim-from index is 1.
Multiline reserve
textarea text has three newline-separated lines
reserved height becomes 3.
Entry removal
transcript removes the edited entry before the next sync
sync returns None, editor is cleared, and height override is cleared.
Narrow width
scrollback width leaves little content after prefix
textarea width is saturated to at least one column rather than underflowing.

requirement: render_inline_edit SHALL clear previous hit rectangles before every frame, draw only when the edited entry has a nonzero visible screen area, blank the old entry content, paint the prompt arrow, render the textarea in the matching content area, record current hit rectangles, and return the hardware cursor position.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: render_inline_edit returns None without state, missing EntryId, missing screen area, or zero-width/height area. It clears last_text_area and last_rect before lookup so an offscreen edit cannot receive clicks at old coordinates. For a visible entry it fills the entry rect with theme.bg_visual spaces, derives HorizontalLayout content coordinates and width, paints prompt_arrow with accent_user, allocates textarea width as content_w-prefix_w saturated to one and height equal to entry rect, renders TextArea via render_ref, records both rects, and returns cursor_pos_with_state. The existing entry text is not mutated by rendering.
scenarios: Visible overlay
edited entry is visible in the prepared scrollback area
old glyphs are blanked, prompt arrow and textarea are painted, hit rects are recorded, and cursor coordinates are returned.
Offscreen entry
edited entry scrolls beyond the viewport after a previous visible frame
last_rect and last_text_area are cleared and rendering returns None, preventing stale cursor hits.
Zero area
screen area has zero width or height
nothing is painted and no hit rectangle survives.
Entry removal before render
EntryId no longer resolves
render returns None without using stale rectangles.
Busy editing
session is already TurnRunning but entry remains visible
render path remains available; cancellation offer is not created by this module.

requirement: Quote bar style gating and raw-mode selection behavior
contract: QuoteBarStrip SHALL cache an optional theme-derived blockquote bar style: enabled mode SHALL derive the exact DIM/blockquote_outer style, while disabled raw mode SHALL avoid theme lookup and return zero prefix width plus Selectable::All. Enabled selection SHALL delegate to quote_prefix_selectable only when a genuine styled bar prefix is present.
scenarios: Pretty mode
QuoteBarStrip::new(true) is used
the current theme-derived bar style is cached and eligible rows can exclude a prefix.
Raw mode
QuoteBarStrip::new(false) is used
prefix_width returns 0, selectable returns All, and source `>` markers remain selectable.
Wrong style
a line starts with an unstyled or differently styled `│`
it is treated as content and remains fully selectable.

requirement: Rendered quote prefix shape scanner and interior-bar rejection
contract: rendered_quote_prefix_len SHALL recognize one or more bar_style-styled `│` bars separated by exactly one space, stop at the content boundary, and return the UTF-8 byte length including the separator. Bar-only rows with optional trailing space SHALL be accepted. Any unstyled/differently styled leading bar, interior bar after genuine prefix, malformed separator, or non-quote line SHALL return None so content is never deleted from copies.
scenarios: Single/nested prefix
a row has `│ text` or `│ │ deep` with the exact bar style
the scanner returns the byte boundary before content.
Blank quote
the scanner returns the entire bar-only prefix length.
Content bar
a literal bar occurs after a genuine prefix
the scanner returns None rather than stripping user content.
Non-quote/malformed
the bar is unstyled, separators are wrong, or no bar exists
the scanner returns None.

requirement: Quote prefix selection range and span splitting
contract: quote_prefix_selectable SHALL require the parser-generated bar to be the first span and carry the exact bar style, scan a valid prefix, split a straddling span at the byte boundary, and return Selectable::Spans covering only content. Bar-only rows SHALL return an empty selectable span range so multiline copy retains their newline; all other rows SHALL remain Selectable::All.
scenarios: Styled quote row
the first span is the genuine bar and content shares a span
the content span is split at the prefix boundary and only the content span range is selectable.
Nested quote
multiple genuine bars precede content
all nesting bars and separator spaces are excluded from derived selection text.
Blank quote row
the row contains only prefix bars
an empty Spans range is returned and remains selectable to the selection model.
Conservative first-span guard
a list bullet or other decoration precedes the bar
the row stays fully selectable, preserving the prefix as a documented false negative.

requirement: Wrapped quote continuation copy reconstruction
contract: The quote-bar metadata SHALL be applied to every markdown-wrapped continuation row, excluding each reinjected `│ ` prefix from derived selection text while preserving joiner metadata. Reconstructing a drag selection across the rows SHALL rejoin the content with soft-wrap separators and produce the original quote text without bars or leading prefix spaces.
scenarios: Wrapped quote
a long quoted paragraph wraps at a narrow width
every output row begins with a rendered bar, each derived selection omits the bar/prefix space, and no row begins with a prefix space.
Drag copy
the wrapped rows are reconstructed with their joiners
the copied text is the original paragraph with normal spaces and no quote bars.
