requirement: Blank quote preservation and literal/table content safety
contract: Quote-bar detection SHALL preserve user-authored box-drawing bars, table borders, paragraph/code content, and quoted literal bars by returning Selectable::All whenever the interior-bar rule or first-span/style guard identifies content. A parser-generated blank quote row SHALL instead retain an empty selectable range and contribute a newline to full drag copies.
scenarios: Blank line copy
a quote contains an empty `>` line between content
the bar-only row is retained as an empty selectable span and full drag copy contains a blank line.
Quoted box art
quote content begins with a literal `│`, including the degenerate bar-only content case
the content bar is not consumed and copied text retains both quote decoration/content bars.
List/paragraph/code/table
a bar appears under a list prefix, plain paragraph, code block, or table
the row remains fully selectable and table borders/literal bars survive copy.

requirement: Raw markdown quote rows remain source-selectable
contract: When MarkdownContent raw mode is enabled, quote-bar stripping SHALL be disabled so the source `>` marker and following content remain fully selectable and are copied exactly as authored.
scenarios: Raw quote
raw mode renders `> QUOTE alpha`
the row is Selectable::All and derived selection text is exactly `> QUOTE alpha`.

requirement: ConfirmResetSetting(Reset) for the permission_mode Enum SHALL reset the future-session default to canonical ask and persist it without changing an active session that is currently AlwaysApprove.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The reset route emits PersistPermissionMode with canonical "ask" and session_id=None. The active AgentSession permission remains AlwaysApprove, while app.default_permission_mode becomes Ask. This is the security boundary between the settings default and a live session selector.
scenarios: Reset permission default
active session and future default are both initially AlwaysApprove, then permission_mode reset is confirmed
only the future default is changed and the live session stays AlwaysApprove.

requirement: Enabling AlwaysApprove SHALL drain queued permissions owned by the root session by selecting AllowOnce, while leaving child-session requests queued; queue transitions SHALL invalidate the double-click tracker only when the resolved root request is removed and SHALL preserve front-child follow-up input, draft text, and click state.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: SetPermissionMode(AlwaysApprove) sets the active session mode and invokes the root permission drain. A root request is popped and its response channel receives Selected(AllowOnce) when that option exists. A child request identified by a different session_id remains queued and unresponded. When the root request is selected or drain_root_permission_queue processes it, last_permission_click is cleared and the next front prompt resets to Options; when the front is a child request, its FollowupInput focus, composer draft, and armed click remain unchanged. Enabling the parent AlwaysApprove likewise leaves queued child Ask requests untouched.
scenarios: Allow-once drain
root permission queue contains an AllowOnce option and AlwaysApprove is enabled
queue empties and response selects opt-allow-once, never RejectOnce or Cancelled.
Selection tracker reset
two root requests are queued and first is selected
resolved request is removed, last_permission_click clears, and next front focus is Options.
Turn-end drain tracker
root queue request has an armed last_permission_click
draining empties the queue and clears the armed click.
Child protection
queued request session_id is child-session while root drain runs
child request remains queued and its response channel is empty.
Child front follow-up
child request is front, focused FollowupInput, with draft and click armed; root request follows
root request is not drained; child focus, draft, and click remain.
Parent mode change
parent AlwaysApprove is enabled while a child Ask request is queued
parent session becomes AlwaysApprove but child request remains pending/unresponded.

requirement: PermissionSelect and PermissionCancel SHALL remove the selected front request even when its requester response channel is disconnected, and SHALL toast the standardized requester-disconnected message instead of silently swallowing the action.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Both answer and cancel paths pop the dead permission request, attempt the response, detect the closed oneshot sender, and set the Agent toast to "This permission request is no longer valid (the requester disconnected)". The queue is empty afterward and no successful approval/cancel response is asserted because the requester no longer exists.
scenarios: Disconnected select
front request response receiver is dropped before PermissionSelect(AllowOnce)
request is removed and the requester-disconnected toast is shown.
Disconnected cancel
front request receiver is dropped before PermissionCancel
request is removed and the same toast is shown.

requirement: SetPermissionMode SHALL update only the active session, leave the future default/current UI mirror as defined, downgrade Auto to Ask when auto_mode_gate is disabled, and emit one canonical NotifySessionPermissionMode effect; Ask transitions SHALL use the branded Permission mode toast.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: With the auto gate enabled, SetPermissionMode(Auto) makes the active session auto, leaves current_ui.permission_mode None and emits canonical "auto" notification. With the gate disabled the same request becomes Ask and emits canonical "ask". A real AlwaysApprove→Ask transition clears active always-approve, leaves current_ui.permission_mode None, emits canonical "ask", and sets toast text exactly "✓ Permission mode: Ask"; the test avoids the idempotent fast path by changing mode first.
scenarios: Auto enabled
auto_mode_gate is true and active session receives Auto
session is auto, no future default mirror is changed, and NotifySessionPermissionMode canonical is auto.
Auto gated off
auto_mode_gate is false and Auto is requested
session is not auto and notification canonical is ask.
Ask branding
session is first changed to AlwaysApprove, then Ask is dispatched
session no longer always-approves, canonical ask is notified, and toast uses Permission mode: Ask branding.

requirement: A failed permission_mode persistence SHALL roll back the future-session default and current UI canonical value, safely map an unknown canonical to Ask, retain the active session mode, and refresh an open Settings modal UI snapshot without rewriting its pager snapshot.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: TaskComplete(SettingPersistFailed) with permission_mode applies typed rollback. Unknown enum values defensively become Ask and set the standard failure toast; the active AgentSession remains AlwaysApprove when it was independently set. If Settings is open, pager_snapshot preserves the pre-rollback session-facing AlwaysApprove state while ui_snapshot.permission_mode becomes "ask". The test acknowledges the warning log as non-contractual and does not assert it.
scenarios: Unknown rollback
active session is AlwaysApprove and rollback_value is garbage-value
future default becomes Ask, current_ui.permission_mode is ask, active session remains AlwaysApprove, and failure feedback uses the standard path.
Open modal rollback
Settings opens after optimistic AlwaysApprove, then persistence failure rolls back to ask
modal stays open; ui_snapshot refreshes to ask while pager_snapshot and live session stay AlwaysApprove.

requirement: A non-empty top-level permission queue SHALL classify an agent as NeedsInput, and rejecting a permission SHALL not move the process-level sticky permission cursor away from the last affirmative selection.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: classify_top_level returns RowState::NeedsInput whenever permission_queue is non-empty. PermissionSelect for AllowOnce records DefaultSelectedPermission::AllowOnce; a subsequent reject-once selection resolves the request but leaves last_used_permission at AllowOnce, so reject choices do not steer the sticky cursor.
scenarios: Needs input
synthetic permission is pushed into an agent queue
dashboard classification is NeedsInput.
Allow selection
sticky cursor starts at AlwaysAllowAllSessions and AllowOnce is selected
last_used_permission becomes AllowOnce.
Reject selection
next queued request is answered with RejectOnce
last_used_permission remains AllowOnce.

requirement: Todo status styling, list entries, icons, and search identity
contract: TodoPaneStyle SHALL map Pending to primary icon/text, InProgress to warning icon and bold primary text, Completed to success icon and bright-gray text, and Cancelled to error icon and crossed-out bright-gray text. TodoListEntry SHALL cache styled content, expose status icons (□, ▶, check mark, ballot X) with a trailing space, preserve the supplied id as stable_id, and return the canonical content for search.
scenarios: Status style
a TodoItem has any supported status
the corresponding icon color and content style are selected from TodoPaneStyle.
Entry rendering
a TodoListEntry is constructed
content is cached from item.content, prefix contains icon plus space, and stable_id/search_text expose id/content.
Theme default
TodoPaneStyle is default-constructed
colors come from the current theme with the documented modifiers.

requirement: Todo counts, progress denominator, and empty placeholder messages
contract: TodoCounts::total SHALL include every status while total_excluding_cancelled SHALL omit cancelled items. empty_placeholder_message SHALL say `No todo items.` for an empty source list; for a non-empty list it SHALL say `All done.` when cancelled is zero, `{N} cancelled.` when only cancelled items exist, and `{D} done. {C} cancelled.` otherwise. The status badge SHALL render completed over the non-cancelled total and disappear for no todos or all-cancelled lists.
scenarios: Empty list
todos_empty is true
the placeholder is `No todo items.` and the badge has no denominator.
All completed
completed > 0 and cancelled = 0
the empty-state placeholder says `All done.` and badge denominator includes all non-cancelled tasks.
Mixed statuses
completed and cancelled are both nonzero
the placeholder includes both done and cancelled counts and the badge denominator excludes cancelled.
Only cancelled
completed = 0 and cancelled > 0
the placeholder reports cancelled count and the all-cancelled badge is absent.

requirement: Todo pane initialization, updates, counts, and badge flash lifecycle
contract: TodoPane::new SHALL create a hidden pane with show_done enabled, an empty NoWrap ListPane configured for search/copy/filter without follow/wrap-toggle/visual selection/goto-line, a system clipboard provider, default counts/styles, and current theme kind. update_todos SHALL replace the raw list, recompute all-status counts, and arm a 1200ms absolute badge flash only when counts change; it SHALL not auto-show the pane. badge_flash_active_at SHALL use a strict before-deadline check, maintain_badge SHALL clear and report expiry at/after the deadline, and counts/deadline accessors SHALL expose current snapshots.
scenarios: Initialization
a pane is newly created
overlay is hidden, show_done is true, todos/counts/entries are empty, and list configuration matches the pane contract.
First/change update
incoming items change aggregate counts
todos and prev_counts are replaced and badge flash is armed until now plus 1200ms.
Same counts
incoming item content/order changes but aggregate counts remain equal
raw todos are replaced without rearming the count flash.
Expiry
now reaches or passes the deadline
maintain_badge clears the deadline and returns true; before deadline it leaves it armed and returns false.

requirement: Todo visibility filter, stable entry rebuild, and bounded desired height
contract: TodoPane SHALL report visibility from overlay.visible, preserve accepted list filters while closing an active input bar when hidden, and toggle show_done independently. When show_done is false, completed/cancelled items SHALL be filtered without reordering pending/in-progress items and entry IDs SHALL retain original todo indices. desired_height SHALL be zero when hidden, one for a visible empty/filter-empty pane, otherwise cap visible rows by floor(15% of view height) and 10 with a minimum of one.
scenarios: Visibility/input state
overlay becomes hidden
is_visible is false and on_state_change closes only the active input bar while accepted filters remain.
Filter toggle
show_done is toggled
completed/cancelled visibility changes and entries are rebuilt in original order.
Stable IDs
items are filtered
each visible entry uses its original index as id so ListPane selection can survive rebuilds.
Height
pane is hidden, visible but empty, or contains items
desired_height returns 0, 1, or bounded visible count respectively.

requirement: Todo pane keyboard, paste, scroll, and mouse delegation
contract: handle_key SHALL consume `h` only when the ListPane input bar is closed by toggling show_done and rebuilding entries; empty panes SHALL reject other keys, while non-empty panes delegate to ListPaneState. handle_paste and handle_mouse SHALL delegate with current entries. handle_scroll SHALL cap absolute deltas to one line for viewports up to five rows, two for six-to-ten rows, and leave larger viewport deltas unchanged before delegation.
scenarios: Toggle key
key is `h` and no search/filter input is active
show_done toggles, entries rebuild, and the event is consumed.
Empty/key delegation
entries are empty or a non-toggle key arrives
empty panes return false; populated panes delegate the key event.
Paste/mouse
paste text or a mouse event is supplied
the corresponding ListPaneState handler receives current entries and mouse area.
Scroll cap
viewport height is 0..5, 6..10, or above 10
the delegated delta is capped to ±1, ±2, or the original absolute magnitude respectively.

requirement: Todo pane theme-aware rendering and padded layout projection
contract: render SHALL detect theme-kind changes and recreate both TodoPaneStyle and ListPaneStyle before rebuilding entries. It SHALL compute an inner area using HorizontalLayout accent plus left padding and right block padding with saturating width. Empty entries SHALL render a muted gray-bight placeholder only when the inner area has positive dimensions; non-empty entries SHALL prepare ListPane layout with inner dimensions and render a focused/styled ListPane.
scenarios: Theme switch
current theme kind differs from last_theme
cached status/list styles refresh before entries rebuild.
Empty render
filtered entries are empty and inner width/height are positive
the correct no-items/all-done/counts placeholder is painted in gray_bright.
Zero area
inner width or height is zero
empty placeholder painting is skipped.
Non-empty render
visible entries exist
ListPaneState prepares layout and ListPane renders with focus and list style in the padded inner area.

requirement: The timeline rail SHALL reserve exactly RAIL_WIDTH columns only when the setting is enabled, the view is not a subagent view, the terminal width meets MIN_TERMINAL_WIDTH, and the conversation has at least MIN_TURNS; otherwise it SHALL reserve zero columns.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: rail_width is the single policy gate: show_timeline && !is_subagent_view && area_width >= 60 && turn_count >= 2 yields 2, all other combinations yield 0. Geometry feasibility such as available rows is intentionally deferred to compute_rail.
scenarios: Eligible rail
timeline enabled, root agent view, width 80, and five turns
two rail columns are reserved.
Setting off
show_timeline is false
zero columns are reserved.
Subagent exclusion
timeline is enabled but is_subagent_view is true
zero columns are reserved.
Narrow terminal
width is MIN_TERMINAL_WIDTH - 1
zero columns are reserved.
Too few turns
turn_count is 1
zero columns are reserved.

requirement: compute_rail SHALL fail closed for fewer than MIN_TURNS or fewer than three available rows, otherwise compute a centered chevron-plus-tick stack and a turn-index window that shows every turn when possible or slides around the active/bottom viewport without hiding the active turn.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: turn_count < 2 returns None. The rail requires height.checked_sub(2) tick rows and returns None when no tick fits. If all turns fit, window is 0..turn_count; otherwise max_ticks rows are selected around active (or newest when active is None), clamped to the tail. At bottom, the tail is preferred but the start is min(active, tail_start), guaranteeing active visibility. The full stack of two chevrons plus ticks is centered within scrollback_area; rect spans the entire scrollback height at rail_x with width 2, and ticks_y/up_y/down_y are derived from the stack.
scenarios: Too few turns
turn_count is 1
compute_rail returns None.
No tick room
scrollback height is 2
compute_rail returns None because two chevrons consume all rows.
Small conversation
four turns fit in the available 18 tick rows
window is 0..4 and six rows are vertically centered.
Overflow around active
50 turns, active turn 25, not at bottom
18 ticks are shown in window 16..34 and include active 25.
Tail clamp
50 turns with active last or active None
window is 32..50.
Bottom before tail
50 turns at bottom with active 25
window begins at 25 so active remains visible even though tail is preferred.
Bottom inside tail
50 turns at bottom with active 40
window pins to tail 32..50 and includes active.

requirement: TimelineRail::hit SHALL use the full rail rectangle as the hit target, map chevron rows to Up/Down and tick rows to absolute turn indices, and return None outside the rail or in unused rows. chevron_target SHALL return tick identity or the rail’s up/down target verbatim, with None as a no-op end stop.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: hit first checks Rect::contains, then gives exact up_y/down_y rows chevron precedence, then maps rows from ticks_y through window.len() to window.start + relative index. chevron_target never computes active±1 itself: it uses up_target/down_target supplied by RailViewport, allowing pre-turn and over-scroll semantics; render_rail derives chevron dim/enabled styles from the same function.
scenarios: Rail bounds
pointer is outside the two reserved columns or outside the rail rect
hit returns None.
Chevron rows
pointer lands at up_y or down_y inside the rail
hit returns Up or Down.
Tick row
pointer lands at ticks_y plus relative row
hit returns the absolute turn index from the window.
Unused row
pointer lands above the tick stack but inside rail rect
hit returns None.
Middle chevrons
active turn 3 has up_target 2 and down_target 4
chevron_target returns 2 and 4.
End stops
first turn has no up target or last turn has no down target
corresponding chevron target is None.
Pre-turn content
active is 0 and down_target is 0
Down targets the first turn rather than skipping it.
Bottom over-scroll
bottom viewport has active 4 and down_target 5
Down still returns 5; only last turn with down_target None dims/no-ops.

requirement: render_rail SHALL draw two chevrons and one tick per visible turn directly on the supplied buffer, derive enabled/dim chevron appearance from chevron_target, highlight active and hovered ticks, and leave ordinary ticks dim in the rightmost rail cell.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Chevron x is rail.rect.x + RAIL_WIDTH - 1. Enabled chevrons use gray, disabled targets use gray_dim, and a hovered enabled chevron uses text_primary. Active ticks use the active glyph and bright style, hovered non-active ticks use hover glyph and bright style, and other ticks use a padded horizontal line in gray_dim. Rendering iterates a cloned window and writes each row with the rail width; no track background strip is painted.
scenarios: Enabled navigation
up_target or down_target is Some
chevron is normal gray, or bright when hovered.
Disabled navigation
corresponding target is None
chevron is dim and the matching click is a no-op.
Active tick
turn index equals rail.active
active tick glyph is bright.
Hovered tick
turn index is hovered but not active
hover tick glyph is bright.
Ordinary tick
turn is neither active nor hovered
short dim tick is drawn in the rightmost cell.

requirement: render_tick_hover_popup SHALL draw a rounded, cleared popup only for a hovered turn inside the rail window, trim and wrap the preview to at most two display-width-bounded lines, ellipsize the second line, anchor the card left of the rail, and clamp it inside the scrollback and buffer bounds; empty or too-tall content SHALL render nothing.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: A turn outside rail.window returns immediately. max_text is (scrollback_area.width/2).clamp(16,32); the trimmed preview is split at display width for the first line and truncated with truncate_str for the second, with empty preview producing no card. Card width is max line display width + 4 and height line count + 2. Cards taller than scrollback_area are skipped; x is rail left minus card width plus one with lower-bound scrollback x, y is vertically centered on tick_y and clamped to scrollback bottom and buffer height. The card is cleared, filled with bg_base, bordered with rounded gray/bg_base chrome, and text is painted in primary color.
scenarios: Outside window
hovered turn is not in the currently visible window
popup function returns without painting.
Empty preview
trimmed preview is empty
no card is rendered.
Long preview
preview exceeds two display-width-bounded lines
first line is width-sliced, second is ellipsized, and no third line is added.
Short terminal
card height exceeds scrollback area height
popup is skipped to avoid painting over adjacent panes.
Normal placement
valid tick and preview fit
rounded popup is left of the rail, vertically centered near tick, and clamped to visible bounds.

requirement: Runtime logo assets, per-slot overrides, validation, and normalization
contract: The logo asset loader SHALL keep compiled LOGO and LOGO_SMALL as independent per-slot fallbacks, load user `big.txt`/`small.txt` once per process from the logo directory in non-test builds, and avoid render-path filesystem I/O after OnceLock initialization. Each slot SHALL read at most MAX_LOGO_BYTES, reject invalid UTF-8, empty/whitespace/control-containing content, and fall back independently. Valid CRLF/CR input SHALL normalize to LF, remove only boundary blank lines, and preserve interior blank rows and visible-width content.
scenarios: No overrides
the logo directory lacks one or both files
each missing slot uses its compiled asset independently.
Valid override
one or both files contain visible non-control art
only those slots use normalized user text.
Invalid/oversized
a slot is empty, whitespace-only, invalid UTF-8, contains non-newline control characters, or exceeds 1 MiB
that slot falls back without affecting the other slot.
Line normalization
valid input contains CRLF/CR and boundary/interior blank rows
CR characters become LF, leading/trailing empty lines are removed, and interior blank rows remain.

requirement: Measured logo geometry, tiers, and layout gate constants
contract: LogoSize SHALL expose Big/Small art and measured visual width/line height. visual_width SHALL use maximum terminal display width of non-empty trimmed lines with a fallback of 24 and u16 saturation; count_lines SHALL count retained lines. pick_logo SHALL choose Big only when both width and height meet its measured extents plus horizontal/vertical padding and STACKED_CHROME, otherwise choose Small under its gates, otherwise None. logo_line_count SHALL return the picked line count or zero.
scenarios: Asset extents
the compiled Braille assets are inspected
all glyphs are Braille, Big measures 80x35, and Small measures 50x22.
Big gate
area meets Big width and height thresholds
pick_logo returns LOGO; if either dimension misses, it may fall back to Small.
Small gate
area meets Small but not Big thresholds
pick_logo returns LOGO_SMALL.
Too small
area misses Small width or height
pick_logo returns None and logo_line_count is zero.
Hero constants
asset extents and layout constants are combined
side-by-side and stacked gate totals match the calibrated values.

requirement: Logo shine sweep, pulse, and bounded opacity
contract: shine_opacity SHALL return a clamped [0,1] blend factor composed of a raised-cosine band that sweeps bottom-left to top-right during the active SWEEP_FRAC of each CYCLE and parks off-screen during the rest, plus a low-amplitude periodic global pulse. The sweep position SHALL advance with elapsed seconds and the resting phase SHALL remain dim.
scenarios: Range
diagonal positions and times are sampled
opacity remains in the closed unit interval.
Sweep
early, middle, and late active times are compared
the brightest diagonal position advances left to right.
Rest
time falls after the active sweep fraction
an interior point receives only the gentle pulse and remains below full brightness.

requirement: Logo rendering, centering, padding, and frame-driven colors
contract: render_into SHALL trim only boundary line endings, pad each art row to the maximum display width, compute a bottom-left to top-right diagonal per glyph using frame elapsed seconds, blend resting gray toward primary text color, coalesce adjacent glyphs with identical blended colors into spans, center each Line, and render a Paragraph into the supplied area. render_logo SHALL render only when pick_logo selects a tier; render_logo_into SHALL render a caller-selected static asset for hero/empty-state consumers.
scenarios: Picked render
render_logo receives an area satisfying a logo gate
the selected art is rendered centered with animated per-glyph color spans.
Too small
pick_logo returns None
render_logo performs no drawing.
Specific tier
render_logo_into is called by a consumer with a chosen asset
that exact art is rendered without re-running stacked selection.
Wide glyph/padding
art rows have differing display widths or wide Unicode glyphs
rows are padded by display width and diagonal display columns advance by Unicode width.

requirement: Process-scoped asset cache and deterministic test assets
contract: assets SHALL use OnceLock so the selected built-in or user-overridden pair is stable for the lifetime of the process. Under cfg(test), assets SHALL deterministically use the compiled constants even when a developer has personal overrides under GROW_HOME; filesystem loader behavior SHALL remain testable through the explicit directory boundary without mutating global state.
scenarios: First access
assets is requested for the first time
the pair is initialized exactly once.
Later access
LogoSize art/width/height or pick_logo requests assets again
the same cached pair is reused without another lookup.
Unit-test process
tests run with local user logo files present
LogoSize and geometry use compiled LOGO/LOGO_SMALL; explicit loader tests still exercise overrides.

requirement: ScrollbackState::timeline_entries SHALL enumerate turns oldest-first, expose each turn ordinal and stable prompt EntryId, and derive a bounded first-line preview from the corresponding UserPrompt; missing or non-prompt turn anchors SHALL be omitted rather than targeting a shifted index.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: timeline_entries iterates self.turns with enumerate, resolves turn.prompt_index through entries.get_index, returns None for missing positions, extracts UserPrompt text via prompt_preview and stores the EntryId rather than an ephemeral index. turn_preview performs the same stable turn lookup for one requested index and returns None for out-of-range turns or non-UserPrompt anchors. Appends/removals are therefore resolved by EntryId at the caller boundary.
scenarios: One per turn
scrollback contains a pre-turn banner, two user prompts and intervening agent/tool blocks
timeline has two entries in conversation order with turn_idx 0/1 and IDs resolving to prompt indices 1/3.
Missing anchor
a turn prompt index no longer resolves in entries
that turn is filtered out rather than producing a stale target.
Single preview
turn_preview is requested for a valid UserPrompt turn
the bounded first nonempty line is returned.
Invalid preview
turn index is out of range or anchor block is not UserPrompt
turn_preview returns None.

requirement: prompt_preview SHALL select the first non-empty trimmed logical line, preserve its internal text, cap stored preview length at PREVIEW_MAX_CHARS=120 characters, and replace the final retained character with an ellipsis when truncation occurs.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The helper traverses text.lines(), trims each line, chooses the first non-empty value or empty string, collects at most 120 chars, then checks whether a 121st char exists; if so it pops the 120th character and pushes U+2026, keeping the result at 120 chars. The cap is by Unicode scalar count rather than display width, intentionally bounding snapshot work; renderers may truncate again for available width.
scenarios: Leading blank lines
prompt begins with blank lines and whitespace before a meaningful line
preview is the trimmed first meaningful line, ignoring later lines.
Long prompt
first nonempty line exceeds 120 characters
preview has 120 chars and ends in an ellipsis.
Short prompt
first meaningful line is within the cap
preview contains the full trimmed line without an ellipsis.
All blank
prompt has no nonempty line
preview is empty.

requirement: active_turn_for_viewport SHALL identify the turn whose prompt owns the viewport top: in SingleTurn mode it SHALL return current_turn, while normal mode SHALL choose the last prompt at-or-above the top, pin pre-turn content to the first turn, and keep a top-anchored active turn at the bottom instead of clamping to the newest turn.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: SingleTurn returns current_turn directly. Normal mode returns None for no turns, otherwise uses prompts_above_top(false).saturating_sub(1); prompts_above_top requires layout cache and visible range, computes top as cached base virtual_y plus scroll_offset, and partition_points monotone prompt positions. With content before the first prompt, count is zero and saturating_sub yields turn 0. At bottom, the active turn is whichever prompt actually owns top, including a non-newest turn when trailing short turns fit below it; a one-row nudge changes the active boundary by at most one.
scenarios: Top/middle/bottom
three tall turns are laid out, then viewport is top, prompt 2 top, and bottom
active turns are 0, 1, and 2 respectively.
Short trailing turns at bottom
one tall response is followed by clustered short turns and viewport goes bottom
active remains the top-anchored turn, not an unconditional newest-turn clamp.
Pre-turn content
banner blocks precede the first prompt at top or bottom
active turn is the first turn, index 0.
Single-turn view
view_mode is SingleTurn with current_turn set
active returns current_turn rather than layout-derived state.
No turns/no layout
turn list is empty or layout cache is unavailable
active returns None rather than guessing a turn.

requirement: turn_above_viewport_top SHALL return the nearest turn prompt strictly above the viewport top, and turn_below_viewport_top SHALL return the nearest turn below it; both SHALL use current_turn adjacency in SingleTurn mode and preserve pre-turn, mid-turn, trailing-turn and end-stop semantics.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Normal above uses prompts_above_top(true)?.checked_sub(1), so an up action from mid-response first snaps to the current prompt and never targets an unreachable trailing turn. Normal below uses prompts_above_top(false) and returns the next turn if it exists; before the first prompt this is turn 0. SingleTurn uses current_turn.checked_sub(1) and current_turn+1 bounded by turns.len(). None denotes a dim/no-op chevron. These targets are later consumed by timeline chevron_target/jump_to_turn, while this state module only computes them.
scenarios: Mid-turn up
viewport is partway through the first tall response
up target is turn 0, snapping to its prompt; the next up is None at top.
Bottom trailing turns
bottom viewport top is an earlier turn while later short turns remain below
down target is active+1 and jump enters it instead of dimming.
Everything fits
two turns fit in one screen and first turn owns top
up is None, down targets turn 1.
Pre-turn down
viewport top is before all prompts
up is None and down targets first turn 0.
End stops
viewport is at first/last reachable turn
corresponding above/below target is None.
End-to-end walk
repeated chevron clicks rebuild rail and jump targets
up visits strictly decreasing turn boundaries to 0 without sticking; down visits strictly increasing targets and terminates.

requirement: prompts_above_top SHALL derive its partition from the prepared layout cache and visible-entry range, using cached virtual_y plus scroll_offset and monotone turn prompt indices; missing cache or missing base geometry SHALL return None so callers cannot navigate from stale/unprepared layout.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The helper obtains layout_cache, visible_entry_range and virtual_y at range.start with ?; computes the viewport top from the range base and scroll offset; then partition_points turns by prompt_y <= top or prompt_y < top according to strictness. It assumes turns are ordered by prompt positions and does not repair layout, clamp the viewport, mutate selection, or jump. The public active/above/below methods propagate None where geometry is unavailable (except SingleTurn paths).
scenarios: Prepared cache
layout cache and visible range contain prompt virtual positions
partition count identifies prompts at-or-above or strictly above the viewport top.
Strict boundary
prompt virtual_y equals viewport top
strict query excludes it while non-strict query includes it.
Missing cache
normal multi-turn query occurs before prepare_layout
helper returns None and public target/active methods do not invent an index.
Monotone turns
turn prompt positions are ordered
partition point yields the nearest boundary without scanning or reordering turns.

requirement: MCP section identity, ordering, labels, descriptions, and removability
contract: McpSectionId SHALL distinguish Plugin(name) from Local, order plugin sections alphabetically before Local, and compare Local equal to itself. section_key SHALL produce stable plugin/local collapse keys; section_label SHALL include the section name and count; section_description_lines SHALL currently return no descriptions; section_for SHALL classify plugin_name servers into Plugin and others as Local. is_removable SHALL currently permit deletion for every server.
scenarios: Section identity
a server has plugin_name or not
section_for returns Plugin(name) or Local.
Ordering
plugin/local sections are compared
plugins sort lexicographically before Local and Local equals Local.
Presentation
a section and count are supplied
stable collapse key and label are produced, with no description lines.
Removal
any server is checked
is_removable returns true.

requirement: MCP wire models, setup metadata, tool details, and status presentation
contract: MCP wire structs SHALL deserialize camelCase fields while applying defaults for optional display/source/config/setup/session data, setup fields/options, session tools, and setup_required. McpServerDisplayStatus SHALL map Ready/SetupRequired/Unavailable/Initializing to theme success/warning/error/running colors and stable labels ready/setup required/unavailable/initializing.
scenarios: Wire defaults
a response omits optional/defaulted fields
deserialization supplies None/empty/default values while preserving required name/enabled fields.
Setup metadata
a server declares setup fields/options
field id/label/type/required/default/options and option label/value are retained and serde-compatible.
Status presentation
a display status is rendered
the correct theme color and human label are returned.

requirement: MCP list response conversion, status precedence, plugin parsing, and stable sorting
contract: convert_list_response SHALL convert each wire entry into McpServerInfo. Session setup_required SHALL take priority and produce SetupRequired with zero tools; disabled sessions SHALL become Unavailable, zero tools, and enabled=false; enabled sessions SHALL map ready/initializing statuses, unknown statuses to Unavailable, preserve enabled, map each tool with safe defaults, and count tools. Missing sessions SHALL be unavailable and disabled. source SHALL preserve source_label or use local; plugin_name SHALL parse only non-empty `plugin:` labels; setup_required SHALL mirror the session flag/status. The result SHALL sort plugins before local entries, then by display name (falling back to name), then name.
scenarios: Plugin parsing
source_label is `plugin: name`
plugin_name is the trimmed name and source preserves the original label.
Setup priority
session.setup_required is true even with another status
status is SetupRequired, tools/count are empty, setup metadata survives.
Disabled/missing
session is disabled or absent
status is Unavailable, tool count/tools are zero/empty, and enabled is false.
Ready tools
session is enabled and status is ready/initializing
status and enabled are preserved and each JSON tool maps name/displayName/description/enabled with defaults.
Stable order
multiple plugin/local entries have display names/names
plugins precede local and ties use display name then canonical name.

requirement: MCP server status push patching and tool preservation
contract: patch_server_row SHALL find only the first server whose name equals the pushed name, update its status, and return true. When new_tools is Some it SHALL replace the tool list and derive tool_count from its length; when None it SHALL preserve existing tools/count. A missing name SHALL be a silent no-op returning false without mutating any row.
scenarios: Existing status/tools
a matching name and new_tools are supplied
only the first matching row changes status, tools are replaced, and tool_count equals the new vector length.
Status-only push
a matching name and new_tools is None are supplied
status changes while existing tools and tool_count remain untouched.
Missing push
no row has the pushed name
the function returns false and all rows remain unchanged.
Duplicate names
multiple rows share a name
only the first occurrence is mutated.

requirement: RenderOutput SHALL provide a pure, defaultable carrier for selection-box, scrollbar, selected-entry, resolved-selection, OSC8-link, inline-media, and Mermaid-affordance outputs; with_selection_box SHALL initialize the selected box while leaving other artifacts empty, and with_scroll_info SHALL attach scroll metrics fluently.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: RenderOutput::new delegates to Default. Default has None for selection_box, scroll_info and selected_entry_area, plus empty ResolvedSelectionModel, LinkOverlay, inline_media and diagram_affordances. with_selection_box sets only selection_box and explicitly resets the remaining fields to their empty values; with_scroll_info replaces scroll_info and returns the modified output. ScrollInfo uses usize for scroll_offset/total_height and u16 for viewport_height to support tall transcripts without narrowing offsets.
scenarios: Empty output
a caller creates RenderOutput::new or default
all optional surfaces are absent and all per-frame collections/models are empty.
Selection output
a caller wraps an existing SelectionBox
selection_box is Some while scroll info and post-flush collections remain empty.
Scroll metrics
a caller adds ScrollInfo
output carries exact usize scroll/total values and u16 viewport height.

requirement: SelectionBox SHALL capture inner-area geometry, border style, top/bottom clipping, and optional close state through chainable builders; close_button_rect SHALL return a one-row hit rectangle only when closable, top is visible, and the inner area has room.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: SelectionBox::new initializes unclipped, non-closable state with no custom label. with_top_clipped and with_bottom_clipped set continuation flags; with_closable records enabled/hover state; with_close_label stores a static label and implies closable when Some. close_button_rect returns None when not closable, top_clipped, or inner_area.y==0. Otherwise it positions a width=max(label.chars().count,1) rect on inner_area.y-1, ending at the inner-area rightmost column; None label uses width one for default ballot-x. Hit computation is pure and does not touch Buffer.
scenarios: Default box
SelectionBox::new receives a nonzero Rect/style
box stores inner area/style and starts unclipped/non-closable.
Clipped top
top_clipped is true
close_button_rect returns None because no top corner row is available.
Top edge
inner_area.y is zero
close_button_rect returns None to avoid underflow/out-of-area hit.
Closable default
closable is enabled with no custom label and top is visible
one-cell close hit rect is placed at the top-right corner row.
Custom label
close_label is Some(label)
box becomes closable and hit width equals label.chars().count().

requirement: SelectionBox::render SHALL draw side borders around every visible inner row, use dashed vertical glyphs on clipped edge rows, draw top/bottom corners only when the corresponding end is visible and in bounds, and safely no-op for zero-area boxes or cells outside the Buffer.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: For nonzero inner_area, left/right x are the inner edges and each y in the visible height receives │, except first row when top_clipped and last row when bottom_clipped receive ┆. Top corners ┌/┐ are drawn one row above only when !top_clipped and y_top>0; bottom corners └/┘ are drawn one row below only when !bottom_clipped. All writes use Buffer cell checks; close control replaces the top-right corner when available. A one-row box applies both clipping checks to the same row, so both flags produce dashed sides with no corners.
scenarios: Normal box
nonzero box has neither end clipped and has room above
solid side borders and both top/bottom corner pairs are rendered.
Top clipped
top_clipped is true
top corners are omitted, first visible row uses dashed sides, and bottom corners remain if visible.
Bottom clipped
bottom_clipped is true
bottom corners are omitted, last visible row uses dashed sides, and top corners remain.
Both clipped
both flags are true
both corner pairs are omitted; first and last visible rows use dashed sides.
Single-row both clipped
height is one and both flags are true
the only row is dashed on both sides and no corner is drawn.
Single-row top clipped
height is one and only top is clipped
the only row is dashed, while bottom corners are drawn.
Top edge
inner_area.y is zero while top is not clipped
side borders render from row zero, but top corners are skipped because there is no row above.

requirement: When a visible selection box is closable, render SHALL replace the top-right corner with the configured label or default ballot-x, use the border style normally and a bright primary foreground while hovered, and keep the close hit target aligned with the rendered label.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: render calls close_button_rect only for the visible top-corner path, so a clipped top never paints a close control. A custom close_label is written with SafeBuf at the computed rect; without one the ballot_x glyph replaces ┐. Hovered close uses Theme::current().text_primary, while unhovered close uses self.style. The implementation does not emit an action; the rect is for the caller’s mouse hit testing.
scenarios: Default close
closable box has no custom label and top is visible
ballot-x replaces the top-right corner and the computed hit rect covers one cell.
Custom close
closable box has a static multi-character label
label is painted in the hit rect, replacing the corner region.
Hover feedback
close_hovered is true
close label uses bright theme primary foreground.
Clipped close
top_clipped is true
close control is neither hit-testable nor rendered.

requirement: SelectionBox rendering SHALL operate as a post-render overlay over an already-painted buffer, preserve caller-provided inner content, and avoid mutating selection state; callers remain responsible for ordering it after component rendering and for interpreting close hits.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: SelectionBox owns only border/close geometry and Style. Its render method writes border cells and close label/glyph directly, never edits inner content cells except edge columns, never changes the SelectionBox, and returns no outcome. RenderOutput documents that selection boxes are emitted by components and rendered after the main pass so a box may span component boundaries; link/media/diagram artifacts are carried separately for later post-flush handling.
scenarios: Post-pass overlay
component first paints selected content then caller invokes SelectionBox::render
border appears over the content edge without requiring the component to own the full frame.
State purity
same SelectionBox is rendered more than once
geometry/configuration remains unchanged; only Buffer output changes.
Cross-component handoff
RenderOutput carries selection_box separately from selected_entry_area and other artifacts
caller can defer border drawing and process other overlays independently.

requirement: Context percentage and token compact formatting
contract: fmt_pct5 SHALL return a fixed five-character percentage representation: `X.XX%` below 10, `XX.X%` from 10 through 99.999…, and `MAX %` at or above 100. fmt_tokens SHALL compact counts below 1K as integers, 1K–9.999K as one-decimal K, 10K–999.999K as integer K, 1M–9.999M as one-decimal M, and 10M+ as integer M, keeping supported outputs at four characters or fewer.
scenarios: Percentage below ten
two decimal places are used and output length is five.
Percentage ten-plus
one decimal place with normal rounding is used and output length is five.
Maximum percentage
pct is 100 or greater
`MAX %` is returned.
Token boundaries
n lies below 1K, in K buckets, or in M buckets
the documented compact suffix/rounding is used and tested values remain <=4 chars.

requirement: Usage gradient breakpoints and terminal-compatible color interpolation
contract: default_breakpoints SHALL define the text-primary → accent-user → warning → accent-error gradient at 0, 50/65, 75/85, and 95 percent. blend_color SHALL return Reset for no breakpoints, clamp below/above the range to endpoint colors, linearly interpolate within the first matching interval, resolve named/Reset colors to RGB for interpolation, clamp t to [0,1], and quantize back to a nearest indexed color when either endpoint is indexed.
scenarios: Breakpoint endpoints
0% or 95% is requested with the default theme
the exact first/last theme colors are returned.
Intermediate gradient
pct lies between adjacent breakpoints
RGB channels are linearly interpolated and rounded.
Empty/outside input
breakpoints are empty or pct is outside their range
Reset or the nearest endpoint color is returned.
Indexed theme
either endpoint is Color::Indexed
the interpolated RGB is converted to nearest indexed color.

requirement: Context bar availability, gateway suppression, and usage prerequisites
contract: context_bar_line SHALL delegate to the session-aware builder with gateway_chat=false. context_bar_line_for_session SHALL return None for gateway/chat sessions before reading token inputs, and otherwise require Some used_tokens plus a strictly positive Some total_tokens before computing usage_percentage; missing or zero totals SHALL return None for both hover states.
scenarios: Gateway chat
gateway_chat is true even with token values
the context bar is suppressed.
Available data
gateway_chat is false and used/total are present with total > 0
a line is produced for hovered and non-hovered states.
Unavailable data
used or total is None, or total is zero
None is returned without a partial bar.

requirement: Default and hover context bar width invariant and progress rendering
contract: For available token data, the builder SHALL derive total display width from `fmt_tokens(used) / fmt_tokens(total)`, right-pad the default form to at least BAR_PCT_GAP + PCT_WIDTH (six columns), and color it with the usage gradient over the theme base background. Hover mode SHALL replace the token text with a progress_bar_spans bar of total_width minus six, append one background gap and a five-character secondary-colored percentage, and preserve the default line width across hover states.
scenarios: Default display
hovered is false
the line shows compact `used / total` text, padded only for sub-minimum widths, with urgency color and base background.
Hover display
hovered is true
the line contains a progress bar, one gap, and the fixed-width percentage suffix.
Width invariant
the same used/total pair is rendered in both modes
default and hover Line widths are identical, including `0 / 9` minimum-width input.
Bar scaling
compact token strings have different natural widths
hover bar width grows with default token string length.

requirement: Context bar exported separator and theme-aware line spans
contract: The context bar SHALL expose the status-bar separator as the stable `│` constant and return static Line spans whose background is theme.bg_base; default token text uses the quantized blended urgency color, while hover percentage uses theme.text_secondary and the progress fill uses theme.bg_highlight with the same quantized urgency color.
scenarios: Separator
a caller inserts the exported status-bar separator
the constant is exactly `│`.
Color roles
default or hover line is built
the usage signal color is shared with the progress fill/default text and the hover percentage remains secondary-colored on the base background.

requirement: Memory search output and soft failures
contract: parse_memory_results SHALL split tool output on the exact `### Result ` marker, ignore non-numeric sections and the preamble, parse score/source metadata from the result heading with numeric fallback 0.0, parse the optional `**File:**` path and inclusive line range, extract the first fenced code body, and retain a result when either path or snippet is nonempty. Missing or malformed fields are represented by empty strings or zero values rather than an error. shorten_path SHALL remove the configured memory-root prefix plus its first child component when possible, preserve the top-level memory filename, and otherwise fall back to the final slash-delimited path component.
scenarios: Single result
tool output contains one numeric Result heading, File line, score/source metadata, and a fenced snippet
one MemoryResult preserves score, source, path, start/end lines, and snippet text.
Multiple results
tool output contains several exact Result sections
results are returned in source order with each section's independent score/source/path metadata.
No result output
output contains only a nonnumeric preamble or no Result section
the parser returns an empty vector without raising an error.
Path shortening
a path is under the configured memory root, is the root-level memory file, or is outside the root
the display path becomes the path after the first memory child component, the root filename, or the final slash component respectively.

requirement: dispatch_show_plan SHALL target the active Agent and return no effects; when plan approval is already visible it SHALL reopen that approval, otherwise it SHALL request the AgentView plan preview.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The helper routes through with_active_agent, selecting reopen_plan_approval when plan_approval_view.is_some() and show_plan_preview otherwise. Missing/non-Agent views are a no-op because with_active_agent cannot invoke the closure. It does not itself read files, emit effects, or mutate unrelated agents.
scenarios: Existing approval
active Agent has plan_approval_view
the approval view is reopened with no effects.
No approval
active Agent has no plan approval view
show_plan_preview is invoked with no effects.
No active agent
active view is Welcome or cannot resolve an agent
nothing is changed and the effect list is empty.

requirement: dispatch_set_behavior_then_prompt SHALL only act on an active root Agent, reject child-owned behavior, enforce behavior availability and session presence, optionally enqueue a prompt with recognized skill-token ranges, stage one deferred behavior target, and enqueue behavior control only when the same target is not already pending and the session is not reconnecting.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Non-Agent or missing Agent returns empty effects. If parent.active_subagent is Some, the helper refuses to control the child and toasts the resolved child "Behavior is owned by the parent session" when present. behavior_unavailable_reason and missing session produce toasts and no control. With a prompt, the prompt is enqueued first using slash_controller.recognized_token_ranges, deferred_session_mode is set to mode, and an already matching behavior_control_target returns no effect while leaving staged state; otherwise enqueue_behavior_control receives !reconnect_pending. Without a prompt, a matching pending target only toasts "Behavior selection is pending"; other selections enqueue control. Permission policy is untouched by this route.
scenarios: Inactive root
active_view is not an Agent or its id is missing
no prompt/control effect is emitted.
Child ownership
active root has active_subagent and child view exists
child receives ownership toast and parent behavior is not changed.
Unavailable behavior
behavior_unavailable_reason returns a reason
reason is toasted and no session control is queued.
Sessionless behavior
root agent has no session_id
No active session is toasted and no behavior control is emitted.
Staged prompt
session exists and prompt is supplied
prompt is queued with recognized skill ranges, deferred mode is set, and behavior control is queued unless that exact mode is already pending.
Reconnect
reconnect_pending is true
control is enqueued with immediate admission disabled.
Pending no-prompt selection
same mode is already behavior_control_target and no prompt is supplied
selection is a pending toast with no duplicate control.

requirement: dispatch_set_behavior_mode SHALL select one root Agent behavior without changing permission policy, preserve parent ownership, gate unavailable/pending modes, maintain one deferred_session_mode for sessionless or failed admissions, clear an accepted Plan nudge, refresh open settings modals, and either enqueue session control or create a session for an unbound agent.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: Non-Agent and active-subagent views return empty effects, with a child toast when resolvable. If a deferred mode equals the current behavior mode, the helper marks canceling_deferred_admission and toasts that queued prompts wait for confirmation clearance. Unavailable behavior or duplicate behavior_control_target returns after any required admission toast. Selecting Plan clears PLAN_NUDGE_KEY and logs Accepted. A pre-existing deferred target is replaced by the new mode unless this is the canceling case. Without session_id, non-Normal modes store deferred_session_mode and all modes call skip_picker_and_create_session; with a session, enqueue_behavior_control receives !reconnect_pending. Settings modal snapshots refresh before the final effect/creation result.
scenarios: Parent-owned mode
active root displays an active child
parent mode change is rejected and child gets ownership feedback.
Cancel deferred admission
deferred_session_mode exists and requested mode equals current behavior_mode
deferred target is retained and a confirmation-clearance toast is shown.
Unavailable/pending
requested mode is unavailable or already a control target
no duplicate control is emitted and the reason/pending toast is shown.
Plan tip acceptance
requested mode is Plan while current tip is PLAN_NUDGE_KEY
tip is cleared and contextual acceptance is logged before admission.
Sessionless Plan
no session_id and mode is non-Normal
deferred target is stored and session creation/picker flow is invoked.
Sessionless Normal
no session_id and mode is Normal
no deferred behavior target is stored, but session creation/picker flow still runs.
Connected session
session_id exists
one behavior control is enqueued and settings modal snapshots refresh.

requirement: When auto_mode_gate is disabled, downgrade_displayed_auto_if_gated SHALL convert every active Auto session and the global current UI mirror to Ask, and inherit_permission_mode SHALL convert an Auto future default to Ask; enabled gates SHALL preserve the configured mode.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: downgrade_displayed_auto_if_gated returns immediately when the gate is on. When off it iterates all agents, changes session.permission_mode Auto to Ask, and changes current_ui.permission_mode only when it is exactly "auto". inherit_permission_mode returns Ask for default Auto with gate off and otherwise returns app.default_permission_mode unchanged. The helpers do not persist settings or emit effects.
scenarios: Kill switch
auto_mode_gate is false and one or more sessions/global UI display Auto
all per-session Auto values and the global auto mirror become Ask.
Already clamped
gate is false but no session/UI value is Auto
helper makes no additional changes.
Gate enabled
auto_mode_gate is true
displayed sessions and inherited default are preserved.
New session inheritance
default permission is Auto while gate is false
new-session resolver receives Ask.

requirement: set_permission_mode SHALL clamp Auto to Ask when gated off, require an active bound Agent session, mutate only that session through the scoped setter, auto-approve root-owned queued requests with AllowOnce when AlwaysApprove is enabled, preserve child requests, and emit one canonical NotifySessionPermissionMode effect with plan-aware feedback.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: A non-Agent/missing session returns empty effects; a missing session additionally shows "Permission can be changed after the session connects." Auto is rewritten to Ask if auto_mode_gate is false. set_permission_mode_inner_scoped flips the session mode before draining, iterates the permission queue, responds Selected(AllowOnce) for root-session requests when available or Cancelled otherwise, retains child requests, resolves queue transition if the original front was removed, and logs diagnostics only on a real mode change. The public setter always emits NotifySessionPermissionMode for a bound session, toasts permission_mode_toast, or uses ALWAYS_APPROVE_ON_UNDER_PLAN_TOAST when AlwaysApprove enters effective plan mode. It never changes default_permission_mode.
scenarios: No session
active Agent has no session_id
setter toasts connection requirement and emits no notification.
Auto gate off
Auto is requested while auto_mode_gate is false
runtime mode is Ask and notification canonical is ask.
AlwaysApprove root drain
bound root session has queued root and child permission requests
root requests are answered using AllowOnce where present, child requests remain queued, and notification targets root session.
No AllowOnce
root request lacks an AllowOnce option
that root response is Cancelled rather than selecting another option.
Plan-aware approval
AlwaysApprove is selected while effective plan is active
warning toast preserves Plan approval/contract enforcement.
Ordinary commit
Ask or Auto transition succeeds
canonical session notification is emitted and current session state changes without changing future default.

requirement: set_default_permission_mode SHALL change only the future-session default, reject gated Auto, no-op idempotent selections, update the current UI canonical mirror and open settings snapshots, show a branded default toast, and emit PersistPermissionMode with session_id=None and the previous canonical value for rollback.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: When Auto is requested with auto_mode_gate false, the helper toasts "Auto permission mode is unavailable" and returns no effect. If the requested canonical equals the current default it returns empty without mutation. Otherwise it records the prior canonical, updates default_permission_mode and current_ui.permission_mode, refreshes open settings modals, emits "✓ Default permission mode: <display>" and returns PersistPermissionMode{canonical, session_id:None, persist:WithRollback(previous)}. It never drains active permission queues or changes active session mode.
scenarios: Gated Auto default
Auto is requested while auto_mode_gate is false
future default remains unchanged and no persistence effect is emitted.
Idempotent default
requested canonical equals current default
no state, toast, refresh or persistence mutation occurs.
Changed default
requested default differs
default and UI mirror update, modal snapshots refresh, and rollback-bearing persistence effect is returned.
Session isolation
active session has a different permission mode
default commit leaves active session untouched.

requirement: permission_mode_toast SHALL return stable, mode-specific feedback: warning AlwaysApprove-on, safe AlwaysApprove-off, classifier Auto, and branded Ask; ALWAYS_APPROVE_ON_UNDER_PLAN_TOAST SHALL explicitly preserve Plan approval and contract enforcement.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: permission_mode_toast maps AlwaysApprove to always_approve_toast(true), Auto to "✓ Permission mode: Auto (classifier)", and Ask to "✓ Permission mode: Ask". always_approve_toast(true) returns "⚠ Always-approve ON: all tool actions auto-run"; false delegates save_success_toast("Always-approve", false). The Plan constant is "⚠ Always-approve ON: Plan approval phases and contract remain enforced" and is selected only by the public setter when effective plan is active.
scenarios: Ask label
permission_mode_toast(Ask) is requested
result uses the Permission mode brand and Ask label.
Auto label
permission_mode_toast(Auto) is requested
result identifies classifier-backed Auto mode.
Always on
always_approve_toast(true) is requested
result is warning-branded and explains all tool actions auto-run.
Always under Plan
AlwaysApprove is committed while effective_plan is true
Plan-specific warning preserves approval/contract semantics.
Always off
always_approve_toast(false) is requested
result delegates to the standard successful Always-approve off toast.

requirement: Remember mode entry, rewrite review, and memory note save
contract: dispatch_enter_remember_mode SHALL set the active agent to Remember input mode, clear the prompt, and emit no effect. dispatch_send_remember_note SHALL require an active Agent view/agent, restore Normal mode, clear the prompt and ephemeral submit tip, trim input, reject empty notes with a notice, open a raw-only review modal without a session, or otherwise open a nonce-correlated raw/rewrite review modal and emit RewriteMemoryNote with session id, raw text, extracted context, and nonce. dispatch_save_remember_note SHALL save the displayed enhanced text when selected (falling back to raw), trim it, close the modal, set replaceable progress feedback, and emit SaveMemoryNote with agent id/text/cwd. Completion SHALL clear feedback and append success/error notices.
scenarios: Enter remember
an active agent enters remember mode
prompt mode is Remember, prompt text is empty, and no effect is emitted.
Empty note
trimmed text is empty
mode/prompt are reset, a Please provide notice is appended, and no rewrite/save effect is emitted.
No session
a non-empty note has no session id
raw-only RememberNoteReview opens with enhanced None, tab unavailable semantics, and nonce 0.
Rewrite path
a non-empty note has a session id
review modal opens with a fresh nonce and RewriteMemoryNote carries raw text/session/context.
Save review
a review modal is active
the chosen enhanced/raw text is trimmed, modal closes, progress feedback is set, and SaveMemoryNote carries cwd.
Save completion
memory save succeeds or fails
feedback clears and a success path or error notice is appended.

requirement: Session context extraction for memory rewrites
contract: extract_session_context SHALL walk scrollback newest-first, collect up to five recent user prompts and up to twenty recent Read/Edit/ListDir file paths, truncate long prompt text at the configured character boundary, stop once both budgets are filled, then emit CWD, optional git branch, prompts in chronological order, and deduplicated file paths preserving first-seen reverse-walk order under Recent prompts/Recent files headings.
scenarios: Prompt context
scrollback contains user prompts
at most five are collected newest-first then reversed for chronological output; long prompt text is abbreviated with an ellipsis.
File context
Read/Edit/ListDir tool calls occur
at most twenty paths are collected, unrelated tools are ignored, duplicates are removed while retaining first-seen order.
Session metadata
cwd and optional current_branch are present
CWD is always emitted and Branch is emitted only when available.
Budget stop
both collection caps are reached
reverse scan stops early.

requirement: Btw side-question dispatch, minimal correlation, and response focus
contract: dispatch_send_btw SHALL require an active Agent view/agent and session id, clear the prompt, and in minimal mode start a correlated minimal request while in fullscreen mode set a Loading overlay and leave prompt focus. It SHALL emit SendBtw with agent/session/question and optional minimal request id. handle_btw_response SHALL route correlated minimal responses to finish_minimal_btw, ignore stale/dismissed requests through that lifecycle, and for fullscreen responses show Done/focus on success or Error/retain prompt focus on failure without emitting effects.
scenarios: Minimal request
minimal screen has an active session
a correlated minimal request starts and SendBtw carries its UUID.
Fullscreen request
fullscreen screen has an active session
BtwOverlayState::Loading is stored, prompt is cleared, btw_focused is false, and SendBtw has no minimal id.
No session
SendBtw is requested without a session
minimal app gets a system notice, fullscreen app gets a toast, and no effect is emitted.
Minimal response
a correlated response arrives after dismissal or while another request is active
finish_minimal_btw scopes the response by request id; stale/dismissed responses do not re-open state.
Fullscreen response
a normal response succeeds or fails
Done stores the question/answer and focuses the panel; Error stores question/error and leaves prompt focus.

requirement: Session recap availability, history detection, and manual/automatic dispatch
contract: recap_unavailable_toast SHALL distinguish empty history (`No messages yet`) from generation failure (`Couldn't generate recap`). scrollback_has_user_messages SHALL scan actual scrollback entries for user prompts rather than turn_count. dispatch_send_recap SHALL honor the shell-authoritative session_recap_available gate, require a session id, clear the manual prompt, short-circuit manual empty non-replay sessions with the empty toast, keep requesting during replay/batch history loading, set replaceable manual progress feedback, and emit SendRecap with auto flag. Automatic calls SHALL note the retry attempt and silently no-op when unavailable/no session.
scenarios: Availability
session recap is disabled
manual dispatch shows a disabled toast while automatic dispatch emits nothing.
No session
recap is enabled but no session id exists
manual dispatch shows No active session; automatic dispatch silently no-ops.
Empty manual session
manual recap has no user prompt and replay is not loading
prompt is cleared, no effect/live status is left, and No messages yet is shown.
History present
scrollback contains a user prompt
SendRecap auto=false is emitted and Generating session recap feedback is set.
Batch/replay loading
turn_count is stale during batch or replay is still loading
entry scan/loading flag prevents the empty short-circuit and SendRecap is still emitted.
Automatic retry
auto=true with a session
focus tracker records an auto recap attempt and SendRecap auto=true is emitted.

requirement: Recap task-result failure distinction and note feedback contract
contract: When the recap request completes with a transport error, the task-result path SHALL clear the replaceable recap live status and distinguish no-user-history from sessions with turns using recap_unavailable_toast; this dispatcher contract keeps the empty-session message separate from generic generation failure.
scenarios: Failure without history
a recap request fails and no user prompt exists
live status clears and the toast says No messages yet.
Failure with history
a recap request fails after a user prompt exists
live status clears and the generic Couldn't generate recap toast is shown.

requirement: AgentView SHALL route input through subagent, confirmation, image/gboom/workflow/goal/btw/viewer/modal/permission/plan/rewind/edit/jump/question layers before pane handlers and global registry actions; consumed events return Changed/Action and unconsumed events bubble Unchanged.
contract: The input and takeover tests SHALL give an input-owning overlay precedence over an open jump picker. If an overlay appears after the picker opened, wheel and key handling SHALL drop the hidden jump state before it can move the invisible cursor. Ctrl-C SHALL still dismiss the picker and return CancelTurn for a running turn. Rewind and inline-edit entry SHALL also clear the jump picker rather than allowing it to reappear after the owning surface closes.
scenarios: Hidden picker scroll
cancel-turn input ownership appears after JumpShowPicker and a wheel event arrives
jump_state is cleared, the cancel-turn view remains present, and the hidden picker does not shift scrollback.
Hidden picker key
cancel-turn input ownership appears after JumpShowPicker and a Down key arrives
the key path clears jump_state before picker navigation handles the key.
Running cancellation
a running turn has an open jump picker and Ctrl-C is pressed
the picker closes and the returned InputOutcome is Action(CancelTurn).
Rewind takeover
rewind starts with a jump preview moved away from its captured viewport
jump closes, rewind opens, and the pre-jump scroll offset is restored.
Inline edit takeover
inline edit starts with a jump picker open
jump closes and inline_edit becomes active.

requirement: HintItem SHALL preserve semantic keys, a short label, optional custom key display, optional cheatsheet description, and a pinned compact-visibility flag; constructors SHALL create single or paired key hints and pinned SHALL be chainable.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: HintItem::new creates one-key, unpinned data with no custom display/description. paired creates two keys displayed with "/" between their normal KeyShortcut displays. pinned sets pinned=true and returns the item. key_display prefers custom_display verbatim, otherwise joins every key.display() with "/"; labels/descriptions remain Cow values for static or owned text.
scenarios: Single key
a view creates HintItem::new(key,label)
one semantic key and label are stored, with default unpinned state.
Paired navigation
a view creates HintItem::paired(j,k,"nav")
both keys are retained and rendered as j/k.
Custom display
custom_display is Some("Shift+Enter")
key_display uses that string instead of recomputing keys.
Pinned hint
pinned() is chained on a hint
compact filtering treats the hint as always visible.

requirement: ShortcutsBar::new SHALL borrow the supplied hint slice and initialize ordinary rendering; compact SHALL configure a max-visible budget and optional trailing help hint, with_pending SHALL replace normal hints with a confirmation message, and with_right_text SHALL attach right-aligned auxiliary text.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: new stores hints and clears pending_confirmation/right_text/compact. compact stores CompactConfig without copying the hints. with_pending stores or clears PendingHint; with_right_text stores the optional borrowed string. PendingHint carries a KeyShortcut and static label. The widget consumes this immutable builder state at render time; it does not mutate the source hint list.
scenarios: Full mode
ShortcutsBar::new receives hints and no compact config
all hints are eligible for rendering.
Compact mode
compact(max_visible, help_hint) is set
effective hints are computed with the configured budget and optional help row.
Pending confirmation
with_pending(Some(PendingHint)) is set
normal hints are replaced by press-again text.
Right text
with_right_text(Some(team)) is set
auxiliary text is placed at the right when it fits without overlapping hints.

requirement: ShortcutsBar SHALL clear and style its one-row area, render either the pending confirmation or effective hints with Unicode display widths and separators, stop before content exceeds the right edge, and optionally place right_text at the right without overwriting hint content.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: A zero-height area returns without writes. Otherwise the bar fills each cell in the row with spaces and bg_base/gray style, removing stale text/modifiers. Normal keys use secondary bold on bg_base, labels and separators use gray without bold, and each hint is key:label separated by dim "  │  ". key/label/separator widths use UnicodeWidthStr and each segment is omitted/breaks when it would pass area.x+area.width. Pending mode renders only <shortcut.display()>:<"press again to label"> with key style and action style, without normal separators/right text. right_text appends a trailing space, computes display width, and is written only when it is narrower than area and starts after x+1.
scenarios: Pending replacement
pending_confirmation is Some
only the press-again message is rendered; normal hints are suppressed.
Normal hints
pending is None and effective hints are nonempty
keys, colon, labels and separators are rendered in themed styles.
Long content
a hint or separator would exceed the row width
rendering stops before writing past the supplied area.
Right auxiliary text
right_text fits and has room after the left hints
text is right-aligned with a trailing space.
Zero height
area.height is zero
widget returns without clearing or painting.
Unicode labels
key or label includes wide Unicode
width budgeting uses display columns rather than byte count.

requirement: compute_effective_hints SHALL return every hint in full mode; in compact mode it SHALL include all pinned hints, fill remaining max_visible slots with unpinned hints in original order, and append help_hint unconditionally when configured, even for an empty input or when pinned items exceed the budget.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: With no CompactConfig, the result is a borrowed vector in input order. With compact config, pinned_count counts all pinned entries, unpinned_budget uses saturating_sub(max_visible,pinned_count), and a single pass keeps every pinned item while consuming that many unpinned slots in original order. Help is pushed after all selected source hints regardless of remaining budget. Therefore total output can exceed max_visible when pinned_count or help_hint requires it.
scenarios: Full list
compact is None and three hints are supplied
all three hints are returned.
Simple truncation
max_visible=2 and no pinned/help hints among three inputs
first two unpinned hints are returned.
Help on empty
input list is empty but help_hint exists
help hint is returned as the only item.
Large budget
max_visible exceeds input length and no help
all input hints are returned safely.
Pinned reservation
three unpinned plus two pinned, max_visible=3
one unpinned plus both pinned are returned.
Pinned order
a pinned hint is between unpinned source entries
selected entries preserve original source order.
Pinned over budget
three pinned and one unpinned, max_visible=2
all pinned hints are returned and no unpinned slot remains.
Help after pinned
pinned items already exceed budget and help exists
all pinned entries remain and help is appended.

requirement: The shortcuts bar SHALL only project already-built HintItems and PendingHint data; compact filtering, confirmation replacement, and right-text fitting SHALL not dispatch actions, mutate application state, or infer whether an advertised key is actually enabled.
contract: The implementation SHALL satisfy the following tested behavior: The module exposes pure compute_effective_hints and a Widget renderer. It does not resolve ActionRegistry entries, handle key events, open the shortcuts modal, or invoke pending actions. Rendering truncation is geometric: hints omitted after the first overflow are not transformed into an ellipsis or help row unless the caller configured help_hint. Pinned semantics are visibility policy only and do not affect input routing.
scenarios: Registry supplied hints
caller passes context-filtered hints
bar renders those items without rechecking action availability.
Pending action
caller passes PendingHint
bar displays confirmation copy but does not consume or execute the second keypress.
Compact omission
hint list exceeds visible budget
omitted hints are absent from this frame; no action state is changed.
No help configured
compact mode has help_hint=None
bar only renders selected hints and provides no discoverability fallback.

requirement: Recap unavailable toast distinguishes empty history from generation failure
contract: recap_unavailable_toast SHALL return `No messages yet` when the session has no user messages, and SHALL return `Couldn't generate recap` when user messages exist.
scenarios: Empty history
recap_unavailable_toast is called with false
the exact text is `No messages yet`.
History present
recap_unavailable_toast is called with true
the exact text is `Couldn't generate recap`.

requirement: Manual recap dispatch gates empty history while preserving loading history
contract: A manual SendRecap request SHALL clear the slash-command prompt. With recap enabled and an idle session containing no user prompt, it SHALL emit no effect, leave no live loading status, and show `No messages yet`.
